components.description: Builds a directed acyclic graph from subtasks with identifiers, descriptions, and optional dependencies, then returns the subtasks grouped into topologically sorted batches that can run in parallel.

components.name: Health
components.description: Return a structured health snapshot including version information, registered tool status, channel counts, secrets-file metadata, and runtime channel-health details. Values are redacted before return.

components.name: List channels
components.description: Lists configured channels with their live runtime availability status, including status, tier, messages, fix hints, and unmet requirements. An optional filter limits results to channels marked ok, warn, or off.

components.name: List modes
components.description: Lists built-in and user-defined search modes with their identifiers, labels, trigger keywords, channel priorities, and channels to skip.

components.name: List Skills
components.description: Lists autosearch skills with their frontmatter metadata, optionally filtered by group or domain and optionally including deprecated skills. Returns static skill catalog data without running a skill.

components.name: Loop add gap
components.description: Marks a topic as a coverage gap in a reflective search loop using a loop state identifier and gap description. Returns the state identifier and current gaps, or an invalid-state response.

components.name: Loop Get Gaps
components.description: Retrieves coverage gaps for a reflective search loop using its state identifier. Returns the loop state identifier and identified gaps, or an invalid-state response for an unknown identifier.

components.name: Loop init
components.description: Initialize a reflective search loop and return a state identifier for subsequent loop operations.

components.name: Loop update
components.description: Updates a reflective search loop state using a state identifier, evidence records, and a research query, returning a state summary.

components.name: Perspective questioning
components.description: Generate sub-questions about a topic from user, expert, critic, and competitor viewpoints. The tool accepts a topic and returns viewpoint-question pairs.

components.name: Recent signal fusion
components.description: Filters an evidence list to items published within a specified number of recent days, using supported date fields and returning parseable items in newest-first order.

components.name: Run channel
components.description: Run a selected autosearch channel with a query and return raw evidence items, including source-page-slimmed records and result counts. The tool supports channels such as arXiv, GitHub, Bilibili, and Xiaohongshu.

components.name: Run Clarify
components.description: Clarifies a user's research query and returns structured guidance indicating whether clarification is needed, along with a question or verification text and suggested search mode, query type, rubrics, and channel priorities. An optional mode hint can select fast, deep, or comprehensive processing.

components.name: Submit Real-World Action for Confirmation
components.description: Submit a previously proposed real-world action for a patient's own out-of-band confirmation after they have reviewed and agreed to the draft. Requires step-up authorization via an X-Step-Up-Token header and returns an 'awaiting_confirmation' status; the call never executes anything or accepts a human-confirmed flag.

components.name: Propose Real-World Action
components.description: Propose a real-world action (phone call or SMS) on the patient's behalf and return a draft with an id and script for patient review before submission via action_commit. Does not execute anything.

components.name: Action Status
components.description: Check the status and outcome of an action by action_id, returning lifecycle states such as proposed, awaiting confirmation, executing, completed, failed, needs_review, unknown, or expired, for reporting final results to the patient.

components.name: Preventive Care Gaps
components.description: Check which preventive-care screenings and immunizations a patient may be due for, such as blood pressure, cholesterol, cancer screenings, flu, and diabetes A1c, from their connected records. Decision support based on USPSTF/ACIP/ADA guidelines; response includes an embeddable review UI reference.

components.name: Get Health Context
components.description: Retrieves a pre-built patient-centric FHIR context envelope by context ID, returning bounded, policy-stamped, time-limited health context.

components.name: Apply Data Quality Fix
components.description: Applies patient-approved data quality fixes to a specified FHIR resource and creates a linked Provenance record with full attribution. Requires step-up authorization token; approval is proved by the token.

components.name: Evaluate Data Quality
components.description: Evaluates a FHIR resource for data quality issues by checking coding elements against public terminology services and structural rules. Returns plain-language issues with patient-facing impact descriptions and resolution suggestions.

components.name: Fetch Health Record
components.description: Fetches a single FHIR health record resource by its reference (ResourceType/id) as returned by search, and returns the full document with metadata after server-side PHI redaction.

components.name: Commit FHIR Write
components.description: Commit a previously proposed write operation for a FHIR resource, supporting create and update actions. Requires step-up authorization token; destructive operation.

components.name: Compiled Truth Timeline
components.description: Returns the current compiled state of a FHIR resource together with its append-only Provenance evidence trail, curation state, and quality score, and provides a link to an embeddable review UI.

components.name: Mint Step-Up Token
components.description: Retrieves a fresh step-up authorization token for FHIR write operations from the internal service; the token expires after 5 minutes and is returned for the caller to set as the X-Step-Up-Token header. Optionally scoped by a tenant identifier provided in the request or context.

components.name: Interpret Lab Results
components.description: Interpret FHIR lab Observations against reference ranges, flagging each value as low, normal, high, or critical using HL7 v3 ObservationInterpretation, and return clinician and consumer summaries. Read-only decision support that may include an embeddable trend timeline resource URI.

components.name: Latest Observations
components.description: Retrieves the most recent N observations per code using the standard FHIR $lastn operation, optionally filtered by code and patient.

components.name: Evaluate Access Permission
components.description: Evaluates FHIR R6 Permission resources to make access control decisions, returning a permit or deny result based on stored Permission rules. Accepts subject, action, and resource inputs and separates access control from consent records.

components.name: Propose FHIR Write
components.description: Validates a FHIR resource and operation for a proposed write and returns a preview without committing; write operations require step-up authorization supplied by the deployment as an X-Step-Up-Token header.

components.name: Read FHIR Resource
components.description: Reads a specific FHIR resource by type and ID using FHIR R4 US Core v9 stable or FHIR R6 ballot3 experimental resources, returning a redacted resource with PHI protection.

components.name: Search FHIR Resources
components.description: Search for FHIR resources across FHIR R4 US Core v9 stable and FHIR R6 ballot3 experimental resources using patient, code, status, _lastUpdated, _count, and _sort parameters, returning a paginated and redacted FHIR Bundle.

components.name: Seed Demo Data
components.description: Seeds a tenant with a realistic FHIR Patient + Observations + Condition bundle for live testing using a tenant ID. Returns created resource IDs and a ready-to-use step_up_token.

components.name: Observation Statistics
components.description: Compute descriptive statistics such as count, minimum, maximum, and mean over numeric FHIR Observation values that use valueQuantity, with optional filtering by patient and/or code.

components.name: List Subscription Topics
components.description: List available FHIR SubscriptionTopics for event-driven subscriptions, enabling agents to discover what events they can subscribe to.

components.name: Validate FHIR Resource
components.description: Validate a proposed FHIR R6 resource against structural rules and return a FHIR OperationOutcome. Accepts a FHIR resource object as input.

components.name: Guardrail Conformance Scorecard
components.description: Runs the guardrail conformance self-test on a HealthClaw deployment and returns a graded scorecard across seven guardrail properties: PHI redaction, immutable audit, step-up auth, human-in-the-loop, tenant isolation, medical disclaimers, and error fidelity. Uses synthetic data only and accepts an optional fresh flag t…

components.name: Extract Form Data to FHIR
components.description: Extracts FHIR resources from a completed FHIR QuestionnaireResponse into a transaction Bundle using SDC $extract. Accepts a QuestionnaireResponse, optional Questionnaire or stored questionnaire ID, and a subject reference; write tier requiring step-up authorization.

components.name: Questionnaire populate
components.description: Pre-fills a FHIR Questionnaire for a subject using the SDC $populate operation and returns a QuestionnaireResponse.

components.name: Request Prescription Transfer
components.description: Drafts a prescription-transfer request by assembling the patient's active medications and staging a phone call to the receiving pharmacy; refuses Schedule II medications and returns a draft for the patient to review and confirm out-of-band.

components.name: Search Health Records
components.description: Search a tenant's FHIR records using a FHIR search string, returning compact results with id, title, and URL. Reads are PHI-redacted and audit-logged server-side.

components.name: Generate SMART Health Link
components.description: Generate a SMART Health Link (shlink:/ QR payload) sharing a patient's record with a clinic. Accepts an action ID from a proposed action, fetches the guardrailed share-bundle from HealthClaw using step-up authorization, encrypts client-side, uploads ciphertext, and returns the shlink URI, viewer link, and patient mana…

components.name: Check Data Sources
components.description: Survey all connected health data sources (Fasten, HealthEx, Health Bank One, MEDENT, Flexpa, Epic/Health Skillz, wearables) at once and return each source's connection status and patient record counts by type.

components.name: Wearables Sync Status
components.description: Lists wearable connections (Garmin, Oura, Polar, Suunto, Whoop, Fitbit, Strava, Ultrahuman) for a tenant, including last sync time, observation count, and status, and provides a resource URI for connection-management UI. Data flows into HealthClaw as FHIR Observations with LOINC codes.

components.name: Daily Activity
components.description: Get daily aggregated activity data including steps, distance, elevation, heart rate, calories, and activity durations (soft/moderate/intense). Returns summary data aggregated per day. Accepts date range or lastupdate timestamp for synchronization.

components.name: ECG Signal
components.description: Retrieves detailed ECG (electrocardiogram) signal data in micro-volts (μV) for a specific recording, returning high-frequency waveform data with sampling information. Requires a signal ID obtained from list_heart_records.

components.name: Heart Rate Variability During Sleep
components.description: Get heart rate variability (HRV) captured during sleep at minute-level resolution. Returns timestamp-keyed maps of RMSSD, SDNN, and HRV quality scores. Accepts a sleep period start and end date, with a maximum 24-hour range.

components.name: Intraday Activity
components.description: Retrieves high-frequency intraday activity data from Withings devices, returning time-series data with timestamps. Accepts optional start and end dates (with a 24-hour maximum range) and a comma-separated list of data fields including steps, elevation, calories, distance, heart rate, SpO2, and HRV metrics. If no dates…

components.name: Health Measures
components.description: Get health measures including weight, height, body composition, blood pressure, heart rate, temperature, and more. Accepts an optional numeric measure type ID and returns matching health measurement records.

components.name: Sleep Data
components.description: Get high-frequency sleep data captured during sleep, including sleep stages and health metrics at minute-level resolution. Accepts start and end dates and optional data fields, returning detailed sleep records with timestamps.

components.name: Sleep Summary
components.description: Get aggregated sleep activity summaries for a specified date range from Withings. Returns comprehensive sleep metrics including duration, stages, quality scores, heart rate, breathing analysis, and sleep apnea indicators. Accepts start/end dates or a lastupdate timestamp for synchronization, and optional data_fields t…

components.name: Stethoscope Signal
components.description: Retrieves detailed stethoscope audio signal data for a specific recording, including raw audio signal array and technical metadata such as frequency, duration, format, size, resolution, channel information, device model, stethoscope position, and valve heart disease (VHD) indicators.

components.name: User Goals
components.description: Get the user's health and fitness goals, including daily step count target, daily sleep duration target in seconds, and target weight with value and unit.

components.name: Workouts
components.description: Get workout summaries including calories burned, heart rate data, distance, steps, elevation, and swimming metrics. Returns aggregated data for each workout session. Accepts date range or lastupdate timestamp parameters.

components.name: Heart Records
components.description: Get a list of ECG (electrocardiogram) records with Afib (atrial fibrillation) classification for a given time period. Returns ECG metadata including signal IDs, timestamps, heart rate, Afib detection results, and blood pressure measurements (if taken with BPM Core).

components.name: Stethoscope Records
components.description: List stethoscope recordings from Withings devices for a given time period, returning metadata including signal IDs, timestamps, device IDs, valve heart disease (VHD) indicators, and timezone information.

components.name: Binding affinity lookup
components.description: Retrieves measured protein-ligand binding affinities (Ki/Kd/IC50) for a target protein from BindingDB using a UniProt accession and an affinity cutoff in nM.

components.name: Compound by name
components.description: Resolve a chemical compound name or synonym to its PubChem identity and key properties, including CID, molecular formula, molecular weight, canonical SMILES, InChIKey, and IUPAC name, using the PubChem REST API.

components.name: Similarity search
components.description: Performs a 2D Tanimoto similarity search in PubChem for compounds similar to a query SMILES. Returns PubChem JSON containing matching compound IDs (CIDs).

components.name: Gene info lookup
components.description: Look up gene annotation records from MyGene.info by gene symbol, name, or identifier, optionally filtered by species, and return matching gene summaries including symbols, names, Entrez, Ensembl, and UniProt identifiers.

components.name: GO annotations
components.description: Fetch Gene Ontology annotations for a gene product from EBI QuickGO using a UniProt accession. Returns QuickGO annotation-search JSON including GO id, aspect, and evidence.

components.name: Reactome pathway lookup
components.description: Retrieves Reactome pathways in which a specified protein participates, using a UniProt accession and optional species filter via the Reactome ContentService.

components.name: UniProt entry
components.description: Fetch a UniProtKB protein entry by accession, returning function annotations, sequence features, and cross-references.

components.name: Get AlphaFold prediction
components.description: Fetch AlphaFold DB predicted-structure metadata for a UniProt accession, returning prediction records that include model URLs and mean pLDDT.

components.name: Get structure
components.description: Fetch experimental structure metadata for a PDB entry from the RCSB Protein Data Bank using a 4-character PDB identifier and return the core-entry JSON, including title, method, resolution, and deposition.

components.name: Search Complexes
components.description: Search the EBI Complex Portal for curated macromolecular complexes using a free-text query that matches protein names, complex names, or accession numbers, and return matching complex records.

components.name: ClinVar record lookup
components.description: Look up ClinVar records and clinical significance summaries for a gene, rsID, HGVS, or condition query using NCBI E-utilities. Returns matching ClinVar IDs and summary data.

components.name: Gene variants
components.description: Retrieves variant records for a gene from gnomAD via its GraphQL API, given an HGNC gene symbol and optional dataset ID. Returns variant IDs, consequences, and allele frequencies for the requested gene.

components.name: Variant frequency
components.description: Retrieves population allele frequency for a single genomic variant from gnomAD using a gnomAD variant ID and optional dataset selector, returning genome and exome allele frequencies and counts.

components.name: Batch Search and Download
components.description: Search ENCODE for genomic data files using filters such as file format, assay, organism, organ, biosample type, and target, then batch download matching files to a local directory with optional organization and MD5 verification.

components.name: Compare Experiments
components.description: Compare two ENCODE experiments by accession to identify compatibility issues for combined analysis, comparing organism, genome assembly, assay type, biosample, organ, target, replication strategy, and lab. Both experiments must be tracked first.

components.name: Download ENCODE Files
components.description: Downloads specific ENCODE files by accession to a local directory, with optional organization by experiment, file format, or experiment-format, and supports MD5 verification and skip-if-already-downloaded.

components.name: Export Tracked Data
components.description: Export tracked experiments as a shareable table (CSV, TSV, or JSON) with metadata, publication counts, PMIDs, and derived file counts. Accepts optional filters by assay title, organism, and organ.

components.name: Get Citations
components.description: Get publications and citations for tracked experiments, returning publication metadata such as authors, journal, DOI, and PMID, with optional export as BibTeX or RIS.

components.name: Get Experiment Details
components.description: Retrieve full details for a specific ENCODE experiment by accession ID, including associated files, quality metrics, controls, replicate information, and audit status.

components.name: Explore Available Data
components.description: Queries the ENCODE portal for live faceted counts of experiments or files, optionally filtered by assay title, organism, organ, and biosample type, to help discover available genomic data before performing detailed searches.

components.name: Get File Details
components.description: Retrieve detailed metadata for a specific ENCODE file using its accession ID, returning JSON with file format, size, download URL, MD5, assembly and biological replicate information.

components.name: Get Filter Values
components.description: Get available filter values for ENCODE searches for a specified metadata type, returning JSON with valid values to use in search parameters.

components.name: Get File Provenance
components.description: Get provenance information for derived files, tracing the chain back to original ENCODE data including tools and parameters used; accepts a derived file path or ENCODE accession and returns a JSON provenance chain or list of derived files.

components.name: ENCODE Get Linked References
components.description: Retrieves external references (PMIDs, DOIs, NCT IDs, GEO accessions, preprints) linked to tracked experiments, optionally filtered by reference type. Accepts an experiment accession and returns a JSON string of identifiers for downstream use with PubMed, bioRxiv, ClinicalTrials.gov, or other tools.

components.name: Link External Reference
components.description: Links an external reference (e.g., PubMed ID, DOI, NCT ID, GEO accession) to a tracked ENCODE experiment. Accepts an experiment accession, reference type and identifier, and returns a JSON summary of the link operation.

components.name: List Experiment Files
components.description: Lists all files associated with a specified ENCODE experiment accession, with optional filters for file format, type, output category, assembly, and status. Returns a JSON list of matching file records from ENCODE.

components.name: List Tracked Experiments
components.description: List all experiments tracked locally, with optional filters by assay title, organism, or organ, and show their metadata, publication counts, and derived file counts.

components.name: Log Derived File
components.description: Log a file derived from ENCODE data to create a provenance record linking the derived file back to source ENCODE accessions. Accepts a file path, source accessions and optional metadata such as description, file type, tool used and parameters.

components.name: Manage API Credentials
components.description: Manage ENCODE API credentials for accessing restricted or unreleased data by storing, checking, or clearing credentials in the operating system keyring. Accepts credential actions and optional API keys as inputs and returns a JSON status result.

components.name: Search ENCODE Experiments
components.description: Search ENCODE experiments by assay, organism, biosample, target, status, and other filters, returning matching experiment records.

components.name: Search Files Across Experiments
components.description: Search ENCODE files across experiments using combined file and experiment filters such as file format, assay title, organism, organ, biosample type, target, assembly, and search term, returning matching file records from the ENCODE database.

components.name: Summarize Collection
components.description: Summarizes a tracked experiment collection with grouped statistics by assay type, target, organism, organ, biosample type, and lab, and reports total counts for publications, derived files, and external references. Accepts optional filters for assay title, organism, and organ.

components.name: Track Experiment Locally
components.description: Track an ENCODE experiment locally by fetching its metadata, associated publications, and pipeline information from ENCODE and storing them in a local SQLite database.

components.name: Get Paper Fulltext
components.description: Retrieves the full text of a PubMed article by its PMID when available through PubMed Central; otherwise returns a message explaining why and where the text might be available (e.g., DOI).

components.name: Search PubMed
components.description: Searches PubMed for medical and life sciences research articles using a query string. Supports field-specific search, date ranges, and Boolean operators, and returns matching article records.

components.name: Verifying a quote
components.description: Mint standalone citations by verifying quotes against document identifiers, accepting single doc_id/quote pairs or batch rows and returning minted citation records or rejected rows with error hints.

components.name: Capability
components.description: Fetch the FHIR server's CapabilityStatement via GET /metadata, which describes the server's supported FHIR capabilities and conformance.

components.name: Connect
components.description: Connect to a FHIR R4 server, optionally using SMART-on-FHIR standalone login with client_id or direct bearer_token authentication. Must be called before any other tool in the FHIR MCP server.

components.name: Connect complete
components.description: Complete a SMART login started by connect() in headless mode by passing the full callback URL from the browser's address bar after redirect.

components.name: Create FHIR resource
components.description: Creates a FHIR R4 resource via POST, requiring a resource type and resource body. This operation is irreversible on a real EHR and requires create permissions.

components.name: Disconnect
components.description: Clear the current FHIR connection and any in-memory token.

components.name: Get document content
components.description: Fetch and decode the text body of a FHIR DocumentReference. Text-family attachments (plain text, HTML, RTF, XML/C-CDA narrative) are decoded in-process; binary formats return a null text with reason 'binary_not_extracted'. The returned text is untrusted clinical content.

components.name: Get patient
components.description: Read a single Patient resource (demographics) from a FHIR server using a patient ID.

components.name: Lookup code
components.description: Resolve a code's display name via CodeSystem/$lookup, the licensed route for CPT and other server-hosted code systems. Takes a canonical code-system URI and a code as input, and returns the display name.

components.name: Read resource
components.description: Read a single FHIR resource by type and id (e.g. Encounter/abc123). Returns the raw resource.

components.name: Save document for extraction
components.description: Saves a FHIR DocumentReference attachment to a server-chosen temporary directory and returns the file path for external text extraction, used when get_document_content returns binary_not_extracted for formats like PDF, DOCX, or scanned images.

components.name: Search allergies
components.description: List a patient's allergies and intolerances using a patient identifier.

components.name: Search conditions
components.description: List a patient's problem list or encounter diagnoses from a FHIR server, with optional filtering by clinical status and date range.

components.name: Search document references
components.description: Search DocumentReference resources (clinical notes) for a patient, with optional filtering by LOINC type and date range.

components.name: Search medication requests
components.description: List a patient's medications, including prescribed orders (MedicationRequest) and self-reported/home meds (MedicationStatement), filtered by status and date range.

components.name: Search observations
components.description: List a patient's observations (labs, vitals) from a FHIR server, filterable by LOINC code, category, and date range.

components.name: Search patients
components.description: Search for patient records in a FHIR server by name, birthdate, or identifier (MRN).

components.name: Search resource
components.description: Generic FHIR search for any resource type the server supports (Encounter, Procedure, Immunization, DiagnosticReport, CarePlan, Coverage, ServiceRequest, ExplanationOfBenefit, Appointment, ...). Returns raw resources without summarization. Takes a resource type and FHIR search parameters as input.

components.name: Status
components.description: Report current connection status and configured defaults for the FHIR server. Call this first to see whether connect() can run with no arguments.

components.name: Update FHIR resource
components.description: Replace a FHIR resource by id using a PUT operation. Requires resource_type, id, and a full replacement resource body. This is an irreversible operation on a real EHR and requires update permission in the connect() scope.

components.name: Get Agent Guidance
components.description: Provides comprehensive guidance for assisting users with Teal application development, including creating Teal apps, adding modules, and building clinical trial analysis applications. The tool returns a complete agent usage guide with role and responsibilities.

components.name: Check Dataset Requirements
components.description: Checks whether all datasets required by a TealFlow module are present in the supplied available dataset names and returns a markdown report with clear compatibility feedback.

components.name: Discover ADaM Datasets
components.description: Scans a local directory for ADaM dataset files, identifies dataset names, and collects metadata about each dataset, supporting file format and filename pattern filters.

components.name: Generate Data Loading Code
components.description: Generates R code that loads ADaM datasets from files and creates a teal_data object with appropriate join keys. It uses the datasets list produced by tealflow_discover_datasets as its main input and returns the generated code as a string.

components.name: Generate Teal Module Code
components.description: Generate ready-to-use R code for adding a Teal module to a clinical data exploration application. Accepts a module name and optional parameters, and returns R code with defaults based on the module's specifications and available datasets, with guidance to verify dataset compatibility first.

components.name: Get Teal App Template
components.description: Get the Teal application template as a starting point for building apps. This tool returns the base R code template that should be used to start any Teal app, including data loading, configuration variables, and the basic structure for adding Teal modules. The output format can be specified as markdown or JSON.

components.name: Get Dataset Information
components.description: Get detailed information about a dataset file, including columns, types, and row count, from an absolute path to an .rds or .csv file without loading the entire dataset into memory.

components.name: Get module details
components.description: Get comprehensive details about a specific Teal module, including required and optional parameters, their types, default values, descriptions, and official R help documentation, given the module name.

components.name: List Available Datasets
components.description: Lists available clinical trial datasets in the project, providing information about standard ADaM datasets that follow CDISC standards for use with Teal clinical modules. The tool accepts an optional response format parameter and returns dataset names, descriptions, and usage information.

components.name: List Teal Modules
components.description: Lists all available Teal analysis modules with their descriptions and dataset requirements, optionally filtered by package (clinical, general, or all) and category. Returns a markdown catalog of modules, including clinical trial reporting modules that use ADaM datasets and general data exploration modules.

components.name: Search Modules by Analysis Type
components.description: Searches for Teal modules that perform a specified type of analysis using structured analysis type categories and text search. Accepts an analysis type query and returns matching module details in the requested output format.

components.name: Setup Renv Environment
components.description: Prepares an R project directory for running Teal Shiny applications by initializing an renv environment and installing required packages (shiny, teal, teal.modules.general, teal.modules.clinical). Takes a project path and returns setup status.

components.name: Snapshot Renv Environment
components.description: Creates an renv snapshot of the current R project environment, recording installed packages in renv.lock to support reproducibility and sharing. Accepts a project path and returns the snapshot result.

components.name: Citation manager
components.description: Builds formatted citations in APA, MLA, BibTeX, RIS, or EndNote style from a PMID, PMCID, DOI, or ArXiv ID, and optionally retrieves PubMed citation counts for PMIDs.

components.name: Paper analysis
components.description: Retrieve metadata and optional full text for one paper using a PMID, PMCID, DOI, or arXiv identifier. Supports basic metadata/abstract and full-text modes with heuristic section splitting and optional case-insensitive sentence filtering.

components.name: Research preferences
components.description: Read or update persisted scholarly research preferences on disk, including source, search, display, and cache settings used by research_search.

components.name: Research search
components.description: Search PubMed, Google Scholar, and ArXiv for scholarly articles and preprints using a unified query, with optional source overrides, date filters, and sort preferences; returns matching publication records and any source warnings.

components.name: Web research
components.description: Scrapes a single URL to GET-like markdown and searches the open web via Firecrawl v2 endpoints, using an action selector with optional URL, query, and maximum results parameters. Requires FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.

components.name: Advanced search
components.description: Perform complex searches of the ChEMBL database using multiple chemical property and biological filters, returning matching compound records.

components.name: Analyze ADMET properties
components.description: Analyze ADMET properties (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion, Toxicity) for a ChEMBL compound specified by its ChEMBL ID.

components.name: Assess drug-likeness
components.description: Assess drug-likeness of a compound using Lipinski Rule of Five and other metrics, accepting either a ChEMBL compound ID or a SMILES string.

components.name: Batch compound lookup
components.description: Process multiple ChEMBL compound IDs in batch and return the matching compound records from the ChEMBL database.

components.name: Calculate molecular descriptors
components.description: Calculate molecular descriptors and physicochemical properties for a compound identified by ChEMBL ID or provided as a SMILES string.

components.name: Compare activities
components.description: Compare bioactivity data across multiple ChEMBL compounds or targets. Accepts an array of 2-10 ChEMBL compound IDs plus optional target and activity type filters and returns bioactivity comparisons from ChEMBL.

components.name: Get assay info
components.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific ChEMBL assay using its ChEMBL assay ID, returning assay metadata from the ChEMBL database.

components.name: Get compound info
components.description: Get detailed information for a specific compound by ChEMBL ID, such as CHEMBL59. The tool queries the ChEMBL database and returns compound descriptor records.

components.name: Get compound structure
components.description: Retrieve chemical structure information for a ChEMBL compound ID in formats such as SMILES, InChI, Molfile, and SDF.

components.name: Get Dose Response
components.description: Get dose-response data and activity profiles for compounds from ChEMBL using a ChEMBL compound ID and optional target ID filter.

components.name: Get drug info
components.description: Retrieve drug development status and clinical trial information for a ChEMBL compound ID from the ChEMBL database.

components.name: Get external references
components.description: Retrieves links to external databases such as PubChem, DrugBank, and PDB for a given ChEMBL compound or target ID.

components.name: Get mechanism of action
components.description: Get mechanism of action and target interaction data for a ChEMBL compound using its ChEMBL ID.

components.name: Get target compounds
components.description: Get compounds tested against a specific target from ChEMBL using its ChEMBL target ID. Returns compound records with optional filters for activity type and result limit.

components.name: Get target info
components.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific target by ChEMBL target ID, returning target records from the ChEMBL database.

components.name: Get target pathways
components.description: Retrieve biological pathways associated with a target using its ChEMBL target ID.

components.name: Predict Solubility and Permeability
components.description: Predict aqueous solubility and permeability properties for a compound provided as a ChEMBL ID or SMILES string.

components.name: Search activities
components.description: Search ChEMBL bioactivity measurements and assay results using target, assay, molecule, or activity type filters. Returns matching bioactivity and assay records.

components.name: Search by activity type
components.description: Find bioactivity data by specific activity type and value range, accepting activity type, min/max value, and units, and returning matching activity records.

components.name: Search by InChI
components.description: Search for compounds by InChI key or InChI string and return matching compound records.

components.name: Search by UniProt
components.description: Search ChEMBL for target records using a UniProt accession number, returning matching ChEMBL target entries.

components.name: Search compounds
components.description: Search the ChEMBL database for compounds by name, synonym, or identifier and return matching compound records.

components.name: Search drug indications
components.description: Search for therapeutic indications and disease areas in ChEMBL by indication term, optionally filtered by drug type, returning matching drug records with indication annotations.

components.name: Search drugs
components.description: Search for approved drugs and clinical candidates by drug name or search query, with optional filters for development phase and therapeutic area.

components.name: Search Similar Compounds
components.description: Search for chemically similar compounds using a SMILES query and Tanimoto similarity threshold, returning matching compound records.

components.name: Search biological targets
components.description: Search for biological targets by name or type using a required query string, with optional filters for target type and organism. Returns matching target records from the ChEMBL database.

components.name: Substructure search
components.description: Search ChEMBL for compounds containing a given SMILES substructure and return matching compound records.

components.name: Get disease details
components.description: Retrieve comprehensive disease information by disease EFO ID. Accepts an EFO identifier and returns disease details.

components.name: Get disease targets summary
components.description: Retrieves an overview of all targets associated with a disease, using an EFO disease ID and returning target summaries from OpenTargets.

components.name: Get target details
components.description: Get comprehensive target information for a gene using its Ensembl gene ID, returning detailed target records.

components.name: Get target disease associations
components.description: Retrieves target-disease associations with evidence scores, accepting Ensembl gene IDs and EFO disease IDs with an optional score threshold.

components.name: Search diseases
components.description: Search for diseases by name, synonym, or description using a text query and return matching disease records.

components.name: Search targets
components.description: Search for therapeutic targets by gene symbol, name, or description. Returns matching target records for the query.

components.name: Advanced search
components.description: Performs advanced literature search with field-specific queries and boolean operators, returning matching article records.

components.name: Batch article lookup
components.description: Retrieves multiple PubMed articles by their PubMed IDs (up to 200 PMIDs per request) and returns the corresponding article records.

components.name: Convert Identifiers
components.description: Convert between PMID, DOI, and PMC ID for a supplied article identifier, with optional identifier_type auto-detection.

components.name: Export citation
components.description: Export a formatted citation for a PubMed article given its PubMed ID (PMID). Supports APA, MLA, Chicago, BibTeX, and RIS citation formats.

components.name: Get Abstract
components.description: Retrieve an article abstract from PubMed using a PMID.

components.name: Get article details
components.description: Retrieve comprehensive metadata and abstract for a specific article by PubMed ID.

components.name: Find citing articles
components.description: Find articles that cite a specific PubMed ID (PMID) and return the citing articles.

components.name: Get Full Text
components.description: Retrieve full text from PubMed Central (PMC) when available using a PMC ID.

components.name: Get references
components.description: Get the reference list for a PubMed article by PubMed ID, returning cited reference records.

components.name: Get similar articles
components.description: Finds related articles in PubMed based on content similarity for a given PubMed ID and returns matching article records.

components.name: Get Trending Articles
components.description: Get recently published or trending articles for a specified research field or topic, with configurable lookback days and maximum result count.

components.name: Search Articles
components.description: Search PubMed for articles by keywords, authors, journals, dates, or MeSH terms and return PMIDs and basic metadata.

components.name: Search by author
components.description: Find PubMed articles by specific author(s) using an author name and optional affiliation, returning matching article records.

components.name: Search by journal
components.description: Search for articles within specific journals using journal name or abbreviation, optional keywords, and date range; returns matching article records from PubMed.

components.name: Search by MeSH terms
components.description: Searches biomedical literature using Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) terms, optionally restricting results to articles where the terms are major topics.

components.name: Validate PMID
components.description: Validates the format of a PubMed ID and checks whether the corresponding article exists in PubMed.

components.name: FHIR Capabilities
components.description: Retrieves the FHIR server's CapabilityStatement resource through the FHIR capabilities interaction, describing the server's supported resource types and interactions.

components.name: FHIR history
components.description: Retrieves the version history of FHIR resources from a configured FHIR server using the MCP history interaction. Returns an FHIR bundle containing prior versions of the specified resource type.

components.name: FHIR Operation
components.description: Executes a named FHIR operation against a configured FHIR server and returns the operation result.

components.name: FHIR resource read
components.description: Reads a FHIR resource from a configured FHIR server using the read verb. Accepts a resource type and id, and returns the current state of the requested FHIR resource.

components.name: FHIR Search
components.description: Search a FHIR server using FHIR search parameters and return matching FHIR resources.

components.name: FHIR vread
components.description: Retrieve a specific historical version of a FHIR resource from the configured FHIR server using the vread interaction, returning the resource payload as stored at that version.

components.name: Batch query Open Targets GraphQL
components.description: Execute the same Open Targets GraphQL query across multiple variable sets and return results mapped by a designated key field. The tool supports batched queries for targets, diseases, drugs, variants, studies, and related biomedical entities.

components.name: Get Open Targets GraphQL Schema
components.description: Retrieve the Open Targets Platform GraphQL schema as SDL, filtered by one or more categories such as drug mechanisms, genetic associations, or target safety. The returned schema includes types for the selected categories and their expanded dependencies.

components.name: Get type dependencies
components.description: Returns SDL schema subsets for specified GraphQL type names, separated into type-specific and shared dependencies. The tool uses the Open Targets service and accepts a list of starting GraphQL types.

components.name: Query Open Targets GraphQL
components.description: Execute GraphQL queries against the Open Targets Platform API using a required query string and optional variables. Results may contain data for targets, diseases, drugs, variants, studies, or related biomedical entities together with query status and messages.

components.name: Search entities
components.description: Searches the Open Targets Platform for multiple query strings across targets, diseases, drugs, variants, and studies. Returns up to three matching entities per query with each entity's identifier and type.

components.name: Create FHIR Resource
components.description: Create a new FHIR resource in an AWS HealthLake datastore using a datastore ID, resource type, and FHIR resource data provided as a JSON object.

components.name: Delete FHIR resource
components.description: Delete a FHIR resource from an Amazon HealthLake datastore using the datastore ID, FHIR resource type, and resource ID.

components.name: Get datastore details
components.description: Gets detailed information about a specific AWS HealthLake datastore using its datastore ID and returns datastore details.

components.name: List Datastores
components.description: Lists all AWS HealthLake datastores in the account, optionally filtered by datastore status. Returns datastore records from the HealthLake service.

components.name: List FHIR Jobs
components.description: Lists FHIR import and export jobs for a specified AWS HealthLake datastore, with optional filters for job status and job type.

components.name: Patient Everything
components.description: Retrieve all FHIR resources related to a specific patient from an AWS HealthLake datastore using the FHIR $patient-everything operation, with optional start and end date filters.

components.name: Read FHIR resource
components.description: Retrieves a specific FHIR resource by resource type and ID from an AWS HealthLake datastore.

components.name: Search FHIR Resources
components.description: Searches for FHIR resources in an AWS HealthLake datastore using basic, chained, include, and reverse-include search parameters. Returns up to 100 matching resources per call with pagination support.

components.name: Start FHIR Export Job
components.description: Start a FHIR export job that exports data from an AWS HealthLake datastore to an S3 destination. The tool accepts a datastore ID, S3 output configuration, and IAM data access role ARN, with optional job name and KMS key configuration.

components.name: Start FHIR Import Job
components.description: Starts a FHIR import job that loads FHIR data from an S3 location into an AWS HealthLake datastore and configures job output and access settings.

components.name: Update FHIR Resource
components.description: Update an existing FHIR resource in a HealthLake datastore using its datastore ID, resource type, resource ID, and updated resource data.

components.name: OpenEvidence Article Get
components.description: Fetch an OpenEvidence article by its UUID article_id and return normalized status, question, and answer fields by default; optionally include_raw exposes private thread context when explicitly intended. Requires an authenticated session and has no side effects.

components.name: OpenEvidence Article Wait
components.description: Waits for an existing OpenEvidence article_id to finish and returns normalized article fields, taking an article_id UUID and optional timeout/polling controls. Use after oe_ask with wait_for_completion=false for long research questions.

components.name: OpenEvidence Ask
components.description: Creates an OpenEvidence research question and returns the created article data, optionally including normalized completed fields. Uses the OpenEvidence service via the local browser profile and is intended for research questions, not medical advice or patient-specific diagnosis.

components.name: OpenEvidence Auth Status
components.description: Checks whether the saved OpenEvidence browser session is authenticated, returning authenticated true/false and basic account metadata when available. Intended for use before history/article/ask tools; requires the local browser profile created by npm run login:session and has no side effects.

components.name: OpenEvidence History List
components.description: List prior OpenEvidence articles from the authenticated account. Accepts optional search, limit, offset, and include_raw parameters. Returns a privacy-reduced list of article records by default, with optional raw data exposure.

components.name: Get paper abstract
components.description: Retrieves the abstract of an arXiv paper using its arXiv identifier. This provides a faster, lower-cost alternative to fetching the full paper.

components.name: Get paper prompt
components.description: Fetches a paper from arXiv using its identifier and returns flattened LaTeX source for precise interpretation of mathematical expressions.

components.name: Get paper section
components.description: Extract a specific section from an arXiv paper using its arXiv ID and section path. The tool fetches and processes the paper's LaTeX source for section-level retrieval.

components.name: List paper sections
components.description: List the section headings of an arXiv paper to reveal its document structure. The tool accepts an arXiv paper ID and returns the paper's section headings.

components.name: Get STRING network image
components.description: Generate a protein-protein interaction network image for a given protein and species from the STRING database, returning a PNG visualization or error message.

components.name: Analyze cell communication
components.description: Analyze cell-cell communication and ligand-receptor interaction patterns from a dataset. Accepts a dataset ID, required species, cell type key, and analysis method, and returns cell-cell communication results; for mouse with LIANA, the mouseconsensus ligand-receptor resource may be selected.

components.name: Analyze CNV
components.description: Analyze copy number variations (CNVs) in spatial transcriptomics data using a dataset identifier and required reference parameters.

components.name: Analyze enrichment
components.description: Perform gene set enrichment analysis on a dataset specified by ID. The tool accepts enrichment parameters including species, method, and gene set database options, and returns enrichment results.

components.name: Analyze spatial statistics
components.description: Analyzes spatial statistics and autocorrelation patterns for spatial datasets using a dataset ID and optional analysis parameters such as analysis type, cluster key, and genes. Returns spatial statistics results.

components.name: Analyze Trajectory Data
components.description: Analyzes trajectory data to infer cellular trajectories and pseudotime ordering for a dataset identified by data_id, with optional parameters such as method, root cell, and spatial weight.

components.name: Analyze velocity data
components.description: Analyze RNA velocity to understand cellular dynamics using spliced and unspliced layers. The tool accepts a dataset ID and optional velocity parameters and returns an RNA velocity result.

components.name: Annotate cell types
components.description: Annotate cell types in spatial transcriptomics data using a dataset ID and optional annotation parameters, supporting reference-based methods like Tangram and scANVI.

components.name: Compare conditions
components.description: Compare experimental conditions using pseudobulk differential expression with DESeq2. Accepts a dataset ID and condition parameters and returns condition comparison results.

components.name: Compute embeddings
components.description: Compute dimensionality reduction (PCA, UMAP), clustering, and neighbor graphs for a supplied dataset ID with optional embedding parameters, returning an embedding result.

components.name: Deconvolve Data
components.description: Deconvolve spatial spots to estimate cell type proportions using a selected method, cell type key, and reference dataset ID.

components.name: Find markers
components.description: Find differentially expressed genes between groups using a dataset ID and parameters including group key, optional method, group selections, and number of top genes. Returns a differential expression result.

components.name: Find spatial genes
components.description: Identify spatially variable genes from a spatial transcriptomics dataset using a dataset ID and optional parameters such as method and number of top genes.

components.name: Identify Spatial Domains
components.description: Identify spatial domains and tissue architecture from spatial data using a dataset ID and optional parameters. Returns spatial domain results.

components.name: Integrate samples
components.description: Integrates multiple spatial transcriptomics samples into a unified dataset using dataset IDs and optional integration parameters.

components.name: Load Data
components.description: Loads spatial transcriptomics data from local files or directories for supported platforms (Visium, Xenium, Slide-seq, MERFISH, SeqFISH, or generic) and returns a SpatialDataset with cell/gene counts and metadata profiles.

components.name: Preprocess data
components.description: Runs quality control, filtering, normalization, and highly variable gene selection on a dataset selected by ID, returning a preprocessing result with optional parameter overrides. It does not compute PCA, UMAP, clustering, or neighbor graphs.

components.name: Register spatial data
components.description: Registers and aligns spatial transcriptomics data across sections using source and target dataset IDs and optional registration parameters, returning a result with method, dataset IDs, spot counts, and a registered spatial key.

components.name: Reload data
components.description: Reload a dataset from disk after external script modifications using a dataset ID and optional custom path, and return a summary of the reloaded dataset.

components.name: Visualize data
components.description: Visualizes spatial transcriptomics data using a dataset ID and optional visualization parameters such as plot_type, subtype, and genes to generate plots.

components.name: Get articles for topic
components.description: Retrieves evidence-based medical articles and information for a given topic from patient.info, a trusted up-to-date medical resource.

components.name: Return available topics
components.description: Returns a list of currently available topics from patient.info, providing evidence-based medical information trusted by doctors and kept up to date.

components.name: Return full content for articles
components.description: Fetches the full content of medical articles from patient.info given a list of article URLs. It returns the complete text for each requested article.

components.name: Advanced Search
components.description: Perform complex PubMed searches using multiple criteria such as title, abstract, author, journal, and MeSH fields, returning matching article records.

components.name: Analyze research trends
components.description: Analyzes publication trends for a research topic over time, taking a topic query and returning trend analysis results.

components.name: Compare articles
components.description: Compares multiple PubMed articles side by side using their PMIDs and selected comparison fields.

components.name: Export citations
components.description: Exports article citations for PubMed IDs in multiple citation formats including BibTeX, EndNote, RIS, APA, MLA, Chicago, and Vancouver.

components.name: Find related articles
components.description: Find articles related to a specified PubMed ID (PMID) using PubMed's related articles feature. Accepts a PMID and returns matching article records.

components.name: Get article details
components.description: Retrieve detailed information for specific PubMed articles by PMID, optionally including abstracts and citation data.

components.name: Get journal metrics
components.description: Get metrics and information about a specific journal by name or abbreviation. Optionally includes recent notable articles.

components.name: Get trending topics
components.description: Retrieves trending medical topics and research areas, optionally filtered by a medical category and number of days to analyze.

components.name: Search by author
components.description: Search for articles by a specific author in PubMed, returning matching article records.

components.name: Search by journal
components.description: Search for articles published in a specific journal using its name or abbreviation, returning matching article records with optional date filtering and result limit.

components.name: Search MeSH terms
components.description: Search and explore MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) terms by query term, returning matching MeSH term records from the MeSH vocabulary.

components.name: Search PubMed
components.description: Search PubMed for biomedical articles using PubMed query syntax, returning matching article records with optional result limits and sorting.

components.name: Extract PDF text from DICOM
components.description: Retrieves a DICOM instance by study, series, and SOP instance UID, extracts an encapsulated PDF document, and converts it to plain text. Useful for medical reports stored as PDFs within DICOM, such as radiology reports and clinical documents.

components.name: Get attribute presets
components.description: Returns the available DICOM attribute presets (minimal, standard, extended) organized by query level (patient, study, series, instance) for use with query functions.

components.name: List DICOM nodes
components.description: List all configured DICOM nodes and their connection information, including the currently selected node and available calling AE titles.

components.name: Move series
components.description: Moves a DICOM series from the current DICOM server to a configured destination DICOM node using the series instance UID and returns an operation status message.

components.name: Move DICOM study
components.description: Moves a DICOM study from the current DICOM server to a configured destination node using its study instance UID. Returns an operation status with success and message details.

components.name: Query DICOM instances
components.description: Query individual DICOM instances (images) within a series using a DICOM C-FIND at the IMAGE level. Requires a series_instance_uid and returns matching instance records with optional attribute filtering.

components.name: Query patients
components.description: Queries patients matching specified criteria from a DICOM node using a PATIENT-level C-FIND operation. Accepts optional search parameters such as name pattern, patient ID, and birth date, and returns matching patient records as dictionaries.

components.name: Query series
components.description: Query series within a study from a DICOM node using a DICOM C-FIND operation at the SERIES level. Accepts a required study instance UID and optional series filters, and returns matching DICOM series records.

components.name: Query studies
components.description: Query DICOM studies from a DICOM node using a C-FIND operation at the study level. Accepts search criteria such as patient ID, study date, modality, study description, accession number, and study instance UID, and returns matching study records.

components.name: Switch DICOM node
components.description: Switch the active DICOM node connection to a different configured node such as a PACS or workstation by name, returning a success flag and message.

components.name: Verify connection
components.description: Verify connectivity to the currently selected DICOM node by performing a C-ECHO operation and returning connection status including host, port, and AE titles.

components.name: Calculate BMI
components.description: Calculate Body Mass Index (BMI) from height in meters and weight in kilograms.

components.name: Clinical trials search
components.description: Search for clinical trials by medical condition and trial status, returning matching clinical trial records.

components.name: Extract DICOM Metadata
components.description: Extracts metadata from a DICOM file specified by a file path. Returns the embedded metadata from the DICOM file.

components.name: FDA drug lookup
components.description: Look up drug information from the FDA database by drug name, optionally specifying label, adverse events, or general information.

components.name: Health topics
components.description: Retrieves evidence-based health information for a given health topic, with optional language selection for English or Spanish.

components.name: ICD-10 Code Lookup
components.description: Looks up ICD-10 codes by entering either a code or a medical condition description. The tool returns matching ICD-10 code records with an optional maximum number of results.

components.name: MedRxiv Search
components.description: Search for preprint articles on medRxiv using a text query and optional maximum results limit.

components.name: NCBI Bookshelf Search
components.description: Searches the NCBI Bookshelf for biomedical books and documents matching a user query, returning up to a configurable number of results.

components.name: PubMed search
components.description: Search for medical literature in the PubMed database using a user-provided query.

components.name: Calculate BMI
components.description: Calculate Body Mass Index (BMI) from height in meters and weight in kilograms.

components.name: Clinical trials search
components.description: Search for clinical trials by medical condition, status, and other parameters, returning matching trial records.

components.name: Extract DICOM metadata
components.description: Extract metadata from a DICOM file specified by a local file path, returning structured DICOM metadata fields.

components.name: FDA Drug Lookup
components.description: Look up drug information from the FDA database by drug name, with optional search type general, label, or adverse events. Returns matching drug records.

components.name: Health Topics
components.description: Get evidence-based health information on a specified topic, with optional language selection (English or Spanish).

components.name: Lookup ICD code
components.description: Look up ICD-10 codes by code or medical condition description and return matching ICD-10 code entries.

components.name: Medrxiv search
components.description: Search for preprint articles on medRxiv using a text query and return matching preprint records.

components.name: NCBI Bookshelf search
components.description: Search the NCBI Bookshelf for biomedical books and documents using a text query.

components.name: PubMed search
components.description: Search the PubMed database for medical literature using a text query and return matching article records, with optional result count and date range filters.

components.name: ClawBio list skills
components.description: Searches the ClawBio bioinformatics skill library using an optional query and returns matching skill records; an empty query lists all available skills.

components.name: ClinicalTrials Find Eligible
components.description: Matches patient demographics and conditions to eligible recruiting clinical trials on ClinicalTrials.gov, returning studies with matching eligibility criteria, contact information, and recruiting locations, re-ranked by condition match.

components.name: ClinicalTrials field definitions
components.description: Resolves valid field names from the ClinicalTrials.gov data model, returning canonical PascalCase identifiers and definitions. Supports keyword search, section drill-down by dot-notation path, and top-level overview modes.

components.name: ClinicalTrials Get Field Values
components.description: Discover valid values for ClinicalTrials.gov fields with study counts per value to explore available filter options before building a search. Returns value options for a requested field along with associated study counts.

components.name: ClinicalTrials.gov study count
components.description: Get the total number of clinical trial studies on ClinicalTrials.gov matching provided query filters, without fetching individual study data. Useful for quick statistics and breakdown counts by phase, status, or condition.

components.name: ClinicalTrials study record lookup
components.description: Fetch a single clinical trial study record from ClinicalTrials.gov by NCT ID, returning protocol details, eligibility criteria, outcomes, arms, interventions, contacts, and locations.

components.name: ClinicalTrials get study results
components.description: Fetch completed clinical trial results from ClinicalTrials.gov, including outcome measures with statistics, adverse events, participant flow, baseline characteristics, and results metadata such as limitations and point of contact. Use clinicaltrials_search_studies first to find studies where results are available.

components.name: ClinicalTrials Search Studies
components.description: Search for clinical trial studies from ClinicalTrials.gov using full-text or field-specific queries with optional status, phase, and geographic filters. Returns a compact per-study index by default or specific fields at full fidelity when requested.

components.name: PubMed Convert IDs
components.description: Converts between article identifiers (DOI, PMID, PMCID) for articles indexed in PubMed Central, accepting up to 50 IDs per request and returning the corresponding identifiers.

components.name: PubMed Europe PMC Fetch
components.description: Fetches complete Europe PMC records, including full untruncated abstracts, using the record source and Europe PMC ID. This retrieval path supports preprint, patent, and Agricola records, which frequently lack a PMID.

components.name: PubMed Europe PMC search
components.description: Search Europe PMC, a broad open-access biomedical corpus covering preprints, patents, Agricola, PubMed, and PMC records. Accepts a query with field tokens and returns matching literature records with bounded abstract snippets.

components.name: PubMed fetch articles
components.description: Fetches full article metadata from PubMed by PubMed IDs, returning detailed article information including abstract, authors, journal, and MeSH terms.

components.name: PubMed Fetch Fulltext
components.description: Fetch full-text articles from PubMed Central, Europe PMC, and Unpaywall using PMC IDs, PubMed IDs, or DOIs. PubMed IDs and DOIs are automatically resolved to PMC IDs via the NCBI ID Converter before retrieving the article full text.

components.name: PubMed find related
components.description: Find articles related to a source article by similarity, citation, or references. The tool uses NCBI ELink as the primary source and falls back to Europe PMC and OpenAlex, returning related article records.

components.name: Format PubMed citations
components.description: Given a list of PubMed IDs, formats citations for up to 50 articles in one or more of APA, MLA, BibTeX, RIS, and Vancouver styles.

components.name: PubMed Lookup Citation
components.description: Look up PubMed IDs from partial bibliographic citations (such as journal, year, volume, page, and author) using deterministic citation matching against PubMed. Each citation must include at least journal or year, and the tool returns matching PubMed IDs.

components.name: PubMed Lookup MeSH
components.description: Searches and explores the MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) controlled vocabulary, returning descriptor records with tree numbers, scope notes, and entry terms, with pagination via offset.

components.name: PubMed Search Articles
components.description: Search PubMed with full query syntax, field-specific filters (author, journal, MeSH terms), common filters (language, species, free full text), and date ranges. Returns PMIDs and optional brief summaries with pagination via offset.

components.name: PubMed Spell Check
components.description: Spell-checks a PubMed search query using NCBI's suggested correction service, returning the original query and the corrected suggestion.

components.name: Analyze publication count
components.description: Analyzes publication counts over time from a local PubMed results file. Accepts a file name and an optional number of months per analysis period, and recommends JSON format files for better analysis.

components.name: Analyze research keywords
components.description: Analyzes research hotspots and trends in PubMed result files by extracting top keywords from a supplied file. It accepts a result filename and returns keyword ranking and optional trend analysis.

components.name: Generate comprehensive analysis
components.description: Generate a comprehensive analysis of a PubMed results file, producing keyword frequencies and publication count trends over configurable time periods.

components.name: List result files
components.description: Lists all available PubMed result files, returning both JSON files (structured data suitable for AI model analysis) and TXT files (plain text format for backward compatibility).

components.name: Search PubMed
components.description: Search PubMed using an advanced query string with optional date range and result count limits, returning matching PubMed records for analysis.

components.name: Convert KEGG IDs
components.description: Convert identifiers between KEGG and external databases (UniProt, NCBI Gene/Protein, ChEBI, PubChem) using KEGG's link service. Accepts source namespace/identifier(s) and target namespace, and returns mapping pairs.

components.name: Convert ID
components.description: Converts identifiers between biological databases using the TogoID service. Accepts one or more identifiers and a conversion route, returning JSON pairs of source and target identifiers.

components.name: Count ID
components.description: Check how many source identifiers can be converted to a target database before bulk conversion. It accepts source and target database names with an identifier list and returns the number of mappable IDs without returning the mapped IDs.

components.name: EFetch
components.description: Fetches full records from NCBI databases using EFetch, accepting database names and IDs and returning biological data such as sequences and records in the requested format.

components.name: NCBI ESearch
components.description: Search NCBI databases using the E-utilities esearch API, taking a database and query and returning matching search results.

components.name: Esummary
components.description: Fetch summary records for NCBI database entries using the E-utilities esummary endpoint. Accepts a database name and one or more IDs (list or comma-separated string) and returns parsed JSON summary data.

components.name: KEGG Find
components.description: Keyword-search a KEGG database and return matching entry IDs using a database selector and query keywords, with optional chemical formula, exact mass, or molecular weight filters.

components.name: Get case reports
components.description: Lists published case reports for a MONDO disease using PubCaseFinder's curated index. English results cover PubMed case reports, while Japanese results cover J-STAGE articles and include publication metadata and links.

components.name: Get compound attributes from PubChem
components.description: Retrieves compound attributes from PubChem RDF for a given PubChem Compound ID (CID), returning the attributes as a JSON-formatted string. On upstream or HTTP failure, returns an error string instead of raising.

components.name: KEGG Entry Retrieval
components.description: Retrieve full KEGG entries by identifier, including genes, compounds, pathways, enzymes, and drugs, with optional sequence output in flat file, amino acid FASTA, or nucleotide FASTA.

components.name: Get graph list
components.description: Retrieves the list of RDF graph URIs for a specified RDF database, using the database name to resolve endpoint details and rank matching graphs.

components.name: Get MIE file
components.description: Get the Metadata Interoperability Exchange (MIE) file for a specified RDF database as a YAML string containing ShEx schema, verified SPARQL examples, critical warnings, graphs, schema deltas and ID/join mapping; unknown database names return an error listing valid names.

components.name: Get PubChem compound ID
components.description: Looks up PubChem Compound IDs (CIDs) for a given compound name using the PubChem PUG REST API and returns the identifiers as a JSON-formatted string.

components.name: Get SPARQL endpoints
components.description: Retrieves available SPARQL endpoints for RDF Portal, returning a dictionary with database mappings and endpoint details including URLs and associated databases.

components.name: Get workflow
components.description: Retrieves TogoMCP workflow documentation by listing available workflows, fetching a workflow's SKILL.md, or retrieving a specified relative file. Returns workflow listings, metadata, documentation, or file contents.

components.name: Get all dataset
components.description: List all databases registered in TogoID with their ID formats, including labels, regex patterns, URI prefixes, and example IDs.

components.name: Get all relation
components.description: Discover all available ID conversion routes between databases by returning a map of all source-to-target database pairs that TogoID can convert. This planning tool is used early in multi-database workflows to map IDs between different SPARQL endpoints.

components.name: Get dataset configuration
components.description: Retrieves configuration metadata for a specified TogoID database dataset, including ID format, URI prefix, example IDs, and available annotations.

components.name: Get description
components.description: Retrieves human-readable descriptions for all databases registered in TogoID, including names, English and Japanese descriptions, and organization information. Useful for understanding database contents when planning cross-database queries.

components.name: Get Relation
components.description: Checks whether a specific identifier conversion route exists between two TogoID namespaces and returns relationship metadata including forward and reverse labels.

components.name: Identify ID
components.description: Resolve bare accessions such as AEK21611 or P38398 to candidate TogoID dataset keys, returning a JSON string with id and candidates containing dataset, label, category, and shape_match.

components.name: Link
components.description: Find KEGG entries related to other KEGG entries, such as gene-pathway, gene-compound and gene-pubmed relationships, by querying with a target database and a source database or entry identifier.

components.name: List databases
components.description: List all supported NCBI databases with descriptions and example queries, returning a formatted list of available databases.

components.name: Pathway cycles
components.description: Find closed feedback loops (directed cycles) drawn within a single KEGG pathway map. Accepts a KEGG map identifier such as hsa04010 and optional filters for feedback sign, maximum length, and cycle count; returns the detected cycles.

components.name: Pathway graph
components.description: Fetches a KEGG pathway map by its map ID and returns the corresponding pathway graph, with optional expansion of gene members and inclusion of cross-map links.

components.name: Pathway neighborhood
components.description: Walks upstream or downstream from a gene or compound seed within a specified KEGG pathway map and returns a bounded pathway neighborhood, with optional direction, depth and signed-edge filtering.

components.name: Pathway paths
components.description: Enumerates routes between specified source and target molecules within a KEGG pathway map, returning paths with their net activating or inhibiting effect.

components.name: Rank by phenotypes
components.description: Ranks OMIM diseases, Orphanet diseases, or genes against a supplied set of patient HPO phenotype IDs using information-content-weighted similarity over the HPO hierarchy. Returns scored, ranked candidate records with matched phenotypes and related disease or gene identifiers.

components.name: Run SPARQL
components.description: Executes a SPARQL query against an RDF data portal and returns the matching results. The tool requires graph patterns to be pinned using FROM or GRAPH clauses to avoid unbounded reads.

components.name: Search disease
components.description: Resolves a disease term to MONDO or MedGen identifiers for use in variant searches, performing client-side re-ranking for better match relevance against TogoVar endpoints.

components.name: Search gene
components.description: Resolve a human gene symbol or alias to its HGNC ID for use as the first step in variant search, returning re-ranked matching gene records from TogoVar.

components.name: Search MeSH descriptor
components.description: Search the Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) database for descriptor records matching a query string and return matching MeSH descriptor records.

components.name: Search PDB entity
components.description: Search entity records from PDB-related databases (pdb, cc, prd) by query string, with optional filtering by experimental method for PDB entries, returning matching records containing id, name, formula, and description.

components.name: Search Reactome Entity
components.description: Search Reactome entities by a query string, with optional filters for species and entity types, returning matching Reactome records from the Reactome knowledgebase.

components.name: Search Rhea entity
components.description: Search the Rhea database of expert-curated biochemical reactions by a query term and return matching reaction records such as Rhea IDs and reaction equations.

components.name: Search UniProt Entity
components.description: Searches the UniProt knowledgebase for entities matching a query term and returns matching protein records. Supports query aliases and a configurable result limit.

components.name: Search variant
components.description: Search for genomic variant records by TogoVar ID, gene, disease, genomic region, or allele frequency and return matching variant summaries.

components.name: TogoMCP Usage Guide
components.description: Returns the TogoMCP v6 Usage Guide, which provides instructions for classifying questions and following the recommended workflow for using TogoMCP tools, including entity analysis, database selection, and SPARQL query execution.

components.name: Check SQL
components.description: Validates and checks SQL query syntax before execution, returning a corrected version of the query if issues are found. Accepts an SQL query and optional database type.

components.name: Create CDM database
components.description: Create an empty CDM database as a SQLite file, optionally specifying the CDM version (5.4 or 6.0).
