components.name: Create Eunomia
components.description: Create a CDM database pre-installed with Eunomia data at a specified SQLite database path, supporting CDM versions 5.3 and 5.4.

components.name: Example query
components.description: Retrieves example queries for a specified OMOP CDM table from the OHDSI QueryLibrary, helping users understand query patterns for that table.

components.name: Get Engine
components.description: Get database engine for interaction and return an engine URL/type summary for the requested database type and host.

components.name: Get single table info
components.description: Get detailed information about a single OMOP CDM table including its columns and foreign keys. The tool requires a table name and optionally a CDM version (cdm54 or cdm6).

components.name: Get table columns
components.description: Get column names for a specific table in an OMOP Common Data Model database. It takes a table name and optional CDM version and returns the corresponding column names.

components.name: Get usable table names
components.description: Returns the list of usable table names in an OMOP Common Data Model (CDM) database based on the provided database connection settings.

components.name: Run SQL
components.description: Execute a SQL statement on a CDM database, optionally returning results from SELECT queries and configuring the database path and PostgreSQL schema.

components.name: Aggregation group provenance
components.description: Retrieve provenance information for an aggregation group from the Protein Data Bank using a group identifier.

components.name: Branched entity
components.description: Retrieves branched entity records from the Protein Data Bank using PDB entry and entity identifiers. Returns metadata and structural details for branched molecular entities.

components.name: Branched entity instance
components.description: Retrieve branched entity instance records from the Protein Data Bank using a PDB entry identifier and entity identifier.

components.name: Chemical component lookup
components.description: Retrieve a chemical component record from the Protein Data Bank using a component identifier, returning descriptive and structural data for the molecule.

components.name: DrugBank annotations
components.description: Retrieve DrugBank annotations for a chemical component from the Protein Data Bank. Given a chemical component identifier, returns DrugBank annotation records for that component.

components.name: Get residue chains
components.description: Retrieves residue chain information for a Protein Data Bank entry, taking a PDB entry identifier and returning the residue chains of that structure.

components.name: Non-polymer entity
components.description: Retrieve non-polymer entity records from the Protein Data Bank using an entity identifier.

components.name: Non-polymer entity instance
components.description: Retrieve non-polymer entity instance records from the Protein Data Bank using PDB entry and entity identifiers.

components.name: Pairwise polymeric interface description
components.description: Retrieve pairwise polymeric interface descriptions from the Protein Data Bank for a given PDB entry. The tool returns structural interface records describing interactions between polymer entities.

components.name: PDB Cluster Data Aggregation
components.description: Retrieves PDB cluster data aggregation for an entry identifier from the Protein Data Bank, providing aggregated structural cluster information.

components.name: PDB Cluster Data Aggregation Method
components.description: Returns the method used by the Protein Data Bank (PDB) to aggregate cluster data.

components.name: Polymer entity
components.description: Retrieve polymer entity records from the Protein Data Bank using a polymer entity identifier.

components.name: Polymer entity instance
components.description: Retrieve a polymer entity instance record from the Protein Data Bank, such as details for a specific polymeric chain instance in a structure entry.

components.name: Pubmed Annotations
components.description: Retrieves PubMed annotations for a Protein Data Bank entry using a PDB entry identifier.

components.name: Structural assembly description
components.description: Retrieves structural assembly descriptions from the Protein Data Bank using an assembly identifier.

components.name: Structure
components.description: Retrieve a macromolecular structure record from the Protein Data Bank by PDB entry identifier.

components.name: UniProt Annotations
components.description: Retrieves UniProt annotations for a protein record using an identifier.

components.name: Analyze sequence properties
components.description: Analyzes a protein's sequence properties from a UniProt code, including length, molecular weight, isoelectric point, and composition.

components.name: Get Disease Targets
components.description: Retrieves disease-associated targets, genetic constraints, and known drug associations from OpenTargets using a disease ontology ID. Results include target names, functional descriptions, tractability data, and disease-relevant drug associations.

components.name: Get Experimental Structure Details
components.description: Fetches experimental protein structure metadata from the RCSB Protein Data Bank for a supplied PDB ID, including the structure title, experimental method, resolution, atom count, release date, associated keywords, and a direct download link to the PDB structure file.

components.name: Get ligand SMILES from UniProt
components.description: Fetches metadata for non-polymer ligands co-crystallized with PDB structures associated with a UniProt ID. Returns ligand identifiers, names, chemical formulas, and SMILES strings from the RCSB Protein Data Bank.

components.name: Get Possible Diseases List
components.description: Queries the European Bioinformatics Institute REST API with a disease name and returns possible matching disease ontology terms, including EFO identifiers, for confirmation before downstream disease-target retrieval.

components.name: Get Virus Protein Details
components.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a viral protein from UniProt using its accession code, including organism, taxonomic lineage, host species, functional annotations, recommended protein name, complete amino acid sequence, and a reference link to the UniProt entry.

components.name: Get SNOMED CT Concept by Code
components.description: Fetch full details for a known SNOMED CT concept ID, including the preferred term, fully specified name, and all synonyms, from the SNOMED CT terminology service.

components.name: Get Related SNOMED CT Concepts
components.description: Navigates the SNOMED CT IS-A hierarchy for a concept, returning its parents, children, and siblings. Accepts a SNOMED CT concept identifier and outputs related concepts.

components.name: SNOMED CT Concept Lookup
components.description: Searches SNOMED CT for concepts matching a clinical term using prefix matching through a FHIR R4 terminology server. Accepts standardized clinical terminology as input and returns matching SNOMED CT concept records.

components.name: Get User Info
components.description: Returns information about the authenticated Azure user from OAuth token claims, including Azure ID and email, for the Azure FHIR MCP server.

components.name: Search FHIR
components.description: Search FHIR resources in Azure FHIR by resource type and optional search parameters, returning paginated FHIR searchset bundles.

components.name: Clinical trial study details
components.description: Retrieves detailed clinical trial study information by NCT identifier, with AI analysis of the study data.

components.name: Search ClinicalTrials.gov trials
components.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov for clinical studies by medical condition and intervention, returning AI-enhanced matching trial records.

components.name: FDA Adverse Events
components.description: Retrieves adverse event reports for a specified drug from the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System, with optional date range filtering and analysis.

components.name: FDA Drug Search
components.description: Search the FDA drug database by drug name and return drug records with safety analysis.

components.name: PubMed Paper Search
components.description: Searches PubMed for research papers using a query string and returns matching paper records with enhanced analysis.

components.name: Research clinical details
components.description: Provides detailed clinical trials analysis for a specific drug and medical condition, with optional filtering by trial phase and inclusion of completed trials.

components.name: Research competitive landscape
components.description: Analyzes the competitive landscape for a target medical condition, optionally considering competitor drugs and global data, to provide insights across all databases.

components.name: Research comprehensive analysis
components.description: Performs comprehensive drug analysis combining clinical trials, literature, and safety data based on a drug name and condition, with selectable analysis depth.

components.name: Research drug safety profile
components.description: Complete drug safety analysis across clinical trials and FDA reports for a given drug, with configurable timeframe and inclusion of trial and FDA adverse event data.

components.name: Research executive summary
components.description: Generate an executive summary for drug/condition analysis, taking a drug name and medical condition as inputs and producing a context-friendly summary with configurable token limits.

components.name: Research literature details
components.description: Provides detailed literature analysis for a specific drug and medical condition, with optional timeframe and publication type filters.

components.name: Research market details
components.description: Provides detailed market and competitive analysis for a specific drug or medical condition, with options to include competitor analysis and specify market scope (global, US, or EU).

components.name: Research safety details
components.description: Provides detailed safety and FDA analysis for a specific drug, including adverse event analysis and FDA approval information.

components.name: Bundle
components.description: Processes a FHIR Bundle supplied as a body string, with optional FHIRPath filtering and response mode selection, returning FHIR-structured output.

components.name: Capabilities
components.description: Retrieves the FHIR server's CapabilityStatement summary, optionally refreshing cached metadata first, and returns the server's available capabilities.

components.name: Code search
components.description: Expands LOINC and SNOMED value sets by resolving a code system key and applying a text filter, returning matching terminology codes.

components.name: Operate
components.description: Executes a FHIR operation against a configured FHIR server, accepting an operation body string and optional FHIRPath expression, and returning FHIR-formatted output.

components.name: Paginate
components.description: Fetches the next page of a FHIR Bundle response using a provided URL and returns the corresponding FHIR Bundle.

components.name: System history
components.description: Retrieves the system-level change history for FHIR resources using date and count parameters and returns an FHIR Bundle.

components.name: Terminology lookup
components.description: Performs FHIR CodeSystem/$lookup queries for a supplied code system and code, returning the resolved terminology details.

components.name: Firecrawl inspect research paper
components.description: Retrieve canonical metadata for a research paper using an arXiv, PMC, PMID, or DOI identifier. Returns the paper title, abstract, authors, categories, source identifiers, and dates as markdown.

components.name: Firecrawl read research paper
components.description: Retrieve in-body passages from an indexed research paper that are relevant to a supplied question. The tool accepts a canonical paper identifier and returns matching full-text passages when available.

components.name: Firecrawl related research papers
components.description: Find citation-graph candidates from one to ten seed paper identifiers, using a research intent to rank candidates. Returns ranked related-paper candidates and the evaluated pool size.

components.name: Firecrawl research paper search
components.description: Searches indexed biomedical, life-science, clinical, and scientific literature using a natural-language query with optional author, category, and date filters. Returns ranked papers with canonical IDs, titles, authors, and abstracts from sources including PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv, and arXiv.

components.name: Firecrawl Search
components.description: Searches the web and specialized indexes using a query and optional domain, category, location, and result-filter controls. Returns grouped ranked results with titles, URLs, and descriptions, along with an operation identifier.

components.name: Firecrawl search feedback
components.description: Records quality feedback for a prior search using its search ID, rating, valuable source URLs, missing-content topics, and optional query suggestions. The response reports submission status, daily-cap status, and whether a credit refund was applied.

components.name: AlphaGenome predictor
components.description: Predict the effects of a genomic variant on gene regulation using Google DeepMind's AlphaGenome. The tool accepts chromosome, position, reference and alternate alleles, with optional genomic interval and tissue selections, and returns predictions for gene expression, chromatin accessibility, splicing and promoter acti…

components.name: Article getter
components.description: Fetches detailed information for a biomedical article using a PubMed ID, PubMed Central ID, or DOI. Returns the title, abstract, available full text, and source information when available from PubMed, PubMed Central, or Europe PMC.

components.name: Article searcher
components.description: Searches PubMed and PubTator3 for biomedical research articles about chemicals, diseases, genes, variants, or free-text keywords, with optional preprints from bioRxiv and medRxiv. Gene searches can also include cBioPortal cancer genomics summaries.

components.name: Disease getter
components.description: Retrieve detailed disease information from MyDisease.info using a disease name or ontology identifier. Results include disease definitions, synonyms, ontology mappings, associated phenotypes, and links to disease databases.

components.name: Drug getter
components.description: Retrieves detailed drug and chemical information from MyChem.info using a drug name or identifier, including chemical properties, drug identifiers, trade names, clinical indications, mechanisms of action, and pharmacology details.

components.name: Fetch
components.description: Fetch comprehensive biomedical records for articles, clinical trials, genetic variants, genes, drugs, diseases, and NCI entities using identifiers such as PMIDs, NCT IDs, variant IDs, gene IDs, drug IDs, and disease IDs. Results are returned in a standardized format with optional sections for trial protocols, location…

components.name: Gene getter
components.description: Retrieves current gene annotations from MyGene.info using a gene symbol or Entrez ID, including official names, summaries, aliases, gene types, and links to external databases.

components.name: Get performance metrics
components.description: Retrieves performance metrics for BioMCP operations, either for a specified metric or for all collected metrics. The formatted report includes request counts, success and error rates, response-time percentiles, and domain-specific performance breakdowns.

components.name: NCI Biomarker Searcher
components.description: Searches the NCI Clinical Trials database for biomarkers used in clinical trial eligibility criteria, including gene mutations, protein expression markers, gene fusions, and other molecular markers. Accepts an optional biomarker name and type and returns matching biomarker records.

components.name: NCI Disease Searcher
components.description: Searches the National Cancer Institute's controlled vocabulary of cancer conditions and diseases using a disease name or category. Returns curated disease terminology, synonyms, hierarchical classifications, and standardized disease terms used in clinical trials.

components.name: NCI Intervention Getter
components.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for a specific intervention from the NCI Clinical Trials API using an intervention ID. Results include the intervention name and synonyms, type and category, mechanism of action when applicable, FDA approval status, associated clinical trials, and combination therapies.

components.name: NCI Intervention Searcher
components.description: Searches the National Cancer Institute's curated clinical trials database for interventions by name and intervention type, returning matching intervention records. The database includes drugs, devices, biological products, procedures, radiation, behavioral, genetic, dietary, and other interventions.

components.name: NCI Organization Getter
components.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific organization from the NCI Clinical Trials database using an organization ID, including names, aliases, contact information, organization type, research focus areas and associated clinical trials.

components.name: NCI Organization Searcher
components.description: Searches the National Cancer Institute's curated Clinical Trials database for organizations involved in cancer clinical trials using organization name, type, and location filters. Returns matching organization records.

components.name: OpenFDA adverse event getter
components.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific FDA adverse event report from the FAERS data available through OpenFDA, including reported patient, drug, reaction, outcome and narrative details.

components.name: OpenFDA adverse event searcher
components.description: Searches the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) through OpenFDA for drug safety reports using drug names or adverse reaction terms, with optional filtering for serious events.

components.name: OpenFDA approval getter
components.description: Retrieves detailed FDA drug approval information from the Drugs@FDA database using an NDA or BLA application number, including product details, submission history, marketing status, therapeutic equivalence codes, and pharmacologic class information.

components.name: OpenFDA approval searcher
components.description: Searches FDA drug approval records from the Drugs@FDA database using a drug name, NDA or BLA application number, or approval year. Returns application, sponsor, product, marketing status, approval date, and submission history information.

components.name: OpenFDA Device Getter
components.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific FDA medical device event report using an MDR report key, including device identification, event narrative, patient outcomes, manufacturer analysis and actions, and remedial actions.

components.name: OpenFDA Device Searcher
components.description: Searches FDA medical device adverse event reports in the MAUDE database using device name, manufacturer, problem description, or FDA product code. Results can be filtered to genomic and diagnostic devices.

components.name: OpenFDA label getter
components.description: Retrieves complete FDA drug prescribing information by label set ID, with optional selection of specific sections. Returns label content including indications, dosing instructions, warnings, precautions, clinical pharmacology, and related prescribing information.

components.name: OpenFDA Label Searcher
components.description: Searches official FDA drug product labels for prescribing information using a drug name, medical indication, or specified label section. Results cover documented label content such as indications, dosage, contraindications, warnings, interactions, and adverse reactions.

components.name: OpenFDA drug recall lookup
components.description: Retrieve detailed FDA drug recall information from the OpenFDA Enforcement database using an FDA recall number. Results include product identification, recall reasons, distribution details, recalling firm information, quantities, actions taken, and recall timelines.

components.name: OpenFDA Recall Searcher
components.description: Search FDA drug recall records from the Enforcement database using drug, classification, status, reason, and date filters. Results include recall classifications, reasons, product identification, distribution information, recalling firms, and current status.

components.name: OpenFDA Shortage Getter
components.description: Get detailed FDA drug shortage information for a specified generic or brand drug, including shortage timelines, reasons, affected manufacturers, alternative products, resolution status, and related notes. Data is updated periodically from the FDA shortage database.

components.name: OpenFDA Shortage Searcher
components.description: Search FDA drug shortage records by drug name, shortage status, or therapeutic category. Returns shortage status, dates, reasons, manufacturer information, and estimated resolution timelines from periodically updated data.

components.name: Biomedical search
components.description: Unified biomedical search tool that accepts a free-text query with optional domain and entity filters, including articles, clinical trials, variants, genes, drugs, diseases, NCI records, and FDA records. It returns matching results with identifiers, titles, text snippets, and URLs.

components.name: Think
components.description: Performs structured sequential thinking for biomedical research tasks using a current thought, its sequence number, an estimated total, and a flag indicating whether further thoughts are needed. It returns the result of the sequential-thinking process with the thought state.

components.name: Trial getter
components.description: Fetches comprehensive details for a clinical trial identified by its NCT ID, including protocol information, site locations, outcomes, and linked references.

components.name: Trial locations getter
components.description: Fetches contact and location details for a clinical trial using an NCT ID, including facility names and addresses, principal investigators, contact details, and recruitment status by site.

components.name: Trial outcomes getter
components.description: Fetches outcome measures and results for a clinical trial using its NCT identifier, including primary and secondary outcomes and reported adverse events. Results are available when posted for completed trials.

components.name: Trial protocol getter
components.description: Fetches core protocol information for a clinical trial identified by its NCT ID, including the official title, summary, study status, sponsor, design, eligibility criteria, and primary completion date.

components.name: Trial references getter
components.description: Fetches publications and references linked to a clinical trial using its NCT identifier, including published results papers, background literature, protocol publications, related analyses, and PubMed IDs when available.

components.name: Trial Searcher
components.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov for clinical studies using medical conditions, treatment interventions, additional terms, geographic location, recruiting status, study phase, participant characteristics, study type, and funder filters. Returns matching clinical trial records with paginated results.

components.name: Variant getter
components.description: Fetches comprehensive annotations for a genetic variant identified by an HGVS expression, rsID, or MyVariant ID. Returns gene location and consequences, population frequencies, ClinVar clinical significance, functional predictions, and optionally external annotations.

components.name: Variant Searcher
components.description: Searches MyVariant.info for genetic variant database records using gene symbols, HGVS expressions, dbSNP identifiers, genomic regions, consequence and prediction filters, and allele-frequency or clinical-significance criteria. Optional gene searches can include cBioPortal cancer genomics and OncoKB precision oncology…

components.name: Cancel workflow invocation
components.description: Cancel a running workflow invocation using its hexadecimal invocation ID and return cancellation status with updated invocation information.

components.name: Connect
components.description: Connects to a Galaxy server using a server URL and optional API key, returning connection status and user information.

components.name: Create history
components.description: Create a new Galaxy history to organize datasets and analyses. The tool accepts a descriptive history name and returns the created history record, including its identifier, name, and creation time.

components.name: Get history contents
components.description: Retrieves paginated datasets and dataset collections from a specified Galaxy history, with controls for pagination, visibility, deletion status, and ordering.

components.name: Get IWC workflow details
components.description: Retrieve comprehensive details for a specific Intergalactic Workflow Commission (IWC) workflow using its TRS ID. Returns workflow documentation, inputs, outputs, authors, tags, step count, tools used, license, and update information.

components.name: Get IWC Workflows
components.description: Fetches all workflow records from the IWC (Interactive Workflow Composer) workflow manifest and returns them in a Galaxy result.

components.name: Get tool citations
components.description: Retrieves citation information for a specific Galaxy tool using its tool identifier, including the tool name, version, and citation records.

components.name: Get Workflow Input Template
components.description: Builds a ready-to-fill input template and run guide for a Galaxy workflow identified by workflow ID, optionally using a history ID to surface compatible datasets. It resolves workflow slots through Galaxy's run model when available and falls back to the workflow export for static restrictions.

components.name: Recommend Biocontainer
components.description: Resolves a quay.io/biocontainers image for one or more conda packages, optionally pinned to specific versions. Returns the selected image together with match quality, source, notes, and verification status.

components.name: Recommend IWC workflows
components.description: Recommends ranked IWC bioinformatics workflows based on a natural-language analysis intent. The search uses BM25 ranking across workflow names, descriptions, readmes, tags, and tool names.

components.name: Run tool
components.description: Runs a specified Galaxy tool on datasets in a selected history using a history ID, tool ID, and formatted tool inputs. Returns job information and created output datasets or collections.

components.name: Run user tool
components.description: Run a user-defined tool in Galaxy using its UUID, a target history ID, and tool input parameters. The tool returns job information and output dataset handles immediately while the job runs asynchronously.

components.name: Search IWC workflows
components.description: Searches the Intergalactic Workflow Commission (IWC) manifest for bioinformatics workflows matching a query across workflow names, descriptions, tags, and readmes. Returns matching workflow records with metadata such as identifiers, descriptions, tags, step counts, authors, categories, and tools used.

components.name: Search tools by keywords
components.description: Recommends Galaxy bioinformatics tools from a list of keywords by matching tool names, descriptions, and accepted input formats. Returns recommended tool records.

components.name: Search tools by name
components.description: Searches the Galaxy tool catalog for tools whose name, ID, or description contains a supplied query, returning matching tool records with identifiers, names, versions, and descriptions.

components.name: Upload file
components.description: Uploads a local bioinformatics data file to Galaxy, optionally targeting a specified history. Galaxy detects common sequence, alignment, annotation, and tabular formats and returns created dataset and upload job information.

components.name: Upload file from URL
components.description: Uploads a file from a URL to Galaxy, with optional history, file format, genome build, and file name settings. Returns upload status and information about the created dataset or datasets.

components.name: BioMCP command
components.description: Run one read-only BioMCP command for biomedical entity discovery or workflow listing, with optional JSON structured output. The generic command-entry point rejects binary downloads and mutations and prefers typed tools.

components.name: ClinGen CSpec
components.description: Retrieves ClinGen CSpec manifests, pages, or attachment metadata for a gene of interest from the ClinGen CSpec resource.

components.name: BioMCP get
components.description: Get one biomedical record using typed inputs. Binary assets are CLI-only.

components.name: BioMCP search
components.description: Search biomedical entities using typed, bounded query inputs and return matching biomedical entity records.

components.name: Variant literature batch
components.description: Get compact literature shortlists for 1-10 variant identities.

components.name: ClinGen ERepo assertions
components.description: Get ClinGen ERepo expert assertions by CAid or gene.

components.name: ClinGen Allele Registry normalization
components.description: Normalize 1-50 RefSeq HGVS variant descriptions using ClinGen Allele Registry, returning normalized variant representations.

components.name: Compare variants
components.description: Compare multiple genetic variants side-by-side by fetching clinical label, pathogenicity score, gene, HGVS protein, consequence, and top-1 disruption for each variant ID in chr:pos:ref:alt format.

components.name: Get variant
components.description: Retrieves comprehensive information for a specific genetic variant by ID, including clinical significance, model-derived pathogenicity scores aligned to AlphaMissense/CADD/REVEL/SIFT, reference predictor scores, gene constraint, disease associations, protein domains, and AI-generated mechanistic interpretation.

components.name: Get variant annotations
components.description: Retrieves detailed annotation probe values for a given variant identifier, returning Evo 2 model predicted ref/alt/delta values across 325 biological annotations.

components.name: Get variant disruptions
components.description: Predicts top biological annotation disruptions for a given genetic variant using the Evo2 model, comparing reference and alternate allele predictions across 325 biological annotations and ranking affected molecular features by magnitude of change.

components.name: Search variants
components.description: Autocomplete-style lookup of genetic variants in the EVEE database using a gene name, rsID, or ClinVar variation ID. Returns at most six matching variant records.

components.name: Wait for variant analysis
components.description: Poll EVEE's on-demand variant interpretation until it completes or times out, returning a curated variant summary with wait status details.

components.name: Search abstracts
components.description: Search PubMed abstracts based on request parameters and return article title, abstract content, authors, journal name, publication date, DOI, and PMID.

components.name: Download PDF
components.description: Downloads a PDF file from a specified URL, typically an NCCN clinical guideline, using optional NCCN login credentials, and returns the local file path.

components.name: Get index
components.description: Retrieves the raw contents of the NCCN guidelines index YAML file, returning the full YAML content as a string.

components.name: Analyze Meal Nutrition
components.description: Aggregates nutrition for a meal from multiple foods, assuming 100 g per food, and returns per-food nutrition breakdowns together with a combined meal total.

components.name: Batch Interpret Lab Results
components.description: Interpret a full panel of laboratory results against LOINC reference ranges in one call. The tool accepts a JSON array of LOINC-coded values together with age and gender, and returns the batch interpretation.

components.name: Browse ICD Category
components.description: Browse the ICD-10-CM structure by chapter or 3-character category. Omitting the category enumerates categories with counts, while providing a category expands it into codes.

components.name: Check medical conflict
components.description: Fetches full metadata for one diagnosis code and one procedure code side by side for coding quality assurance and conflict analysis. Returns factual metadata only and does not provide a pass/fail verdict.

components.name: CRUD FHIR server
components.description: Perform controlled FHIR REST operations against an administrator-configured server, including metadata, read, search, create, update, patch, and delete requests. The tool builds standard FHIR paths from the selected operation and resource parameters; write operations require confirmation and must be allowed by the ser…

components.name: FHIR Build Bundle
components.description: Assembles a non-empty list of inline FHIR resources into a Bundle, wiring urn:uuid references between entries. The tool accepts a bundle type and optional context identifier and reports unresolved references as warnings.

components.name: FHIR ValueSet expansion
components.description: Expands a FHIR ValueSet identified by its identifier into member codings, resolving the expansion locally where possible and supporting optional package and version selection. Whole large external systems are not enumerated.

components.name: FHIR Resource Finalization
components.description: Finalize an LLM-filled FHIR resource draft using a specified profile by pinning mechanical fields, inferring single-system codings, wiring references, optionally generating narrative, and validating the result. The operation does not automatically loop.

components.name: FHIR Implementation Guide details
components.description: Provides details for a FHIR ImplementationGuide package, including its identity, dependencies, and per-resource-type artifact counts. The package is selected using a package identifier and optional version.

components.name: FHIR Get Profile
components.description: Returns a summary of a FHIR Profile / StructureDefinition identified by its identifier, including its identity, base definition, derivation, and element count. An optional package and version can be supplied to select the profile definition.

components.name: FHIR Profile Elements
components.description: Reads a FHIR Profile StructureDefinition snapshot and returns profile structure information through views for elements, individual elements, slices, choices, bindings, or examples. A profile identifier is required, with an optional element path, slice name, package, version, and result limit.

components.name: FHIR resource skeleton
components.description: Generates a blank, annotated fill-form for authoring a FHIR resource against a selected profile, including paths, cardinality, types, candidate codes, and optional examples. The tool accepts a profile with optional package and version selectors.

components.name: FHIR get ValueSet
components.description: Returns a FHIR ValueSet definition, including its compose block and metadata, without expanding the ValueSet. The lookup uses a ValueSet identifier and may accept a package ID and version.

components.name: FHIR List Artifacts
components.description: Lists FHIR implementation guide conformance artifacts as summary rows, including StructureDefinitions, ValueSets, CodeSystems, and examples. Results can be filtered by package, version, resource type, or grouping.

components.name: FHIR Implementation Guide Package Listing
components.description: Lists the FHIR Implementation Guide (IG) packages installed on this server using its listIgs service operation.

components.name: FHIR List Resource Profiles
components.description: Lists selectable FHIR implementation-guide resource Profiles, represented as constraint StructureDefinitions, grouped by base FHIR resource type. Results can be filtered by base resource type and optionally selected package and version.

components.name: FHIR lookup code
components.description: Looks up the display and definition for a terminology code identified by a system and code pair from locally held terminology. An optional package and version can constrain the lookup.

components.name: FHIR Normalize Code
components.description: Turns free text into ranked candidate codes for a target coding system or ValueSet using ConceptMap, lexical, and semantic matching. At least one of a value set or coding system must be provided.

components.name: FHIR Rank Resource Profiles
components.description: Ranks candidate FHIR resource Profiles by how many source-data field keys match each profile's element paths, with optional base type, package, version, and result-limit parameters. The results are suggestions only and require selection.

components.name: FHIR Resolve Reference
components.description: Mints or returns a stable urn:uuid reference for a logical key within a build context so FHIR resources can reference one another before finalization. The result includes the context identifier, reference, and optional resource type and display values.

components.name: FHIR Search Artifacts
components.description: Performs full-text searches of implementation guide artifacts using a keyword that can match artifact IDs, canonical URLs, names, titles, or descriptions. Optional resource type, package, and version selectors scope the returned artifact records.

components.name: FHIR Bundle validation
components.description: Validate a FHIR Bundle in-process by checking each entry resource against its meta.profile and verifying internal reference integrity.

components.name: FHIR validate code
components.description: Checks whether a code from a specified system is a member of a ValueSet. Returns valid, invalid, or unverifiable, with optional package and version parameters.

components.name: FHIR Resource Validation
components.description: Validate a FHIR resource against an ImplementationGuide profile in process. The tool accepts a FHIR resource and an optional profile for pre-flight validation and returns validation results.

components.name: Get drug asset links
components.description: Returns persisted drug asset metadata and runtime-generated MinIO download links, optionally filtered by license, asset, asset group, or latest insertion. Presigned URLs are null when MinIO is unconfigured.

components.name: Get Drug Details
components.description: Returns the canonical normalized drug record for one Taiwan FDA license, augmented with stage availability and document counts. Cancelled records can be included through an optional control.

components.name: Get FHIR Server Status
components.description: Get the status and configuration of one admin-configured external FHIR server using its server key. Returns the last stored probe without making a live call, and does not return secrets.

components.name: Get nearby codes
components.description: Retrieve the two ICD-10-CM codes immediately before and after a supplied code in alphabetical ordering. The results are ordering neighbors rather than semantic matches.

components.name: Get SNOMED Relationships
components.description: Retrieve non-IS-A clinical attribute relationships for a SNOMED CT concept, optionally filtered by relationship type. Results are grouped by relationship type and include human-readable labels, target concepts, and a relationship count.

components.name: Health check
components.description: Returns the runtime readiness of the MCP server and each module-backed service. Call this before a workflow to confirm that required services are online.

components.name: Identify unknown pill
components.description: Identifies Taiwan FDA drug records from space-separated pill appearance keywords. The keywords are matched conjunctively against appearance fields using a small color and shape synonym map.

components.name: Infer complications
components.description: Explore the ICD-10-CM hierarchy for a diagnosis code or category prefix. Parent codes expand to child codes, while leaf codes list sibling codes.

components.name: Interpret Lab Result
components.description: Interprets one laboratory result against an applicable age- and gender-stratified LOINC reference range using a LOINC code, measured value, age, and gender. Returns the reference range, measured value, and a normal, high, or low flag; reference values are general guidance only.

components.name: List FHIR servers
components.description: List admin-configured external FHIR servers available for MCP workflows, optionally including disabled servers. Returns server identity, capabilities, non-sensitive authentication metadata, and the last stored probe; secrets are never returned.

components.name: Query FHIR Condition
components.description: Generates a FHIR R4 Condition resource from exactly one of an ICD-10-CM code or a diagnosis keyword. The diagnosis-keyword path uses search-first processing and applies patient, clinical-status, verification-status, and severity fields, while the ICD-code path supports additional category, onset, recorded-date, and no…

components.name: Query FHIR Medication
components.description: Generate a FHIR R4 Medication or MedicationKnowledge resource for a Taiwan FDA (TFDA) drug using exactly one of a direct license ID or a keyword for search-first lookup. Resources are derived from normalized TFDA data only and do not use RxNorm.

components.name: Query Food Ingredient
components.description: Searches the Taiwan FDA food ingredient classification database by keyword, with an optional major-category filter. The search uses a hybrid BM25 and semantic retrieval method and returns matching food ingredient classification records.

components.name: Query food nutrition
components.description: Searches the Taiwan FDA food composition database for nutritional content per 100 g using hybrid BM25 and semantic search. Accepts a food name with an optional nutrient filter and can return either a flat lookup or a detailed nutrient panel grouped by category.

components.name: Query LOINC
components.description: Look up details for a known LOINC code or retrieve an age- and gender-stratified reference range. A LOINC code is required, and age is additionally required for reference-range queries; use the search_loinc tool for code discovery.

components.name: Query SNOMED CT concept
components.description: Fetches a SNOMED CT concept record by concept ID, with optional expansion of its IS-A hierarchy to include ancestor and child concepts.

components.name: Query SNOMED Mapping
components.description: Map between ICD-10-CM codes and SNOMED CT concepts in either direction. The keyword may be an ICD-10 code, a numeric SNOMED CT concept ID, or an English SNOMED CT term, selected with the mode parameter.

components.name: Search drug
components.description: Search Taiwan FDA drug records by drug name, ingredient, license ID, or ATC code using a keyword and selected search mode. Returns matching drug results with the mode, keyword, and cancelled-record inclusion status.

components.name: Search foods by nutrient
components.description: Ranks Taiwan FDA foods by their highest content of a specified nutrient per 100 g. Nutrient matching uses an alias map, partial ILIKE matching, and a semantic embedding fallback.

components.name: Search health supplements
components.description: Search Taiwan FDA certified health supplements using keyword queries, permit numbers, or disease names and ICD-10 codes. Keyword search uses hybrid BM25 and semantic search, while condition queries map conditions to benefit categories and return matching certified product records.

components.name: Search LOINC
components.description: Search LOINC codes and categories by keyword using code, category, specimen, or component modes. Code searches use hybrid BM25 and semantic search by test name, abbreviation, or analyte, with optional category filtering.

components.name: Search medical codes
components.description: Searches ICD-10-CM 2025 diagnosis codes and ICD-10-PCS 2025 procedure codes by keyword, returning relevance-ranked medical code records. Diagnosis searches use BM25 with vector-embedding reranking, while procedure searches use BM25 only; searches can return either code type or both under separate result keys.

components.name: Search SNOMED Concept
components.description: Searches the SNOMED CT International Edition for concepts matching an English term using hybrid BM25 and semantic retrieval. Returns up to the requested number of matching concepts with concept ID, fully specified name, preferred term, active status, and hierarchy tag; full detail is available through query_snomed_con…

components.name: Validate FHIR Condition
components.description: Validates a FHIR R4 Condition resource supplied as a JSON string for basic structural requirements, including resourceType, code, subject, and status presence. Returns whether the resource is valid and any parsing or validation errors.

components.name: Validate FHIR Medication
components.description: Validates the structure and core field semantics of FHIR Medication and MedicationKnowledge resources supplied as JSON. The basic validation checks resourceType, code.coding, and ingredient items, and returns validity and errors, including an error result for invalid JSON.

components.name: Add bibliography item
components.description: Add a single reference to a project bibliography using provided metadata fields such as title, authors, year, DOI, PMID, journal, volume, issue, pages, and abstract.

components.name: Add note to reference
components.description: Add a Markdown note to a bibliography reference identified by result_id in a local project, returning a note_id. Supports note categories including general, critique, summary, extraction, and methodology.

components.name: Copy CSL style to project
components.description: Copy a CSL style file from the shared library into a project directory, making the project self-contained for citation formatting. Accepts a style identifier and project path, and returns the destination path and style title.

components.name: Download CSL citation style
components.description: Download a CSL citation style from the Zotero Style Repository by style ID and save it to the local csl directory, automatically fetching dependent parent styles when applicable.

components.name: Bibliography export
components.description: Export the project bibliography to a bibliographic format (BibTeX, RIS, or CSL JSON) for use with Quarto/Pandoc citations. Takes an absolute project directory path and returns export status and file path.

components.name: Bibliography CSV Export
components.description: Exports references from a bibliography project directory to a CSV file, with optional custom output path and deduplication, and returns export status and file path.

components.name: Bibliography Excel export
components.description: Exports bibliographic references from a project directory to a formatted Excel workbook, with optional deduplication and custom output path.

components.name: Get Bibliography Annotations
components.description: Get stored annotations in a bibliography project, optionally filtered by reference ID, attachment ID, or highlight color; returns a list of annotations.

components.name: Get attachments
components.description: List all files attached to a bibliographic reference in a local project directory, using the project path and reference ID, and returns the total count and attachment list.

components.name: Get bibliography notes
components.description: Retrieve notes associated with references in a bibliography project directory, optionally filtering by result ID and note type. Returns the total number of matching notes and their content.

components.name: BibTeX import
components.description: Import references from a BibTeX file or raw BibTeX text into a bibliography manager project directory, returning a search ID for the imported references.

components.name: Import RIS references
components.description: Import references from an RIS file or raw RIS text into a project directory, returning a search identifier and import status.

components.name: Link file to reference
components.description: Links a PDF or other file to a reference in a bibliography project by attaching a file path and optional MIME type and label to a result_id, returning an attachment_id.

components.name: List CSL styles
components.description: List all citation styles available in the shared CSL library, returning style IDs, titles, and file names from the csl/ directory.

components.name: List bibliography searches
components.description: Lists all searches and imports recorded for a bibliography project, taking an absolute project directory path and returning the recorded search records.

components.name: Bibliography migrate to Zotero
components.description: Exports a local project bibliography to RIS or BibTeX for import into Zotero, transferring only bibliographic metadata and excluding notes and attachments. Accepts a project directory path and output format.

components.name: Bibliography reading list
components.description: Get a reading list view of references with file, note, and annotation counts for a bibliography project, optionally filtered by note type, attachment presence, or note presence.

components.name: Bibliography search
components.description: Search stored references in a project bibliography, with optional filters for source and query substring, and optional deduplication, returning matching reference records and a count.

components.name: Search bibliography annotations
components.description: Search annotation content and comments across all references in a local bibliography project using a text query, returning matching annotations and their reference titles.

components.name: Bib Search Notes
components.description: Full-text search across all notes in a bibliography project, accepting a project path and query term, and returning matching notes with their parent reference titles.

components.name: Store bibliography annotations
components.description: Stores annotations extracted from PDF attachments into a bibliography project, taking a project path, attachment and reference IDs, and a list of annotation records, and returning the number of stored annotations.

components.name: Bib Update Note
components.description: Update an existing note in a bibliography manager project by note ID, optionally replacing content, note type, and tags, and return the update status.

components.name: Check DOI
components.description: Validate whether a DOI exists and retrieve basic bibliographic metadata from Crossref, useful for verifying references are not hallucinated.

components.name: Draft Crossref search
components.description: Draft a reproducible CrossRef search script for user review by generating a standalone Python script from a bibliographic query and optional filters, without executing it.

components.name: Get references by DOI
components.description: Retrieves the reference list for a scholarly work identified by its DOI from the Crossref API, returning the source DOI and each reference with its DOI, key, and unstructured citation text.

components.name: Get Work by DOI
components.description: Retrieves full bibliographic metadata for a scholarly work from Crossref using a Digital Object Identifier (DOI).

components.name: Run search script
components.description: Executes a previously drafted Crossref search script, stores results in a project database, and exports them to Excel. Returns a summary with total count, search ID, result count, and Excel path.

components.name: Search works
components.description: Search CrossRef for bibliographic works using a free-text query and optional filters, returning metadata records such as type, publisher, ISSN, citation counts, URL, and abstract.

components.name: Search works scripted
components.description: Searches the CrossRef bibliographic database using a free-text query and optional filters, and saves a standalone Python script that can reproduce the search; returns matching work records and result count.

components.name: Draft Europe PMC search
components.description: Draft a reproducible Europe PMC search script for user review. Generates a standalone Python script based on the provided query and search parameters, without executing the search.

components.name: Get citations
components.description: Retrieves articles that cite a specified PubMed or PubMed Central article, identified by PMID or PMCID, and returns the citation count and a list of citing articles.

components.name: Get Full Text
components.description: Retrieve the full text of an open access article from Europe PMC using a PubMed Central ID (PMCID), returning the article's full text XML content.

components.name: Get references
components.description: Retrieves articles referenced by a given article (backward references) from Europe PMC using a source database (MED for PubMed or PMC for PubMed Central) and article ID. Returns total reference count and a list of referenced article citations.

components.name: Get text-mined terms
components.description: Retrieves text-mined annotations from an article in Europe PMC by PubMed Central ID, returning named entities such as genes, diseases, and chemicals grouped by type.

components.name: Run search script
components.description: Executes a previously drafted Europe PMC search script and stores results in the project database, returning a summary with total count, search ID, result count, and Excel export path.

components.name: Search Europe PMC
components.description: Search Europe PMC for biomedical and life sciences literature, accepting a query string that supports Europe PMC query syntax and returning article metadata such as year, abstract, open access status, citation counts, and publication dates.

components.name: Search Europe PMC scripted
components.description: Search Europe PMC using Europe PMC query syntax and save a reproducible Python script to the project, returning matching literature records and total count.

components.name: Draft OpenAlex Search
components.description: Drafts a reproducible OpenAlex search Python script for user review based on a query and optional filters. The generated script is not executed by this tool; the user reviews it before running it separately.

components.name: Get author works
components.description: Get an author's profile and publication list from OpenAlex using an OpenAlex author ID or ORCID.

components.name: Get Cited By
components.description: Get works that cite a given work (forward citations) from OpenAlex. Accepts an OpenAlex work ID and returns a total count and list of citing works.

components.name: OpenAlex concept search
components.description: Search the OpenAlex concept hierarchy for topics and fields of study. Accepts a query string and returns matching concepts with hierarchy level, work count, and related concepts.

components.name: Get references
components.description: Get works referenced by a given OpenAlex work (backward references), returning the total count and list of referenced works.

components.name: Get work metadata
components.description: Retrieve detailed metadata for a single scholarly work from OpenAlex using an OpenAlex ID, DOI, or PMID, returning bibliographic details and abstract when available.

components.name: Run search script
components.description: Execute a previously drafted OpenAlex search script to query scholarly literature, storing matching records in the project database and exporting them to Excel. Accepts a script path and project directory, and returns a summary containing total count, search ID, result count, and Excel file path.

components.name: Search sources
components.description: Search OpenAlex for journals, repositories, and other publication sources using a text query, returning matching source records with metadata.

components.name: Search works
components.description: Search OpenAlex for academic works such as articles, books, and datasets using a full-text query and optional OpenAlex filters, returning matching work records.

components.name: Search Works Scripted
components.description: Search OpenAlex for scholarly works using a full-text query and optional filters, save a reproducible Python script to the project, and return the total count and matching work records.

components.name: Export PRISMA checklist
components.description: Generates a PRISMA reporting checklist with completion status for a systematic review project. Accepts a project directory path and a checklist standard (PRISMA 2020, PRISMA-ScR, or MOOSE), and returns checklist items with section, item, and completion status.

components.name: Generate PRISMA flow diagram
components.description: Generates PRISMA 2020 flow diagram data from a project's screening flow, including all PRISMA boxes and their values, plus a Mermaid diagram string ready for rendering in Quarto or other visualization tools. Accepts an optional project path and uses the active project if omitted.

components.name: Get PRISMA status
components.description: Gets the current PRISMA flow status summary for a systematic review project, including screening counts at each stage.

components.name: Init Review
components.description: Initialize PRISMA tracking for a new systematic review by providing a title, optional protocol ID, review type, and project path, and returns a confirmation.

components.name: List reviews
components.description: List all projects under PROJECTS_ROOT that contain PRISMA review data, returning their review title, type, and path.

components.name: Record Deduplication
components.description: Record the deduplication step in a PRISMA systematic review flow, capturing before and after record counts and the deduplication method used, returning updated deduplication counts.

components.name: Record Screening Results
components.description: Records screening results for a PRISMA stage, capturing the number of included records and exclusion reason counts, and returns updated screening counts for the stage.

components.name: Record search
components.description: Records a database search performed during the PRISMA identification stage of a systematic review, capturing the database name, query, date, and number of retrieved records, and returns updated identification totals.

components.name: Set active review
components.description: Sets the active review project for the current session by resolving the supplied project path. Returns a confirmation containing the resolved path and whether PRISMA data exists.

components.name: Run search script
components.description: Executes a previously reviewed PubMed search script from a specified project directory. Search results are stored in the project database and exported to Excel, with counts, a search identifier, and the export path returned.

components.name: Build Search Query
components.description: Builds a PubMed Boolean search query from structured question elements (population, intervention/exposure, optional comparison and outcome, framework PICO). The query is constructed using MeSH terms and free-text synonyms combined with Boolean operators as a starting point for researcher review.

components.name: Draft PubMed search
components.description: Draft a reproducible PubMed search script based on a user-supplied query with optional date and publication-type filters, returning a structured draft for review without executing the search.

components.name: Fetch abstract
components.description: Fetches the full abstract and metadata for a PubMed article by its PMID using NCBI E-utilities EFetch, returning title, abstract, authors, journal, year, DOI, and MeSH terms.

components.name: Fetch MeSH Terms
components.description: Get MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) terms for a PubMed article by its PMID, returning the article PMID, title, and list of MeSH terms.

components.name: Get related articles
components.description: Find articles related to a given PubMed article using NCBI ELink neighbor_score. Accepts a PubMed ID and returns a list of related article summaries.

components.name: Search PubMed
components.description: Search PubMed and return article summaries. Accepts a PubMed query with optional filters for date range, article types, and maximum results; results are persisted to a project directory.

components.name: Search PubMed Scripted
components.description: Search PubMed and save a reproducible standalone script to the project for re-running, storing results in the project database and falling back to the standard search if script generation fails.

components.name: Suggest MeSH terms
components.description: Suggest MeSH terms for a provided keyword using ESpell spelling correction and a PubMed search. Returns a spelling suggestion and relevant MeSH terms to support controlled-vocabulary search strategies.

components.name: Export stored bibliography
components.description: Exports stored search results from a project directory to a bibliographic file in BibTeX, RIS, or CSL-JSON format, optionally deduplicating results.

components.name: Get stored results
components.description: Retrieves previously stored search results from a project database, with optional filtering by source and deduplication, returning total counts, the result list, and search history.

components.name: Draft Semantic Scholar search script
components.description: Drafts a reproducible Semantic Scholar search Python script for user review, taking a query, project path, and optional year, field, open-access, and limit filters; it does not execute the search.

components.name: Get author
components.description: Retrieves an author's profile from Semantic Scholar by author ID, including h-index, publication metrics, and recent papers.

components.name: Get citations
components.description: Retrieves papers that cite a given paper (forward citations) from Semantic Scholar using a paper ID, DOI, or PMID, returning metadata for each citing paper including title, authors, year, citation count, and open access status.

components.name: Get Paper
components.description: Get detailed metadata for a single paper from Semantic Scholar by paper ID, DOI, PMID, or ArXiv ID, returning abstract and TLDR.

components.name: Get recommendations
components.description: Get paper recommendations based on a set of seed papers using Semantic Scholar's recommendation engine. Accepts up to five Semantic Scholar paper IDs and returns a list of recommended papers.

components.name: Get references
components.description: Retrieves backward references for a specified paper from Semantic Scholar. Accepts a Semantic Scholar paper ID, DOI, or PMID and returns referenced papers with identifiers, titles, years, authors, citation counts, and open access status.

components.name: Run search script
components.description: Executes a previously drafted Semantic Scholar search script from a specified script path within a project directory, stores the returned search results in the project database, and exports them to Excel, returning a summary with counts and the export path.

components.name: Search papers
components.description: Search Semantic Scholar for academic papers using a query and optional filters for year range, fields of study, and open access. Returns paper metadata including citation counts, references, open access links, fields of study, and TLDR, and persists results to the specified project directory.

components.name: Search papers scripted
components.description: Search Semantic Scholar for academic papers and save a reproducible Python script to the project. Accepts a query string with optional year range, fields of study, open access, and result limit filters, returning matching paper records and total count while writing a standalone script that can re-run the search indepe…

components.name: BBT Auto Pin
components.description: Pin Better BibTeX citation keys for one or more Zotero items to ensure stable @citekeys in manuscripts. Accepts a list of Zotero item keys and returns the pinned status for each item.

components.name: BBT Cite-As-You-Write
components.description: Triggers Better BibTeX's Cite-As-You-Write picker in Zotero, allowing users to interactively select references. Returns the selected citation(s) in pandoc format.

components.name: BBT export
components.description: Export references from a Zotero library using Better BibTeX enhanced export formats, optionally filtered by collection key, returning formatted bibliography text.

components.name: Get BBT citation key
components.description: Retrieves the Better BibTeX citation key for a Zotero item by item key through the BBT JSON-RPC interface.

components.name: BBT search by citekey
components.description: Looks up a Zotero reference item using its Better BibTeX citation key by calling the Zotero local server API; returns the matching item records or metadata.

components.name: BBT status
components.description: Check if Better BibTeX (BBT) is installed and running in Zotero. BBT provides stable citation keys, enhanced BibTeX/BibLaTeX export, and the Cite-As-You-Write feature. Returns availability status and BBT version if available.

components.name: BBT Sync Bib File
components.description: Exports a Better BibTeX-managed .bib file from Zotero to a specified project directory, optionally scoped to a collection, and supports Better BibTeX, Better BibLaTeX, and Better CSL JSON output formats.

components.name: Build evidence table
components.description: Compiles Zotero annotations and notes into a structured evidence synthesis table, processing either explicit item keys or a whole collection, and returns a table suitable for systematic reviews.

components.name: Compare annotations
components.description: Compare annotations across multiple Zotero items side by side. Accepts a list of 2+ Zotero item keys and an optional color-to-category mapping, and returns per-item annotation summaries and cross-item analysis.

components.name: Detect Zotero storage
components.description: Detect and verify the local Zotero data directory by checking the ZOTERO_DATA_DIR environment variable and platform-specific default locations, then report the path, Zotero version, and storage statistics.

components.name: Export annotations report
components.description: Generate a Markdown report combining Zotero reader annotations and PDF-embedded annotations for a single Zotero item or an entire collection, based on a supplied item or collection key.

components.name: Extract annotations by color
components.description: Filters Zotero annotations for a given item by hex color or category, returning matching annotations with color, category, and comment text.

components.name: Extract highlights as evidence
components.description: Extracts all highlights from a Zotero item as a structured evidence table, combining Zotero reader annotations with PDF-embedded annotations. Takes a Zotero item key and optional color mapping, and returns rows with quote, page, color-coded category, and user comment.

components.name: Extract PDF annotations
components.description: Extracts annotations such as highlights, sticky notes, underlines, strikethroughs, and free text from PDF attachments of Zotero items, accepting an item key and returning annotation objects with content, page numbers, and colors.

components.name: Extract PDF figures
components.description: Extract metadata for embedded images and figures from the PDF associated with a Zotero item using PyMuPDF. Returns per-page figure dimensions and sizes for identification, not actual image data.

components.name: Extract PDF text from Zotero
components.description: Extracts full text from a PDF attachment associated with a Zotero item, given a Zotero item key and optional page numbers, returning page-by-page text content and metadata.

components.name: Get item reading progress
components.description: Reports reading progress for a Zotero item by comparing annotated pages to total pages in its PDF attachment, returning total pages, annotated pages, and coverage percentage.

components.name: Get local notes
components.description: Get all Zotero notes for a given parent item key from the local Zotero database. Works offline and returns a dictionary containing the item key and a list of note objects.

components.name: Get Zotero annotations
components.description: Retrieve Zotero reader annotations from the local Zotero database for a given PDF attachment item key, returning a list of annotation objects.

components.name: List local attachments
components.description: List all attachments stored locally for a Zotero item identified by its parent item key, returning attachment details including file paths from the local Zotero database.

components.name: Search annotations
components.description: Searches all Zotero reader annotations in the local library, including highlighted text and user comments, and returns matching annotations with parent item information.

components.name: Search PDF Content
components.description: Search for a keyword or phrase across all PDFs in the Zotero library. Performs case-insensitive text search through stored PDF files and returns matching items with page numbers and surrounding context.

components.name: Add item
components.description: Add a new reference item to the Zotero library using item type, title, creators, and optional bibliographic fields such as journal, DOI, abstract, URL, volume, issue, pages, and collection key; returns a result dictionary.

components.name: Add item by DOI
components.description: Adds a reference to Zotero by looking up its DOI through CrossRef to fetch metadata, then creates the item and returns its key and metadata.

components.name: Add Note
components.description: Attach a note to a specified Zotero item using the item key and note text, returning the created note's key and status.

components.name: Add related items
components.description: Link two items as related in Zotero (bidirectional) using two Zotero item keys; returns the status of the operation via the Zotero Web API.

components.name: Add to collection
components.description: Add an existing Zotero item to a specified collection in the user's Zotero library using item and collection keys, returning the operation status.

components.name: Batch add by DOI
components.description: Add multiple references to a Zotero library by their DOIs in a batch operation. The tool first returns a preview for confirmation and then imports the references, optionally into a specified collection.

components.name: Create collection
components.description: Create a new collection in the Zotero library with a required name and optional parent collection key, returning the created collection's key and name.

components.name: Delete tag
components.description: Remove a tag from all items in the Zotero library and return the number of items updated.

components.name: Download Attachment
components.description: Download a Zotero attachment file by its item key via the Zotero Web API, returning the file content as base64-encoded binary or plain text along with filename and content type.

components.name: Export bibliography
components.description: Export a Zotero bibliography in multiple citation formats such as BibTeX, RIS, and CSL JSON, optionally limited to a collection and with pagination support.

components.name: Export bibliography to file
components.description: Exports bibliography records from Zotero directly to a file on disk, with optional collection filtering and format selection.

components.name: Get Zotero annotations
components.description: Get all Zotero reader annotations for a PDF attachment using its item key.

components.name: Get attachment metadata
components.description: Retrieves metadata for child attachments of a Zotero item by parent item key without downloading files, returning filename, content type, size, and link mode.

components.name: Get collection items
components.description: List all items in a Zotero collection with full metadata, requiring a collection key and returning collection information plus bibliographic records.

components.name: Get collections
components.description: List all collections in the user's Zotero library, returning key, name, parent collection, and item count for each collection.

components.name: Get groups
components.description: List Zotero group libraries that the authenticated user belongs to, returning group identifiers, names, types, and member counts from the Zotero web API.

components.name: Get item by DOI
components.description: Look up an item in the user's Zotero library by its DOI, checking if the user already has a reference with that DOI. Returns the matching item record or a not-found status, without searching external databases.

components.name: Get Item Children
components.description: Get all child items (notes, attachments, annotations) for a Zotero item by item key, optionally including trashed items. Returns a dictionary with categorised child items.

components.name: Get item metadata
components.description: Fetches full metadata for a single Zotero item by its item key, returning all available fields including abstract, notes count, and related items. Queries the Zotero API to retrieve complete item metadata.

components.name: Get notes
components.description: Retrieves all notes attached to a Zotero item using its item key, returning note records with HTML content.

components.name: Get Related Items
components.description: Retrieves Zotero items linked via the Zotero 'Related' feature for a given item key by querying the user's Zotero library through the Zotero Web API, returning a dictionary with the source item key and a list of related items.

components.name: Get tags
components.description: List all tags in the user's Zotero library with usage counts, with an optional limit parameter (default 100, max 500).

components.name: Import from result store
components.description: Imports references from a project's search result database into Zotero by reading DOIs from search_results.db and batch-adding them to the user's library, with optional collection key, source filter, and deduplication controls. Returns an import summary with added, skipped, and error counts.

components.name: Rename tag
components.description: Renames a tag across all items in the Zotero library, taking existing and new tag names and returning the number of items updated.

components.name: Search group library
components.description: Search a specific Zotero group library by group ID and query string, returning matching bibliographic items while excluding attachments, notes, and annotations. The tool is read-only and interacts with the Zotero API.

components.name: Search library
components.description: Search a user's Zotero library by query across titles, creators, tags, and full text and return matching citation records with metadata such as journal, DOI, year, abstract, and tags.

components.name: Search notes
components.description: Search across all notes in the Zotero library for a keyword or phrase, optionally within a collection, and return matching notes with their parent item keys.

components.name: Tag item
components.description: Adds one or more tags to a Zotero item identified by its item key using the Zotero API, returning the operation status.

components.name: Update item metadata
components.description: Update editable fields on an existing Zotero item using its item key and optional metadata fields such as title, abstract, date, journal, DOI, URL, volume, issue, pages, and extra. Only non-None fields are updated, and the updated item record is returned.

components.name: Upload attachment
components.description: Upload a local file as an attachment to an existing Zotero item using the Zotero Web API file-upload protocol, returning the uploaded file's filename, content type, and base64-encoded content.

components.name: Download PubMed PDF
components.description: Attempt to download the full-text PDF for a PubMed article given its PMID. Returns a string indicating the result of the download attempt.

components.name: Get PubMed article metadata
components.description: Fetches metadata for a PubMed article using its PMID and returns a dictionary containing article metadata.

components.name: PubMed Advanced Search
components.description: Performs an advanced search of PubMed articles with optional filters for term, title, author, journal, and date range, returning matching article records.

components.name: Search PubMed key words
components.description: Searches PubMed for articles matching supplied key words and returns a list of article information, with configurable number of results.

components.name: Get article details
components.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific medical article from PubMed using its PMID.

components.name: Get Health Statistics
components.description: Retrieves health statistics and indicators from the WHO Global Health Observatory using a required health indicator query, with optional country filtering and result limit.

components.name: Health check
components.description: Checks the health and availability of upstream medical data sources, including FDA, TGA, Health Canada, EMA, PubMed, WHO, RxNorm, ClinicalTrials, Semantic Scholar, and TinyFish. Returns source statuses, latency, configuration details, circuit breaker states, and cache health.

components.name: List sources
components.description: Lists medical data sources and the MCP tools that reach them, including registry adapters and dedicated sources such as WHO, PubMed, RxNorm, and Scholar.

components.name: Rank search hits
components.description: Reorder already-fetched medical literature search hits for a general clinical question. The tool accepts a question and search hits containing titles and abstracts, and returns the ranked hits.

components.name: Search clinical guidelines
components.description: Search for clinical guidelines and practice recommendations from medical organizations by medical condition or topic, with optional filtering by a specific organization.

components.name: Search clinical trials
components.description: Searches ClinicalTrials.gov for clinical trial records using a query for a condition, intervention, or drug, with a configurable result limit.

components.name: Search drug nomenclature
components.description: Search for drug information by name using RxNorm, the standardized drug nomenclature, and return matching drug records.

components.name: Search drug safety
components.description: Search FDA pharmacovigilance data for drug safety records, including FAERS adverse events, recalls, and drug shortages. The tool accepts a drug name query and returns matching safety records.

components.name: Search drugs
components.description: Search for drug information from the FDA database by brand or generic name and return matching drug records.
