components.name: Search Google Scholar
components.description: Search for academic research articles using Google Scholar with a topic or research query.

components.name: Search medical journals
components.description: Search specific medical journals (NEJM, JAMA, Lancet, BMJ, Nature Medicine) for high-quality research using a medical topic or condition query, returning formatted journal search results.

components.name: Search medical literature
components.description: Searches PubMed for medical research articles based on a user-supplied medical topic or condition query, returning matching article records.

components.name: Search pediatric drugs
components.description: Search for drugs with pediatric labeling and dosing information from the FDA database by drug name.

components.name: Search Pediatric Guidelines
components.description: Search for pediatric guidelines from AAP Bright Futures and policy statements by medical condition or topic, returning matching guideline records.

components.name: Search pediatric literature
components.description: Search for research articles in major pediatric journals such as Pediatrics and JAMA Pediatrics using a medical topic or condition query. Returns formatted article results.

components.name: FHIR Create
components.description: Create a new FHIR resource in a FHIR R4-compliant EMR system such as Epic, Cerner, or Google Cloud Healthcare API, taking a resource type and resource data as input and returning the created resource.

components.name: FHIR Explorer
components.description: Interactive FHIR R4 resource browser that opens a UI to search, read, create, and update any FHIR resource type, with access to EMR systems like Epic, Cerner, and Google Cloud Healthcare API.

components.name: FHIR Read
components.description: Reads a FHIR resource by type and ID from a configured FHIR server.

components.name: FHIR search
components.description: Search FHIR R4 resources using query parameters against EMR systems such as Epic, Cerner, and Google Cloud Healthcare API. The tool accepts a resource type and query parameters and returns matching FHIR resources.

components.name: FHIR update
components.description: Update an existing FHIR resource in a FHIR R4-compliant EMR system such as Epic, Cerner, or Google Cloud Healthcare API.

components.name: Patient chart review
components.description: Opens a patient chart review dashboard displaying demographics, active conditions, medications, allergies, vitals, labs, and recent encounters for a patient's medical record.

components.name: Download Entrez data
components.description: Download records from NCBI Entrez databases using a list of identifiers, a selected database, and FASTA or GenBank format. The tool returns the fetched Entrez data as a raw string.

components.name: Download Entrez Data Locally
components.description: Download records from NCBI Entrez databases using a list of identifiers and save the data to a local file. The tool supports FASTA and GenBank formats and returns the saved file path and status.

components.name: Assess biomarker panel
components.description: Interpret a cardiovascular biomarker panel against clinical reference ranges by classifying each supplied biomarker value. Accepts optional numeric biomarker measurements and patient demographics, and returns classification results for the panel.

components.name: Assess Lp(a) status
components.description: Assesses lipoprotein(a) level in mg/dL to classify cardiovascular risk and returns interpretation, risk implications, and recommendations. If no Lp(a) value is supplied, recommends ordering the test.

components.name: Assess post-COVID cardiovascular risk
components.description: Assesses post-COVID cardiovascular risk using patient identifiers, COVID severity, and clinical history flags, returning a cardiovascular risk assessment with tier adjustment and workup.

components.name: Assess pregnancy complication cardiovascular risk
components.description: Assesses lifetime cardiovascular risk from a patient's adverse pregnancy outcome history using criteria from 2025 AHA/ACC and ESC guidelines. Accepts patient ID, complications, age and count of affected pregnancies, and severe COVID history; returns risk multipliers, risk category, and screening recommendations.

components.name: Assess renal drug constraints
components.description: Assesses cardiovascular drug safety based on eGFR and functional kidney count, determining whether drug classes such as statins, anticoagulants, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, metformin, and fibrates are safe, require dose adjustment, or should be avoided for patients with CKD or a single functioning kidney.

components.name: Calculate CVD PRS
components.description: Computes a polygenic risk score from a patient's germline genotype file by fetching the scoring file from the PGS Catalog, matching SNPs by rsID, and computing a weighted sum.

components.name: Calculate CVD risk scores
components.description: Calculates Reynolds, Framingham, and ASCVD 10-year cardiovascular risk scores from patient clinical parameters and returns the recommended primary score along with statin initiation guidance per 2018 ACC/AHA guidelines.

components.name: Calculate FH clinical score
components.description: Calculates the Dutch Lipid Clinic Network clinical score for familial hypercholesterolemia using LDL cholesterol, family history, physical signs, personal cardiovascular history, and optional genetic test information, returning the calculated score.

components.name: Calculate lipid treatment targets
components.description: Calculates LDL, ApoB, and non-HDL treatment targets and models a therapy pathway based on current lipid values, risk tier, and treatment status.

components.name: Generate preventive report
components.description: Generates a structured preventive cardiovascular health report by combining patient biomarker values, risk scores, genetic screening results, and evidence-based guidelines. Accepts a patient identifier and optional biomarker panel, risk scores, genetic screen result, and FH ruled-out flag, returning a structured clini…

components.name: Get lifestyle evidence
components.description: Retrieves evidence-based lifestyle interventions ranked by relevance, each citing the supporting landmark clinical trial. Accepts optional risk factors such as hypertension, LDL, or inflammation to filter the recommendations.

components.name: Interpret CVD PRS percentile
components.description: Map a raw polygenic risk score to a population percentile and clinical risk tier using PGS Catalog normalization data and Khera et al. 2018 thresholds. Accepts patient identifier, PGS ID, raw score, and ancestry; returns PRS percentile and risk tier.

components.name: Interpret lipid pattern
components.description: Classifies the clinical dyslipidemia pattern from a full lipid panel, treating the panel as a system rather than individual values. Accepts a patient identifier and optional lipid measurements (LDL, total cholesterol, HDL, triglycerides, non-HDL, apolipoprotein B) and returns a dyslipidemia pattern classification.

components.name: Search CVD PRS scores
components.description: Search the PGS Catalog REST API for published, peer-reviewed cardiovascular polygenic risk scores by trait. Returns score IDs, variant counts, ancestry information, and publication DOIs.

components.name: Classify cell states
components.description: Classifies cells from a segmentation mask and marker intensity image into proliferating, quiescent, or intermediate states based on marker expression thresholds. Returns cell state classifications from the local image inputs.

components.name: Classify Multi-Marker Cells
components.description: Classifies cells by multiple markers simultaneously for multi-marker phenotyping using a segmentation mask, multiple marker intensity images, and per-marker thresholds, returning phenotype assignments such as Ki67+/TP53-.

components.name: Generate phenotype visualization
components.description: Generates a cell phenotype visualization that colors segmented cells according to marker expression (positive vs negative), using an original microscopy image, segmentation mask, and marker-positive cell IDs.

components.name: Download CIBERSORTx deconvolution results
components.description: Download completed CIBERSORTx deconvolution results for a given job ID, returning cell-type fractions and summary statistics from the results CSV.

components.name: Get job status
components.description: Checks the status of a CIBERSORTx deconvolution job by polling the CIBERSORTx API. Accepts a job identifier and returns the current job state, progress percentage, and time estimates.

components.name: Run CIBERSORTx deconvolution
components.description: Runs CIBERSORTx cell-type deconvolution on a bulk RNA-seq expression matrix, submitting the mixture to the CIBERSORTx web API and returning estimated cell-type fractions per sample. Uses the LM22 signature matrix of 22 immune cell types by default.

components.name: Run mock deconvolution
components.description: Run local non-negative least squares (NNLS) deconvolution of bulk expression data using a signature matrix, returning cell-type fractions and summary statistics without requiring CIBERSORTx authentication.

components.name: Upload signature matrix
components.description: Upload a custom scRNA-seq-derived signature matrix (genes x cell types) to CIBERSORTx for use in deconvolution. Accepts a CSV file path and matrix name, and returns a matrix ID, gene count, and cell type count.

components.name: Generate segmentation overlay
components.description: Generates a segmentation overlay visualization by overlaying segmentation boundaries from a mask onto an original microscopy image, producing an output image to help validate segmentation quality and visualize cell boundaries.

components.name: Quantify Marker Intensities
components.description: Quantifies marker intensities per cell from a segmentation mask and associated marker images, computing mean, max, and min intensity for each marker. Produces a per-cell intensity CSV for downstream classification tools such as FlowSOM, Leiden, or scikit-learn.

components.name: Segment cells
components.description: Performs deep learning-based cell segmentation on microscopy images using DeepCell nuclear or membrane models. Accepts an image path and optional parameters and returns a segmentation mask path and the number of detected cells.

components.name: Deidentify Genomics File
components.description: De-identifies personally identifiable information (PII) from genomics file headers for VCF, H5AD, or CNS files, taking a file path and patient identifier and returning a de-identification summary.

components.name: Deidentify JSON
components.description: De-identifies a JSON clinical record by recursively detecting personally identifiable information (PII) with Haiku and replacing each entity with a deterministic anonymization code. Accepts a JSON string and patient identifier, and writes the anonymization key to disk using the patient ID.

components.name: Deidentify PDF text
components.description: Extracts the text layer from a PDF using pdfplumber and de-identifies it, returning deidentified text and detected entities. Accepts a PDF file path and patient identifier; it does not produce a redacted PDF and reports no_text_layer for scanned or image-only PDFs.

components.name: Deidentify text
components.description: De-identify plain text or DOCX content using a supplied patient identifier, returning deidentified text along with a key path and detected entity count.

components.name: Generate anonymization key
components.description: Retrieve or initialize a patient-specific anonymization key file, returning the key path and entity-to-code mappings without modifying existing mappings.

components.name: Validate deidentification
components.description: Validates de-identified patient content for residual PII using three layers: Haiku red-team prompt, regex sweep for structural patterns, and key reverse lookup against the patient anonymization key. Returns a pass/fail validation result.

components.name: Get patient conditions
components.description: Retrieves de-identified patient conditions/diagnoses from Epic FHIR API using a patient ID and optional category filter, returning Condition resources with ICD-10 diagnosis codes, clinical status, and severity.

components.name: Get patient demographics
components.description: Retrieves de-identified patient demographics from the Epic FHIR API using a patient ID. Returns hashed patient ID, gender, birth year, active status, and de-identification metadata.

components.name: Get patient medications
components.description: Retrieves de-identified patient medication information, including current and historical medications, from the Epic FHIR API using a patient identifier and optional status filter. Returns a list of MedicationStatement resources with medication names and statuses.

components.name: Get patient observations
components.description: Retrieve patient observations such as laboratory results and vital signs from the Epic FHIR API using a patient identifier and optional category or code filters. Returns de-identified observation data.

components.name: Extract UMIs
components.description: Extracts Unique Molecular Identifiers (UMIs) from FASTQ reads and adds them to read names for downstream deduplication. Accepts a FASTQ file path, UMI length and read structure and outputs a FASTQ file with extracted UMIs.

components.name: Fetch reference genome
components.description: Downloads a UCSC-style reference genome from UCSC goldenPath and verifies integrity via published md5sum.txt, with optional stronger validation against a VCF.

components.name: Query gene annotations
components.description: Retrieve gene annotation data from GENCODE, Ensembl, or RefSeq for a specified genome, optionally filtered by gene name or chromosome.

components.name: Validate FASTQ
components.description: Validates FASTQ format and computes quality statistics over a sample of reads from a supplied FASTQ file (optionally gzipped). Returns quality validation results including sampled and estimated read counts.

components.name: Assess CNV detectability
components.description: Assesses whether a copy-number variation effect could be detected before running a test, using tumor purity, region site counts, overdispersion, and sequencing chemistry parameters to compute a power-context result. The standard error is based on block count rather than site count.

components.name: Assess UM prognostic class
components.description: Assesses uveal melanoma prognostic class by integrating chromosome arm statuses, gene mutation statuses, gene expression class, and metastasis information into a single graded prognostic statement. Actionability is hard-coded to prognostic-only.

components.name: Calculate HR deficiency score
components.description: Calculate a simplified Homologous Recombination Deficiency (HRD) score from a somatic variants VCF file and a CNVkit .cns segment file by combining LOH, TAI and LST genomic scar signatures with BRCA mutation status. The tool returns an HRD score and warns that it is a simplified proof-of-concept and not clinical-grade.

components.name: Compare CNV architectures
components.description: Compares three copy-number architecture models for a supplied genomic region using AIC and likelihood ratio. Accepts region site data and optional candidate breakpoints, and returns the ranked model comparison with caution flags.

components.name: Detect library chemistry
components.description: Detects whether a BAM file represents an amplicon or hybrid-capture sequencing library. Accepts a BAM file path and optional sample region, and returns a library chemistry verdict that acts as a required gate for downstream copy-number tools.

components.name: Estimate Tumor Purity
components.description: Estimates tumor purity from clonal driver allele fractions using purity = 2 x VAF under assumptions of clonality, heterozygosity, and copy-neutral status, and returns purity estimates with assumptions and confidence grade.

components.name: Extract heterozygous sites
components.description: Extracts informative germline heterozygous loci from a VCF and groups them into haplotype blocks, using dbSNP membership and a purity argument to separate germline from somatic variants. Accepts a VCF, chemistry metadata, and optional BAM input.

components.name: Generate Genomic Report
components.description: Generate a comprehensive genomic report by parsing somatic VCF variants and CNVkit CNS segments, calculating HRD score, and aggregating actionable findings and therapy recommendations.

components.name: Parse CNV calls
components.description: Parses CNVkit .cns segment files, classifies copy-number segments as amplifications or deletions using log2 ratio thresholds, and annotates clinically relevant genes with therapy associations and prognostic information.

components.name: Parse Somatic Variants
components.description: Parses a somatic VCF file, filters variants by allele frequency, and annotates driver mutations with ClinVar/COSMIC IDs, therapy associations, and pathogenicity classifications, returning classified variants and therapy recommendations.

components.name: QC heterozygous sites
components.description: Decide which heterozygous sites may be used for copy-number inference by applying three rules and an overdispersion fit to supplied sites and sequencing chemistry parameters.

components.name: Test allelic imbalance
components.description: Tests one genomic region for allelic imbalance against a copy-neutral null using a latent-sign beta-binomial mixture and resampling of whole haplotype blocks. Accepts region sites and a copy-neutral pool and returns a significance statistic.

components.name: Download GEO expression matrix
components.description: Downloads a GEO Series Matrix expression file from GEO FTP servers for a given GEO Series accession, returning download status and file path.

components.name: Download SRA FASTQ
components.description: Downloads raw FASTQ sequencing reads from NCBI SRA using sra-tools (prefetch and fasterq-dump) for a given SRA Run accession, returning download status and output file paths.

components.name: Get GEO metadata
components.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) dataset using a GEO Series accession (GSE ID), including title, summary, platform, sample count, submission date, and supplementary file URLs.

components.name: Get GEO SOFT file
components.description: Download the raw SOFT file for a GEO dataset by GEO Series accession, returning file info with metadata, platform annotations, sample descriptions, and raw data values.

components.name: List GEO samples
components.description: List all samples (GSMs) in a specified GEO Series (GSE), returning sample accessions, titles, source tissue, and characteristics.

components.name: Search GEO datasets
components.description: Search NCBI GEO DataSets for gene expression datasets using NCBI Entrez E-utilities. Accepts a query string with optional organism and study type filters, and returns matching dataset records with accession IDs, titles, and summaries.

components.name: Link spatial to clinical
components.description: Links a spatial transcriptomics sample and patient identifier with a tissue biopsy site to return linked clinical and spatial metadata.

components.name: Query patient records
components.description: Retrieve mock patient demographics and clinical data including diagnoses, laboratory results, and medication history using a patient identifier.

components.name: Search diagnoses
components.description: Queries ICD-10 diagnosis codes by specific code or keyword and returns matching diagnoses with code and description.

components.name: Compare to cohort
components.description: Compares sample gene expression values against a selected TCGA cohort using statistical tests such as t-test, Wilcoxon, or z-score. Takes a gene-expression dictionary, cohort, gene list, and test method, and returns statistical comparison results.

components.name: Fetch expression data
components.description: Download gene expression data from TCGA for a specified cohort and gene list, returning an expression matrix and sample metadata.

components.name: Get Mutation Data
components.description: Retrieves mutation frequencies and types for a specified TCGA cohort and list of genes. Returns a dictionary with simulated mutation data.

components.name: Get survival data
components.description: Retrieve survival data correlated with gene expression for a given TCGA cohort and gene symbol, returning survival curves and statistics.

components.name: Query TCGA cohorts
components.description: Search TCGA datasets by cancer type and tissue to return matching cancer cohorts with sample counts.

components.name: Calculate Stouffer Meta
components.description: Combines p-values across omics modalities using Stouffer's Z-score method, taking nominal p-values and optional effect sizes and weights to produce meta-analysis p-values with correct FDR timing.

components.name: Create multiomics heatmap
components.description: Creates an integrated heatmap visualization from multi-omics data with hierarchical clustering and annotation tracks for treatment groups and data modalities.

components.name: Estimate analysis cost
components.description: Estimate computational cost for multi-omics analysis before execution based on the number of samples, specified modalities, and optional inclusion of HAllA association testing and upstream regulator prediction. Returns a dictionary with cost estimates and breakdown.

components.name: Integrate Omics Data
components.description: Integrates RNA expression, protein abundance, and phosphorylation data by aligning samples across modalities, handling missing data, and performing normalization. Accepts file paths to tabular datasets and returns an integrated multi-omics data structure.

components.name: Predict upstream regulators
components.description: Predict upstream regulators such as kinases, transcription factors, and drugs from differential expression data using enrichment-based methods similar to IPA Upstream Regulator Analysis.

components.name: Preprocess multiomics data
components.description: Preprocess multi-omics data with normalization, batch correction, and imputation, addressing batch effects, missing values, and sample name harmonization. Accepts RNA and optional protein, phosphoproteomics, and metadata file paths and returns preprocessed multi-omics results.

components.name: Run HAllA analysis
components.description: Run HAllA hierarchical all-against-all association testing between features from two omics modalities, applying hierarchical clustering and statistical testing with chunking for large datasets. Returns nominal p-values for associations.

components.name: Run Multiomics PCA
components.description: Runs principal component analysis (PCA) on integrated multi-omics data from a user-supplied file path, optionally restricted to selected modalities. Returns PCA results for dimensionality reduction and sample clustering visualization.

components.name: Validate multi-omics data
components.description: Validate multi-omics data quality and consistency before integration by checking sample name consistency, missing value patterns, batch effects, and outliers. Accepts file paths for RNA expression, protein abundance, phospho, and metadata data, and returns a validation report.

components.name: Visualize data quality
components.description: Generates quality control visualizations for multi-omics data, including PCA, correlation heatmaps, and missing value patterns. Accepts data file paths keyed by modality and returns QC plots to verify preprocessing and batch correction effectiveness.

components.name: Estimate neoantigen burden
components.description: Estimates neoantigen burden from tumor mutational burden (TMB) using published TMB-to-neoantigen conversion factors. Accepts TMB mutations per megabase, optional HLA alleles, and cancer type, and returns the estimated number of neoantigens.

components.name: Get HLA typing from RNA
components.description: Determines HLA class I alleles from RNA-seq BAM data using OptiType, returning HLA alleles, method, and confidence score.

components.name: MHC class I binding prediction
components.description: Predicts MHC class I binding affinity for peptide-HLA pairs using the IEDB API. Accepts peptide sequences and HLA class I alleles, and classifies peptides as strong binders, weak binders, or non-binders.

components.name: Predict MHC class II binding
components.description: Predicts MHC class II binding affinity for peptide-HLA pairs using the IEDB API. Accepts peptide sequences and HLA class II alleles and returns binding predictions, strong binders, and vaccine candidates.

components.name: pVACseq neoantigen prediction
components.description: Runs the pVACseq neoantigen prediction pipeline using a somatic VCF file and patient HLA alleles. The tool predicts neoantigens locally with pVACtools or via the IEDB API.

components.name: Score Antigen Presentation Pathway
components.description: Scores the antigen presentation pathway for immunotherapy responsiveness by integrating neoantigen count, MHC class I expression, TAP1/TAP2/B2M expression, and HLA LOH into a composite pathway score (0-1).

components.name: Extract image features
components.description: Extracts computer vision features (texture, morphological, or intensity) from histology images, optionally restricted to regions of interest. Returns a feature dictionary for downstream analysis and correlation with spatial expression.

components.name: Fetch histology image
components.description: Retrieve tissue histology images by image ID, with options for H&E or immunofluorescence staining and high, medium, or low resolution, returning image path, dimensions, and file size for spatial transcriptomics integration.

components.name: Generate H&E annotation
components.description: Generates an annotated H&E morphology visualization by overlaying necrotic and high-cellularity region annotations on an H&E histology image, returning the annotated image.

components.name: Generate multiplex composite
components.description: Generate an RGB composite image from multiplex immunofluorescence channels by combining grayscale TIFF channel images for visualization of fluorescent markers.

components.name: Register image to spatial
components.description: Align histology images with spatial coordinates using affine, rigid, or deformable registration methods. Takes a histology image path and a spatial coordinates file, and outputs a registered image.

components.name: Batch score targets
components.description: Score multiple gene targets against a disease using the Open Targets Platform, returning association scores and druggable/novel target classifications for a list of gene symbols and an EFO disease ID.

components.name: Get target disease associations
components.description: Get association evidence scores between a gene target and a disease from the Open Targets Platform, including overall and per-datasource evidence scores for literature, RNA expression, genetic association, somatic mutation, known drug, animal model, and affected pathway.

components.name: Get target drugs
components.description: Retrieve approved and in-trial drugs targeting a specific gene from Open Targets, including drug name, clinical phase, approval status, mechanism of action, and indications.

components.name: Get target info
components.description: Look up gene and target information, including approved symbol, name, description, biotype, and tractability assessments, from Open Targets using a gene symbol or Ensembl ID.

components.name: Target safety lookup
components.description: Retrieves safety liability, organ-specific risk, and adverse event frequency profiles for a given gene symbol from the Open Targets Platform.

components.name: Search targets by disease
components.description: Search Open Targets for genes most strongly associated with a disease, using an EFO disease ID and optional evidence type filter, and returns ranked gene targets with association scores.

components.name: Approve Patient Report
components.description: Approve a draft patient report after clinician review, marking it as reviewed and approved, removing the draft watermark, updating the report status, and preserving the original draft for audit. Accepts the report file path and reviewer name.

components.name: Check PDF capability
components.description: Checks whether PDF generation is available in the environment, reporting whether WeasyPrint is functional and whether output will be PDF or HTML fallback.

components.name: Generate patient report
components.description: Generate a patient-facing summary report from analysis results, including diagnosis explanations, genomic findings with actionability, treatment options with evidence levels, monitoring plans and support resources, with an optional Evidence Strength Summary table.

components.name: Get report template schema
components.description: Retrieves the JSON schema for PatientReportData, including required and optional sections and an example structure, to guide construction of report data.

components.name: Validate report data
components.description: Validates PatientReportData JSON without generating a report, checking structure and returning validity, errors, warnings, and a summary to help ensure data is correctly structured before report generation.

components.name: Perturbation compute delta
components.description: Calculates predicted gene expression changes caused by a perturbation using the GEARS graph neural network. Accepts a model name, source cell type, and treatment key as inputs.

components.name: Perturbation differential expression
components.description: Compares baseline and predicted cell state expression profiles to identify genes with significant expression changes. Accepts file paths to baseline and predicted AnnData (h5ad) matrices and returns differential expression results, optionally limited to a specified number of top genes.

components.name: Perturbation Get Latent
components.description: Extracts graph neural network node embeddings from a GEARS model for visualization using a model name and single-cell expression data path.

components.name: Perturbation load dataset
components.description: Loads scRNA-seq datasets from GEO or local files and preprocesses them with normalization and highly variable gene selection for GEARS training.

components.name: Perturbation Predict Response
components.description: Predicts how cells respond to genetic perturbations using learned gene regulatory network relationships via the GEARS graph neural network. Accepts a trained model name or a dataset identifier and returns a predicted treatment response with perturbation details.

components.name: Perturbation setup model
components.description: Initialize a GEARS graph neural network model architecture for learning perturbation responses using gene-gene relationship networks. Accepts a JSON parameter string with dataset_id, hidden_size, and model_name, and returns a JSON string with status or model configuration.

components.name: Perturbation train model
components.description: Train a GEARS graph neural network on perturbation data to learn perturbation responses using gene regulatory network knowledge, given model training parameters and returning training metrics.

components.name: Perturbation Visualize
components.description: Generates PCA or UMAP plots comparing cell states before and after predicted perturbation. Takes baseline and predicted h5ad files as input and produces a visualization plot.

components.name: Analyze TLS quantum signature
components.description: Analyzes quantum signatures of tertiary lymphoid structures (TLS) in AnnData single-cell data using trained embeddings and TLS marker cell types; identifies TLS candidates and computes their quantum fidelity patterns.

components.name: Compute cell type fidelity
components.description: Computes quantum fidelity scores between cells using trained quantum embeddings from an AnnData file and embedding ID, with optional uncertainty quantification.

components.name: Export for downstream
components.description: Export trained quantum embeddings for downstream analysis in one or more formats (numpy, json, pytorch, anndata), returning status and file paths.

components.name: Identify immune evasion states
components.description: Identifies cells in immune evasion states from single-cell expression data by detecting low fidelity to canonical immune cell types. Accepts an AnnData file, embedding ID, and immune cell type list, and optionally returns classification confidence scores.

components.name: Learn spatial cell embeddings
components.description: Learns cell type embeddings from spatial transcriptomics data using quantum circuit representations (mock/synthetic mode). Accepts an AnnData path and returns an embedding summary saved to memory cache.

components.name: Predict Perturbation Effect
components.description: Predicts the effect of drug, genetic, or environmental perturbations on cell type fidelity using single-cell AnnData and trained embeddings.

components.name: Align spatial data
components.description: Aligns paired spatial transcriptomics FASTQ reads to a reference genome using the STAR aligner, producing BAM files with spatial barcode tags.

components.name: Calculate spatial autocorrelation
components.description: Calculate Moran's I spatial autocorrelation statistics for gene expression from user-provided spatial expression data and gene list, returning Moran's I, z-score, and p-value.

components.name: Deconvolve cell types
components.description: Estimate cell type proportions from bulk spatial transcriptomics data using signature-based deconvolution of marker gene expression. Takes a spatial expression matrix file and returns relative abundance of cell types for each spatial spot.

components.name: Filter quality
components.description: Filters spatial transcriptomics data based on quality metrics including read count, gene count, and mitochondrial gene percentage. Accepts a spatial data file (CSV or H5) and writes filtered output files.

components.name: Generate gene expression heatmap
components.description: Generate a gene-by-region heatmap from a gene expression CSV and region annotation CSV, showing mean expression of selected genes across different tissue regions.

components.name: Generate region composition chart
components.description: Generate a bar chart showing the number of spatial spots per annotated tissue region from a CSV file with spot IDs and region labels. This visualizes the distribution of spots across tissue regions to support assessment of tissue composition and sampling coverage.

components.name: Generate spatial heatmap
components.description: Generates spatial heatmaps showing gene expression overlaid on tissue coordinates. Takes a gene expression CSV, spatial coordinates CSV, and a list of genes, and creates heatmap plots for each gene to visualize spatial expression patterns and regional differences.

components.name: Get spatial data for patient
components.description: Retrieves spatial transcriptomics data for a patient and tissue type, enriched with clinical FHIR context from mcp-epic such as conditions, medications, and biomarkers. Returns genes of interest, suggested analyses, and condition/medication gene mappings.

components.name: Merge tiles
components.description: Combine multiple spatial transcriptomics tile files into a single dataset, resolving overlapping regions with a chosen overlap resolution method and producing a unified expression matrix. Accepts a list of tile file paths and an output file path.

components.name: Perform batch correction
components.description: Perform batch correction across multiple expression matrix files using ComBat, Harmony, or Scanorama, writing a corrected expression matrix and returning batch correction metrics.

components.name: Differential expression analysis
components.description: Perform differential expression analysis between sample groups using scipy statistical testing and FDR correction. Accepts a CSV expression matrix with spots as rows and genes as columns, plus group sample IDs, and returns differential expression results.

components.name: Perform pathway enrichment
components.description: Performs pathway enrichment analysis on a supplied gene list using selected pathway databases such as GO Biological Process, KEGG, Reactome or Hallmark, returning enriched pathways and statistics.

components.name: Resolve patient data paths
components.description: Given a patient identifier, resolves expected file paths for spatial transcriptomics, genomic variants, and multi-omics data and checks which files exist on disk.

components.name: Set patient context
components.description: Sets clinical context for a patient by mapping conditions, medications, and biomarkers to genes of interest and suggested spatial analyses. Use before running spatial tools to receive context-aware recommendations.

components.name: Split spatial data by region
components.description: Split spatial transcriptomics data into region-specific outputs based on spatial coordinates or predefined regions of interest using an input spatial data file and optional coordinate file.

components.name: Visualize spatial autocorrelation
components.description: Generate a bar chart of Moran's I spatial autocorrelation statistics for genes, sorted by autocorrelation strength, and return a result dictionary with chart status or file information.

components.name: ACC list guidelines
components.description: List recent American College of Cardiology (ACC) clinical practice guidelines published in JACC and other ACC journals, sorted by date. Returns guideline records with DOI, journal, and publication date metadata.

components.name: Activity infer ULM
components.description: Infers transcription-factor and pathway activities from per-gene statistics and a regulatory network using decoupleR's univariate linear model (ULM). Returns per-source activity scores (slope t-values) and p-values.

components.name: ADA Standards section fetch
components.description: Fetches detailed content from a specific ADA Standards of Care section by PubMed ID (PMID), returning title, abstract, full-text snippet when available via PubMed Central, and links.

components.name: ADA list standards sections
components.description: Lists the sections and chapters of the ADA Standards of Medical Care in Diabetes for a specified year, returning section titles, numbers, PMIDs, and PMC links.

components.name: ADA Search Standards
components.description: Searches PubMed for American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines and publications by topic. Accepts a search query and returns publication records with title, abstract, PMID, and PMC link.

components.name: Addgene get plasmid
components.description: Get detailed information about a specific Addgene plasmid by its catalog ID, including cloning details, insert information, bacterial resistance, growth conditions, article references, and depositor comments.

components.name: Addgene depositor search
components.description: Searches the Addgene repository for depositors (PIs / principal investigators) by name or institution and returns depositor records with plasmid counts and example plasmids.

components.name: Addgene Search Plasmids
components.description: Searches Addgene's plasmid repository by plasmid name or keyword and optional organism, returning plasmid records with name, ID, purpose, depositor, genes, species, vector types, and expression systems.

components.name: ADMETAI Predict BBB Penetrance
components.description: Predicts blood-brain barrier (BBB) penetrance for one or more molecules provided as SMILES strings.

components.name: ADMETAI Predict Bioavailability
components.description: Predicts bioavailability endpoints (Bioavailability_Ma, HIA_Hou, PAMPA_NCATS, Caco2_Wang, Pgp_Broccatelli) for one or more molecules provided as SMILES strings.

components.name: ADMETAI Predict Clearance Distribution
components.description: Predicts clearance and distribution endpoints (Clearance_Hepatocyte_AZ, Clearance_Microsome_AZ, Half_Life_Obach, VDss_Lombardo, PPBR_AZ) for a list of molecules provided as SMILES strings.

components.name: ADMETAI Predict CYP interactions
components.description: Predicts CYP enzyme interactions for a given list of molecules in SMILES format, returning interaction predictions.

components.name: ADMETAI Predict Nuclear Receptor Activity
components.description: Predicts nuclear receptor activity endpoints (NR-AR-LBD, NR-AR, NR-AhR, NR-Aromatase, NR-ER-LBD, NR-ER, NR-PPAR-gamma) for molecules provided as SMILES strings.

components.name: ADMET-AI Predict Physicochemical Properties
components.description: Predicts physicochemical properties for molecules provided as SMILES strings using ADMET-AI, returning values such as molecular weight, logP, hydrogen bond acceptors/donors, Lipinski, QED, stereo centers, and TPSA.

components.name: ADMETAI predict solubility lipophilicity hydration
components.description: Predicts solubility, lipophilicity, and hydration free energy for molecules supplied as SMILES strings, returning ADMET endpoint predictions.

components.name: ADMETAI predict stress response
components.description: Predicts stress response endpoints (SR-ARE, SR-ATAD5, SR-HSE, SR-MMP, SR-p53) for a given molecule or list of molecules in SMILES format.

components.name: ADMETAI Predict Toxicity
components.description: Predicts toxicity endpoints (AMES, Carcinogens_Lagunin, ClinTox, DILI, LD50_Zhu, Skin_Reaction, hERG) for molecules supplied as SMILES strings.

components.name: ADMETAnalyzerAgent
components.description: AI agent that analyzes ADMET data and provides insights on drug-likeness and safety profiles for compounds, incorporating disease context.

components.name: Advanced Literature Search Agent
components.description: Advanced multi-agent deep literature search system that plans focused queries, searches multiple scholarly databases in parallel, deduplicates and scores results, and generates a synthesized literature report strictly from searched results.

components.name: AdverseEventICDMapper
components.description: Extracts adverse events from narrative clinical or pharmacovigilance text and maps each event to the most specific ICD-10-CM code.

components.name: Adverse event prediction question generator
components.description: Generates a set of personalized adverse-event prediction questions for a given disease and drug, across multiple patient subgroups, including a broad safety question and population-specific extensions.

components.name: Adverse Event Prediction Question Generator With Context
components.description: Generates personalized adverse-event prediction questions for a given disease and drug, incorporating context information such as patient medical history, clinical findings, or research data. The tool takes a disease name, drug name, and context information and returns a hierarchy of personalized adverse-event predict…

components.name: Aging cohort search
components.description: Search a curated registry of approximately 30 longitudinal cohort studies relevant to aging research using keyword query and filters such as country, study design, and sample size, returning matching study metadata including design, variables, and data access information.

components.name: AHA/ACC guideline retrieval
components.description: Fetch the full text or abstract of a specific AHA or ACC guideline from PubMed Central using its PMID, returning the abstract and, for open-access PMC articles, up to 6000 characters of full guideline text including recommendations, evidence tables, and rationale.

components.name: AHA ACC guideline search
components.description: Search AHA and ACC clinical practice guidelines by topic via PubMed, returning matching guideline records with publication date, PMC URL, and full-text snippet for cardiovascular conditions.

components.name: AHA List Guidelines
components.description: Lists recent American Heart Association (AHA) clinical practice guidelines and scientific statements from Circulation and other AHA journals, with optional filtering by publication year.

components.name: AllenBrain get expression datasets
components.description: Retrieves gene expression experiment datasets from the Allen Mouse Brain Atlas for a given gene symbol or acronym, returning section datasets with plane of section, thickness, and linked gene information including ISH images.

components.name: Allen Brain structure lookup
components.description: Get detailed information about a brain structure from the Allen Brain Atlas by its structure ID, including name, hierarchy path, parent structure, and color code.

components.name: AllenBrain get structure expression values
components.description: Retrieves quantified per-structure gene-expression values for one Allen Mouse Brain ISH experiment (SectionDataSet). Returns expression_energy, expression_density, sum_expressing_pixels, and the structure record for each annotated brain structure.

components.name: Allen Brain search genes
components.description: Search for genes in the Allen Brain Atlas by gene symbol/acronym or name and return gene metadata such as Entrez ID, chromosome, and homologene ID.

components.name: Allen Brain structure search
components.description: Search the Allen Brain Atlas ontology for brain structures by acronym or name. Returns matching structure records with hierarchy, atlas coordinates, and color coding.

components.name: Allen Cell Types specimen search
components.description: Search the Allen Cell Types Database for individual neuron specimens characterized by electrophysiology and morphology, filterable by donor species and brain structure. Returns per-neuron records including donor metadata, brain structure, transgenic line, electrophysiology features, and morphological reconstruction av…

components.name: Alliance Get Alleles and Models
components.description: Get alleles/variants and affected genomic models for a gene via the Alliance of Genome Resources, taking an Alliance gene ID and returning allele/variant records with HGVS genomic locations and disease/phenotype flags plus affected genomic model records.

components.name: Alliance get disease
components.description: Retrieve disease information from the Alliance of Genome Resources using a Disease Ontology (DO) ID as the main input.

components.name: Alliance get disease genes
components.description: Get genes associated with a disease across all model organisms from the Alliance of Genome Resources using Disease Ontology (DO) IDs, including direct annotations and inferred associations from model organism phenotypes.

components.name: Alliance get gene
components.description: Get detailed gene information from the Alliance of Genome Resources, including gene symbol, name, species, synopsis, synonyms, genomic location, and cross-references for a supplied Alliance gene ID. Integrates data from SGD, FlyBase, WormBase, ZFIN, RGD, MGI, Xenbase, and human.

components.name: Alliance gene ortholog lookup
components.description: Retrieves orthologs and paralogs for a given gene identifier across model organisms through the Alliance of Genome Resources, returning stringent orthologs with disease/expression annotation flags and prediction methods as well as paralogs.

components.name: Alliance get gene phenotypes
components.description: Get phenotype annotations for a gene from the Alliance of Genome Resources, aggregating phenotypes observed in model organism knockout or mutation experiments. Input is an Alliance gene ID with source prefix and output is phenotype annotations.

components.name: Alliance get molecular interactions
components.description: Retrieve molecular (physical) interaction records for a gene from the Alliance of Genome Resources. Accepts a gene ID with a member prefix and returns interactor gene identifiers, species, interaction type, and supporting evidence references.

components.name: Alliance search genes
components.description: Search for genes across model organism databases in the Alliance of Genome Resources by gene symbol or synonym and return matching gene records.

components.name: AlphaFill get transplants
components.description: Retrieves ligands, cofactors, and ions that AlphaFill transplants into a protein's AlphaFold model, given a UniProt accession. Returns distinct transplanted compounds with support counts, best local fit RMSD, and source PDB entries.

components.name: AlphaFold get annotations
components.description: Retrieves AlphaFold annotations for a given UniProt accession, including mutation and variant impact annotations.

components.name: AlphaFold Get Prediction
components.description: Retrieve full AlphaFold 3D structure predictions for a protein using a UniProt accession. Returns residue-level metadata including sequence, per-residue confidence scores (pLDDT), and structure download links in PDB, CIF, and PAE formats.

components.name: AlphaFold get summary
components.description: Retrieves an AlphaFold protein structure prediction summary for a UniProt accession, including confidence scores and structure download links from the AlphaFold database.

components.name: AlphaGenome Atlas list scorers
components.description: Lists valid scorer names available from AlphaGenome Atlas, including whether each scorer is signed and how many tracks it contains. The results provide scorer definitions for selecting values in AlphaGenome Atlas genomic analysis tools.

components.name: AlphaGenome Atlas lookup variant
components.description: Looks up precomputed variant effect scores for a single-nucleotide substitution from the AlphaGenome Atlas, including the unified AlphaGenome Variant Impact score combining AlphaGenome and AlphaMissense predictions.

components.name: AlphaGenome Atlas scan interval
components.description: Looks up precomputed AlphaGenome Atlas scores for every possible single-nucleotide substitution in a genomic region of up to 10,000 base pairs. The hosted AlphaGenome API returns scores for ranking variants across the interval.

components.name: AlphaGenome output metadata
components.description: Provides AlphaGenome output metadata for discovering valid prediction output modalities and tissue or cell ontology terms used to configure genomic predictions.

components.name: AlphaGenome predict interval
components.description: Predict multimodal genomic tracks for a genomic interval using DeepMind AlphaGenome, a single DNA-sequence model at single-base resolution, and return per-modality summaries with track counts and shapes.

components.name: AlphaGenome sequence prediction
components.description: Predict multimodal genomic tracks from a raw DNA sequence using DeepMind AlphaGenome, without requiring genome coordinates. The hosted AlphaGenome API supports modalities such as RNA-seq, chromatin accessibility, transcription factor and histone binding, splicing, and contact maps, with optional organism and tissue or…

components.name: AlphaGenome predict variant
components.description: Predicts full multimodal genomic tracks for both the reference and alternate alleles of a supplied variant using the DeepMind AlphaGenome hosted API, returning a compact per-modality summary of the predicted tracks.

components.name: AlphaGenome score interval
components.description: Scores default gene-mask activity for a specified genomic interval using DeepMind AlphaGenome, without comparing a reference and alternate variant. Returns top per-gene, per-track scores sorted by absolute effect, using the hosted AlphaGenome API.

components.name: AlphaGenome score ISM variants
components.description: Uses DeepMind AlphaGenome to score every possible single-nucleotide substitution within a genomic window of up to 500 bp and rank candidates by their most extreme per-gene, per-track effect. The hosted AlphaGenome API is accessed through the alphagenome SDK.

components.name: AlphaGenome score variant
components.description: Scores a regulatory variant's effect using DeepMind AlphaGenome, predicting reference and alternate allele effects over up to 1 Mb at single-base resolution and returning per-track effect scores sorted by absolute effect.

components.name: AlphaMissense Get Protein Scores
components.description: Get AlphaMissense pathogenicity scores for every residue of a protein using a UniProt accession, returning per-position records, protein length, and pathogenicity thresholds from the Hegelab API.

components.name: AlphaMissense Get Residue Scores
components.description: Retrieves AlphaMissense pathogenicity class membership for amino acid substitutions at a specified UniProt protein position, reporting benign, ambiguous, and pathogenic classes for SNV-accessible and all 19 substitutions plus residue mean scores from the upstream hotspot API.

components.name: AlphaMissense get variant score
components.description: Classify a specific missense variant with AlphaMissense using a UniProt ID and variant notation (e.g. p.R123H). Returns the AlphaMissense pathogenicity class (pathogenic/ambiguous/benign) and whether it came from the SNV-accessible or all-substitutions set; numeric per-variant score is not available.

components.name: AMPSphere AMP record lookup
components.description: Retrieves the full AMPSphere record for an antimicrobial peptide (AMP) by its accession. Returns amino-acid sequence, physicochemical properties, quality-control flags, predicted secondary structure, and gene/sample provenance metadata from the AMPSphere database.

components.name: AMPSphere Get AMP Distributions
components.description: Retrieve the ecological and geographic distribution of a single AMPSphere antimicrobial peptide by accession, returning a bubble-map of geographic coordinates with sample counts, habitat distribution, and microbial source distribution via the AMPSphere REST API.

components.name: AMPSphere get AMP features
components.description: Retrieves the full physicochemical feature profile for a single AMPSphere antimicrobial peptide by accession, returning molecular weight, length, molar extinction, aromaticity, GRAVY hydrophobicity, instability index, isoelectric point, net charge at pH 7, and predicted secondary-structure fractions via the AMPSphere…

components.name: AMPSphere Get Family
components.description: Retrieve full detail for an AMPSphere protein family by accession via the keyless AMPSphere REST API, returning consensus sequence, member count, member accession list, per-member feature statistics, distributions, and download URLs for alignment, sequences, HMM profile, and phylogenetic tree.

components.name: AMPSphere Search AMPs
components.description: Search and filter the AMPSphere catalogue of 863,498 prokaryotic small open reading frame antimicrobial peptides by habitat, SPHERE family, microbial source, peptide length, molecular weight, isoelectric point, charge, and quality-control flags, returning paginated peptide records with sequence, physicochemical proper…

components.name: AMPSphere sequence match
components.description: Checks whether an exact amino-acid sequence already exists in the AMPSphere metagenomic antimicrobial peptide catalog and returns the AMPSphere accession if present, otherwise null. This is an exact-match membership test, not a homology search.

components.name: Annotate variant multi-source
components.description: Annotates a genetic variant from ClinVar, gnomAD, CIViC, and UniProt in a single call, returning pathogenicity classification, population constraints, clinical evidence, and protein function. Accepts a variant name, gene symbol, or dbSNP rsID.

components.name: Antibody Registry get by RRID
components.description: Retrieve an antibody record from the Antibody Registry by its persistent RRID, returning target, clonality, clone ID, host organism, conjugate, applications, vendor, catalog number, and defining citation.

components.name: Antibody Registry search
components.description: Search the Antibody Registry (antibodyregistry.org) by target, name, or vendor keyword and return matching antibody records with persistent RRIDs, target identifiers, clonality, host, applications, vendor, catalog number, and citations.

components.name: AOPWiki get AOP
components.description: Search the AOPWiki knowledge base for adverse outcome pathways by title or short name keyword, returning matching AOP IDs, titles, and short names.

components.name: AOPWiki get key event
components.description: Retrieves a single AOP-Wiki Key Event by its numeric event ID, returning the event record with machine-readable ontology annotations and biological organization level.

components.name: AOPWiki List AOPs
components.description: List Adverse Outcome Pathways (AOPs) from AOPWiki, optionally filtering by a case-insensitive keyword in title or short name. Returns AOP IDs, titles, and short names for toxicology and risk assessment.

components.name: APPRIS Functional Annotation Lookup
components.description: Retrieves detailed functional annotations for gene isoforms from APPRIS, including structural domains, functional residues, 3D structure coverage, conservation, transmembrane helices, signal peptides, and proteomics evidence. Accepts a gene identifier and optional transcript identifier and returns annotations grouped…

components.name: APPRIS get isoforms
components.description: Retrieves all transcript isoforms and their APPRIS annotations for a given Ensembl gene ID, classifying isoforms as PRINCIPAL or ALTERNATIVE with reliability levels.

components.name: APPRIS get principal isoform
components.description: Retrieves the principal (most functionally important) transcript isoform for a gene from the APPRIS database using an Ensembl gene ID.

components.name: ARCHS4 Get Gene Correlations
components.description: Retrieves genes most co-expressed with a query gene from ARCHS4, using Pearson correlation computed across 300K+ uniformly processed RNA-seq samples. Returns ranked top correlated genes with their Pearson correlation coefficients.

components.name: ARCHS4 gene expression lookup
components.description: Get gene expression levels across human or mouse tissues and cell lines from ARCHS4, returning box-plot statistics (min, Q1, median, Q3, max) in log2(TPM+1) units per tissue/cell line computed from uniformly processed RNA-seq samples.

components.name: ArrayExpress Experiment Lookup
components.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a specific ArrayExpress experiment by accession ID (E-GEOD, E-MTAB, etc.), including title, description, protocols, experimental design, and publication information from the ArrayExpress database.

components.name: ArrayExpress get experiment files
components.description: Get list of files associated with an ArrayExpress experiment, returning file metadata such as file names, types, sizes, and download paths for raw, processed, and MAGE-TAB annotation files.

components.name: ArrayExpress Get Experiment Samples
components.description: Retrieves sample metadata for an ArrayExpress experiment by experiment ID, including sample names, characteristics, experimental factors, and technical details from the original MAGE-TAB annotations.

components.name: ArrayExpress Experiment Search
components.description: Search ArrayExpress experiments from EMBL-EBI by keywords, species, or array platform to retrieve experiment metadata including accession IDs, titles, descriptions, and study information.

components.name: ArXiv PDF Snippets
components.description: Fetch an arXiv paper's PDF and return bounded text snippets around user-provided terms, using markitdown to convert the PDF to markdown. Useful for locating details in full text when abstracts are insufficient.

components.name: ArXiv search papers
components.description: Search arXiv for papers by keyword using the public arXiv API. Returns papers with title, abstract, authors, publication date, category, and URL.

components.name: BacDive strain search
components.description: Search BacDive by bacterial or archaeal genus and optional species to retrieve BacDive strain IDs for further phenotype lookup.

components.name: BacDive search by taxon
components.description: Search the BacDive database for strain IDs associated with a bacterial or archaeal taxon, specified by genus alone or genus plus species.

components.name: BAR Gene Info
components.description: Get plant gene annotation from the BAR (Bio-Analytic Resource for Plant Biology), including genomic position, strand, aliases, and functional annotation, using a gene identifier.

components.name: BAR get RNA-seq expression
components.description: Get RNA-seq gene expression data for a supplied gene identifier from the Bio-Analytic Resource for Plant Biology (BAR), returning per-cluster mean expression values across replicates from single-cell atlases.

components.name: Bgee Get Gene Expression
components.description: Get gene expression data from the Bgee database using an Ensembl gene ID and NCBI taxonomy ID, returning expression across tissues and organs with expression scores, confidence levels, and quality ratings. Supports RNA-Seq, Affymetrix, EST, and in situ hybridization data types.

components.name: Bgee list species
components.description: List all species available in the Bgee gene expression database, returning species with taxonomy IDs, genome versions, and common names. Useful for discovering which species are available before querying gene expression data.

components.name: Bgee gene search
components.description: Search the Bgee comparative gene expression database by gene symbol, name, or description across 29+ animal species, returning matching genes with species information, biotype, and expression summaries.

components.name: BGPT Search Paper Evidence
components.description: Search scientific papers and return structured, full-text-derived study evidence for critical appraisal, including methods, sample size, results, limitations, biases, and quality scores.

components.name: BiGG download model
components.description: Download a complete FBA-ready COBRA metabolic model from BiGG, including reactions, metabolites, gene-protein-reaction associations, and compartments. The tool accepts a BiGG model identifier and returns the model in JSON (COBRApy-loadable) or SBML format.

components.name: BiGG get database version
components.description: Retrieves the BiGG Models database version number, API version, and last update timestamp using a fixed get_database_version operation to check data currency and reproducibility.

components.name: BiGG Get Metabolite
components.description: Retrieves detailed metabolite information from BiGG, including formula, compartments, database cross-references and model presence, using a metabolite identifier and optional model filter.

components.name: BiGG Get Model
components.description: Get detailed metadata for a specific metabolic model from BiGG, including organism, genome accession, reaction/metabolite/gene counts, and publication reference (PMID).

components.name: BiGG get model reactions
components.description: Get all reactions in a BiGG metabolic model by model identifier. Returns reaction IDs, names, and organisms for each biochemical reaction in the model.

components.name: BiGG Get Reaction
components.description: Retrieve detailed reaction information from the BiGG Models database by reaction ID, including stoichiometry and gene-reaction rules.

components.name: BiGG list models
components.description: List all genome-scale metabolic models in the BiGG database, returning model IDs, organisms, reaction counts, metabolite counts, and gene counts for bacteria, archaea, and eukaryotes.

components.name: BiGG search
components.description: Search the BiGG database for models, reactions, metabolites, or genes, returning matching entries with IDs, names, and organism information.

components.name: BindingDB get ligands by PDB
components.description: Get binding affinity data for proteins by PDB structure ID from BindingDB. Returns ligands with measured affinities for the specified protein structures, useful for structure-activity relationship analysis.

components.name: BindingDB get ligands by UniProt
components.description: Retrieve ligands associated with a UniProt accession from the BindingDB database.

components.name: BindingDB ligand lookup by UniProt IDs
components.description: Retrieves binding affinity data and SMILES for ligands matching specified UniProt IDs from BindingDB, supporting comparison across protein family members or paralogs.

components.name: BindingDB Get Targets by Compound
components.description: Find protein targets for a compound by SMILES structure. Returns proteins with binding affinity data for compounds BindingDB considers similar, useful for polypharmacology analysis and off-target prediction.

components.name: BindingDB search by target
components.description: Searches the BindingDB database for binding affinity data using a UniProt accession as the target identifier. Returns binding-affinity records for the specified target.

components.name: BioBank Japan PheWAS by variant
components.description: Perform a phenome-wide association study (PheWAS) lookup for a single genetic variant in BioBank Japan, returning all associated phenotypes sorted by p-value. Accepts an rsID or GRCh37 chr:pos:ref:alt variant and is useful for cross-ancestry replication in East Asian populations.

components.name: Bioconductor_get_package
components.description: Search Bioconductor packages by keyword, analysis type, or topic and return matching packages with title, description, usage count, and relevance score using the R-universe search index.

components.name: Bioconductor Search Packages
components.description: Search Bioconductor bioinformatics R packages by keyword, topic, or analysis type and return matching packages with title, description, usage count, and relevance score using the R-universe search index.

components.name: BioGRID get chemical interactions
components.description: Queries experimentally validated gene and protein interactions from BioGRID for a supplied set of gene names, with optional filtering for potential chemical relevance. Requires a BioGRID API key.

components.name: BioGRID Get Interactions
components.description: Queries experimentally validated protein and genetic interactions from the BioGRID database and returns curated interaction records with evidence methods, PubMed citations, and throughput information.

components.name: BioGRID get PTMs
components.description: Retrieve post-translational modifications (PTMs) for proteins from the BioGRID database, including phosphorylation, ubiquitination, acetylation, methylation and other covalent modifications with site positions, modifying enzymes, and literature evidence.

components.name: BioGRID search by PubMed
components.description: Retrieve protein interactions curated in BioGRID from specific publications identified by PubMed ID, returning interactions with experimental methods and evidence codes.

components.name: BioImage Archive Get Study
components.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a specific BioImage Archive study by accession number, including title, description, imaging methods, organism, and file information.

components.name: BioImageArchive list study files
components.description: List the file/image manifest of a BioImage Archive study, returning per-file download paths, file sizes, and per-image experimental annotations. Accepts a study accession and pages through large manifests with limit and offset.

components.name: BioImage Archive search bioimages
components.description: Search the BioImage Archive BioImages collection at EBI for biological imaging datasets by query, returning imaging studies with microscopy-specific metadata.

components.name: BioImage Archive search studies
components.description: Search the BioImage Archive (EBI BioStudies) for biological imaging datasets using a free-text query that can specify imaging modality, organism, technique, or topic. Returns matching study accessions, titles, and metadata.

components.name: Biomarker Discovery Workflow
components.description: Discovers and validates biomarkers for a specified disease condition using literature analysis, expression data, pathway enrichment, and clinical validation. Accepts a disease condition and optional sample type, and returns biomarker candidates.

components.name: BioModels download model
components.description: Downloads a specific file from a BioModels entry or returns the download URL for the entire model as a COMBINE archive. Accepts a BioModels model ID and optional filename, and provides download URL plus file metadata for simulation software such as COPASI or CellDesigner.

components.name: BioModels Get Model
components.description: Retrieve comprehensive metadata for a specific BioModels model by its identifier, including model name, description, publication references, organism, biological processes, SBML level/version, creation/modification dates, and curator annotations.

components.name: BioModels list all model IDs
components.description: Enumerates the complete registry of BioModels model identifiers, including curated (BIOMD...) and non-curated (MODEL...) IDs, returning a hits count and an array of model ID strings for use with other BioModels tools.

components.name: BioModels list files
components.description: Get a detailed file listing for a specific BioModels entry, including file names, types, sizes, and metadata for associated SBML files, figures, supplementary data, and COMBINE archives. Requires a BioModels model ID and returns file records for that model.

components.name: BioModels Search
components.description: Search the EBI BioModels database by keyword to find computational biological models, returning model identifiers, names, formats (typically SBML), and URLs for systems biology models related to biological processes, diseases, or pathways.

components.name: BioModels Search Parameters
components.description: Search BioModels models using structured search parameters and return matching model records. This parameter-based search complements keyword search and full catalog enumeration.

components.name: BioPortal Annotate Text
components.description: Annotates free biomedical text with ontology terms using BioPortal's Annotator named entity recognition, scanning mentions of diseases, drugs, gene functions, phenotypes, and anatomical terms across 900+ ontologies. Accepts a text input and returns matching ontology concept annotations.

components.name: BioPortal Get Concept
components.description: Retrieves detailed information for a concept from a BioPortal ontology using its ontology acronym and concept IRI, including definition, synonyms, CUI codes, and semantic types.

components.name: BioPortal get hierarchy
components.description: Get children, parents, or ancestors of a specific concept in a BioPortal ontology, enabling hierarchical browsing of is-a term relationships. Takes an ontology and concept identifier and returns related ontology terms.

components.name: BioPortal ontology term search
components.description: Search across 900+ biomedical ontologies in BioPortal (NCBO) for concepts matching a query. Returns matching ontology concepts with labels, IDs, definitions, and synonyms, with optional filtering by specific ontologies.

components.name: Bioregistry get prefix mappings
components.description: Look up cross-registry prefix mappings for a given Bioregistry prefix using the Bioregistry database. Maps an input prefix such as chebi, go, or mondo to equivalent identifiers in registries including identifiers.org, OLS, BioPortal, and Wikidata.

components.name: Bioregistry Get Registry
components.description: Look up metadata for a biological database or ontology by its Bioregistry prefix, returning name, description, homepage, ID pattern, URI format, example IDs, and synonyms.

components.name: Bioregistry resolve reference
components.description: Resolves a compact identifier (prefix and identifier) to provider URLs across 2600+ biological databases using the Bioregistry, enabling cross-database linking and identifier resolution.

components.name: Bioregistry search registries
components.description: Search the Bioregistry by keyword to find databases, ontologies, and resources, returning matching registry records for identifier resolution.

components.name: BioRxiv Get Preprint
components.description: Retrieve full metadata for a specific bioRxiv or medRxiv preprint by its DOI, including title, authors, abstract, publication date, version, category, corresponding author, funding information, and URLs.

components.name: BioRxiv list recent preprints
components.description: Lists recent bioRxiv and medRxiv preprints within a given date range, returning up to 100 records with title, authors, abstract, DOI, category, and publication status using the bioRxiv API.

components.name: BioSamples get facets
components.description: Discovers available attribute facets in EBI BioSamples for a free-text query, returning each facet with sample counts and top values to guide subsequent structured filter searches.

components.name: BioSamples get relationships
components.description: Retrieves the relationship/provenance graph for a BioSample, returning sample-to-sample lineage edges (e.g., derived from, has member, child of, same as, recurated into) with source, type, target, and direction relative to the queried sample.

components.name: BioSamples Get Sample
components.description: Retrieve detailed metadata for a specific biological sample from the EBI BioSamples database by accession. Returns sample name, organism, tissue, disease, experimental context, and links to associated data archives.

components.name: BioSamples search
components.description: Search the EBI BioSamples database by free-text query across more than 60 million biological samples. Returns matching sample records with accessions, names, organisms, and key characteristics, useful for finding source material metadata.

components.name: BioSamples search by filter
components.description: Search the EBI BioSamples database with structured attribute filters such as organism, tissue, or disease, returning matching biosample records.

components.name: BioStudies Get Study
components.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a BioStudies study by accession number, including attributes, sections, files, and links.

components.name: BioStudies get study files
components.description: Get list of files associated with a BioStudies study by accession, returning file metadata including paths, sizes, types, and attributes.

components.name: BioStudies search
components.description: Search the BioStudies repository at EMBL-EBI for biological studies across all collections using keyword, phrase, or Boolean queries, returning matching study records with pagination and sorting.

components.name: BioStudies search by collection
components.description: Search BioStudies for study records matching a query within a specified collection, with pagination and sorting. Returns matching records with HTML responses converted to Markdown.

components.name: BioThings Get Entity
components.description: Search a BioThings-hosted API with an Elasticsearch-style query by supplying an API slug and query string, returning matching records with their _id fields. Example APIs include DDInter, RepoDB, and SemMedDB.

components.name: BioThings Get Metadata
components.description: Retrieve metadata about a BioThings API, including available field names, using an API slug.

components.name: BioThings list APIs
components.description: Lists the biomedical APIs available through the BioThings gateway, each with a one-line description, and optionally filters by keyword in the slug or description. Intended to be called before BioThings_query to select an API slug.

components.name: BioThings query
components.description: Query a selected BioThings API endpoint using an API slug and a query string, returning matching records in JSON format.

components.name: BioTools get tool
components.description: Retrieve comprehensive metadata for a bioinformatics tool from the ELIXIR Bio.tools registry by biotoolsID, including name, description, homepage, tool type, EDAM topics and operations, input/output formats, programming languages, operating systems, license, documentation links, and credits.

components.name: BioTools search
components.description: Search the ELIXIR Bio.tools registry for bioinformatics software tools, databases, and web services by free-text query, returning matching resource records with names, descriptions, types, topics, and homepages.

components.name: BioTools search by operation
components.description: Search the ELIXIR Bio.tools registry for bioinformatics tools by EDAM operation and return matching tool records.

components.name: BioTools search by topic
components.description: Search the ELIXIR Bio.tools registry for bioinformatics tools by EDAM scientific topic, returning tools classified under a specific research domain.

components.name: BioTools search by type
components.description: Searches the ELIXIR Bio.tools registry for bioinformatics resources by resource type. Returns records of matching tools such as command-line tools, web applications, or database portals.

components.name: BLAST nucleotide search
components.description: Search a nucleotide sequence against NCBI BLAST blastn nucleotide databases and return matching sequence alignments or hits.

components.name: BLAST protein search
components.description: Search a protein sequence against NCBI BLAST protein databases using blastp, returning similarity hits and alignments. Supports databases such as nr, swissprot, and pdb via NCBI's remote BLAST service.

components.name: BMRB get entries by PDB ID
components.description: Find BMRB NMR entries associated with a PDB structure by PDB accession, returning linked BMRB entry IDs and match type (BLAST or author-provided).

components.name: BMRB NMR entry lookup by UniProt accession
components.description: Finds BMRB NMR entries for a protein using its UniProt accession and returns NMR data entries associated with the protein, allowing cross-referencing between sequence databases and NMR spectroscopy data.

components.name: BMRB entry lookup
components.description: Retrieves full NMR-STAR data for a Biological Magnetic Resonance Data Bank (BMRB) entry by entry ID. Returns chemical shifts, coupling constants, relaxation data, structure restraints, and experimental conditions for biological macromolecules and small molecules.

components.name: BMRB get entry citation
components.description: Get citation or publication information for a BMRB NMR entry in BibTeX format, including author list, title, journal, DOI, and year, using a BMRB entry ID.

components.name: BMRB get validation
components.description: Retrieves the BMRB-computed NMR assignment validation report for a BMRB entry ID, returning AVS and PANAV per-residue assignment-consistency scores and deviant/suspicious assignment lists.

components.name: BMRB search by keyword
