components.description: Search BMRB (Biological Magnetic Resonance Data Bank) entries by keyword or molecule name, optionally targeting macromolecules or metabolomics small molecules, and return matching entry IDs and summary information.

components.name: BMRB Search by Sequence
components.description: Search the Biological Magnetic Resonance Data Bank (BMRB) by protein or nucleic-acid sequence similarity (FASTA/BLAST), returning ranked NMR entry matches with alignment metrics such as percent identity and e-value.

components.name: BMRB chemical shift search
components.description: Query assigned NMR chemical-shift values for a given residue and atom across all BMRB entries, returning archive-wide rows with entry identifiers, atom type, shift value, error, ambiguity code, pH, and temperature. Optional shift_low and shift_high bounds can be specified.

components.name: Boltz create workspace
components.description: Create an official Boltz workspace with an optional name, data-retention policy, and spending limit. The tool requires explicit confirmation and returns metadata for the newly created workspace.

components.name: Boltz delete ADME data
components.description: Permanently deletes retained input and output data for one official Boltz ADME prediction job while preserving its metadata record. The irreversible deletion requires the prediction job ID and explicit confirmation, and returns the deletion timestamp.

components.name: Boltz Delete Protein Design Data
components.description: Permanently deletes retained input and output data for one official Boltz protein-design pipeline job while preserving its metadata record. The operation requires a job ID and explicit confirmation and returns deletion status information.

components.name: Boltz delete protein library screen data
components.description: Permanently deletes retained input and output data for an official Boltz protein-library screen job while preserving its metadata record. The operation requires a job ID and explicit confirmation, and returns the deletion status and timestamp.

components.name: Boltz protein sequence redesign data deletion
components.description: Permanently delete retained input and output data for a Boltz protein sequence-redesign pipeline job while preserving its metadata record. The operation requires explicit confirmation and returns the job ID and data deletion timestamp.

components.name: Boltz Delete Small Molecule Design Data
components.description: Permanently delete retained input and output data for a Boltz small-molecule design pipeline job while preserving its metadata record. The operation requires a job ID and explicit confirmation, and returns the deletion status and timestamp.

components.name: Boltz Delete Small Molecule Library Screen Data
components.description: Permanently deletes retained input and output data for a specified Boltz small-molecule library screen job while preserving its metadata record. The operation requires the job ID and explicit confirmation, and returns the deletion timestamp.

components.name: Boltz delete structure binding data
components.description: Permanently deletes retained input and output data for one official Boltz structure-and-binding prediction job while preserving its metadata record. The operation requires a job ID and explicit confirmation and returns the deletion timestamp.

components.name: Boltz download experiment results
components.description: Resumes polling and downloads results for an existing official Boltz design or screening job using a job ID or local experiment directory, returning the local directory created or updated by the Boltz SDK.

components.name: Boltz estimate ADME cost
components.description: Estimate the authoritative USD cost of an official Boltz ADME prediction without creating a compute job. The tool accepts molecules specified by SMILES and the adme-v1 model identifier.

components.name: Boltz estimate protein design cost
components.description: Estimate the USD cost of an official Boltz protein-design pipeline without creating a compute job. The tool accepts a protein design specification and returns a cost estimate or an error response.

components.name: Boltz estimate protein library screen cost
components.description: Estimate the USD cost of an official Boltz protein-library screen from a supplied protein screen configuration without creating a compute job.

components.name: Boltz estimate protein sequence redesign cost
components.description: Estimate the USD cost of an official Boltz protein sequence-redesign pipeline from a redesign specification and protein structure without creating a compute job.

components.name: Boltz estimate small molecule design cost
components.description: Estimate the authoritative USD cost of an official Boltz small-molecule design pipeline from its design configuration without creating a compute job.

components.name: Boltz estimate small molecule library screen cost
components.description: Estimates the USD cost of an official Boltz small-molecule library screen from a supplied molecule library and optional filtering configuration without creating a compute job.

components.name: Boltz estimate structure binding cost
components.description: Estimates the USD cost of an official Boltz structure-and-binding prediction without creating a compute job. The input specifies prediction entities and optional binding, bond, constraint, model, sampling, and template parameters, and the output is a cost estimate.

components.name: Boltz get ADME
components.description: Retrieves one official Boltz ADME prediction by its account-scoped ID, returning lifecycle status and available prediction outputs, inputs, metrics, failure details, and temporary artifact URLs.

components.name: Boltz get protein design
components.description: Retrieve an official Boltz protein-design pipeline by its account-scoped ID, including lifecycle status, failure details, inputs, outputs, metrics, and temporary artifact URLs when available.

components.name: Boltz Get Protein Library Screen
components.description: Retrieve an official Boltz protein-library screen by its account-scoped ID, including lifecycle status, failure details, inputs, outputs, metrics, and temporary artifact URLs when available.

components.name: Boltz get protein sequence redesign
components.description: Retrieve a Boltz protein sequence-redesign pipeline by its account-scoped job or prediction ID, including lifecycle status, failure details, inputs, outputs, metrics, and temporary artifact URLs when available.

components.name: Boltz Get Small Molecule Design
components.description: Retrieve an official Boltz small-molecule design pipeline by its account-scoped ID, including lifecycle status, failure details, inputs, outputs, metrics, and temporary artifact URLs when available.

components.name: Boltz Get Small Molecule Library Screen
components.description: Retrieve an official Boltz small-molecule library screen by its account-scoped ID. The result includes lifecycle status, failure details, inputs, outputs, metrics, and temporary artifact URLs when available.

components.name: Boltz get structure binding
components.description: Retrieve an official Boltz structure-and-binding prediction by its account-scoped prediction ID, including lifecycle status, failure details, inputs, outputs, metrics, and temporary artifact URLs when available.

components.name: Boltz list ADME
components.description: List official Boltz ADME prediction jobs visible to the current credential, with cursor pagination and optional workspace filtering. The tool returns prediction job records whose IDs can be used with corresponding retrieval tools.

components.name: Boltz list protein design
components.description: Lists official Boltz protein-design pipeline jobs visible to the current credential, with optional workspace filtering and cursor-based pagination. Returns job records and identifiers for use with related retrieval or results tools.

components.name: Boltz list protein design results
components.description: Lists generated results for a Boltz protein-design pipeline job using a required job ID, with optional result-ID filtering and cursor pagination. Returns a page of protein design result records.

components.name: Boltz list protein library screen
components.description: List official Boltz protein-library screen jobs visible to the current credential, optionally filtered by workspace, and return paginated job records with identifiers and status information.

components.name: Boltz list protein library screen results
components.description: Lists generated results for an official Boltz protein-library screen job using a required job or prediction ID, with optional result-ID filtering and cursor pagination. Results are returned as a paginated set of result objects.

components.name: Boltz protein sequence redesign job listing
components.description: Lists official Boltz protein sequence-redesign pipeline jobs visible to the current credential, with optional workspace filtering and cursor pagination. Returns job records whose IDs can be used with the corresponding Boltz get or results tools.

components.name: Boltz list protein sequence redesign results
components.description: Lists generated results for an official Boltz protein sequence-redesign pipeline job using a job or prediction ID, with optional result-ID filtering and cursor pagination. Returns a page of protein sequence-redesign result records.

components.name: Boltz Small Molecule Design Job Listing
components.description: Lists official Boltz small-molecule design pipeline jobs visible to the current credential, with optional workspace filtering and cursor-based pagination. Returns design job records for use with matching retrieval or results tools.

components.name: Boltz list small molecule design results
components.description: Lists generated small-molecule design results for a Boltz pipeline job using the parent job ID, with cursor pagination and optional result-ID filtering.

components.name: Boltz list small molecule library screen
components.description: Lists official Boltz small-molecule library screen jobs visible to the current credential, with optional workspace filtering and cursor-based pagination. Returns library screen job records whose IDs can be used with corresponding retrieval or results tools.

components.name: Boltz list small molecule library screen results
components.description: Lists generated results for an official Boltz small-molecule library screen job using its job ID, with optional result-ID filtering and cursor pagination. Results are retrieved from the Boltz API.

components.name: Boltz list structure binding
components.description: Lists official Boltz structure-and-binding prediction jobs visible to the current credential, with optional workspace filtering and cursor-based pagination. Returns prediction job records whose IDs can be used with matching retrieval tools.

components.name: Boltz list usage
components.description: Queries official Boltz usage over a required ISO 8601 time range using hourly or daily aggregation, with optional application or workspace filters and grouping. Returns usage totals and grouped usage data.

components.name: Boltz list workspaces
components.description: Lists official Boltz workspaces with optional exact-name filtering and cursor pagination, returning workspace records that include workspace IDs and names.

components.name: Boltz resume protein design
components.description: Resumes a stopped official Boltz protein-design pipeline job using an account-scoped job or prediction ID and explicit confirmation. Returns the resumed job status with any available output or error information.

components.name: Boltz Resume Protein Library Screen
components.description: Resumes a stopped protein-library screening job through the Boltz API. It accepts an account-scoped job or prediction ID and returns the job ID and current status; explicit confirmation is required because resuming may continue billable remote computation.

components.name: Boltz resume protein sequence redesign
components.description: Resume a stopped Boltz protein sequence-redesign pipeline job using its account-scoped job or prediction ID. The tool returns the job status and any available output or error information, and requires explicit confirmation because resuming may continue remote compute work.

components.name: Boltz resume small-molecule design
components.description: Resumes a stopped official Boltz small-molecule design pipeline job through the Boltz API using an account-scoped job ID, returning the job status and any available output or error.

components.name: Boltz Resume Small-Molecule Library Screen
components.description: Resume a stopped Boltz small-molecule library screen job using its account-scoped job ID. Explicit confirmation is required because resuming changes remote compute state and may continue billable work.

components.name: Boltz Revoke API Key
components.description: Revoke an official Boltz API key by its metadata ID, immediately disabling the credential. The operation requires an administrator API key and explicit confirmation.

components.name: Boltz run ADME
components.description: Runs an official Boltz ADME prediction for supplied molecules, polling the job until completion and persisting the downloaded results in a named local experiment directory. Returns the directory path containing the experiment results.

components.name: Boltz Run Protein Design
components.description: Runs the official Boltz protein-design pipeline using a design input, selected model, and named experiment, then returns the local directory containing the downloaded results.

components.name: Boltz protein library screen
components.description: Run an official Boltz protein-library screen using a target, binder specification, library size, and stable experiment name. The tool submits and monitors the screen, downloads the results, and returns the local experiment directory path.

components.name: Boltz Run Small Molecule Design
components.description: Runs the official Boltz small-molecule design pipeline using protein inputs, a molecular target, and a named experiment, then downloads the completed design results to a local experiment directory.

components.name: Boltz run small molecule library screen
components.description: Run a Boltz small-molecule library screen against a specified molecular target, poll the job to completion, and download the screening results into a named local experiment directory.

components.name: Boltz structure binding
components.description: Runs an official Boltz structure-and-binding prediction from specified biomolecular entities, binding definitions, and optional structural constraints. The tool submits and monitors the job, downloads the completed results, and returns the named local experiment directory path.

components.name: Boltz start ADME
components.description: Submits an asynchronous Boltz ADME prediction for supplied molecules represented by SMILES structures and returns an account-scoped job ID with its initial status. The request uses the official adme-v1 model and requires an idempotency key.

components.name: Boltz Start Protein Design
components.description: Submits a protein-design request to the official Boltz API as an asynchronous pipeline, using a stable idempotency key and returning an account-scoped job ID with its initial status.

components.name: Boltz start protein library screen
components.description: Submits a paid asynchronous protein-library screen to the official Boltz API using protein library entries and a stable idempotency key, returning an account-scoped job ID and initial status.

components.name: Boltz start protein sequence redesign
components.description: Submit an asynchronous Boltz protein sequence-redesign pipeline using protein entities, an optional structure source, and design filters. Returns an account-scoped job ID and initial status.

components.name: Boltz start small molecule design
components.description: Submits a small-molecule design pipeline to the official Boltz API and returns an account-scoped job ID with its initial status. The request requires a stable idempotency key to prevent duplicate billing.

components.name: Boltz start small molecule library screen
components.description: Submit a small-molecule library screen to the official Boltz API using molecule definitions, filtering configuration and a stable idempotency key. The asynchronous submission returns an account-scoped job ID and initial status.

components.name: Boltz start structure binding
components.description: Submit a paid asynchronous Boltz structure-and-binding prediction using molecular entities, binding specifications and optional structural constraints. The official hosted API returns an account-scoped job ID and initial status, with a required idempotency key to prevent duplicate billing.

components.name: Boltz stop protein design
components.description: Stops an active official Boltz protein-design pipeline job using its account-scoped job or prediction ID and explicit confirmation. Returns the remote job status and any associated output or error information.

components.name: Boltz Stop Protein Library Screen
components.description: Stops an active official Boltz protein-library screen job using its account-scoped job or prediction ID and returns the job status response.

components.name: Boltz stop protein sequence redesign
components.description: Stops an active official Boltz protein sequence-redesign pipeline job using its account-scoped job or prediction ID and returns the job status. The operation changes remote compute state and requires explicit confirmation.

components.name: Boltz update workspace
components.description: Updates an official Boltz workspace name or data-retention policy using a workspace ID and explicit confirmation. Returns the updated workspace identifier and name on success or an error response.

components.name: Boltz wait and download experiment
components.description: Resumes an existing local Boltz experiment, polls its remote job until a terminal state, and downloads pending results into the local experiment directory. The experiment is identified by run_dir or by name with an optional root_dir.

components.name: Boltz2 Docking
components.description: Perform protein-ligand docking via Boltz-2: input a protein sequence and one or more ligands as SMILES, and receive predicted structures and confidence scores.

components.name: Enzyme information lookup
components.description: Retrieve general enzyme information from BRENDA by EC number, including enzyme name, systematic name, and catalyzed reaction.

components.name: BRENDA Get Enzyme Kinetics
components.description: Retrieves comprehensive enzyme kinetic parameters and enzyme identity from ExPASy ENZYME and SABIO-RK, with optional BRENDA data for optimal pH, temperature, and specific activity when credentials are set. Accepts an EC number or enzyme name and returns aggregated summary statistics and individual measurements with su…

components.name: BRENDA enzyme inhibitor lookup
components.description: Retrieves enzyme inhibitor data from the BRENDA database for a given EC number, returning inhibitor names, Ki values in mM, and organism information.

components.name: BRENDA get kcat
components.description: Get kcat (turnover number) values from the BRENDA enzyme database for a specified EC number, returning catalytic rate values in 1/s.

components.name: BRENDA get Km
components.description: Get Km (Michaelis constant) values from the BRENDA enzyme database for an enzyme, returning mM values with organism and substrate information. Requires a free BRENDA account.

components.name: BridgeDb attributes
components.description: Get properties and attributes for a biological identifier from BridgeDb, returning metadata such as molecular formula, molecular weight, InChI, InChIKey, synonyms, and other database-specific attributes for metabolites and genes.

components.name: BridgeDb search
components.description: Search for biological identifiers by name using BridgeDb across supported databases, returning matching identifier-database pairs for genes, proteins, or metabolites.

components.name: BridgeDb xrefs
components.description: Maps a biological identifier across multiple databases using BridgeDb, returning equivalent identifiers for genes, proteins, metabolites and other biological entities from ChEBI, KEGG, PubChem, Wikidata, CAS, HMDB, Ensembl, HGNC, UniProt and NCBI Gene.

components.name: BV-BRC get genome
components.description: Retrieves detailed genome metadata from the BV-BRC database for a supplied BV-BRC genome identifier, including organism name, taxonomy, genome size, GC content, assembly status, host, disease, and isolation information.

components.name: BVBRC Get Protein Structure
components.description: Get detailed pathogen protein structure information from BV-BRC by PDB ID, returning structure metadata including title, resolution, method, gene, organism, UniProt accession, PMID references, sequence, and taxonomic lineage.

components.name: BV-BRC Taxonomy Lookup
components.description: Retrieves detailed taxonomy information for a pathogen from BV-BRC using an NCBI Taxonomy ID, returning taxon name, rank, lineage, alternative names, and genome counts.

components.name: BVBRC Search AMR
components.description: Search antibacterial resistance (AMR) phenotype data in BV-BRC using antibiotic, resistant phenotype, and BV-BRC genome ID filters. Returns resistance/susceptibility records for pathogens against specific antibiotics, including MIC values, testing methods, and evidence.

components.name: BVBRC Search Epitopes
components.description: Search for pathogen epitopes (B-cell and T-cell) in the BV-BRC resource, returning epitope sequences, types, protein associations, and assay results. Accepts an NCBI Taxonomy ID to retrieve epitopes from IEDB for bacteria and viruses, including SARS-CoV-2, influenza, and tuberculosis.

components.name: BVBRC search genome features
components.description: Search BV-BRC for antibiotic resistance data, including MIC values, testing methods, and evidence, filterable by antibiotic name, resistant phenotype, and genome ID.

components.name: BV-BRC Search Genomes
components.description: Search for pathogen genomes in BV-BRC by organism name or keyword and return a list of matching genome assemblies with metadata, including bacterial and viral examples.

components.name: BVBRC search pathways
components.description: Search for metabolic pathways in pathogen genomes from BV-BRC using taxonomy ID and optional pathway name. Returns KEGG pathway assignments with EC numbers, enzyme descriptions, and genome associations.

components.name: BVBRC search protein structures
components.description: Search for pathogen protein structures in BV-BRC by organism taxon ID, gene name, or experimental method, returning PDB entries with titles, resolution, methods, and references.

components.name: BVBRC Search Specialty Genes
components.description: Searches BV-BRC for specialty genes associated with antimicrobial resistance (AMR), filterable by antibiotic, resistant phenotype, and genome ID, returning matching gene records for bacterial AMR surveillance research.

components.name: BV-BRC subsystem search
components.description: Search for functional subsystems in BV-BRC pathogen genomes by NCBI taxonomy ID and return curated subsystem classifications including superclass, class, subclass, and functional roles for understanding pathogen functional organization.

components.name: BV-BRC search surveillance
components.description: Search influenza and pathogen surveillance data in BV-BRC. Returns surveillance samples with host species, geographic location, subtype, and collection metadata.

components.name: BVBRC search taxonomy
components.description: Searches BV-BRC pathogen taxonomy entries by keyword and returns matching taxa with names, ranks, genome counts, and lineage information. Useful for discovering pathogen taxon IDs for use with other BV-BRC tools.

components.name: CADD get position scores
components.description: Get CADD PHRED scores for all possible single-nucleotide substitutions at a genomic position. Accepts chromosome and position and returns scores for A, C, G, and T variants to support saturation mutagenesis analysis.

components.name: CADD get range scores
components.description: Retrieve pre-computed CADD deleteriousness scores for all variants within a specified genomic range (up to 100 bp) using chromosome, start, and end coordinates. Returns scores useful for hotspot analysis or exon scanning.

components.name: CADD variant score lookup
components.description: Retrieves Combined Annotation Dependent Depletion (CADD) deleteriousness scores for a specific genomic variant using chromosome, position, reference and alternate alleles, with support for GRCh37 and GRCh38 reference assemblies.

components.name: CallAgent
components.description: CallAgent accepts a feasible and concise solution plan and delegates the task to an agent that solves the problem, returning the resulting answer. The solution plan can emphasize different aspects of the question such as genes, phenotypes, diseases, or drugs.

components.name: Cancer biomarkers disease target score
components.description: Retrieve disease-target association scores from cancer biomarkers data for a given EFO disease ID, returning numeric scores such as the Cancer Gene Census score (0-1).

components.name: Cancer Gene Census disease target score
components.description: Extracts disease-target association scores from the Cancer Gene Census for a given disease EFO ID, returning numeric scores (0-1) for curated cancer genes.

components.name: CancerPPD2 search peptides
components.description: Search CancerPPD 2.0 for experimentally validated anticancer peptide records by cancer type, cell line, or sequence nature, returning peptide sequence, modifications, target cell line, cancer type, assay, and PubMed ID.

components.name: CancerPrognosis get gene expression
components.description: Fetch gene expression values (RNA-seq) for a specified gene across cancer samples in TCGA or cBioPortal studies. Returns per-sample expression values with summary statistics and supports 33 TCGA cancer types and any cBioPortal study with mRNA expression data.

components.name: Cancer study summary
components.description: Retrieves summary information for a TCGA cancer study, including available molecular profiles (mutations, expression, CNV), survival-related clinical attributes, and sample counts, helping determine available data before downstream queries.

components.name: CancerPrognosis get survival data
components.description: Retrieve patient-level overall survival and disease-free survival data from a TCGA or cBioPortal cancer study by specifying a cancer type or study ID; returns per-patient survival times, event status, and age for custom survival analyses.

components.name: CancerPrognosis search studies
components.description: Search cBioPortal for cancer genomics studies by keyword, including cancer type, institution, or data type, and return study IDs for use with other CancerPrognosis tools.

components.name: CancerVar classify variant
components.description: Classifies somatic cancer variants using AMP/ASCO/CAP 2017 guidelines (CancerVar), returning Tier I–IV clinical significance assignments, 12 CBP evidence scores, and an Oncogenicity Pathogenicity Index from genomic coordinates in hg19 or hg38.

components.name: CATH domain summary
components.description: Get CATH structural classification for a specific protein domain using its CATH domain ID (PDB code + chain + domain number). Returns the full CATH hierarchy (Class, Architecture, Topology, Homologous superfamily) and residue count.

components.name: CATH Get FunFam
components.description: Retrieve details for a specific CATH functional family (FunFam) within a CATH superfamily, returning name, description, member count, seed alignment size, DOPS quality score, and representative domain ID from the CATH database.

components.name: CATH get superfamily
components.description: Retrieves CATH protein structure superfamily information by CATH ID, including classification name, number of families, domain counts, and an example domain ID. CATH classifies protein domain structures into Class, Architecture, Topology, and Homologous superfamily levels.

components.name: CATH List FunFams
components.description: Lists functional families (FunFams) within a specified CATH superfamily. Takes a CATH superfamily ID and returns FunFam numbers, names, member counts, and representative domain IDs.

components.name: cBioPortal Get Cancer Studies
components.description: Retrieves one page of the cBioPortal cancer study catalogue, using limit and offset pagination, and returns a slice of cancer studies along with counts and truncation status.

components.name: cBioPortal get cancer types
components.description: Retrieves all cancer types from cBioPortal, including TCGA, Pan-Cancer Atlas, and other studies. Returns cancerTypeId, name, and clinical trial keywords for filtering studies.

components.name: Get clinical attributes
components.description: Get available clinical attributes for a cancer study from cBioPortal. Accepts a study ID and returns attribute IDs, names, and data types in JSON.

components.name: cBioPortal clinical data retrieval
components.description: Retrieves patient-level clinical data such as tumor stage, histology, and survival status for samples in a cBioPortal cancer study. Supports filtering by clinical attribute ID and returns paginated records with total availability and truncation notes.

components.name: Get Copy Number Alterations
components.description: Retrieves discrete copy-number alteration calls per sample from GISTIC profiles for a gene in a specified cBioPortal cancer study, returning per-sample alteration values (-2 to 2) and category counts, with optional filtering by alteration type.

components.name: cBioPortal get gene info
components.description: Get basic information about a specific gene by Entrez Gene ID from the cBioPortal API, returning the HUGO gene symbol and gene type.

components.name: cBioPortal get gene panel genes
components.description: Retrieves all genes in a specified cBioPortal gene panel by gene panel ID. Returns gene records for the panel, supporting analysis of targeted sequencing mutation frequency data.

components.name: cBioPortal get gene panels
components.description: Get gene panels used in cBioPortal studies. Gene panels define which genes were sequenced in a study. Use to understand coverage before querying mutation data. Returns one page: page_size defaults to 50, and the response reports total_available (all panels matching) next to count (panels returned), plus truncated/trun…

components.name: cBioPortal Gene Search
components.description: Search for genes by gene symbol or alias using the cBioPortal REST API and return matching gene records in JSON format.

components.name: Get molecular profiles
components.description: Get molecular profiles for a cancer study from cBioPortal, including mutation data, copy number alterations, and mRNA expression, using a study ID.

components.name: cBioPortal get mutations
components.description: Get mutation data for specific genes in a cancer study using the cBioPortal API, which requires a study ID and gene list.

components.name: cBioPortal Get Patients
components.description: Get all patients in a cancer study from cBioPortal using a study ID. The response is a bare array of patient records, and the default page_size is high enough to return the full cohort.

components.name: cBioPortal Get Sample Lists
components.description: Retrieves all sample lists (cohort definitions) for a specified cancer study from the cBioPortal API, returning JSON records that define groups like samples with mutations or CNA data.

components.name: cBioPortal Get Samples
components.description: Retrieves all samples in a specified cancer study from cBioPortal, using the study_id as input and returning the full sample cohort by default; the count is documented as a denominator for mutation-frequency calculations.

components.name: CDC data aggregate
components.description: Runs server-side SoQL aggregations on CDC Data.CDC.gov (Socrata) datasets to compute grouped statistics such as counts, sums, and averages by disease event, state, or year. Accepts a dataset ID and either select/group clauses or a full SoQL query, returning aggregated rows.

components.name: CDC Data Get Dataset
components.description: Retrieve data from a specific CDC dataset on Data.CDC.gov using a dataset ID. Returns matching dataset records.

components.name: CDC Data Search Datasets
components.description: Search for datasets on Data.CDC.gov, CDC's Socrata-based open data portal, and return a list of available datasets matching the search query. Supports optional category and pagination filters.

components.name: CellMarker list cell types
components.description: Lists available cell types in the CellMarker 2.0 database for a given tissue and species, returning all annotated cell types in that tissue context for normal and cancer contexts.

components.name: CellMarker search by cell type
components.description: Search the CellMarker 2.0 database for marker genes of a specific cell type. Returns curated lists of marker genes sourced from single-cell RNA-seq studies and experimental literature for cell type annotation or gene set scoring.

components.name: CellMarker search by gene
components.description: Search the CellMarker 2.0 database to identify cell types that express a given marker gene. Accepts a gene symbol (e.g., CD3D, CD68, EPCAM) and returns curated cell type annotations from single-cell RNA-seq studies and experimental literature across human and mouse.

components.name: CellMarker search cancer markers
components.description: Search the CellMarker 2.0 database for cancer-specific cell markers filtered to cancer cell annotations. Users can query by cancer type, gene symbol, or cell type, and results include marker genes and cell types from cancer tissue contexts.

components.name: Cellosaurus cell line info
components.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific cell line using its Cellosaurus accession number (CVCL_ format). The tool accepts a CVCL accession and returns cell line details from the Cellosaurus knowledge resource.

components.name: Cellosaurus query converter
components.description: Converts natural language queries to Solr syntax for Cellosaurus API searches, using semantic similarity to map terms to appropriate fields. Accepts a natural language query and returns the converted Solr query string.

components.name: Cellosaurus cell line search
components.description: Search Cellosaurus cell lines using the /search/cell-line endpoint with Solr query syntax for precise field-based searches, returning matching cell line records.

components.name: CellPainting get screen plates
components.description: Get the list of plates in a Cell Painting screen from the Image Data Resource (IDR) using a screen ID; returns plate IDs and names.

components.name: Cell Painting get well data
components.description: Get well-level metadata and image links for a specific plate in a Cell Painting experiment from the Image Data Resource (IDR). The tool accepts a plate ID and returns well IDs, row/column positions, well URLs, and links to microscopy images.

components.name: CellPainting search screens
components.description: List available Cell Painting screens and studies in the Image Data Resource (IDR), returning screen names, IDs, descriptions, and URLs, with optional keyword filtering.

components.name: Cellpose segment image
components.description: Segment cells or nuclei in a single microscopy image locally using the deep-learning Cellpose model. Given a local image file path, returns the number of segmented objects, per-object area and centroid, image shape, and optionally the path to a saved integer label-mask image.

components.name: CellTypist Get Model
components.description: Retrieve metadata for a CellTypist model by filename, including training description, number of resolved cell types, version, source DOI, and download URL. This tool returns catalog metadata only and does not perform cell annotation.

components.name: CellTypist search models
components.description: Search the CellTypist catalog of pre-trained models for automated single-cell type annotation by keyword, returning model metadata such as filename, training data, resolved cell types, and download URL. Use this to select a classifier for a tissue.

components.name: CELLxGENE download H5AD
components.description: Download original H5AD (HDF5-based AnnData) files from CELLxGENE datasets or retrieve their URIs using a dataset ID from CELLxGENE Discover, for raw single-cell data access and offline analysis.

components.name: CELLxGENE get cell metadata
components.description: Queries cell metadata from CELLxGENE Census, a collection of over 50 million human and mouse single cells. Accepts a required obs_value_filter for tissue, cell type, and disease, and returns cell type, tissue, disease, and donor information.

components.name: CELLxGENE get census versions
components.description: Get a list of available CELLxGENE Census versions with release dates and descriptions. The Census contains single-cell RNA-seq data from 50M+ cells across human, mouse, and non-human primates. This tool requires the cellxgene-census Python package for live access.

components.name: CELLxGENE Get Embeddings
components.description: Access pre-calculated cell embeddings (scVI, Geneformer) from CELLxGENE Census. Returns available embedding names or specific embedding data for visualization and analysis.

components.name: CELLxGENE get expression data
components.description: Query gene expression data from the CELLxGENE Census, a large-scale transcriptomics resource with over 50 million cells and 60,000 genes. Accepts required filters on cell and gene metadata and returns an AnnData summary with dimensions and metadata.

components.name: CELLxGENE Gene Metadata Lookup
components.description: Query gene metadata from the CELLxGENE Census, returning gene symbols, Ensembl IDs, feature types, and summary statistics. Supports filtering by gene name, feature type, or expression characteristics.

components.name: CELLxGENE get presence matrix
components.description: Retrieves a feature presence matrix from the CELLxGENE Census, showing which genes are measured in which datasets, and returns sparse matrix dimensions and density to support gene coverage and dataset selection.

components.name: ChannelsDB get channels cofactor
components.description: Get cofactor access tunnel data for a PDB structure from ChannelsDB, including geometric profiles, physicochemical properties, and residue layers lining each tunnel.

components.name: ChannelsDB Get Channels PDB
components.description: Retrieves protein channel, tunnel, and pore data for a PDB structure from ChannelsDB, including channel geometry profiles, physicochemical properties, residue layers, and expert annotations, using a PDB ID as input.

components.name: ChEBI Get Compound
components.description: Retrieves detailed information about a chemical entity from the ChEBI database by its CHEBI ID, returning compound name, definition, synonyms, molecular formula, mass, InChIKey, SMILES, charge, and curation star rating.

components.name: ChEBI get ontology children
components.description: Get the ontology children of a ChEBI compound using relationships such as is-a, has-part, has-functional-parent, and conjugate base/acid. Supports obsolete identifier redirects to the primary entry.

components.name: ChEBI ontology parents
components.description: Get the ontology parents (is-a and has-role ancestors) of a ChEBI compound by its ChEBI identifier, navigating upward in the chemical classification hierarchy. Obsolete or merged accessions are resolved to the primary ChEBI entry.

components.name: ChEBI compound lookup
components.description: Retrieves a ChEBI compound record by its ChEBI identifier, returning details such as name, accession, and definition from the ChEBI database.

components.name: Chem SA Score
components.description: Computes the synthetic accessibility (SA) score for a molecule provided as a SMILES string using the RDKit SA_Score contribution module. Scores range from 1 (simple) to 10 (complex) and are useful for filtering synthetically intractable hits in virtual screening workflows.

components.name: ChEMBL disease-target score
components.description: Extract disease-target association scores from the ChEMBL database using an EFO disease identifier. Returns scored targets with association values between 0 and 1.

components.name: ChEMBL get activity
components.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific ChEMBL bioactivity record by its activity ID. Accepts a ChEMBL activity ID and returns the corresponding activity record from the /activity/{activity_id}.json endpoint.

components.name: ChEMBL assay lookup
components.description: Retrieve detailed information about a ChEMBL assay by its ChEMBL assay ID from the ChEMBL database.

components.name: ChEMBL Get Assay Activities
components.description: Get all activity data for a ChEMBL assay by its ChEMBL assay ID. Returns bioactivity measurements from the specified assay.

components.name: ChEMBL compound record lookup
components.description: Get compound record information by ChEMBL compound record ID from the ChEMBL database via its REST endpoint.

components.name: ChEMBL Get Compound Record Activities
components.description: Retrieves all bioactivity measurements for a ChEMBL compound record by compound record ID. Returns activity data from the ChEMBL database.

components.name: ChEMBL get drug
components.description: Get detailed information about a drug by its ChEMBL drug ID, including approval status, indications, and mechanisms.

components.name: ChEMBL get drug mechanisms
components.description: Retrieves mechanisms of action for a drug from ChEMBL using either a ChEMBL drug ID or drug name, with automatic ChEMBL ID lookup when a name is provided.

components.name: ChEMBL Get Molecule
components.description: Retrieves detailed information for a molecule by its ChEMBL ID, including molecule properties, structures, synonyms, and related data from the ChEMBL database.

components.name: ChEMBL molecule image retrieval
components.description: Get molecular structure image (SVG or PNG format) for a molecule by ChEMBL ID, returning the image URL and metadata.

components.name: ChEMBL Get Molecule Targets
components.description: Get all unique targets associated with a molecule by ChEMBL ID, returning targets that have activity data for the specified molecule and deduplicated from activity records.

components.name: ChEMBL Get Target
components.description: Retrieves detailed information about a ChEMBL target (protein, gene, etc.) by its ChEMBL target ID from the ChEMBL database.

components.name: ChEMBL get target activities
components.description: Retrieve all bioactivity measurements (IC50, Ki, etc.) for molecules tested against a target specified by a ChEMBL target ID from the ChEMBL database.

components.name: ChEMBL get target assays
components.description: Retrieves all ChEMBL assays associated with a specified target using its ChEMBL target ID and returns the assay records from the /assay.json endpoint.

components.name: ChEMBL search activities
components.description: Search ChEMBL bioactivity data by molecule, target, assay, or activity value filters such as IC50, Ki, and EC50.

components.name: ChEMBL search assays
components.description: Search ChEMBL assay records by target ChEMBL ID and return matching assay records.

components.name: ChEMBL search ATC classification
components.description: Search ATC (Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical) classifications for drugs using the ChEMBL REST API. Accepts an optional ATC level 4 code filter and returns matching classification records.

components.name: ChEMBL search binding sites
components.description: Search ChEMBL binding sites by site name using the /binding_site resource, returning matching binding-site records.

components.name: ChEMBL Search Cell Lines
components.description: Search ChEMBL for cell lines used in assays by cell line ChEMBL ID or name contains filters, returning matching cell line records.

components.name: ChEMBL Search Compound Structural Alerts
components.description: Search ChEMBL compound structural alerts (toxicity warnings) by molecule ChEMBL ID or alert name. Returns matching structural alert records from ChEMBL.

components.name: ChEMBL search documents
components.description: Searches ChEMBL document records for publications by document ChEMBL ID or title substring and returns matching document objects from the ChEMBL /document.json endpoint.

components.name: ChEMBL Search Drugs
components.description: Search ChEMBL for drugs by name and return matching drug records with ChEMBL identifiers.

components.name: ChEMBL search mechanisms
components.description: Search ChEMBL mechanisms of action by drug ChEMBL ID or mechanism type, returning mechanism records from the /mechanism.json endpoint.

components.name: ChEMBL search molecules
components.description: Search ChEMBL molecules by name, ChEMBL ID, or other criteria with filtering and pagination. Returns molecule data including structures, properties, and synonyms.

components.name: ChEMBL protein classification search
components.description: Browse ChEMBL protein family classifications by class ID and other classification fields, returning matching protein classification records from the ChEMBL database.

components.name: ChEMBL similar molecule search
components.description: Search for molecules similar to a given SMILES, ChEMBL ID, or compound/drug name using the ChEMBL Web Services. Returns similar small molecules from ChEMBL, excluding biologics.

components.name: ChEMBL similarity search
components.description: Search ChEMBL for molecules similar to a given SMILES string using Tanimoto similarity, returning molecules above the specified threshold.

components.name: ChEMBL search substructure
components.description: Search molecules by substructure using SMILES. Returns molecules containing the specified substructure from ChEMBL.

components.name: ChEMBL search targets
components.description: Search the ChEMBL database for target records by target name or gene symbol, returning matching target entries.

components.name: ChEMBL search tissue
components.description: Search ChEMBL tissue records by tissue name substring or ChEMBL ID, returning matching tissues used in ChEMBL assays.

components.name: ChIPAtlas enrichment analysis
components.description: Perform enrichment analysis to identify transcription factors and histone modifications enriched in user-provided BED genomic regions, DNA sequence motifs, or gene symbol lists by comparing against 433,000+ ChIP-seq/ATAC-seq/Bisulfite-seq experiments in ChIP-Atlas, returning a ranked list of proteins.

components.name: ChIP-Atlas Colocalization
components.description: Returns proteins whose ChIP-seq peaks co-occur genome-wide with a specified antigen or transcription factor in a tissue class, ranked by overlap score. Uses ChIP-Atlas precomputed colocalization matrices and requires antigen and tissue class inputs.

components.name: ChIPAtlas get experiment metadata
components.description: Given a ChIP-Atlas experiment accession (SRX/DRX/ERX), return structured metadata including antigen class and antigen, cell-type class and cell type, title, and parsed sample attributes, with optional filtering by genome assembly.

components.name: ChIPAtlas get experiments
components.description: Search ChIP-Atlas experiment metadata by genome, antigen, and cell type, returning experiment details such as experiment IDs and processing statistics for dataset discovery.

components.name: ChIPAtlas Get Peak Data
components.description: Get download URLs for ChIP-Atlas peak-call data in BigWig, BED, or BigBed format. The tool accepts a ChIP-Atlas experiment identifier and returns file URLs for coverage or peak regions for genome browser integration, visualization, or custom analysis.

components.name: ChIPAtlas target genes
components.description: Retrieves ranked potential target genes for a transcription factor from ChIP-Atlas, based on average ChIP-seq binding strength across experiments within a selectable TSS-distance window.

components.name: ChIPAtlas search datasets
components.description: Search ChIP-Atlas by antigen or cell type to find available datasets and return experiment counts and IDs. Supports dataset discovery, planning comparative analysis, and checking data availability.

components.name: CIViC Get Assertion
components.description: Get detailed information about a specific CIViC assertion by assertion ID, including description, evidence summary, and associated molecular profile or variant information.

components.name: CIViC evidence item lookup
components.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific CIViC evidence item by evidence ID, including evidence level, type, significance, disease, therapies, molecular profile, and citation.

components.name: CIViC Molecular Profile Lookup
components.description: Retrieves detailed information about a CIViC molecular profile by integer ID, including profile name, description, clinical significance score, and associated evidence items with diseases, therapies, and evidence levels.

components.name: CIViC Get Variant
components.description: Retrieves variant records from the CIViC database by variant identifier or name.

components.name: CIViC Get Variants by Gene
components.description: Retrieve all variants associated with a specific gene from the CIViC database using gene name, gene symbol, or gene ID, returning variant information including names, coordinates, and associated evidence.

components.name: CIViC Search Assertions
components.description: Search the CIViC database for clinical assertions, which are higher-level interpretations integrating evidence items into statements about clinical actionability. Accepts filters for therapy, disease, or variant name and returns matching assertions with descriptions and associated molecular profiles or variants.

components.name: CIViC disease search
components.description: Search for cancer diseases and conditions in the CIViC database by name or query. The tool returns matching disease records with identifiers and names that are associated with variants and evidence in CIViC.

components.name: CIViC Evidence Item Search
components.description: Search the CIViC database for curated evidence items linking variants or molecular profiles to clinical outcomes, therapies, or disease states. Accepts filters by therapy, disease, molecular profile, or evidence type and returns evidence with disease, therapies, significance, direction, and citation.

components.name: CIViC gene search
components.description: Search the CIViC cancer variant knowledgebase for genes by symbol, returning matching gene records with IDs, names, and descriptions.

components.name: CIViC molecular profile search
components.description: Search CIViC molecular profiles by profile name (including gene variants and fusions) and evidence type, returning matching molecular profile records.

components.name: CIViC Search Therapies
components.description: Search for therapies (drugs/treatments) in the CIViC database. Accepts a therapy name or query filter and returns matching cancer therapy and drug records with identifiers and names.

components.name: CIViC search variants
components.description: Search CIViC database for clinically relevant cancer variants by variant name, gene, or combined gene+variant query. Returns a list of variants with IDs and names.

components.name: ClassyFire classify by InChIKey
components.description: Classify a chemical structure into the ClassyFire ChemOnt chemical taxonomy by its InChIKey, returning the hierarchical classification from kingdom to direct parent, molecular framework, structural substituents, and a textual description.

components.name: ClinGen dosage by gene
components.description: Retrieve ClinGen dosage sensitivity curation for a gene symbol, returning haploinsufficiency and triplosensitivity scores, genomic coordinates in GRCh37/GRCh38, pLI score, HI prediction score, and associated MONDO diseases.

components.name: ClinGen dosage region search
components.description: Searches ClinGen dosage sensitivity curations by genomic region and returns genes and recurrent CNV regions with haploinsufficiency and triplosensitivity scores overlapping the specified coordinates, supporting GRCh37 and GRCh38.

components.name: ClinGen get actionability adult
components.description: Get ClinGen clinical actionability curations for adult context, returning genes with actionable findings, intervention scores, and outcome scores. Accepts an optional gene symbol filter to prioritize incidental findings for return.

components.name: ClinGen get actionability pediatric
components.description: Retrieves ClinGen clinical actionability curations for pediatric context, returning genes with actionable findings, intervention recommendations, and evidence scores. Optionally filters by gene symbol.

components.name: ClinGen Get Dosage Sensitivity
components.description: Retrieves ClinGen dosage sensitivity curations for genes, including haploinsufficiency and triplosensitivity scores, with optional filtering by gene symbol and inclusion of recurrent CNV regions.

components.name: ClinGen gene validity lookup
components.description: Retrieves ClinGen gene-disease validity curations, returning a comprehensive list of gene-disease relationships with classifications such as Definitive, Strong, Moderate, and Limited, with an optional gene symbol filter.

components.name: ClinGen variant classification lookup
components.description: Get variant pathogenicity classifications from the ClinGen Evidence Repository. Returns expert-curated variant classifications with supporting evidence, optionally filtered by gene or variant, following ACMG/AMP guidelines.

components.name: ClinGen Search Actionability
components.description: Search ClinGen clinical actionability data by gene symbol, returning actionability records for adult and pediatric contexts for comparison.

components.name: ClinGen dosage sensitivity search
components.description: Search ClinGen dosage sensitivity curations by gene symbol and return haploinsufficiency (HI) and triplosensitivity (TS) scores on a 0-3 scale for CNV interpretation.

components.name: ClinGen search gene validity
components.description: Search ClinGen gene-disease validity curations by gene symbol to retrieve classification, disease associations, and inheritance patterns.

components.name: Get allele details by CA ID
components.description: Get detailed information for a canonical allele by its ClinGen Allele Registry CA ID, returning cross-references to ClinVar, dbSNP, COSMIC, gnomAD, genomic coordinates, and transcript-level HGVS expressions.

components.name: ClinGen Allele Lookup by HGVS
components.description: Look up a genetic variant by HGVS expression in the ClinGen Allele Registry to obtain its canonical allele identifier (CA ID) and cross-references to ClinVar, dbSNP, COSMIC, gnomAD, and other databases. Accepts genomic, coding, or protein HGVS expressions and returns allele records with coordinate details.

components.name: ClinGenAR get external records
components.description: Get detailed cross-references and external database records for a ClinGen canonical allele by allele ID. Returns links to ClinVar, dbSNP, COSMIC, gnomAD, ExAC, and other databases.

components.name: ClinGen Allele Registry variant lookup
components.description: Looks up a genetic variant in the ClinGen Allele Registry by HGVS notation and returns the canonical allele identifier, community standard title, and cross-references to ClinVar, dbSNP, COSMIC, gnomAD, and other databases, normalizing variant representations across coordinate systems.

components.name: ClinGen AR lookup by external ID
components.description: Reverse-lookup the ClinGen Allele Registry by an external identifier (dbSNP rsID or ClinVar VariationID) to resolve the canonical ClinGen allele (CA ID) and return cross-references and HGVS titles.

components.name: Clinical Trial AE Severity Test
components.description: Merge clinical trial demographics and adverse event CSVs and run statistical tests on adverse event severity across treatment groups. Supports merge-only, chi-square contingency, and ordinal logistic regression analyses, returning statistical results such as chi2/p/dof/contingency_table or odds ratio, 95% CI, p-value,…

components.name: ClinicalCalc ASCVD risk
components.description: Calculates 10-year atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) risk using the 2013 ACC/AHA Pooled Cohort Equations (Goff 2013) from age, cholesterol, blood pressure, smoking, diabetes, sex, and race; returns risk percent and category.

components.name: ClinicalCalc CHA2DS2 VASc
components.description: Calculates the CHA2DS2-VASc score for stroke risk in non-valvular atrial fibrillation from age, sex and boolean risk factors, returning the 0-9 score, anticoagulation interpretation, and per-component points.

components.name: ClinicalCalc Child-Pugh
components.description: Calculates the Child-Pugh score and class (A/B/C) for chronic liver disease/cirrhosis severity and surgical risk from laboratory values (bilirubin, albumin, INR) and clinical grades (ascites, encephalopathy).

components.name: ClinicalCalc CURB-65
components.description: Calculates the CURB-65 severity score for community-acquired pneumonia from age, confusion, elevated urea, high respiratory rate, and low blood pressure, returning a 0-5 point score to guide disposition.

components.name: ClinicalCalc eGFR CKD-EPI
components.description: Estimates glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) using the CKD-EPI 2021 creatinine equation (race-free, Inker 2021) from serum creatinine, age, and sex, and reports eGFR in mL/min/1.73m^2 with CKD stage (G1-G5). Inputs outside the validated range return caveats; results above 150 are reported as not stageable.

components.name: ClinicalCalc_HAS_BLED
components.description: Calculates the HAS-BLED score, a clinical risk score for estimating 1-year major bleeding risk in patients with atrial fibrillation on anticoagulation, using clinical inputs such as age, hypertension, renal disease, liver disease, and other risk factors, and returns a point score (0-9).

components.name: MELD-Na Score Calculator
components.description: Calculate the MELD-Na score (UNOS/OPTN 2016) for 90-day mortality risk in chronic liver disease and liver transplant allocation priority. Uses serum creatinine, total bilirubin, INR, and sodium with standard bounds and dialysis rule.

components.name: ClinicalCalc qSOFA
components.description: Calculates the qSOFA (quick SOFA) score from three clinical criteria: respiratory rate >=22/min, altered mentation (GCS <15), and systolic blood pressure <=100 mmHg, returning a point score of 0-3.

components.name: ClinicalCalc Wells DVT
components.description: Calculates the Wells score for deep vein thrombosis (DVT) pretest probability from clinical features such as active cancer, immobilization, recent surgery, and localized tenderness; a score of 2 or higher indicates DVT is likely and guides D-dimer versus ultrasound workup.

components.name: Wells score for pulmonary embolism
components.description: Calculates the Wells score for pulmonary embolism pretest probability from clinical criteria such as DVT signs, PE as most likely diagnosis, tachycardia, and immobilization. Returns the weighted score and three-tier (low/moderate/high) and two-tier (PE unlikely/likely) risk categories to guide D-dimer versus CT pulmon…

components.name: ClinicalTrialDesignAgent
components.description: AI agent that designs clinical trial protocols based on preclinical data, drug name, indication, and target population, incorporating regulatory requirements to produce study design, endpoints, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and dosing strategy.

components.name: ClinicalTrials get database stats
components.description: Get aggregate statistics about the ClinicalTrials.gov database, including total number of registered studies and size distribution. Returns database-wide counts and file size metrics.

components.name: ClinicalTrials field value distribution
components.description: Retrieves registry-wide value distribution for a specified ClinicalTrials.gov field, returning distinct field values and the number of studies recording each value.

components.name: ClinicalTrials get study
components.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for a clinical trial from ClinicalTrials.gov using its NCT ID, returning the protocol including title, objectives, eligibility criteria, interventions, outcome measures, contacts, and results summary.

components.name: ClinicalTrials search by intervention
components.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov for clinical trials testing a specific drug, biologic, device, or other intervention, returning trial identifiers, titles, phases, status, and conditions.

components.name: ClinicalTrials search by sponsor
components.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov for clinical trials by sponsor or lead organization. Returns matching trial records using a sponsor query, with query rewriting for exact phrase matching.

components.name: ClinicalTrials search studies
components.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov for studies matching condition, intervention, or free-text query terms and return matching clinical trial records.

components.name: ClinVar get clinical significance
components.description: Retrieves clinical significance information for a ClinVar variant by variant ID.

components.name: ClinVar get submitted records
components.description: Retrieves individual per-submitter assertions (SCV / ClinicalAssertion records) for a ClinVar variant by calling NCBI E-utilities efetch and parsing the VariationArchive XML. Accepts a ClinVar variant identifier (VCV accession or bare ID) and returns each submitter's classification, review status, condition, and last-…

components.name: ClinVar get variant details
components.description: Get variant summary information from ClinVar by variant ID, including accession, title, genes, clinical significance, review status, chromosome location, and variation name.

components.name: ClinVar search by region
components.description: Search ClinVar for variants that overlap a specified genomic region, including large copy-number variants whose start is far outside the queried window. Returns matching variant records with variant IDs, clinical significance, and submitter information.

components.name: ClinVar variant search
components.description: Search ClinVar database for variants by gene name, condition, variant ID, or variant name; returns variant identifiers and basic information. At least one search criterion is required, and combining gene with variant name enables exact-match lookup of a specific variant.

components.name: CLUE get cell lines
components.description: Get cell line information used in L1000 Connectivity Map experiments. Returns cell line metadata including tissue of origin, growth properties, and available data types, optionally filtered by cell_id.

components.name: CLUE get gene expression
components.description: Retrieve gene metadata from the L1000 Connectivity Map landmark and inferred gene set by gene symbol. Returns gene symbol, Entrez ID, and L1000 gene type (landmark or inferred).

components.name: CLUE Get Perturbation
components.description: Get detailed information about a specific L1000 perturbagen from CLUE.io by ID or name. Returns metadata including mechanism of action, target, SMILES, dose, and time points.

components.name: CLUE Search Compounds
components.description: Search chemical compounds (small molecule drugs) in the L1000 Connectivity Map, filtered to trt_cp perturbation type, by drug name or mechanism of action. Returns compound metadata including targets, pathways, and clinical status.

components.name: CLUE Search Signatures
components.description: Search L1000 Connectivity Map perturbation signatures from CLUE.io by perturbagen name or type filter and return perturbation records including genetic and chemical perturbagens with metadata.

components.name: ClusPro Submit Peptide Docking
components.description: Submit a peptide-protein docking job to ClusPro in peptide mode by providing a receptor PDB ID, peptide sequence, and optional peptide motif; returns a ClusPro job ID for asynchronous retrieval of clustered poses and scores.

components.name: CMA Guidelines Search
components.description: Search Canadian Medical Association (CMA) Infobase clinical practice guidelines by medical condition, treatment, or clinical topic, returning matching guideline records.

components.name: CMS Open Payments search payments
components.description: Search CMS Open Payments (the Sunshine Act database) for payments and transfers of value from drug/device manufacturers to US physicians or teaching hospitals, or all payments by a manufacturer, for a selected program year. Accepts one identifying filter such as NPI, recipient last name, manufacturer ID, or manufactur…

components.name: Coding variant fraction
components.description: Computes the fraction of coding variants in a local Excel/CSV variant table that match a given Sequence Ontology annotation and fall below a VAF threshold, using a coding-only denominator convention; returns the coding-denominator fraction and a naive fraction over all VAF-filtered records.

components.name: Optimal codon lookup
components.description: Returns the most-used codon for each amino acid in an organism, identified by a taxonomy ID, to provide the reference codon-usage table needed for codon-optimizing sequences for expression in that host.

components.name: Codon usage table lookup
components.description: Retrieve the codon usage table for an organism from the Codon Usage Database using its NCBI taxonomy identifier. Returns all 64 codons with raw counts, frequency per thousand codons, and fraction of amino acid usage.

components.name: Coexpression modules
components.description: Detect co-expression modules from a genes x samples expression matrix using a simplified WGCNA-style soft-thresholded correlation network and modularity partitioning, returning each module's genes and module eigengene. Pure-compute method using NumPy and NetworkX.

components.name: Coloc_abf_test
components.description: Bayesian colocalization of two GWAS/QTL signals over the same SNP set in a region, testing whether the two traits share a single causal variant. Accepts per-SNP effect sizes and standard errors for two traits and returns posterior probabilities PP0-PP4, with PP4 indicating the probability of a shared causal variant.

components.name: Complex Portal complex lookup
components.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific protein complex by Complex Portal accession ID, including subunit composition with stoichiometry, function, disease associations, GO annotations, and cross-references to PDB and Reactome.

components.name: ComplexPortal search complexes
components.description: Search curated protein complexes by gene symbol, protein name, or complex name from the EBI Complex Portal (including CORUM mammalian complexes), returning complex names, subunit compositions, and cross-references.

components.name: Compound Discovery Agent
components.description: AI agent that analyzes potential drug compounds using multiple strategies and LLM reasoning. It accepts a disease name, targets, and discovery context, and returns potential therapeutic compounds including target-based, mechanism-based, repurposing, natural product, and novel candidates.

components.name: ComprehensiveDrugDiscoveryPipeline
components.description: Complete end-to-end drug discovery workflow from disease to optimized candidates. Takes a disease EFO ID and identifies targets, discovers lead compounds, screens ADMET properties, assesses safety, and validates with literature.

components.name: DepMap 24Q2 gene correlations
components.description: Computes gene-gene correlation from DepMap 24Q2 CRISPR knockout screening data across 1,320+ cancer cell lines, taking two HUGO gene symbols as input and returning correlation results that indicate genetic dependencies or synthetic lethal relationships.

components.name: ConoServer get conopeptide
components.description: Retrieve a full ConoServer conopeptide record by its ConoServer protein ID, including sequence, post-translational modifications, cysteine framework, gene superfamily, pharmacological family, source Conus species, masses, pI, extinction coefficient, and literature references from ConoServer.

components.name: ConoServer search conopeptides
components.description: Search ConoServer conopeptides (cone-snail venom peptides) by one or more substring filters such as name, sequence, pharmacological family, gene superfamily, cysteine framework, organism, or conopeptide class. Returns matching records with sequence, modifications, masses, organism, and references from ConoServer.

components.name: Consensus search papers
components.description: Searches more than 220 million peer-reviewed papers through the Consensus API, returning ranked paper records with an AI-generated one-line takeaway and study-design metadata such as study type, sample size, and journal quality for evidence triage.

components.name: Consult human expert
components.description: Consults a human expert for complex scientific questions requiring human judgment. Accepts a question and optional specialty and returns expert-provided clinical decision support, analysis validation, treatment recommendations, or specialized opinions.

components.name: CORE fulltext snippets
components.description: Search within the full text of an open-access paper PDF from CORE using a text query to retrieve matching snippets of body text for exact-term discovery.

components.name: CORE Search Papers
components.description: Search for open access academic papers using the CORE API by keyword query, returning matching paper records from aggregated OA repository and journal content. Queries can match metadata and, for many records, indexed full text.

components.name: COSMIC mutations by gene
components.description: Retrieves all somatic mutations for a specified gene symbol from the COSMIC database. Returns mutation records including CDS changes, amino acid changes, cancer types, and genomic positions.

components.name: COSMIC search mutations
components.description: Search the COSMIC database for somatic mutations in cancer by gene name, mutation ID, or mutation description. Returns mutation IDs, gene names, CDS changes, and amino acid changes.

components.name: CPIC get alleles
components.description: Get pharmacogenomics alleles and their functional status for a specified gene from CPIC, returning allele names, activity values, functional status, and total count with pagination support.

components.name: CPIC Get Drug Info
components.description: Get pharmacogenomics information for a drug by name from the CPIC database, returning drug identifiers such as PharmGKB ID, RxNorm, DrugBank, and ATC codes.

components.name: CPIC gene-drug pair lookup
components.description: Retrieves all gene-drug pairs for a specified pharmacogene from CPIC, including CPIC evidence level and PharmGKB clinical annotation level.

components.name: CPIC gene info lookup
components.description: Retrieves pharmacogenomic gene information from the CPIC database using a gene symbol, returning gene coordinates, sequence IDs, and cross-references to PharmGKB, HGNC, NCBI, and Ensembl.

components.name: CPIC Get Recommendations
components.description: Retrieves specific dosing recommendations from CPIC pharmacogenomic guidelines using a guideline ID, returning genotype/phenotype-based drug dosing guidance for gene-drug pairs.

components.name: CPIC list drugs
components.description: Queries the CPIC drug API by exact drug name and returns matching drug records with identifiers such as CPIC drug ID, clinical PGx ID, and RxNorm ID.

components.name: CPIC List Guidelines
components.description: List all CPIC pharmacogenomic guidelines, optionally filtered by gene, returning guideline records with IDs, names, URLs, associated genes, and PharmGKB IDs.

components.name: CPIC list PGx genes
components.description: Lists all pharmacogenomics genes curated by the Clinical Pharmacogenomics Implementation Consortium (CPIC), returning 130+ genes with known drug interactions including CYP enzymes, transporters, and other pharmacogenes, along with gene coordinates, sequence IDs, and database cross-references.

components.name: CPIC search gene drug pairs
components.description: Search CPIC gene-drug pairs by exact drug name, returning associated gene-drug pair records from the CPIC database.

components.name: CRAN get package
components.description: Get metadata for an R package from the CRAN database (crandb). Accepts a case-sensitive R package name and returns title, version, description, authors, license, dependencies, URL, publication date, and release history.

components.name: CRAN get package versions
components.description: Retrieves all historical versions of an R package from CRAN, including release dates and dependencies, to support compatibility checking and feature timeline analysis.

components.name: Crossref check retraction
components.description: Checks whether a published paper identified by DOI has been retracted, withdrawn, corrected, or flagged with an expression of concern using Crossref update metadata sourced from the Retraction Watch database; returns an is_retracted flag and a list of notices with type, label, notice DOI, and date.

components.name: Crossref funder lookup
components.description: Get detailed metadata for a specific research funder by its Crossref funder ID. Returns comprehensive funder information including official name, alternative names, location, hierarchy, DOI count, and URI from Crossref.

components.name: Crossref Get Journal
components.description: Retrieves metadata for a scholarly journal from Crossref by ISSN, returning title, publisher, ISSN variants, coverage dates, and publication frequency.

components.name: Crossref member search
components.description: Search Crossref members (publishers and depositing organizations) by name and return each member's numeric Crossref ID, primary name, location, and DOI-coverage analytics including current, backfile, and total counts, per-year breakdowns, and prefixes.

components.name: Crossref Get Work
components.description: Searches Crossref academic literature by keyword and returns publication metadata including title, abstract, journal, authors, publication year, DOI, URL, citations, and publisher. Supports filtering by publication type and date range.

components.name: Crossref list funders
components.description: Search and list research funding organizations in the Crossref database, returning funder details such as ID, name, location, DOI count, and alternative names.

components.name: Crossref list types
components.description: List all publication types available in Crossref (e.g., journal-article, book-chapter, conference-paper, dataset, preprint). Returns type identifiers and labels. Use this to discover valid publication type filters for Crossref_search_works, understand the classification of research outputs, or analyze publication type…

components.name: Crossref search members
components.description: Search Crossref members (publishers or depositing organizations) by name and return each member's numeric Crossref member ID, primary name, location, and DOI coverage analytics including current, backfile, and total DOI counts, per-year breakdowns, and prefixes.

components.name: Crossref search works
components.description: Search the Crossref Works API for scholarly articles, publications, and research outputs by keyword. Returns metadata including title, abstract, journal, authors, publication year, DOI, URL, citations, and publisher, with optional filtering by publication type and date range.

components.name: CryoET get dataset
components.description: Retrieve full metadata for a specific CryoET Data Portal dataset by its numeric ID, including organism taxonomy, sample details, publication references, access paths, and file size.

components.name: CryoET list annotations
components.description: Lists biological annotations (segmentations, point annotations, surface meshes) for a specific cryo-ET run from the CryoET Data Portal, returning object name, GO/EMDB ontology ID, annotation method description, count of annotated instances, software used, and metadata paths.

components.name: CryoET list datasets
components.description: Search and list cryo-electron tomography datasets from the CZ BioHub CryoET Data Portal, returning metadata such as title, organism, tissue/cell type, sample type, and data access paths. Supports filtering by organism name or tissue name.

components.name: CryoET list depositions
components.description: Browse depositions from the CZ BioHub CryoET Data Portal. A deposition is the top-level submission unit that bundles datasets, runs, tomograms, and annotations under one author submission, and carries cross-database links (e.g., EMDB entries) in relatedDatabaseEntries. Returns per deposition: id, title, description, d…

components.name: CryoET list runs
components.description: List experimental tilt-series acquisition runs within a specified CryoET Data Portal dataset, returning run names and data access paths for downstream tomogram or annotation retrieval.

components.name: CryoET list tiltseries
components.description: List tilt-series raw acquisition metadata from the CZ BioHub CryoET Data Portal, including microscope details, acceleration voltage, tilt range, tilt step, tilt axis, electron dose, camera information, acquisition software, binning, and pixel size for a given run ID.

components.name: CryoET list tomograms
components.description: Lists tomographic reconstructions for a specified experimental run from the CryoET Data Portal, returning voxel spacing, tomogram dimensions, reconstruction method, processing pipeline, and download URLs in OME-Zarr and MRC formats.

components.name: CrystalStructure validate
components.description: Validates a crystal structure by computing theoretical density from unit cell parameters (a, b, c, alpha, beta, gamma), Z formula units per cell, and molecular weight; optionally compares against reported density and flags deviations >1% or >5%, and auto-detects the crystal system.

components.name: CTD chemical-disease associations
components.description: Get curated chemical-disease associations from CTD. Given a chemical name, returns associated diseases, the underlying evidence type (marker/mechanism vs therapeutic), and supporting PubMed IDs, using mydisease.info's cached copy of CTD data.

components.name: CTD chemical-gene interactions
