components.description: This tool is configured to retrieve curated chemical-gene interaction data from the Comparative Toxicogenomics Database (CTD) based on a chemical name, CAS RN, or MeSH ID, but it is permanently unavailable and always returns an error.

components.name: CTD disease chemicals lookup
components.description: Get curated disease-chemical associations from CTD via mydisease.info's cached copy. Given a disease name, MONDO CURIE, or MeSH disease ID, returns associated chemicals with evidence type and supporting PubMed ID.

components.name: CTD get gene chemicals
components.description: Intended to retrieve chemicals that interact with a query gene from the Comparative Toxicogenomics Database (CTD) using a gene symbol or NCBI Gene ID, returning the source database and matching chemical records. The tool is permanently unavailable and always returns an error because CTD's batchQuery is CAPTCHA-blocked…

components.name: CTD gene-disease lookup
components.description: Documented to retrieve CTD-curated gene-disease associations for a gene symbol or NCBI Gene ID; the tool is permanently unavailable and returns a structured error redirecting to OpenTargets_get_diseases_phenotypes_by_target_ensembl.

components.name: CTFPHC list guidelines
components.description: List all published guidelines from the Canadian Task Force on Preventive Health Care (CTFPHC). Fetches the official index of 27 published preventive health guidelines covering cancer screening, cardiovascular risk, diabetes, mental health, and other primary care topics.

components.name: CTFPHC guideline search
components.description: Searches published guidelines from the Canadian Task Force on Preventive Health Care (CTFPHC) by keyword and returns matching preventive health guidelines.

components.name: CTIS Get Trial
components.description: Retrieve a single EU CTIS clinical trial by its CT number (format like '2022-503001-38-01'). The tool returns the trial's status, key dates, trial region, authorized application details, events, and results availability.

components.name: CTIS search trials
components.description: Search the EU Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) for authorized clinical trials under the Clinical Trials Regulation using free-text queries, returning CT number, title, status, conditions, therapeutic areas, phase, sponsor, participating countries, enrollment, and dates.

components.name: CTIS Search Trials Filtered
components.description: Structured search of the EU Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) that filters authorized EU/EEA clinical trials by medical condition, trial status, phase, age group, gender, sponsor, therapeutic area, and country or member state concerned. Returns matching clinical trial records.

components.name: CxGDisc Get Collection
components.description: Retrieve detailed metadata for a specific CellxGene Discovery collection by its collection UUID, including associated datasets with tissue, disease, organism, cell type, and assay details.

components.name: CxGDisc list collections
components.description: List curated single-cell RNA-seq collections from CZI CellxGene Discovery. Each collection is a published dataset group with DOI, typically corresponding to a paper. The platform hosts 350+ public collections spanning diverse tissues, diseases, and organisms with cell-type annotations. Returns collection name, DOI, da…

components.name: CellxGene Discovery dataset search
components.description: Search CellxGene Discovery single-cell RNA-seq datasets by tissue, disease, organism, or cell type. Returns matching dataset records sorted by cell count, sourced from the CellxGene Discovery platform's 2,000+ annotated datasets.

components.name: DailyMed Get SPL by Set ID
components.description: Retrieves the complete DailyMed structured product label (SPL) for a given SPL Set ID and returns the content in XML format.

components.name: DailyMed SPL history lookup
components.description: Get the full version history of a DailyMed SPL Set ID, including every published SPL version with its version number and publication date. Accepts a UUID setid and returns SPL version history records from DailyMed.

components.name: DailyMed get SPL media
components.description: Retrieves structured drug-label media such as pill photos, packaging images, and figures from DailyMed for a given SPL Set ID, returning each item's MIME type, file name, and direct image URL.

components.name: DailyMed parse adverse reactions
components.description: Parses the adverse reactions section from DailyMed SPL XML using an SPL Set ID and returns structured adverse event frequencies, severity, and descriptions.

components.name: DailyMed Parse Clinical Pharmacology
components.description: Parses the clinical pharmacology section from DailyMed SPL XML using an SPL Set ID, returning PK parameters (Cmax, Tmax, t1/2, AUC), PD effects, metabolism pathways, and elimination data.

components.name: DailyMed parse contraindications
components.description: Parses the contraindications section from a DailyMed SPL XML document into a structured list of conditions, populations, or situations where a drug should not be used, given an SPL Set ID.

components.name: DailyMed parse dosing
components.description: Parses the dosage and administration section from DailyMed SPL XML documents using an SPL Set ID and optional drug name, returning structured dosing instructions, dose modifications, and administration guidelines.

components.name: DailyMed parse drug interactions
components.description: Parses DailyMed SPL XML drug labels into structured drug interaction records using a SPL Set ID and optional drug name, returning CYP substrates/inhibitors/inducers, P-gp interactions, and specific drug-drug interactions.

components.name: DailyMed search drug classes
components.description: Searches the DailyMed database for FDA Established Pharmacologic Classes (EPC) by drug class name or therapeutic area query. Returns matching drug class names and NDF-RT codes, which can be used to search DailyMed SPLs for all drugs in that class.

components.name: DailyMed search SPLs
components.description: Search DailyMed Structured Product Labeling (SPL) records by drug name, NDC, RxCUI, set ID, or publication date and return matching metadata and data arrays.

components.name: DANDI Get Dataset
components.description: Search the DANDI Archive for neurophysiology datasets in NWB standard, covering electrophysiology, optical physiology, and behavior recordings; returns matching dandiset IDs for use with other DANDI tools.

components.name: DANDI List Assets
components.description: Search the DANDI Archive for neurophysiology datasets in NWB format by free-text query and return matching dandiset identifiers for use with DANDI_get_dataset and DANDI_list_assets.

components.name: DANDI search datasets
components.description: Search the DANDI Archive for neurophysiology datasets in NWB format, including electrophysiology, optical physiology, and behavior recordings. Accepts a free-text query and returns matching dataset records with dandiset_id for further retrieval.

components.name: Data Analysis Validity Reviewer
components.description: Reviews a statistical analysis section and results for appropriateness of tests/models, assumption verification, reporting completeness, and reproducibility, producing ratings and critiques.

components.name: DataCite Get Dataset
components.description: Retrieves comprehensive metadata for a research dataset from DataCite using a DOI, including title, creators, description, subjects, publication year, publisher, resource type, funding references, related identifiers, rights, and landing page URL.

components.name: DataCite DOI lookup
components.description: Retrieves metadata for a research dataset or publication by DOI from DataCite, including title, creators, affiliations, publication year, resource type, subjects, funding information, and related identifiers.

components.name: DataCite search datasets
components.description: Searches for research datasets with DOIs across worldwide repositories using DataCite. Accepts a query string and returns matching dataset metadata including DOI, title, description, creators, publisher, publication year, URL, and subjects.

components.name: DataCite Search DOIs
components.description: Search DataCite by keyword, subject, or creator to find research datasets, software, and other research outputs. Returns DOI metadata for registered outputs across repositories such as Zenodo, Dryad, and Figshare.

components.name: DataGov search datasets
components.description: Search the US federal open data catalog (Data.gov) via the CKAN API using keyword queries and an optional federal agency organization filter. Returns dataset titles, descriptions, organizations, download resource URLs, tags, and last-modified dates.

components.name: Data quality assess
components.description: Assesses the quality of a tabular dataset (CSV file or JSON array of records) locally with pandas, returning per-column statistics, overall summary, and warnings for missing values, zero variance, outliers, and highly correlated numeric pairs.

components.name: Dataverse get dataset
components.description: Retrieves a dataset record and associated metadata from Dataverse by persistent identifier or DOI, returning fields such as description, publisher, and publication timestamp.

components.name: Dataverse Search Datasets
components.description: Search the Harvard Dataverse repository for research datasets, files, and dataverses by query and optional type filter; returns dataset metadata including names, DOIs, descriptions, publication dates, publishers, citations, subjects, authors, and file counts.

components.name: DBAASP Get Peptide
components.description: Retrieves full antimicrobial peptide records from DBAASP by numeric peptide ID, returning sequence, modifications, structure, activity measurements, toxicity and antibiofilm data, source genes, UniProt cross-references, SMILES, and references via the keyless DBAASP v3/v4 API.

components.name: DBAASP Search Peptides
components.description: Search and filter DBAASP antimicrobial peptides by sequence, peptide name, target organism/species, target group, sequence length, synthesis type, source kingdom, UniProt xref, or DBAASP ID. Returns a paginated list of matching AMPs with total count.

components.name: Database entry batch fetch
components.description: Fetch multiple database entries by IDs in batch from a specified database, returning entries in the requested format such as FASTA, XML, or JSON.

components.name: dbfetch_fetch_entry
components.description: Fetch a single database entry by ID from various databases such as UniProt, PDB, EMBL, and Ensembl in the specified output format (FASTA, XML, JSON, etc.) using the EBI dbfetch service.

components.name: Dbfetch list databases
components.description: List all available databases in the EBI Dbfetch service. This returns a static list of common database names as the API endpoint for listing is web-only.

components.name: DBFetch list formats
components.description: List available output formats for a specified database via EBI DBFetch. Accepts a database name and returns a text list of available format names.

components.name: DbGaP get study
components.description: Retrieve a dbGaP study record by its phs_id.

components.name: DbGaP search studies
components.description: Search dbGaP (NCBI's controlled-access genotype-phenotype archive) for studies by title keyword using its FHIR API and return each study's phs_id.

components.name: dbSNP Get Frequencies
components.description: Retrieves parsed allele frequency values for dbSNP variants from raw per-study frequency entries in global MAF data, accepting a variant identifier and returning numeric population frequencies.

components.name: dbSNP Variant Lookup by rsID
components.description: Look up variant information from dbSNP by rsID, returning genomic coordinates, alleles, and basic variant information on GRCh38 and GRCh37 assemblies via NCBI E-utilities.

components.name: DbSNP Search by Gene
components.description: Search dbSNP for genetic variants associated with a specified gene symbol, returning matching variant records in JSON.

components.name: DDBJ Get Cross References
components.description: Lists DDBJ records linked to a given accession, such as a study to its experiments, runs, and samples or back to its BioProject. Returns linked accessions with their type and URL, plus counts per type, and supports filtering by reference_type and limiting results.

components.name: DDBJ record lookup
components.description: Retrieve a DNA Data Bank of Japan (DDBJ) record by accession. Supports records from DDBJ-hosted databases such as BioProject, BioSample, SRA, JGA, GEA and MetaboBank, with optional entry_type to disambiguate the record type.

components.name: DDBJ keyword entry search
components.description: Performs keyword search across DDBJ entry types such as bioproject, biosample, SRA studies/experiments/runs/samples, JGA studies, GEA, and MetaboBank, optionally filtered by NCBI taxonomy ID. Requires an entry type and keywords, and returns matching entry identifiers.

components.name: DeepGO predict function
components.description: Predicts protein function from an amino acid sequence using the DeepGOPlus deep learning method, returning Gene Ontology (GO) term predictions for biological process, molecular function, and cellular component with confidence scores.

components.name: DeepSpotM predict gene expression
components.description: Predicts spatial gene expression for a single H&E histology tile locally using the DeepSpot-M multimodal foundation model. Takes a 224x224 H&E image path and a list of HGNC gene symbols, and returns predicted expression for those genes in log1p-CPM units.

components.name: DepMap Get Cell Line
components.description: Fetch cancer cell line metadata from DepMap/Sanger, with optional filters by tissue or cancer type, returning cell line IDs, tissue, and cancer type for target validation studies.

components.name: DepMap get cell lines
components.description: Retrieve cancer cell lines from DepMap/Sanger with optional filters by tissue or cancer type, returning cell line IDs, tissue, and cancer type metadata for target validation studies.

components.name: DepMap gene dependency lookup
components.description: Retrieves gene dependency information from CRISPR knockout screens, returning gene IDs and annotations for a supplied gene symbol, with optional filtering by cell line. Negative gene effect scores indicate essentiality.

components.name: DepMap cell line search
components.description: Search DepMap cancer cell lines by common name and return matching cell lines with identifiers and cancer type annotations.

components.name: DepMap gene search
components.description: Search for genes in DepMap/Sanger by gene symbol or name, returning matching genes with Ensembl IDs and exact-match flags. Use it to find the correct gene symbol before querying gene dependency data.

components.name: Dfam get annotations
components.description: Get transposable element (TE) annotations for a genomic region from Dfam, returning all TE/repeat hits with family name, type, strand, bit score, E-value, and alignment coordinates.

components.name: Dfam get family
components.description: Get detailed information for a specific Dfam transposable element family by accession, including consensus sequence, taxonomic classification, repeat type/subtype, clade distribution, author, citations, and curation state.

components.name: Dfam Search Families
components.description: Search Dfam for transposable element (TE) and repeat element families by name prefix, taxonomic clade, or repeat type, returning family accession, name, length, classification, and repeat type.

components.name: DGIdb drug-gene interactions
components.description: Get drug-gene interactions for a list of genes from DGIdb, returning drugs targeting each gene, interaction types, and evidence sources. Gene symbols unrecognized by DGIdb are omitted and reported in metadata.unmatched_genes.

components.name: DGIdb get drug info
components.description: Get basic drug metadata from DGIdb by drug name. Returns drug name, concept ID, and approval status; unmatched drug names are reported in metadata.unmatched_drugs.

components.name: DGIdb gene druggability lookup
components.description: Queries DGIdb for druggability information for a list of gene symbols. Returns gene categories (e.g., kinase, GPCR, ion channel) indicating druggability; unrecognized genes are omitted and listed in metadata.unmatched_genes.

components.name: DGIdb gene info lookup
components.description: Look up detailed gene information from DGIdb, including aliases, categories, and interaction counts, using one or more gene symbols. Unmatched symbols are omitted from results and listed in metadata.unmatched_genes.

components.name: DHS Program indicator search
components.description: Searches the DHS Program's indicator catalog by keyword, covering health topics such as fertility, maternal and child mortality, nutrition, immunization, and HIV; returns matching indicator records with their identifiers for later data retrieval.

components.name: DHS Program indicator search
components.description: Search the DHS Program indicator catalog by keyword for fertility, maternal and child mortality, nutrition, immunization, and HIV indicators from nationally representative household surveys across approximately 90 low- and middle-income countries. Returns matching indicator records with indicator_id for use with DHSPr…

components.name: DICTrank drug cardiotoxicity search
components.description: Search the DICTrank dataset for drug-induced cardiotoxicity (DICT) risk information by trade name, generic name, or active ingredient. Returns matching drug cardiotoxicity risk records from the DICTrank dataset.

components.name: DILI search
components.description: Search the DILIrank dataset for drug-induced liver-injury risk information by compound name, returning matching drug records with DILI risk annotations.

components.name: DIQT search
components.description: Search the DIQTA dataset for drug-induced QT-interval prolongation risk information by generic name or DrugBank ID, returning matching risk records.

components.name: Disease target score
components.description: Retrieve disease-target association scores from a specified data source via GraphQL API, given an EFO disease identifier and datasource ID. Returns all targets associated with the disease and their scores.

components.name: Disease Analyzer Agent
components.description: AI agent that analyzes disease characteristics and identifies potential therapeutic targets using LLM reasoning. Accepts a disease name and context and returns a structured report covering disease overview, molecular mechanisms, target prioritization, and research gaps.

components.name: DiseaseNames search
components.description: Searches the NLM Clinical Table Search Service disease_names table by partial or full disease name and returns matching canonical disease names with UMLS Concept Unique Identifiers (CUIs). Sourced from UMLS/MedlinePlus disease vocabulary.

components.name: Disease Ontology get parents
components.description: Get parent disease terms for a Disease Ontology term using its DOID identifier, returning direct parents via is_a relationships, definitions, and their ancestors to trace the hierarchy to root.

components.name: Disease Ontology term lookup
components.description: Retrieve detailed information about a human disease from the Disease Ontology using a DOID identifier. Returns disease name, definition, synonyms, parent terms, cross-references to ICD-10, ICD-9, MeSH, NCI Thesaurus, SNOMED-CT, UMLS, and OMIM, and ontology subset membership.

components.name: Disease.sh Country Statistics
components.description: Get COVID-19 statistics for a specific country from the Disease.sh API using a country name, ISO2, ISO3, or country ID. Returns total and daily cases, deaths, recovered, active, critical, testing data, per-million rates, and country metadata such as population and continent.

components.name: DiseaseSH get COVID historical
components.description: Retrieves historical COVID-19 timeline data (cases, deaths, recoveries) for a country or globally from the Disease.sh API, with configurable lookback period.

components.name: DiseaseSh_get_global_stats
components.description: Get global COVID-19 statistics from the Disease.sh API. Returns worldwide totals for confirmed cases, deaths, recovered, active cases, critical cases, tests performed, and per-million rates. Data is aggregated from multiple sources including Johns Hopkins University, Worldometers, and government health agencies. Updat…

components.name: DiseaseSh Get Historical
components.description: Retrieves historical COVID-19 time series data for a country or globally from Disease.sh, returning daily cumulative totals for cases, deaths, and recovered over a specified time period controlled by the lastdays parameter. Data is sourced from Johns Hopkins University CSSE.

components.name: DiseaseSH get vaccine coverage
components.description: Get COVID-19 vaccine coverage data for a specific country using the Disease.sh API. Accepts a country name or ISO code and returns a timeline of total vaccination doses administered and percentage of population vaccinated.

components.name: DisGeNET get disease genes
components.description: Retrieves genes associated with a disease from DisGeNET using a disease identifier, returning a ranked gene list with association scores and evidence counts. Useful for disease gene prioritization.

components.name: DisGeNET gene-disease associations
components.description: Retrieve gene-disease association records from DisGeNET, accepting gene symbols or disease identifiers and filtering by data source (CURATED, LITERATURE, ANIMAL_MODELS) and minimum score. Returns comprehensive GDA data with evidence levels.

components.name: DisGeNET Get VDA
components.description: Get variant-disease associations from the DisGeNET knowledge base by querying rsID or gene symbol. Returns matching variant IDs, diseases, and evidence scores for pharmacogenomics and variant interpretation.

components.name: DisGeNET search disease
components.description: Search the DisGeNET database for genes associated with a disease using a UMLS CUI. Returns associated genes with scores and supporting evidence.

components.name: DisGeNET search gene
components.description: Search DisGeNET for diseases associated with a given gene, returning diseases, association scores, and evidence counts.

components.name: DisProt get entry
components.description: Get detailed disorder region annotations for a protein from DisProt using a DisProt ID or UniProt accession. Returns experimentally validated disordered regions with residue ranges, evidence codes, experimental methods, PDB cross-references, and classification terms.

components.name: DisProt search
components.description: Search DisProt for intrinsically disordered proteins by text query (gene name, protein name, organism, or keyword) and return curated disorder annotations with evidence codes and literature references.

components.name: DNA calculate GC content
components.description: Calculates GC content percentage and full nucleotide composition (A, T, G, C, N counts and GC/AT percentages) for a supplied DNA sequence, returning an interpretation of low, normal, or high GC content for primer design and sequence characterization.

components.name: DNA codon optimize
components.description: Codon-optimize an amino acid sequence for expression in a target species (human, E. coli, mouse, or yeast) using species-specific codon frequency tables, returning the optimized DNA sequence, GC content, Codon Adaptation Index, and sequence length.

components.name: CRISPR guide design
components.description: Find candidate SpCas9 (NGG PAM) guide RNAs from a target DNA sequence on both strands. Ranks 20 bp protospacers by a rule-based heuristic using GC content, PAM-proximal G, and avoidance of Pol III terminators and homopolymers, with no off-target search.

components.name: DNA find ORFs
components.description: Find open reading frames (ORFs) in a DNA sequence by scanning for ATG start codons followed by stop codons (TAA, TAG, TGA). Returns ORFs sorted by length with positions, strand, and reading frame, supporting forward, reverse, or both strands.

components.name: DNA find restriction sites
components.description: Find restriction enzyme recognition sites in a supplied DNA sequence using the NEB curated common enzyme library and Biopython's broader enzyme library. Returns positions, recognition sequences, and cut counts for each enzyme that has sites, supporting cloning strategy design and vector linearization planning.

components.name: DNA Gibson design
components.description: Designs Gibson Assembly overlaps for seamless DNA fragment assembly by computing 5' and 3' overhangs from adjacent fragments and returning modified fragment sequences ready for Gibson Assembly cloning.

components.name: DNA Golden Gate Assemble
components.description: Simulates the product of a Golden Gate assembly reaction from combined DNA parts and a Type IIS enzyme, digesting inputs, discarding re-cut fragments, and ligating matching overhangs into a circular product. Returns the assembled sequence, its length, and fragment order with junction overhangs.

components.name: DNA Golden Gate Design
components.description: Design Golden Gate Assembly parts with Type IIS restriction enzyme sites (BsaI or BbsI), assigning unique non-palindromic 4-bp overhangs and building the full synthetic part sequences for scarless multi-part assembly and modular cloning.

components.name: DNA Primer Design
components.description: Design forward and reverse PCR primers for a target DNA region using the SantaLucia 1998 nearest-neighbor thermodynamic model, selecting primers with target melting temperature, GC content, length, and 3'-end constraints.

components.name: DNA reverse complement
components.description: Generate the reverse complement of a DNA sequence by complementing each base (A↔T, G↔C) and reversing the sequence; accepts a nucleotide sequence and returns the reverse-complemented sequence, preserving N bases.

components.name: DNA translate reading frames
components.description: Translate a DNA sequence to protein in all three forward reading frames using the standard genetic code, identify the longest open reading frame per frame, and report the best frame, accepting a DNA sequence and returning protein sequences and ORF annotations.

components.name: DNA translate sequence
components.description: Translate a DNA coding sequence to protein using the standard genetic code (NCBI Code 1). Returns the protein sequence, stop codon positions, and protein length, trimming at the first stop codon by default.

components.name: DNA virtual digest
components.description: Perform virtual restriction enzyme digest on linear or circular DNA sequences using the NEB enzyme library and Biopython enzyme library. Returns resulting restriction fragments with sequences, lengths, positions, and cut sites.

components.name: DOAJ Search Articles
components.description: Search the Directory of Open Access Journals (DOAJ) for open-access articles using Lucene query syntax and return matching article records with title, authors, year, DOI, venue, and URL.

components.name: IC50/EC50 calculation from dose-response data
components.description: Fits the Hill sigmoidal equation to paired concentration-response data to calculate IC50/EC50, Hill exponent, plateau values, R2, and log10(EC50). Suited to potency ranking in compound screens and cross-assay comparisons.

components.name: DoseResponse compare potency
components.description: Fits Hill sigmoidal curves to two concentration-response datasets and compares potency by EC50 fold-shift, reporting EC50, Hill exponent, Emax, fold-ratio and which compound is more potent.

components.name: DoseResponse fit curve
components.description: Performs nonlinear regression of paired concentration-response measurements to the Hill sigmoidal (4PL) model, returning fitted parameters with standard errors, 95% CI for EC50, R2, and predicted responses; requires at least 4 positive concentration inputs.

components.name: DrugBank filter drugs by name
components.description: Filters DrugBank records by conditions applied to drug names, such as suffix, substring, or exact matches, and returns matching drug records.

components.name: DrugBank full search
components.description: Search the cleaned DrugBank dataframe (one row per drug) by DrugBank ID, common name, or synonym and return identifiers, ATC codes, main pharmacology text fields, and protein partners.

components.name: Drug basic info lookup by drug name or ID
components.description: Retrieve basic drug information including name, description, CAS number, and approval status from DrugBank by drug name or DrugBank ID.

components.name: DrugBank drug chemistry lookup by name or ID
components.description: Get drug chemical properties including molecular formula, weight, and structure from DrugBank by drug name or DrugBank ID.

components.name: DrugBank Get Drug Description and Pharmacology by Mechanism of Action
components.description: Retrieves DrugBank drug records including name, ID, description, pharmacodynamics, mechanism of action, and pharmacokinetics by querying the mechanism of action field.

components.name: DrugBank drug interaction lookup
components.description: Retrieve documented drug interactions and contraindications by drug name or DrugBank ID. The result is a paginated list of interacting drugs with total count and truncation flags.

components.name: DrugBank get drug name and description by indication
components.description: Retrieves drug name, DrugBank ID, and description from the DrugBank database for a given indication.

components.name: DrugBank drug name and description lookup by pathway
components.description: Get drug names and descriptions from DrugBank by searching for a pathway name.

components.name: DrugBank target-drug lookup
components.description: Get associated drug names and descriptions from DrugBank for a given target, enzyme, carrier, or transporter protein by searching the DrugBank XML dataset.

components.name: DrugBank drug product lookup
components.description: Retrieves commercial drug product, dosage form, and pricing information from DrugBank by drug name or DrugBank ID.

components.name: Drugbank get drug references by drug name or ID
components.description: Retrieves drug literature references, patents, and external links from DrugBank using a drug name or DrugBank ID.

components.name: Drug indications lookup
components.description: Retrieves drug indications and therapeutic uses from the DrugBank database by drug name or DrugBank ID.

components.name: DrugBank pathway and reaction lookup
components.description: Retrieves drug pathways and metabolic reactions from DrugBank for a given drug, supporting lookup by drug name, synonyms, brand names, or DrugBank ID.

components.name: DrugBank pharmacology lookup
components.description: Retrieve pharmacological information including pharmacodynamics, mechanism of action, and pharmacokinetics for a drug by its name or DrugBank ID from the DrugBank database.

components.name: DrugBank get safety by drug name or DrugBank ID
components.description: Get drug toxicity, contraindications, and safety information by drug name or DrugBank ID from the DrugBank database.

components.name: DrugBank target lookup
components.description: Retrieves drug targets, enzymes, carriers, and transporters from the DrugBank database by querying drug names, synonyms, brand names, or DrugBank IDs.

components.name: DrugBank links search
components.description: Search the DrugLinks cross-reference table linking DrugBank IDs to external identifiers such as CAS, KEGG, PubChem, ChEBI, PharmGKB, and UniProt by free-text query, returning matching drug link records.

components.name: DrugBank vocabulary filter
components.description: Filter the DrugBank vocabulary dataset by field-value criteria to return matching drug records such as names, IDs, and chemical identifiers.

components.name: DrugBank vocabulary search
components.description: Search the DrugBank vocabulary dataset by drug name, ID, synonym, or other text query and return detailed drug records including DrugBank ID, common name, CAS number, UNII, and synonyms.

components.name: DrugCentral get drug
components.description: Retrieves detailed DrugCentral information for a specific drug by InChIKey or ChEMBL ID, including regulatory approvals, therapeutic indications, contraindications, off-label uses, chemical structure, and cross-references to DrugBank, ChEMBL, PubChem, KEGG, and RxNorm. DrugCentral data is accessed via MyChem.info.

components.name: DrugCentral get targets
components.description: Looks up drug target information from DrugCentral for a specific drug by InChIKey or ChEMBL ID, returning bioactivity data including target protein names, target classes, organisms, action types, potency measurements, mechanism of action flags, UniProt protein IDs, and gene symbols.

components.name: DrugCentral search
components.description: Search for drugs in DrugCentral by name or identifier, returning drug names, CAS registry numbers, SMILES structures, regulatory approval status, and cross-references to DrugBank, ChEMBL, PubChem, and other databases via the MyChem.info aggregation service.

components.name: Drug interaction analyzer agent
components.description: AI agent that analyzes drug-drug interactions for supplied compounds and patient context, producing structured clinical recommendations including interaction type, mechanism, severity, clinical significance, management strategy, and monitoring requirements.

components.name: DrugOptimizationAgent
components.description: AI agent that analyzes drug optimization strategies based on ADMET and efficacy data. It accepts compounds, ADMET data, efficacy data, and a target profile as inputs and returns optimization strategies including current strengths, weaknesses, modifications, synthetic feasibility, and expected improvements.

components.name: DrugProps calculate QED
components.description: Calculate the Quantitative Estimate of Drug-likeness (QED) score for a compound from a SMILES string using the Bickerton et al. (2012) method. Returns a QED score between 0 and 1 based on eight molecular descriptors.

components.name: DrugProps Lipinski filter
components.description: Evaluates drug-likeness of a SMILES-string compound using Lipinski Rule of Five, Veber, Pfizer 3/75, Egan, and Ghose filters, returning molecular descriptors (MW, cLogP, HBD, HBA, TPSA, RotBonds, Csp3 fraction) and pass/fail status for each filter.

components.name: DrugProps pains filter
components.description: Screen a compound SMILES string for PAINS, Brenk undesirable substructures, and NIH alerts using RDKit FilterCatalog, returning match details and remediation recommendations.

components.name: Drug Safety Analyzer
components.description: Comprehensive drug safety analysis combining adverse event data from FAERS, literature review, and molecular information. Accepts a required drug name and optional patient sex and serious-event filters, returning a combined safety analysis.

components.name: DrugSynergy calculate bliss
components.description: Calculates the Bliss Independence synergy score for a drug combination from fractional inhibition values using the Bliss model. Returns a score where positive indicates synergy and negative indicates antagonism.

components.name: Drug synergy combination index calculation
components.description: Calculate Chou-Talalay Combination Index (CI) for drug synergy quantification, including Dose Reduction Index (DRI), from dose-effect data for individual drugs and their combination. Supports mutually exclusive and mutually non-exclusive assumptions based on the median effect equation.

components.name: Drug synergy calculate HSA
components.description: Calculates Highest Single Agent (HSA) synergy scores for drug combinations across dose points by taking the maximum single-agent effect and subtracting it from the observed combination effect. Accepts matching arrays of effects for drug A, drug B, and the combination, and returns synergy scores indicating synergistic…

components.name: DrugSynergy calculate Loewe
components.description: Calculate Loewe Additivity synergy score for a drug combination using single-agent dose-response data, combination doses, and observed effect based on the Loewe & Muischnek (1926) model. Use for rigorous synergy quantification and comparison with Bliss, HSA, or ZIP models.

components.name: DrugSynergy calculate ZIP
components.description: Calculates the ZIP (Zero Interaction Potency) delta synergy score from a full dose-response matrix by fitting Hill curves to marginal dose-response data for each drug and comparing observed combination effects to expected additivity, returning a delta score matrix in which positive values indicate synergy.

components.name: DTU protein prediction
components.description: Run DTU Health Tech machine-learning protein predictors on a protein sequence via the BioLib cloud. Choose among DeepTMHMM for transmembrane topology, SignalP 6 for signal-peptide detection and cleavage site, or DeepLocPro for prokaryotic subcellular localization; input is an inline FASTA or amino-acid string or a FAS…

components.name: DynaMut2 get job
components.description: Retrieve results for a previously submitted DynaMut2 protein stability prediction job, returning its current status if still running or the full prediction result with ddG value and effect classification when complete.

components.name: DynaMut2 predict stability
components.description: Predicts the effect of a single-point amino acid mutation on protein stability and dynamics using DynaMut2, taking a PDB ID, chain identifier, and mutation, and returning the predicted change in Gibbs free energy (ddG) in kcal/mol.

components.name: EBI build phylogenetic tree
components.description: Builds a phylogenetic tree from an aligned FASTA multiple sequence alignment using EMBL-EBI simple_phylogeny, returning a Newick tree via neighbour-joining or UPGMA with optional Kimura distance correction and gap-column exclusion.

components.name: EBI cross-reference search
components.description: Search for cross-references between EBI domains by providing a source domain and a query that can include cross-reference filters, returning matching entries such as UniProt records referenced by Ensembl genes.

components.name: EBI Get Domain Fields
components.description: Get the list of available searchable fields for a specified EBI domain from EBI Search, returning the fields that can be used in queries and field-specific searches.

components.name: EBI Get Domain Info
components.description: Searches a specified EBI domain (e.g., Ensembl, UniProt, InterPro) with faceted filtering, returning search results with facet categories. Accepts a query string and optional facet filters.

components.name: EBI Get Entry
components.description: Get detailed information for a specific entry from EBI Search domains such as Ensembl, UniProt, and InterPro by entry ID, returning complete entry data.

components.name: EBI list domains
components.description: Lists available EBI domains for searching across 160+ EBI data resources, providing domain names that can be used as input to the EBI search tool.

components.name: EBI MSA Align
components.description: Performs de novo multiple sequence alignment of user-provided protein, DNA, or RNA sequences via EMBL-EBI Job Dispatcher. Accepts two or more FASTA sequences and an aligner choice, returning the alignment in FASTA and Clustal formats along with a guide tree.

components.name: EBI Pairwise Align
components.description: Align exactly two sequences via EMBL-EBI EMBOSS and return the alignment with percent identity, similarity, gaps, and score. Supports Needleman-Wunsch global alignment, memory-efficient global alignment, and Smith-Waterman local alignment.

components.name: EBI predict membrane topology
components.description: Predicts transmembrane helices and signal peptides from a protein sequence using Phobius via EMBL-EBI. Returns helix count, whether a signal peptide is predicted, and per-feature coordinates (TRANSMEM, SIGNAL, DOMAIN) with inside/outside orientation.

components.name: EBI profile search
components.description: Search a protein sequence against EMBL-EBI sequence databases using profile-based methods (phmmer or PSI-BLAST) to detect remote homologs, returning matching protein sequence records.

components.name: EBI Scan Pfam Domains
components.description: Scans a protein sequence against Pfam HMMs via EMBL-EBI PfamScan and returns matched protein domains with coordinates, Pfam accession, bit score, E-value, and significance flag.

components.name: EBI Search Domain
components.description: Search a specified EBI domain such as ensembl, uniprot, or interpro using the unified EBI Search API. Accepts a domain and query string and returns search results with metadata.

components.name: EBI Search with Facets
components.description: Search EBI domains with faceted filtering via the EBI Search service, taking a domain and query and returning search results with facet categories for advanced filtering.

components.name: EBI translate sequence
components.description: Translate nucleotide sequences to protein, back-translate protein sequences to nucleotide, or produce a six-frame translation with ORF detection, via EMBL-EBI EMBOSS. Accepts a sequence string and optional mode and codon_table parameters, returning the translated sequence or ORF predictions.

components.name: EBI Proteins antigen prediction
components.description: Retrieves predicted antigenic regions for a protein by UniProt accession from the EBI Proteins API, returning immunogenic sequence regions and match confidence scores for antibody design and immunology research.

components.name: EBI Proteins get coordinate mapping
components.description: Maps UniProt protein positions to genomic coordinates at exon-level resolution using a UniProt accession. Returns chromosome, strand, and per-exon mappings between protein residue positions and chromosomal coordinates for all transcript isoforms.

components.name: EBI Proteins Get Coordinates
components.description: Retrieves genomic coordinate mappings for a given UniProt protein accession from the EBI Proteins API, returning Ensembl gene/transcript IDs, chromosome location, strand, and exon structure.

components.name: EBI Proteins domain and site lookup
components.description: Retrieve domain and site features for a protein by UniProt accession from the EBI Proteins API, including binding sites, DNA-binding regions, active sites, motifs, and zinc finger domains annotated in UniProtKB.

components.name: EBI Proteins get epitopes
components.description: Retrieve experimentally-determined immune epitope regions for a protein by UniProt accession using the EBI Proteins API and Immune Epitope Database. Returns epitope positions, sequences, and supporting literature.

components.name: EBI Proteins Get Features
components.description: Retrieves protein features filtered by category from the EBI Proteins API. Accepts a protein accession and optional feature category, returning consolidated UniProt-annotated features such as domains, PTMs, structural elements, topology, and variants.

components.name: EBI Proteins Get HPP Peptides
components.description: Retrieve Human Proteome Project (HPP) peptide-level mass-spectrometry evidence for a protein from the EBI Proteins API. Accepts a protein accession and returns HPP-curated peptide records containing sequence, start/end positions, uniqueness flag, and source (e.g. HppPeptideAtlas).

components.name: EBI Proteins get interaction details
components.description: Retrieves detailed protein information, including binary interaction partners, disease associations, and subcellular localizations, for a UniProt accession from the EBI Proteins API. Returns full protein records with partner details.

components.name: EBI Proteins get interactions
components.description: Retrieves experimentally validated protein-protein interaction partners for a given UniProt accession from the EBI Proteins API, sourced from IntAct, returning partner accessions, gene names, and supporting experiment counts.

components.name: EBI Proteins molecule processing lookup
components.description: Retrieves molecule processing features for a protein by UniProt accession from the EBI Proteins API, including signal peptides, transit peptides, mature protein chains, propeptides, and initiator methionine annotations.

components.name: EBI Proteins get mutagenesis
components.description: Retrieves mutagenesis experiment data for a protein by UniProt accession from the EBI Proteins API, returning experimentally characterized mutations with their functional effects curated from UniProtKB.

components.name: EBI Proteins get proteins by genomic location
components.description: Reverse genome-to-protein coordinate lookup: given a genomic position (taxonomy ID + chromosome:position), returns all UniProt proteins whose coding sequence overlaps that position, with exon-level mapping including accession, Ensembl gene/transcript/translation IDs, protein start/end residue, amino acid, chromosome,…

components.name: EBI Proteins get proteomics peptides
components.description: Retrieves mass spectrometry proteomics peptide evidence for a protein by UniProt accession from the EBI Proteins API. Returns detected peptides with their positions, uniqueness status, and source databases such as PeptideAtlas, ProteomicsDB, MaxQB, and EPD.

components.name: EBIProteins Get Proteomics PTM
components.description: Retrieves post-translational modification evidence from mass spectrometry proteomics for a UniProt protein accession via the EBI Proteins API, returning detected PTM positions, types, and confidence from PeptideAtlas, ProteomicsDB, MaxQB, and EPD.

components.name: EBI Proteins RNA editing lookup
components.description: Retrieve RNA editing annotations for a UniProt protein accession from the EBI Proteins API, returning post-transcriptional A-to-I editing sites with protein and genomic positions, amino acid changes, and tissue statistics.

components.name: EBI Proteins get structural features
components.description: Get secondary structure annotations for a protein from the EBI Proteins API, returning helix, beta strand, and turn assignments mapped to the UniProt protein sequence.

components.name: EBI Proteins get variation
components.description: Retrieves known protein sequence variants for a UniProt protein accession from the EBI Proteins API, including disease associations, clinical significance classifications, and cross-references from COSMIC, ClinVar, gnomAD/ExAC, and UniProt.

components.name: EBI Proteins variation lookup by dbSNP
components.description: Given a dbSNP rsID, retrieves every UniProt protein and isoform carrying that variant from the EBI Proteins API, including natural-variant features such as wild-type and alternative residues, protein position, genomic location, clinical significance, and cross-references to ClinVar, COSMIC, and dbSNP.

components.name: EBI Proteins get variation by HGVS
components.description: Looks up an HGVS genomic variant expression via the EBI Proteins API and returns overlapping UniProt proteins with projected protein consequences, including wild-type and alternative residues, protein position, and genomic location.

components.name: EBI Taxonomy get by ID
components.description: Retrieves taxonomy classification for an NCBI Taxonomy ID from the EBI Taxonomy service. Returns scientific name, common name, rank, division, full lineage string, genetic codes, authority citation, and alternative names.

components.name: EBITaxonomy Get by Scientific Name
components.description: Look up taxonomy by scientific (Latin) name using the EBI Taxonomy service. Returns taxonomy ID, lineage, rank, division, and genetic codes, and handles subspecies and strain names.

components.name: EBI Taxonomy search by name
components.description: Searches EBI Taxonomy for organisms by any provided name (scientific, common, or synonym) and returns matching taxa with their IDs, scientific names, and lineage.

components.name: EBI Taxonomy suggest
components.description: Get taxonomy name suggestions matching a partial organism name from EBI Taxonomy, returning matching organism names and taxonomy IDs. Useful for resolving taxonomy identifiers from partial names.

components.name: EGA Get Dataset
components.description: Resolve an EGA dataset accession to its public metadata, including technology platform, sample count, and access policy; returns metadata only, while underlying data requires Data Access Committee approval.

components.name: EGA get study
components.description: Retrieve public metadata for an EGA study accession, returning fields such as title, description, study type, and publication. Metadata only; controlled-access sequence/genotype data requires separate Data Access Committee approval.

components.name: EGA Get Study Datasets
components.description: Fetches public metadata for a European Genome-phenome Archive (EGA) study by accession, including title, description, study type, and publication, and can be used to locate associated dataset accessions.

components.name: ELIXIR TeSS search events
components.description: Search ELIXIR TeSS for upcoming and past bioinformatics training events, workshops, and courses. Accepts a search query and returns event details including organizer, location, dates, costs, and registration links.

components.name: ELIXIRTeSS search materials
components.description: Searches ELIXIR TeSS for bioinformatics and life science training materials such as tutorials, online courses, webinars, and training presentations, returning materials with scientific topics, EDAM operations, difficulty levels, and resource URLs.

components.name: ELM get instances
components.description: Retrieves experimentally validated short linear motif (SLiM) instances for a protein from the ELM database using a UniProt accession, returning motif positions, types, validation methods, PubMed references and PDB structures.

components.name: ELM interaction domain mapping
components.description: Retrieves the ELM motif-to-interaction-domain mapping, linking Short Linear Motif (SLiM) classes to the Pfam protein domain families that recognize them. Supports filtering by a specific ELM identifier or free-text query (such as Pfam accession or domain name) over approximately 409 records.

components.name: ELM list classes
components.description: List short linear motif (SLiM) classes from the ELM database, returning motif class records with regex patterns, descriptions, and instance statistics; accepts optional filtering by functional type or keyword.

components.name: EMDB get imaging info
components.description: Retrieves electron microscopy imaging parameters such as microscope model, detector type, acceleration voltage, dose rate, total electron dose, defocus range, and data collection strategy for an EMDB entry.

components.name: EMDB map info lookup
components.description: Get detailed electron density map information for an EMDB entry, including map statistics, contour levels, pixel spacing, dimensions, symmetry, and map file download URLs. Accepts an EMDB identifier and returns technical details for map visualization, model fitting, and computational analysis.

components.name: EMDB Get Publications
components.description: Retrieve publication details (titles, authors, journals, DOIs, PubMed IDs, and abstracts) associated with an EMDB structure entry. Accepts an EMDB ID and returns the research papers describing the cryo-EM structure.

components.name: EMDB Get Sample Info
components.description: Retrieve detailed sample preparation information for an EMDB entry, including macromolecular composition, organism source, expression system, molecular weight, oligomeric state, and ligands, using an EMDB identifier as input.

components.name: EMDB Get Structure
components.description: Retrieve 3D electron microscopy structure metadata from the Electron Microscopy Data Bank (EMDB) by EMDB identifier. Returns cryo-EM structure metadata including resolution, imaging method, organism, molecule details, voxel dimensions, map download URLs, and PDB cross-references.

components.name: EMDB Get Validation
components.description: Retrieves validation analysis results for an EMDB entry, including FSC curves, resolution estimates, map-model correlation, B-factors, geometry validation, and quality scores, using an EMDB structure identifier.

components.name: EMDB search structures
components.description: Search the Electron Microscopy Data Bank (EMDB) for cryo-EM structures by keyword query. Returns matching entries with basic metadata such as entry IDs, titles, organisms, methods, resolutions, and deposition dates.

components.name: eMolecules Get Compound
components.description: Get compound details by eMolecules ID, accepting an eMolecules compound/vendor ID and returning a URL linking to the compound page with vendor, pricing, and availability information.

components.name: eMolecules get vendors
components.description: Generate an eMolecules vendor search URL for a compound specified by SMILES, returning a search_url to browse 200+ supplier listings.

components.name: eMolecules search
components.description: Generate an eMolecules search URL from a compound name or keyword. eMolecules aggregates over 200 chemical suppliers and returns a search URL to browse matching results, with no API access to vendor data.

components.name: eMolecules structure search URL generation
components.description: Generates an eMolecules structure search URL from a provided SMILES string using exact, substructure, or similarity search modes and returns a search_url to browse matching compounds without direct API access to vendor data.

components.name: EMPIAR entry lookup
components.description: Retrieve full details for a specific EMPIAR entry by its identifier, returning metadata and associated raw EM image dataset information from the Electron Microscopy Public Image Archive.

components.name: EMPIAR search entries
components.description: Search the EMPIAR electron microscopy public image archive by keyword to retrieve matching raw EM image dataset entries with EMPIAR IDs, titles, and release dates.

components.name: ENA Get Entry
components.description: Retrieve ENA entry metadata by EMBL/GenBank accession number, returning basic sequence header information extracted from the FASTA header in XML text format. Supports EMBL/GenBank accessions only and does not support RefSeq accessions.

components.name: ENA Get Entry History
components.description: Retrieves version history for an ENA sequence entry by EMBL/GenBank accession number, returning all versions with sequence version number, first public date, last updated date, and status. RefSeq accessions are not supported.

components.name: ENA Get Entry Summary
components.description: Retrieve entry summary information from the European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) by EMBL/GenBank accession number, returning sequence header metadata in text format.

components.name: ENA sequence retrieval (EMBL format)
components.description: Retrieves a nucleotide sequence from the European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) in EMBL format using an EMBL/GenBank accession number.

components.name: ENA get sequence FASTA
components.description: Retrieve a nucleotide sequence in FASTA format from the European Nucleotide Archive by EMBL/GenBank accession number. Returns the sequence with header information for supported accessions.

components.name: ENA XML metadata lookup
components.description: Retrieves XML metadata records from the European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) for Study, Sample, Run, Experiment, Analysis, or Taxon accessions, returning submitter-provided information, cross-references, and FTP locations.

components.name: Enamine compound lookup
components.description: Retrieves compound details from Enamine by Enamine compound ID, including chemical structure, availability, pricing, and ordering information.

components.name: Enamine get libraries
components.description: Get information about available Enamine compound libraries including REAL database, building blocks, screening compounds, and specialized libraries (fragments, covalent).

components.name: Enamine search catalog
components.description: Search Enamine's compound catalog by keyword or compound name, returning matching compound records from the REAL, building block, and screening collections.

components.name: Enamine Search Smiles
components.description: Search the Enamine compound catalog by SMILES string, supporting exact match, substructure, and similarity search modes to find purchasable analogs of hit compounds.

components.name: ENA Portal count records
components.description: Count the number of records matching a query in the European Nucleotide Archive (ENA), supporting studies, samples, reads, and other result types. Accepts an ENA search query and optional result type, and returns a record count for estimating dataset sizes before downloading.

components.name: ENA Portal search runs FASTQ
components.description: Search the European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) for sequencing runs by taxonomy and library strategy using ENA query syntax, returning run records with ready-to-use FASTQ download URLs, checksums, sizes, library strategy, and instrument platform.

components.name: ENA Portal search samples
components.description: Search the European Nucleotide Archive for biological samples by taxonomy or text query, returning sample accessions, descriptions, taxonomy, and publication dates.

components.name: ENA Portal search studies
components.description: Search the European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) for sequencing studies using text queries or taxonomy filters, returning study accessions, titles, submitting centers, and publication dates.

components.name: ENCODE Get Biosample
components.description: Search ENCODE biosamples by organism, biosample type, or treatment, and retrieve biosample accessions, types, organism, life stage, and descriptions.

components.name: ENCODE chromatin state lookup
components.description: Search ENCODE chromatin state annotations (ChromHMM segmentations) for specific biosamples or tissues, returning genome-wide functional state classifications based on histone marks.

components.name: ENCODE experiment search
components.description: Search ENCODE functional genomics experiments by assay type, target protein, organism, or status and retrieve matching experiment accessions, descriptions, and metadata from the ENCODE portal.

components.name: ENCODE get file
components.description: List ENCODE data files using filters for file format, output type, or assay, and return file metadata such as accessions, formats (FASTQ, BAM, bigWig), output types (alignments, peaks, signal), and file sizes for programmatic discovery of downloadable artifacts.

components.name: ENCODE list files
components.description: List data files from the ENCODE portal, returning matching file records.

components.name: ENCODE search annotations
components.description: Search ENCODE annotations for candidate cis-regulatory elements, chromatin states, and imputed signals by annotation type, biosample, or genome assembly.

components.name: ENCODE Search Biosamples
components.description: Search ENCODE biosamples (cell lines, tissues, primary cells) by organism, biosample type, or treatment. Returns matching biosample accessions, types, organism, life stage, and descriptions.

components.name: ENCODE Search Chromatin Accessibility
components.description: Search ENCODE chromatin accessibility experiments (ATAC-seq and DNase-seq) to find open chromatin data for specific tissues or cell types. Returns experiment accessions, biosample details, and accessibility assay metadata.

components.name: ENCODE search experiments
components.description: Search ENCODE functional genomics experiments (such as ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq, RNA-seq) by assay type, target protein, organism, or status. Returns matching experiment accessions, descriptions, and metadata.

components.name: ENCODE Search Hi-C Experiments
components.description: Search ENCODE Hi-C and intact Hi-C experiments for 3D genome organization data using assay type and biosample filters; returns experiment accessions, biosample details, and metadata.

components.name: ENCODE search histone experiments
components.description: Search ENCODE histone ChIP-seq experiments by histone modification mark, biosample, or organism; returns experiment accessions, histone marks, biosample summaries, and metadata.

components.name: ENCODE search methylation experiments
components.description: Search ENCODE whole-genome bisulfite sequencing (WGBS) and reduced-representation bisulfite sequencing (RRBS) experiments for DNA methylation profiling, returning experiment accessions, biosample information, methylation assay type, and metadata.

components.name: ENCODE search microRNA experiments
components.description: Searches ENCODE microRNA-seq experiments to find miRNA expression profiling data for specific cell types or tissues, returning experiment accessions, biosample details, and metadata. ENCODE contains over 400 released microRNA-seq experiments across diverse cell types.

components.name: ENCODE search RNA-seq experiments
components.description: Search ENCODE RNA-seq experiments by biosample, organism, and assay type, returning experiment accessions, biosample summaries, lab names, and metadata from the ENCODE project.

components.name: ENCORI get ceRNA network
components.description: Build competing-endogenous-RNA (ceRNA) networks via ENCORI (starBase) by querying a gene or lncRNA symbol and returning partner genes and lncRNAs that share miRNA-binding families, with shared miRNA family counts, p-values, and FDR.

components.name: ENCORI degradome cleavage
components.description: Retrieves experimentally confirmed miRNA cleavage sites from ENCORI (starBase) degradomeRNA data. Accepts either a gene symbol to find miRNAs that cleave it or a miRNA identifier to find its cleavage targets, returning cleavage-event counts, degradome experiment counts, sites, reads, and confidence categories.

components.name: ENCORI miRNA target lookup
components.description: Look up miRNA-target interactions from ENCORI (starBase) by providing either a miRNA name to retrieve its target genes or a gene symbol to retrieve targeting miRNAs. Results include the number of supporting CLIP-seq experiments and which prediction programs call each interaction.

components.name: RBP-disease association lookup
components.description: Retrieve RBP-disease associations from the ENCORI (starBase) RBPDisease module. Accepts optional filters for gene, RBP, tissue, or disease and returns records including disease names, COSMIC mutation IDs, mutation counts, affected sample counts, and supporting CLIP experiments.

components.name: ENCORI RBP target lookup
components.description: Look up RBP-RNA binding sites from CLIP-seq data via ENCORI (starBase) RBPTarget by providing an RNA-binding protein symbol to list bound transcripts or a gene symbol to list binding RBPs; results include cluster counts, supporting CLIP experiments/sites, genomic location, and cell line/tissue.

components.name: ENCORI get RNA RNA interactions
components.description: Retrieve ncRNA-RNA duplex interaction networks from ENCORI (starBase) RNARNA module given an RNA identifier; returns direct base-pairing partners with interaction, experiment, read support, predicted free energy and Smith-Waterman alignment score.

components.name: ENCORI scan RBP motifs
components.description: Scan RBP binding-motif enrichment using ENCORI (starBase) RBPMotifScan, accepting either an RNA motif sequence or RBP identifier and returning ranked motif/dataset enrichment records with p-values and HOMER links.

components.name: Enrichr Enrich
components.description: Perform gene set enrichment analysis using Enrichr by submitting a list of genes and selecting a library; returns ranked enriched terms with p-values, z-scores, combined scores, and overlapping genes. Supports species-specific Enrichr instances for fly, worm, yeast, or fish.

components.name: Enrichr gene enrichment analysis
components.description: Performs gene enrichment analysis using Enrichr on a list of gene names or symbols, querying pathway and ontology libraries to return connectivity paths between genes and enrichment terms.

components.name: Enrichr Gene to Genesets
components.description: Reverse gene-to-geneset membership lookup: given one gene symbol, query Enrichr and return a dictionary mapping each of its ~243 gene-set libraries to the names of terms or gene sets containing that gene. Supports libraries such as KEGG, Reactome, WikiPathways, Gene Ontology, transcription-factor target sets, and dise…

components.name: Enrichr get top enriched
components.description: Submits a gene list to Enrichr and returns top enriched terms across multiple functional annotation libraries, including GO, KEGG, Reactome, and WikiPathways, with support for species-specific Enrichr instances.

components.name: Enrichr list libraries
components.description: Lists all available Enrichr gene set libraries with statistics, optionally filtering by keyword in library name and species. Returns library metadata for pathways, gene ontology, transcription factors, diseases, drugs, and other Enrichr categories.

components.name: Ensembl get alignment
components.description: Retrieves genomic alignments between species for a specified genomic region from Ensembl. Returns multiple alignments showing conserved sequences across predefined species groups using EPO or PECAN methods.

components.name: Ensembl Get Archive
components.description: Retrieves archived gene information from Ensembl by stable ID, returning gene location and status across all Ensembl releases to track ID changes and assembly updates.

components.name: Ensembl get assembly info
components.description: Get genome assembly metadata for a species from the Ensembl REST API, including assembly name, accession, version history, karyotype, genebuild date, golden path length and coordinate system versions.

components.name: Ensembl get cross references
components.description: Retrieve all external database cross-references for an Ensembl stable identifier (gene, transcript, or translation). Returns linked records from HGNC, EntrezGene, UniProt, GeneCards, Reactome, MIM/OMIM, ArrayExpress, and other databases, with optional filtering by external database.

components.name: Ensembl Get Gene Overlapping Features
components.description: Get genomic features overlapping an Ensembl gene by Ensembl gene ID, returning neighboring genes, overlapping transcripts, regulatory elements, and antisense transcripts co-located with the gene.

components.name: Ensembl get gene tree
components.description: Retrieves a gene tree for a supplied gene tree ID from Ensembl, returning evolutionary relationships such as orthologues and paralogues across species.

components.name: Ensembl get homology
components.description: Retrieve gene homology (orthologues and paralogues) for a gene symbol in a species from Ensembl REST, returning gene IDs, protein IDs, chromosomal locations, and homology types.

components.name: Ensembl Get Ontology Ancestors
components.description: Get ancestor terms for a Gene Ontology (GO) term, returning parent terms up the ontology hierarchy. Accepts a GO term ID and returns broader biological concepts.

components.name: Get ontology descendants
components.description: Get descendant terms for a Gene Ontology (GO) term via the Ensembl REST API. Accepts a GO term ID and an optional closest-term flag, and returns child terms with accession, name, and namespace.

components.name: Ensembl Get Ontology Term
components.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific ontology term from Gene Ontology, Sequence Ontology, or Human Phenotype Ontology through the Ensembl REST API, including name, definition, synonyms, and relationships.

components.name: Ensembl get overlap features
components.description: Retrieves genomic features such as genes, transcripts, repeats and structural annotations overlapping a specified genomic region from Ensembl. Takes a species and region and returns comprehensive annotation records.

components.name: Ensembl Get Region Features
components.description: Retrieves all genomic features overlapping a specified chromosomal region, including genes, transcripts, regulatory elements, constrained elements, and other annotated features; supports multiple feature types in one query for species such as human, mouse, rat, and zebrafish.

components.name: Get regulatory features
components.description: Retrieve regulatory features such as promoters, enhancers and transcription factor binding sites in a given genomic region and species from Ensembl, returning annotations with feature types, positions and evidence.

components.name: Ensembl Get Sequence
components.description: Retrieves DNA or protein sequences (genomic, CDS, cDNA, peptide) for an Ensembl gene or transcript ID from the Ensembl REST API and returns the sequence in JSON format with metadata.

components.name: Ensembl Get Species
components.description: Retrieve species information from Ensembl, including scientific name, common name, assembly details, and database version. Supports listing all available species (200+) or querying a specific species by ID, with optional division filtering.

components.name: Ensembl species info
components.description: Search and list species available in the Ensembl database with their genome assembly information. Accepts a search term to filter by species name, common name, or taxonomy ID, returning species records with assembly version and Ensembl division.

components.name: Ensembl structural variant lookup
components.description: Get structural variants overlapping a genomic region from Ensembl, returning known SVs from DGVa, ClinGen, and other sources with variant IDs, coordinates, and feature type. Accepts species and region and is limited to regions under 5Mb.

components.name: Ensembl get SV detail
components.description: Retrieves detailed annotation for specific structural variants from Ensembl, including clinical significance, variant class, and supporting evidence, with known variants sourced from DGVa and ClinGen.

components.name: Get taxonomy classification
components.description: Get taxonomic classification for a species from Ensembl, returning the complete lineage from kingdom to species with scientific names and taxonomy IDs. Accepts an NCBI Taxonomy ID or species name as the identifier.

components.name: Ensembl Get Transcript Haplotypes
components.description: Retrieves population protein and CDS haplotypes for an Ensembl transcript from the Ensembl REST API, returning observed haplotypes across 1000 Genomes phase 3 populations with per-population frequencies, contributing variants, and sequence differences.

components.name: Ensembl Get Variants
components.description: Retrieve genetic variants (SNPs and indels) overlapping a specified genomic region from Ensembl, returning variant positions, alleles, and predicted consequences.

components.name: Ensembl Get Variation
components.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific genetic variation from Ensembl by variant ID and species, returning alleles, frequencies, consequences, and evidence.

components.name: Ensembl Get Variation Phenotypes
components.description: Retrieves phenotype associations for a specific genetic variation from Ensembl REST using its variation ID and species, returning traits, studies, and effect sizes.

components.name: Ensembl Get Xrefs
components.description: Get cross-references from Ensembl for a given gene, transcript, or protein ID, returning external database identifiers and mappings to databases such as UniProt, RefSeq, HGNC, and MGI.

components.name: Ensembl cross-reference lookup by name
components.description: Get cross-references for an Ensembl object (such as a gene) by its gene symbol or name. Returns mappings to external databases for the specified species and gene symbol.

components.name: Ensembl Gene Lookup
components.description: Look up gene information from Ensembl using an Ensembl gene ID or symbol. Returns gene details including genomic location, description, and external references; the species parameter is required for symbol lookups.

components.name: Ensembl gene symbol lookup
components.description: Look up Ensembl gene and transcript IDs for a gene symbol across external databases. Given a gene symbol such as TP53 or BRCA1, returns matching Ensembl stable identifiers for use with other Ensembl APIs.

components.name: Ensembl VEP Region
components.description: Ensembl Variant Effect Predictor (VEP) predicts functional consequences of genomic variants including impact on genes, transcripts, and proteins, returning SIFT/PolyPhen scores, consequence types, and affected transcripts.

components.name: Ensembl Archive batch lookup
components.description: Batch look up version histories for up to 50 Ensembl stable gene IDs. Returns current status, release, and assembly information for each ID, including deprecated ID replacements.

components.name: Ensembl Archive ID history lookup
components.description: Look up the version history and current status of an Ensembl stable ID such as a gene, transcript, or protein ID. Returns the latest version string, current release number, assembly, active/deprecated status, and replacement ID when applicable.

components.name: Ensembl Compara Get CAFE Tree
components.description: Retrieves the Ensembl Compara CAFE tree for a gene family, given a gene tree ID or gene symbol/Ensembl ID. Returns ancestral gene-copy counts at each species-tree node together with the birth-death rate lambda and per-node p-values.

components.name: EnsemblCompara get gene tree
components.description: Retrieves a phylogenetic gene tree for a gene family across species from Ensembl Compara using a gene symbol or Ensembl gene ID, returning tree members, tree structure, and optional Newick format.

components.name: Ensembl Compara orthologue lookup
components.description: Finds orthologous genes across species using Ensembl Compara. Accepts a gene symbol or Ensembl gene ID and optional source/target species, returning orthologue gene IDs, species, homology type, and taxonomic divergence level.

components.name: Ensembl Compara get paralogues
components.description: Find paralogous genes for a given gene identifier and species using Ensembl Compara. Returns paralogue gene IDs, duplication type, and evolutionary context.

components.name: Ensembl LD pairwise statistics
components.description: Get pairwise linkage disequilibrium (LD) statistics such as r-squared and D' between two specified variants from the Ensembl REST API across all 1000 Genomes populations to compare LD patterns across ancestries.

components.name: Ensembl LD region lookup
components.description: Get region-wide pairwise linkage disequilibrium (r-squared and D') among all variants within a genomic region from the Ensembl REST API for a specified 1000 Genomes Phase 3 population. Region format is chr:start..end with max 1 Mb, returning LD pairs for fine-mapping and LD-aware clumping at GWAS loci.

components.name: Ensembl LD variant lookup
components.description: Get linkage disequilibrium (LD) data for a variant from the Ensembl REST API, returning variants in LD with the query variant in a specified 1000 Genomes population and including r-squared and D' statistics.

components.name: EnsemblMap convert coordinates
components.description: Convert genomic coordinates between genome assemblies using the Ensembl REST API assembly mapping endpoint. Accepts species, source assembly, and genomic coordinates, and returns mapped coordinates in the target assembly.

components.name: Ensembl coordinate translation
components.description: Maps protein or cDNA positions to genomic coordinates using Ensembl, converting transcript or protein coordinate space to chromosomal positions based on an Ensembl identifier and positional range.

components.name: Ensembl Phenotype Associations by Gene
components.description: Retrieves phenotype associations for a specified gene from the Ensembl REST API, returning diseases, traits, and clinical conditions linked to the gene. Results aggregate from Cancer Gene Census, OMIM, ClinVar, NHGRI-EBI GWAS catalog, and Orphanet and include phenotype descriptions, data sources, genomic locations, an…

components.name: Ensembl Phenotype by Region
components.description: Retrieves phenotype/disease-trait associations for all variants and genes overlapping a specified genomic region from the Ensembl REST API, aggregating evidence from GWAS catalog, ClinVar, and Cancer Gene Census. Accepts a species and genomic region and returns disease/trait association records.

components.name: Ensembl Phenotype Get by Term
components.description: Reverse phenotype lookup from Ensembl REST API: accepts a trait/disease name or ontology accession (EFO, HP, MONDO) and returns associated variants and genes with risk allele, p-value, beta, clinical significance, and source from NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog, ClinVar, and dbGaP.

components.name: EnsemblPheno get by variant
components.description: Retrieves phenotype, trait, and disease associations for a genetic variant identified by rsID from the Ensembl REST API, integrating NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog and ClinVar data and returning risk alleles, effect sizes, p-values, and study references.

components.name: Get binding matrix
components.description: Retrieve a transcription factor binding matrix (position weight matrix/PWM) by stable ID from the Ensembl REST API, including nucleotide frequency matrix, threshold, associated TF complexes, and consensus sequence.

components.name: EnsemblReg constrained elements
components.description: Retrieves evolutionarily constrained elements within a given genomic region from the Ensembl Compara database, returning conserved regions with conservation scores useful for identifying regulatory regions and coding exons.

components.name: EnsemblReg get motif features
components.description: Get transcription factor binding motif features in a genomic region from the Ensembl REST API, returning motif instances with binding matrix IDs, TF complex names, scores and genomic positions.

components.name: Get Ensembl regulatory elements
components.description: Retrieves Ensembl regulatory features such as enhancers, promoters, CTCF binding sites, open chromatin, and TF binding sites for a genomic region. The Ensembl Regulatory Build integrates epigenomic data from ENCODE, Roadmap Epigenomics, and BLUEPRINT, and returns feature IDs, types, coordinates, and extended bounds.

components.name: Ensembl ID Sequence Lookup
components.description: Get the amino acid or nucleotide sequence for an Ensembl stable ID, including protein sequences from ENSP IDs, cDNA/CDS from ENST IDs, and genomic DNA from ENSG IDs. Returns the matching sequence for the requested identifier type.
