components.name: EnsemblSeq get region sequence
components.description: Retrieves the reference DNA nucleotide sequence for a specified genomic region from Ensembl using chromosome coordinates and species, returning the sequence for the requested interval and strand.

components.name: EnsemblVar get population frequencies
components.description: Retrieves allele frequency data for a variant (SNP/indel) across global populations from gnomAD and 1000 Genomes via Ensembl. Takes a dbSNP rsID as input and returns per-population allele frequencies, alleles, and allele counts where reported.

components.name: Ensembl Variant Consequences
components.description: Retrieves detailed variant information from Ensembl, including consequence type, clinical significance, synonyms, evidence attributes, and allele mappings for a supplied dbSNP rsID.

components.name: Ensembl VEP HGVS annotation
components.description: Predict functional consequences of genetic variants from HGVS notation using Ensembl Variant Effect Predictor (VEP). Returns variant effects on genes, transcripts, and proteins including SIFT/PolyPhen scores, consequence types, and colocated known variants.

components.name: Ensembl VEP rsID annotation
components.description: Predicts functional consequences of a genetic variant from a dbSNP rs identifier using Ensembl Variant Effect Predictor (VEP), returning gene, transcript, and protein impacts such as SIFT/PolyPhen scores, consequence types, amino acid changes, and colocated variants.

components.name: EnsemblVEP variant recoder
components.description: Convert genetic variant identifiers between nomenclature formats such as HGVS genomic, HGVS coding, HGVS protein, and SPDI using the Ensembl Variant Recoder. Accepts a variant ID such as an rs number and returns equivalent representations for cross-referencing variants across databases.

components.name: Enzyme Kinetics Calculator
components.description: Calculates enzyme kinetic parameters such as Km, Vmax, Hill coefficient, and inhibitor Ki from experimental data using Lineweaver-Burk linearization, nonlinear grid-search fitting, and inhibition analysis for competitive, uncompetitive, and noncompetitive modes. Supports enzyme characterization, inhibitor Ki determina…

components.name: Epidemiology Bayesian
components.description: Computes post-test probability from pre-test prevalence, test sensitivity, and specificity using Bayes' theorem, applying positive and negative likelihood ratios for clinical test result interpretation.

components.name: Epidemiology diagnostic
components.description: Computes diagnostic test performance metrics from a user-provided 2x2 contingency table (true positives, false positives, true negatives, false negatives). It returns sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive values, accuracy, and likelihood ratios.

components.name: Epidemiology NNT
components.description: Calculates number needed to treat (NNT), number needed to harm (NNH), absolute risk reduction (ARR), relative risk (RR), relative risk reduction (RRR), and odds ratio (OR) from control and treatment event rates.

components.name: Epidemiology R0 herd
components.description: Computes herd immunity threshold (1-1/R0), VE-adjusted minimum vaccination coverage, and optional effective reproduction number at a given coverage from basic reproduction number and vaccine efficacy inputs for vaccine program planning and outbreak assessment.

components.name: Epidemiology Vaccine Coverage
components.description: Computes vaccine effectiveness from surveillance data using the screening method (Farrington 1993), then calculates the required vaccination coverage threshold from R0, PCV, and PPV.

components.name: EpiGraphDB get drugs for trait
components.description: Finds drugs whose target genes are associated with a GWAS risk factor trait, using EpiGraphDB genetic evidence to identify drug repurposing candidates. Accepts a trait name and returns matching drug records.

components.name: EpiGraphDB Get Gene Drug Associations
components.description: Retrieves pharmacogenomics drug-gene associations from CPIC and PharmGKB via EpiGraphDB for a given gene symbol, returning associated drugs with clinical evidence levels.

components.name: EpiGraphDB Get Genetic Correlations
components.description: Queries EpiGraphDB for strong genetic correlations (|rg| > 0.8) between a specified GWAS trait and other traits from the IEU OpenGWAS database, returning shared genetic architecture associations. Empty results indicate no strong-rg edge in the sparse, case-sensitive graph rather than absence of the trait in OpenGWAS.

components.name: EpiGraphDB literature evidence
components.description: Retrieves SemMedDB subject-predicate-object literature triples supporting a supplied GWAS trait via EpiGraphDB, returning mined evidence with PubMed citations.

components.name: EpiGraphDB Mendelian Randomization
components.description: Retrieves Mendelian randomization causal effect estimates between an exposure trait and an outcome trait using IEU OpenGWAS data. Returns effect estimates with beta, standard error, and p-value from multiple instruments and methods.

components.name: EpiGraphDB Map GWAS to EFO
components.description: Maps GWAS trait names to EFO (Experimental Factor Ontology) terms for standardization, returning EFO IDs and labels for a given GWAS trait, useful for cross-database trait harmonization.

components.name: EpiGraphDB search gene
components.description: Search EpiGraphDB for gene information by gene symbol or Ensembl ID, returning gene metadata including druggability classification, chromosomal location, and gene type.

components.name: EpiGraphDB search OpenGWAS
components.description: Search the OpenGWAS database for GWAS trait names and return matching trait records.

components.name: EPMC Get Article Chemicals
components.description: Get chemicals and drugs mentioned in a biomedical article using text mining from Europe PMC, returning chemical/drug names with database links and mention frequency when given a PubMed ID or PubMed Central ID.

components.name: EPMC get article diseases
components.description: Retrieves diseases mentioned in a biomedical article from Europe PMC using text mining. Input is a PubMed ID or PubMed Central ID, and output includes disease names, EFO/HPO ontology links, and mention frequency.

components.name: EPMC Get Article Genes
components.description: Get genes and proteins mentioned in a biomedical article using text mining from Europe PMC. Takes a PubMed or PubMed Central ID and returns gene/protein names with UniProt links and mention frequency.

components.name: EPMC Get Article Organisms
components.description: Retrieves organisms mentioned in a biomedical article from Europe PMC text mining annotations using a PubMed ID or PMCID, returning organism names with NCBI Taxonomy links and mention frequencies.

components.name: EPMC Get Citations
components.description: Given a PubMed ID, queries Europe PMC for articles citing that paper and returns their titles, authors, journals, publication years, and citation counts. Enables citation network traversal for systematic reviews and literature mapping.

components.name: EPMC Get References
components.description: Get the reference list (bibliography) of a specific paper from Europe PMC given a PubMed ID, returning all articles cited by that paper.

components.name: EPMC get text mined annotations
components.description: Retrieve text-mined annotations from a biomedical article in Europe PMC, including gene/protein mentions, diseases, chemicals, organisms, and GO terms, using a PMID or PMCID.

components.name: eQTL association lookup
components.description: Retrieve variant-gene association data from the EBI eQTL Catalogue using a dataset ID. Returns eQTL associations for the specified dataset.

components.name: eQTL_list_datasets
components.description: List available eQTL (expression Quantitative Trait Loci) datasets from the EBI eQTL Catalogue. Each dataset represents a study-tissue-quantification combination with measured genetic associations to gene expression. Returns dataset IDs, study labels, tissue types, sample sizes, and quantification methods (ge=gene expr…

components.name: ESM Describe SAE Feature
components.description: Describes sparse autoencoder (SAE) features from the ESM protein language model, mapping feature activations to biological categories such as catalytic site, ligand-binding region, PTM sequon, and structural motif. The tool takes a feature identifier and returns its description, supporting variant interpretation and m…

components.name: ESM explain variant mechanism
components.description: Explains the mechanism of a protein variant by running ESMC-6B sparse autoencoder variant disruption analysis, describing each top affected feature, and composing a category-level mechanism summary (e.g., disrupted feature categories). Input is a protein variant; output is a mechanism summary.

components.name: ESM fold protein
components.description: Predicts protein 3D structure from an amino acid sequence using the ESM3 model, returning predicted TM-score (pTM), per-residue pLDDT confidence scores, and backbone atom coordinates.

components.name: ESM generate protein sequence
components.description: Generate or complete protein sequences using the ESM3 protein language model. Accepts a prompt sequence with '_' mask positions and returns a generated sequence.

components.name: ESM Get Protein Embedding
components.description: Get mean-pooled protein sequence embeddings (and optional per-residue embeddings) from EvolutionaryScale ESMC models via the Forge API for downstream tasks such as similarity search, clustering, and property prediction.

components.name: ESM Get Region SAE Features
components.description: Aggregates ESMC-6B sparse autoencoder features over a user-specified contiguous residue range to characterize the region's biological identity. Returns features ranked by total absolute activation with per-residue hit patterns, and uses the ESM API.

components.name: ESM get SAE features
components.description: Runs a protein sequence through an ESMC Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) and returns sparse feature activations per residue. The SAE decomposes ESMC hidden states into a 16,384-feature codebook where features can correspond to biological categories such as catalytic sites or PTM sequons.

components.name: ESM score sequence
components.description: Scores a protein sequence using ESMC logits to compute per-residue log-probabilities and a mean pseudo-log-likelihood. Accepts a protein sequence and returns per-residue and summary likelihood scores for assessing sequence naturalness and variant effects.

components.name: ESM score variant SAE batch
components.description: Scores multiple missense variants against one reference protein using the ESMC-6B SAE model in a batch mode that reuses the reference SAE across variants, supporting saturation mutagenesis, DMS-style sweeps, and clinical variant panels up to 100 variants per call.

components.name: ESM score variant SAE disruption
components.description: Given a protein sequence and a missense variant, runs ESMC-6B sparse autoencoder on reference and mutant sequences, computes per-feature activation deltas around the mutation site, and returns ranked top-K features lost and gained in the mutant.

components.name: ESM2 score missense variant
components.description: Score a missense protein variant using ESM-2 masked-marginal log-likelihood ratio over HuggingFace's keyless hf-inference. Takes a wild-type protein sequence, 1-based position, and mutant residue; returns the log-likelihood ratio (logP(mutant) - logP(wild-type)).

components.name: ESMFold predict structure
components.description: Predict protein 3D structure from an amino acid sequence using ESMFold (Meta's ESM-2 language model) without multiple sequence alignment. Returns PDB coordinate text, per-residue pLDDT confidence scores, and summary statistics; best for sequences under 400 residues.

components.name: EU Health Info Deep Dive
components.description: Retrieves detailed cancer-related health data from a cached database, supporting country and language filters, and returns structured records covering incidence, survival, screening, and tumor registries.

components.name: Euhealthinfo search alcohol tobacco psychoactive use
components.description: Searches EU health information datasets focused on substance usage, including alcohol, tobacco, vaping, and psychoactive substances, and returns matching dataset metadata and links for population-level analysis.

components.name: EU Health Info Births Search
components.description: Searches and retrieves fertility, birth trend, and perinatal indicator data for structured analysis, returning metadata and summary outputs for cross-country or regional comparisons.

components.name: EU Health Info Cancer Search
components.description: Search a cached database for curated cancer-related datasets and resources, filterable by country, and return structured outputs that include dataset summaries, metadata, and identifiers covering incidence, prevalence, survival rates, screening, and tumor registries.

components.name: EU Health Info Search Cancer Registry
components.description: Searches for cancer-related statistical datasets, returning links and metadata for datasets covering cancer incidence, prevalence, mortality, and survival across geographic and thematic contexts.

components.name: EU Health Info Search Causes of Death
components.description: Search and retrieve datasets providing cause-specific mortality insights, including mortality trend summaries, metadata, and links to external resources, with optional region/country and term filters.

components.name: Euhealthinfo search COVID-19
components.description: Searches the EU Health Information service for datasets and resources relevant to COVID-19 or SARS-CoV-2, covering topics such as vaccination, hospitalization, seroprevalence, and wastewater monitoring, and returns matching resource records for further exploration.

components.name: EU Health Info Search Deaths
components.description: Search mortality-related datasets from EU health information sources based on user queries, with optional country and term override filters, returning structured mortality dataset results for trend analysis and geographic comparisons.

components.name: EU Health Info diabetes epidemiology registry search
components.description: Search and retrieve structured epidemiological and registry-based health datasets focused on diabetes and associated conditions, returning metadata and links to external data sources or downloads.

components.name: EU Health Info disability dataset search
components.description: Searches multiple dataset repositories for datasets related to disabilities, accessibility, functional limitations, and quality of care, returning links to accessible datasets and warnings when direct retrieval is unavailable. Accepts optional country and search term overrides.

components.name: EU HealthInfo Search Healthcare Expenditure
components.description: Discovers healthcare expenditure and spending datasets by country and optional search term, returning dataset availability or absence for the specified criteria.

components.name: EU Health Info hospital inpatient data search
components.description: Retrieve and explore datasets related to hospital inpatient activity, including admissions, discharges, diagnoses, and medical procedures, based on search criteria such as country and term override.

components.name: Euhealthinfo search infectious diseases
components.description: This tool discovers publicly available health-related datasets by searching and aggregating data from multiple sources, with a focus on infectious diseases, epidemiology, disease statistics, and health indicators. It returns detailed metadata including access information and thematic classifications tailored to the us…

components.name: EU Health Info search key indicators registries surveys
components.description: Search and retrieve aggregated public health datasets containing high-level health indicators derived from registries and surveys, returning organized metadata and links.

components.name: EU Health Info mental health dataset search
components.description: Identifies publicly accessible datasets related to mental health topics, accepting optional search term and country filters, and returns relevant dataset records for research, policy, and intervention planning.

components.name: EU Health Info Search Obesity
components.description: Searches for health-related datasets specializing in obesity, overweight status, BMI, and associated risk factors, returning matching dataset records. Users can explore actual data with the euhealthinfo_deepdive tool.

components.name: EU Health Info Population Health Survey Search
components.description: Search and retrieve population health survey datasets from international and national organizations by thematic interest and country, returning curated survey datasets with access links and derived indicators.

components.name: EUHealthInfo search primary care workforce
components.description: Search metadata for datasets related to the primary-care workforce, accepting search terms and country filters and returning metadata results for data sources relevant to workforce composition and geographic distribution.

components.name: EU Health Info search surveillance
components.description: Identifies and retrieves publicly available sources and systems related to public health surveillance, with optional filtering by country and search term; outputs details on monitoring systems and resources.

components.name: EU Health Info Surveillance Mortality Rates Search
components.description: Identifies and retrieves publicly available sources and systems related to mortality trends, including excess mortality, by country or theme, and returns details on relevant monitoring systems and resources.

components.name: EU Health Info Vaccination Search
components.description: Search and discover vaccination and immunization statistics datasets, including global and regional trends and coverage rates, and receive summaries of relevant datasets. Optional parameters include query terms, country filters, and result limits; use the euhealthinfo_deepdive tool to access the actual data.

components.name: Europe PMC Disease Target Score
components.description: Extracts disease-target association scores from Europe PMC literature for a given EFO disease identifier. Returns all targets with literature-based evidence scores, sorted strongest first, with a 25-second scan cap.

components.name: EuropePMC get article datalinks
components.description: Retrieve Europe PMC datalinks for an article, accepting a PubMed ID (default), PMCID, or other source ID and returning text-mined and curated cross-references to associated data records and external resources grouped by category with counts, identifiers, titles, and target URLs. The tool queries Europe PMC to answer w…

components.name: EuropePMC get citations
components.description: Retrieves citations for a specified article from Europe PMC using a source database (e.g., MED for PubMed) and an article identifier.

components.name: Europe PMC get full text
components.description: Retrieve and parse full-text XML from Europe PMC into structured sections, returning title, abstract, body sections, figure and table captions, and references as structured JSON. Accepts a PMC ID or PMID, and only works for open-access articles available in PubMed Central.

components.name: EuropePMC get fulltext
components.description: Fetch a PMC article's full text by PMC ID using deterministic fallbacks across Europe PMC fullTextXML, NCBI PMC OAI, NCBI efetch, and PMC HTML, returning structured provenance and a retrieval trace.

components.name: Europe PMC full-text snippet retrieval
components.description: Fetches an article's full text via Europe PMC and deterministic fallback sources, then returns bounded text snippets around provided terms with a machine-readable retrieval trace.

components.name: EuropePMC get references
components.description: Retrieve the references cited by an article from Europe PMC using a source database and article identifier.

components.name: Europe PMC Guidelines Search
components.description: Search Europe PMC for clinical guidelines and evidence-based recommendations using a medical condition, treatment, or clinical topic query, returning matching guideline records from the Europe PMC life sciences literature archive.

components.name: Europe PMC article search
components.description: Search Europe PMC for biomedical and life sciences articles, returning abstracts and metadata ranked by relevance. Supports fielded full-text queries when full text is indexed in Europe PMC.

components.name: EuroPMCAnnot get annotations by type
components.description: Retrieves annotations of a specified type from multiple articles using the Europe PMC Annotations API, supporting batch extraction of entities such as chemicals or organisms for up to 200 article IDs per request.

components.name: Get article annotations
components.description: Get text-mined annotations from a scientific article using the Europe PMC Annotations API. Returns entities such as chemicals, organisms, gene ontology terms, diseases, and gene/protein mentions with their exact text, context, ontology URIs, and section locations.

components.name: Extract chemicals from article
components.description: Extracts chemical and compound mentions from a scientific article using Europe PMC text mining, returning chemicals identified in the article with their ChEBI ontology URIs, exact text matches, and surrounding context.

components.name: EVA disease target score
components.description: Extract disease-target association scores from EVA (European Variation Archive) by providing an EFO disease identifier. Returns numeric disease-target association scores based on EVA genetic variant data.

components.name: EVA get clustered variant by RS
components.description: Resolve an EVA clustered-variant RS accession to its canonical assembly, contig, and position record using the EVA accessioning (identifiers) service. Returns a list of accession records, usually one.

components.name: EVA get variants by gene
components.description: Retrieves genetic variants for a specific gene from the European Variation Archive (EVA), which aggregates variant data from ClinVar, dbSNP, and population sequencing projects. Accepts an HGNC gene symbol and optional species, returning variants with allele frequencies, study sources, and variant type.

components.name: EVA get variants by region
components.description: Retrieves genetic variants from the European Variation Archive (EVA) within a specified genomic region (chromosome:start-end), returning SNVs, indels, and structural variants with allele frequencies from multiple studies.

components.name: EVA list studies
components.description: List all variant studies available in the European Variation Archive (EVA) for a given species and assembly, returning study accessions such as PRJEB84021 that have submitted variant data.

components.name: EVA somatic disease target score
components.description: Extracts disease-target association scores from EVA somatic mutation data using an EFO disease identifier and returns numeric EVA genetic variant scores (0-1).

components.name: EVE gene info lookup
components.description: Checks whether EVE pathogenicity scores are available for a requested gene symbol and returns gene information such as Ensembl ID and a link to the EVE website. Covers about 3,000 disease-related human genes.

components.name: EVE variant pathogenicity score
components.description: Get EVE (Evolutionary Variant Effect) pathogenicity score for a variant using unsupervised deep learning on evolutionary data, accessed via Ensembl VEP API. Accepts a variant in HGVS format or genomic coordinates and returns a score from 0 to 1 where >0.5 is likely pathogenic.

components.name: Evo2 Score Variant
components.description: Score variant effects using the NVIDIA-hosted Evo 2 genome foundation model. Accepts reference and alternate DNA windows and returns a delta log-likelihood score (alt - ref), where negative values indicate variants disfavored by the model; supports evo2-40b and evo2-7b model sizes.

components.name: EWAS Catalog search by CpG
components.description: Look up all published epigenome-wide association study (EWAS) results for one CpG methylation site from the EWAS Catalog (MRC-IEU). Returns trait, effect size, tissue, cohort, and publication for every association, ranked by significance.

components.name: EWAS Catalog search by gene
components.description: Look up published epigenome-wide association study (EWAS) results annotated to one gene from the EWAS Catalog (MRC-IEU), returning associated traits, effect sizes, tissues, cohorts, and publications for CpG sites mapped to the gene, ranked by significance.

components.name: Expression ANOVA per gene
components.description: Computes per-gene one-way ANOVA or log2 fold change between groups on a gene-by-sample expression matrix, using gene-level means per group. Accepts CSV count matrix and sample metadata files and returns gene-level expression statistics.

components.name: Expression Atlas disease target score
components.description: Extract disease-target association scores from Expression Atlas using an EFO disease identifier, returning scores derived from gene expression data.

components.name: ExpressionAtlas get baseline
components.description: Lists baseline gene expression experiments from EBI Expression Atlas for a given species. The optional gene argument labels the request but does not filter results.

components.name: Expression Atlas get experiment
components.description: Retrieve metadata for a specific Expression Atlas experiment by accession (e.g., E-MTAB-2836), including accession, type, species, and description/URLs. The underlying API does not expose per-experiment design, technology, contrasts, PubMed IDs, or assay counts through this endpoint.

components.name: ExpressionAtlas Search Differential
components.description: Search EBI Expression Atlas for differential expression experiments by condition text and/or a gene mentioned in the experiment description, returning matching experiment records; supports disease-context expression analysis. Gene matches are text-search coincidences and not validated per-gene differential-expression…

components.name: ExpressionAtlas search experiments
components.description: Search all EBI Expression Atlas experiments (baseline and differential) by condition text and/or a gene mentioned in the experiment description, returning experiment accessions, types, descriptions, and assay counts. Use to find relevant expression datasets, not a validated per-gene result set.

components.name: Extract clinical trial adverse events
components.description: Extracts detailed adverse event results from ClinicalTrials.gov by NCT ID, with optional organ system filtering.

components.name: Extract clinical trial outcomes
components.description: Extracts detailed clinical trial outcome results, such as overall survival months and p-values, from ClinicalTrials.gov using NCT IDs. Accepts a list of NCT IDs and an outcome measure type and returns the corresponding trial outcome data.

components.name: FAERS temporal trend analysis
components.description: Analyzes temporal trends in adverse event reporting by year, accepting a generic drug name and adverse event, and returns yearly counts and trend direction (increasing/decreasing/stable). Uses FAERS data for signal evolution monitoring.

components.name: FAERS calculate disproportionality
components.description: Calculates disproportionality statistics (ROR, PRR, IC with 95% CI) for drug-event pairs from FAERS using reported product names and openFDA SPL annotations, returning signal strength classifications for pharmacovigilance signal detection.

components.name: FAERS Compare Drugs
components.description: Compare safety signals for two drugs with the same adverse event using FAERS data, returning ROR, PRR, and IC metrics with comparative analysis.

components.name: FAERS count additive administration routes
components.description: Enumerates and counts administration routes for adverse events across specified medicinal products using FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) data. Accepts medicinal product names and returns ranked term/count results with limit and truncation information.

components.name: FAERS Count Additive Adverse Reactions
components.description: Aggregates adverse reaction counts from the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) for specified medicinal products using OR (union) logic across the product list, with optional filters for patient sex, age group, country, and seriousness.

components.name: FAERS count additive event reports by country
components.description: Aggregates FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) report counts by country of occurrence across specified medicinal products, with optional filters for patient sex, age group, and seriousness, returning ranked term/count rows.

components.name: FAERS count additive reaction outcomes
components.description: Counts adverse reaction outcomes (e.g., recovered, resolving, fatal) across medicinal products from the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS). The tool accepts medicinal product filters and returns ranked reaction outcome counts with result metadata.

components.name: FAERS count additive reports by reporter country
components.description: Aggregates FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) adverse event reports by primary reporter country across medicinal products, with optional filters for patient sex, age group, and seriousness, returning ranked term/count rows.

components.name: FAERS Count Additive Seriousness Classification
components.description: Quantifies serious vs non-serious adverse event classifications across medicinal products using FAERS data, requiring a medicinal product query and returning ranked term/count rows with applied limit and truncation metadata.

components.name: FAERS Count Country by Drug Event
components.description: Counts adverse event reports in FDA FAERS by country of occurrence for a given medicinal product, with optional filters for patient sex, age group, and seriousness. Returns country-term/count rows ranked by descending report count.

components.name: FAERS death-related report count by drug
components.description: Counts FAERS adverse event reports for a given drug by the 'seriousnessdeath' criterion using the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS). Only the medicinalproduct drug name is required, and the tool returns death-related report counts.

components.name: FAERS count drug characterization
components.description: Aggregates FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) reports for a given medicinal product by drug characterization role (suspect, concomitant, or interacting), returning counts of reports for each role. An optional serious filter restricts results to serious or non-serious reports.

components.name: FAERS count drug routes by event
components.description: Counts the most common routes of administration for drugs involved in adverse event reports from the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System, taking a medicinal product name and returning ranked term/count rows with a truncation flag.

components.name: FAERS count drugs by drug event
components.description: Counts the number of different drugs involved in FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) reports, optionally filtered by medicinal product, patient sex, age group, occurrence country, or seriousness. Returns a ranking of drugs with their report counts.

components.name: FAERS Count Indications by Drug
components.description: Aggregate FDA adverse event (FAERS) reports for a drug by the indication (the medical condition the drug was being used to treat), returning the distribution of indications across all reports for that drug. Requires a medicinalproduct (drug name) and optionally filters reports by seriousness.

components.name: FAERS count outcomes by drug event
components.description: Counts adverse event outcomes for a specified medicinal product in the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS), returning ranked outcome counts with optional filters.

components.name: FAERS count patient age distribution
components.description: Analyzes the age distribution of patients experiencing adverse events for a specified drug using FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) data. Takes a medicinal product name and returns term/count rows ranked by descending report count with optional limit and truncation handling.

components.name: FAERS count reactions by drug event
components.description: Counts the number of adverse reactions reported for a given drug in the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS), optionally filtered by patient sex, age group, country, seriousness, and MedDRA terms, and returns term/count rows ranked by descending report count.

components.name: FAERS Count Reporter Qualification
components.description: Aggregates FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) reports for a specified drug by primary-source reporter qualification (Physician, Pharmacist, Other health professional, Lawyer, or Consumer or non-health professional), returning counts or shares by category. The tool requires a medicinal product name and optional…

components.name: FAERS Count Reporter Country by Drug Event
components.description: Counts FDA adverse event reports from FAERS grouped by primary reporter country for a given medicinal product, with optional filters for patient sex, age group, and seriousness. Returns ranked country count rows, result count, applied limit, and truncation flag.

components.name: FAERS count seriousness by drug event
components.description: Counts FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) reports classified as serious or non-serious for a specified medicinal product, with optional filters for patient sex, age group, and occurrence country. Returns term/count rows for the seriousness classification.

components.name: FAERS filter serious events
components.description: Filter FAERS adverse event records for a specified generic drug to identify serious reactions (death, hospitalization, disability, life-threatening) and return top reaction summaries meeting seriousness criteria.

components.name: FAERS rollup MedDRA hierarchy
components.description: Aggregates adverse event reports from FAERS by MedDRA Preferred Term for a given drug, returning the most-reported terms with counts ranked by descending report count via openFDA.

components.name: FAERS adverse event report search
components.description: Search and retrieve detailed individual case safety reports from the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) via openFDA. Accepts a required medicinal product name and optional filters for patient sex, age group, country, seriousness, and death, and returns a paginated object containing adverse event reports, count…

components.name: FAERS search reports by drug and indication
components.description: Search and retrieve detailed adverse event reports for a specific drug and indication from the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS). Returns individual case reports with patient information, adverse event details, drug information, and report metadata.

components.name: FAERS Search Reports by Drug and Outcome
components.description: Searches and retrieves detailed adverse event case reports from the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) for a specified drug, optionally filtered by reaction outcome. Returns a paginated object containing individual case reports, per-page count, total available matching reports, and truncation status.

components.name: FAERS search reports by drug and reaction
components.description: Searches FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) for individual adverse event case reports by required drug name and MedDRA reaction term. Returns a page of case reports with patient information, adverse event details, drug information, and report metadata, along with count and total available.

components.name: FAERS search reports by drug combination
components.description: Search the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) for detailed adverse event case reports involving multiple specified drugs (drug interactions). Requires a list of at least two drug names and returns paginated individual case reports with optional filters such as patient sex, age group, seriousness, and reaction…

components.name: FAERS search serious reports by drug
components.description: Search and retrieve detailed FAERS case reports for a specific drug, returning individual case reports with patient information, adverse event details, drug information, and report metadata. Requires a drug name (medicinalproduct); optional filters include seriousness, reaction term, limit, and skip.

components.name: FAERS Stratify by Demographics
components.description: Stratifies FAERS adverse event reports by demographics (sex, age group, country) for a given drug and adverse event, returning counts and percentages by demographic group and total reports. Uses openFDA FAERS data.

components.name: Fatcat Search Scholar
components.description: Searches Internet Archive Scholar via Fatcat releases, using a keyword query across titles, abstracts, and metadata to return detailed scholarly publication records including authors, publication year, DOI, journal, publisher, abstract, and PDF links.

components.name: FAVOR annotate variant
components.description: Comprehensive functional annotation of a single GRCh38 variant via FAVOR, returning allele frequencies, gene consequences, deleteriousness scores, ClinVar significance, and regulatory context. Input is a GRCh38 coordinate string and output is variant annotation records.

components.name: FDA drug abuse and dependence information by drug name
components.description: Retrieves FDA drug labeling information about drug abuse and dependence by drug name, including controlled substance status, types of possible abuse, and adverse reactions relevant to those abuse types.

components.name: FDA Get Abuse Info by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve information about types of abuse associated with a drug name from FDA drug labeling data.

components.name: FDA get accessories info by drug name
components.description: Retrieve information about accessories based on a drug name from FDA drug labeling data. Accepts a drug name and returns matching accessory records.

components.name: FDA Get Active Ingredient Info by Drug Name
components.description: Fetch a list of active ingredients in a specific drug product using a drug name query against FDA drug labeling data.

components.name: FDA Get Adverse Reactions by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve adverse reactions information from FDA drug labels based on a drug name, covering both modern PLR and legacy/OTC label safety sections using openFDA drug/label data.

components.name: FDA get alarms by drug name
components.description: Retrieve alarm records associated with a specified drug name from openFDA. Accepts a drug_name query and returns matching alarms.

components.name: FDA Get Animal Pharmacology Info by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve animal pharmacology and toxicology information from FDA drug labeling based on a drug name. Accepts a drug name with optional limit and skip parameters and returns matching records.

components.name: FDA get assembly installation info by drug name
components.description: Retrieve assembly or installation instructions based on drug names from FDA drug labeling.

components.name: FDA boxed warning info lookup
components.description: Retrieves boxed warning information from FDA drug labeling for a given drug name using OpenFDA.

components.name: FDA get brand name generic name
components.description: Retrieve the brand name and generic name of a drug by searching openFDA drug labeling data with a drug's generic or brand name. Accepts a required drug_name string and optional limit.

components.name: FDA Get Carcinogenic Mutagenic Fertility by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieves carcinogenic, mutagenic, and fertility impairment information for a specified drug name from FDA drug labeling.

components.name: FDA child safety information by drug name
components.description: Retrieve child safety information for a specific drug by its name.

components.name: FDA get clinical pharmacology by drug name
components.description: Retrieve clinical pharmacology information for a drug name from FDA drug labeling.

components.name: FDA get clinical studies info by drug name
components.description: Retrieve clinical studies information from FDA based on a drug name.

components.name: FDA conditions info for doctor consult by drug name
components.description: Get information about when a doctor should be consulted before using a specific drug by supplying a drug name.

components.name: FDA get consulting doctor pharmacist info by drug name
components.description: Get information about when a doctor or pharmacist should be consulted regarding drug interactions for a specific drug, using a drug name query.

components.name: FDA get contact for questions info by drug name
components.description: Retrieves information on who to contact with questions about a drug based on a provided drug name.

components.name: FDA Get Contraindications by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve contraindications information for a specified drug name from FDA drug labeling. The tool accounts for differences in safety content section names between modern PLR-format and legacy/OTC labels.

components.name: FDA get DEA schedule info by drug name
components.description: Retrieve the controlled substance Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) schedule information for a specified drug name. Accepts a drug name and returns the matching DEA schedule details.

components.name: FDA Dependence Information by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieves dependence characteristics for a given drug name from FDA drug labeling data, returning drug dependence information.

components.name: FDA DHCP letter lookup by drug name
components.description: Fetch information about dear health care provider letters for a specific drug from the FDA, accepting a drug name and returning corresponding letter records. The letters are sent by drug manufacturers to provide new or updated information about the drug.

components.name: FDA disposal info by drug name
components.description: Retrieves disposal and waste handling information for a supplied drug name from FDA drug labeling data.

components.name: FDA Get Do Not Use Info by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve all contraindication information for a specified drug name from FDA drug labeling.

components.name: FDA document ID lookup by drug name
components.description: Retrieves the FDA drug labeling document ID for a given drug name by querying the FDA drug labeling records.

components.name: FDA Dosage and Storage Information by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieves dosage and storage information for a specific drug from FDA drug labeling data using the drug name as input.

components.name: FDA dosage forms and strengths lookup
components.description: Retrieve dosage forms and strengths information for a given drug name from FDA drug labeling data.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Generic Name
components.description: Queries FDA drug labeling data via openFDA using a supplied generic or brand drug name and returns the associated generic name.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Interactions by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve drug interactions based on a specified drug name from FDA drug labeling data via openFDA. The tool also clarifies how FDA label safety content section names such as 'warnings' and 'warnings_and_cautions' vary by label format.

components.name: FDA get drug label
components.description: Retrieve the full text of a drug label from OpenFDA for a single drug by brand or generic drug name.

components.name: FDA drug label field lookup
components.description: Retrieve FDA drug label information by searching a specific drug label field for a given value, with optional return_fields selection or ALL to return full label records from openFDA.

components.name: FDA get drug name by adverse reaction
components.description: Retrieve drug names associated with a specific adverse reaction reported, using an adverse_reaction query string. Returns a predefined limited number of drug names and does not cover all possible drugs.

components.name: FDA drug name lookup by conditions for doctor consult
components.description: Retrieve a predefined limited list of drug names that require consulting a doctor before use based on a patient's specific condition or symptom. The tool accepts a condition or symptom and returns matching drug names.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Name by Dependence Info
components.description: Retrieve the drug name based on information about psychological and physical dependence characteristics. Accepts a dependence information string and returns the matching drug name from FDA drug labeling.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Name by Document ID
components.description: Retrieve the drug name associated with an FDA labeling document ID. Accepts a document ID and returns the corresponding drug name.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Name by Dosage Info
components.description: Retrieves the drug name based on dosage and administration information provided as a string, returning matching drug name records with optional pagination controls.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Name by Environmental Warning
components.description: Retrieve drug names that match a specified environmental warning text from FDA drug labeling.

components.name: FDA get drug name by inactive ingredient
components.description: Retrieve the drug name associated with a supplied inactive ingredient using FDA drug labeling data.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Name by Labor and Delivery Info
components.description: Retrieves a drug name based on information about the drug's use during labor or delivery. Accepts a free-text labor and delivery information query and returns the corresponding drug name.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Name by Microbiology
components.description: Retrieve drug names from FDA drug labeling records that match a supplied microbiology information query, with optional pagination controls.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Name by Other Safety Info
components.description: Retrieve the drug name from FDA drug labeling data based on provided safety information, which may not be specified in other fields.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Name by Pharmacodynamics
components.description: Retrieves drug names from FDA drug labeling data based on a provided pharmacodynamics description. Accepts a pharmacodynamics query string and returns the matching drug name.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Name by Pharmacogenomics
components.description: Retrieves FDA drug names that match provided pharmacogenomics field information. Accepts a pharmacogenomics query and returns the corresponding drug name.

components.name: FDA get drug name by precautions
components.description: Retrieve drug names from FDA drug labeling records based on a supplied precautions field query.

components.name: FDA get drug name by pregnancy or breastfeeding info
components.description: Retrieves drug names from FDA drug labeling data based on pregnancy or breastfeeding information provided by the user.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Name by Principal Display Panel
components.description: Retrieve the drug name based on the content of the principal display panel of the product package.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Name by Reference
components.description: Retrieves the drug name associated with reference information found in FDA drug labeling records. Accepts a reference query and returns matching drug names, with optional limit and skip pagination parameters.

components.name: FDA drug name lookup by Set ID
components.description: Retrieve the drug name associated with an FDA drug labeling Set ID. Accepts a Set ID string and returns the matching drug name.

components.name: FDA Drug Name Lookup by SPL ID
components.description: Retrieve the drug name from FDA Structured Product Label records using an FDA application number, NUI unique identifier, SPL document ID, or SPL set ID.

components.name: FDA get drug name by stop use info
components.description: Retrieve the drug name associated with a supplied stop-use information string. Accepts a required stop-use-info query and returns matching drug name(s).

components.name: FDA Get Drug Name by Storage and Handling Info
components.description: Retrieves drug names based on provided storage and handling information. Accepts storage and handling information and returns matching drug name records.

components.name: FDA get drug name by warnings
components.description: Retrieve drug names based on specific warning information found in drug labeling. The tool accepts a warning_text query against FDA drug labeling and returns matching drug names.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Name From Patient Package Insert
components.description: Retrieves the drug name based on the information provided in a patient package insert; accepts patient package insert text and returns the corresponding drug name.

components.name: FDA get drug names by abuse dependence info
components.description: Retrieves drug names based on information about drug abuse and dependence, including controlled substance status, abuse types, and adverse reactions. Accepts an abuse/dependence query and returns matching drug names.

components.name: FDA Drug Names by Abuse Info
components.description: Retrieve a predefined, limited set of drug names from FDA drug labeling based on abuse information, related adverse reactions, and drug indication. The tool accepts abuse information and indication as inputs and returns matching drug names; it does not cover all possible drugs.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Accessories
components.description: Retrieve drug names from FDA drug labeling data by querying the accessories field and optional indication.

components.name: FDA drug names by active ingredient
components.description: Retrieve drug names associated with a given active ingredient, optionally filtered by indication, from FDA drug labeling data.

components.name: FDA get drug names by alarm
components.description: Retrieves a limited list of drug names from openFDA drug labeling data that match a specified adverse-event alarm type and optional indication. Results may include a warning when the query was broadened to return closest matches.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Animal Pharmacology Info
components.description: Retrieve drug names based on animal pharmacology and toxicology information. The tool accepts pharmacology information and optional indication and returns a predefined limited set of drug names.

components.name: FDA get drug names by application number NDC number
components.description: Retrieves drug names matching an FDA application number, manufacturer, or National Drug Code (NDC) number.

components.name: FDA get drug names by assembly installation info
components.description: Retrieves drug names from FDA drug labeling data based on assembly or installation instructions and optional drug indication, returning a predefined limited set of drug names that may not cover all possible drugs.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Boxed Warning
components.description: Finds drugs whose FDA label contains a boxed warning matching a supplied contiguous phrase, returning matching drug names.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Child Safety Info
components.description: Retrieves drug names from FDA drug labeling based on child safety information, including whether the product should be kept out of reach of children and accidental contact or ingestion instructions, with an optional indication filter.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Clinical Pharmacology
components.description: Retrieves drug names based on clinical pharmacology terms and indication. Returns a predefined limited set of drug names and does not cover all possible drugs.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Clinical Studies
components.description: Retrieves drug names based on clinical studies keywords and optional drug indication. Accepts clinical studies information and drug indication as queries and returns matching drug names.

components.name: FDA get drug names by consulting doctor pharmacist info
components.description: Retrieve a predefined limited list of drug names based on provided information about when a doctor or pharmacist should be consulted regarding drug interactions and indication.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Contraindications
components.description: Retrieve drug names based on specific contraindication information, optionally filtered by indication.

components.name: FDA get drug names by controlled substance DEA schedule
components.description: Retrieves drug names, including brand name and generic name, for drugs associated with a specified DEA controlled substance schedule. Supports optional indication filtering and returns FDA drug labeling data through openFDA.

components.name: FDA get drug names by DHCP letter info
components.description: Fetches drug names based on information about Dear Health Care Provider letters, which manufacturers send to provide new or updated drug information. Accepts letter information and indication and returns matching drug names.

components.name: FDA drug name lookup by disposal info
components.description: Retrieve drug names from FDA drug labeling data based on disposal and waste handling information, optionally filtered by indication.

components.name: FDA drug names by dosage forms and strengths info
components.description: Retrieve drug names from FDA drug labeling data based on specified dosage forms and strengths, with optional filtering by indication.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Drug Interactions
components.description: Retrieves a list of drug names from FDA drug labeling that match a specified drug interaction term and optional indication.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Effective Time
components.description: Retrieves drug names from FDA labeling documents based on an effective time date and optional indication, returning brand and generic names from openFDA.

components.name: FDA drug names by food safety warnings
components.description: Retrieves FDA drug names whose label discusses a food-drug interaction or food safety warning by searching openFDA label sections such as food_safety_warning, drug_interactions, precautions, and warnings_and_precautions for terms like grapefruit, alcohol, or dairy.

components.name: FDA drug names by general precautions
components.description: Retrieves drug names from FDA drug labeling data based on general precaution information, with optional filtering by indication.

components.name: FDA get drug names by geriatric use
components.description: Retrieve drug names that have specific information about geriatric use from FDA drug labeling, optionally filtered by indication or geriatric-use criteria.

components.name: FDA get drug names by health claim
components.description: Retrieve drug names based on specific health claims and indications.

components.name: FDA drug names by indication
components.description: Retrieve a list of drug names based on a specific indication or usage from FDA drug labeling data.

components.name: FDA get drug names by indication aggregated
components.description: Retrieve drug names from FDA drug labeling by indication and aggregate generic names with all associated brand names, iterating through all available results.

components.name: FDA drug names by indication statistics
components.description: Retrieves and aggregates brand_name and generic_name distributions for drugs matching a supplied indication using the FDA count API, without fetching full records.

components.name: FDA get drug names by info for nursing mothers
components.description: Retrieves drug names from FDA drug labeling using nursing mothers information and drug indication.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Info for Owner or Caregiver
components.description: Retrieve drug names from FDA drug labeling based on owner or caregiver information and indication.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Ingredient
components.description: Retrieve drug product names associated with a specific ingredient using FDA drug labeling data. Accepts an ingredient name and optional indication to filter results.

components.name: FDA get drug names by instructions for use
components.description: Retrieves drug names based on specific instructions for use text and optionally filters by indication.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Lab Test Interference
components.description: Retrieves drug names that have known interference with laboratory tests using laboratory test interference information and optional indication filters.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Lab Tests
components.description: Retrieve drug names from FDA drug labeling data based on laboratory test information and optional indication.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Mechanism of Action
components.description: Retrieve drug names from FDA drug labeling by searching the Mechanism of Action section using a free-text mechanism keyword, with an optional indication filter.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Medication Guide
components.description: Retrieve drug names based on the presence of specific information in the medication guide, with optional filtering by indication.

components.name: FDA get drug names by nonclinical toxicology info
components.description: Retrieve drug names based on nonclinical toxicology information and drug indication.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Nonteratogenic Effects
components.description: Retrieves drug names based on provided nonteratogenic effects information and optional indication, returning matching drug names.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Overdosage Info
components.description: Retrieves drug names from FDA drug labeling data based on user-provided information about signs, symptoms, and laboratory findings of acute overdosage, with an optional indication filter. Returns matching brand and generic drug names via openFDA.

components.name: FDA Drug Name Lookup by Pediatric Use
components.description: Retrieves drug names based on pediatric use information and an optional indication from FDA drug labeling.

components.name: FDA drug name lookup by pharmacokinetics
components.description: Retrieve drug names based on specific pharmacokinetics information such as absorption, distribution, elimination, metabolism, drug interactions, and patient populations, optionally filtered by indication.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Population Use
components.description: Retrieves drug names based on their use in specific populations, such as pregnant women, nursing mothers, pediatric patients, and geriatric patients, with optional indication filtering.

components.name: FDA get drug names by pregnancy effects info
components.description: Search FDA drug labeling data for drug names by pregnancy-related effects information and optional therapeutic indication, returning matching brand and generic names.

components.name: FDA drug names by residue warning
components.description: Retrieves drug names from FDA drug labeling data based on a residue warning query and optional indication filter. Returns matching drug names.

components.name: FDA get drug names by risk
components.description: Retrieve drug names based on specific risk information, particularly pregnancy or breastfeeding, with optional filtering by drug indication.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Route
components.description: Retrieves drug names based on a specified route of administration and optional indication.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by Safe Handling Warning
components.description: Retrieve drug names that have specific safe handling warnings from FDA drug labeling data, optionally filtered by indication.

components.name: FDA drug names by safety summary
components.description: Retrieve drug names from FDA drug labeling data by searching the summary of safety and effectiveness text and optionally filtering by indication.

components.name: FDA get drug names by SPL indexing data elements
components.description: Retrieves drug names from the FDA Structured Product Labeling dataset based on SPL indexing data elements and optional indication filters.

components.name: FDA get drug names by teratogenic effects
components.description: Retrieves drug names from FDA drug labeling based on a teratogenic effects category such as Pregnancy category A, B, C, D, or X, with optional filtering by drug indication.

components.name: FDA Get Drug Names by User Safety Warning
components.description: Retrieves drug names that have a specific user safety warning from FDA drug labeling data via openFDA. Accepts a safety warning and optional indication, and returns matching brand and generic names.

components.name: FDA drug names by warnings and cautions
components.description: Retrieves drug brand and generic names from FDA drug labeling data matching supplied warnings and cautions text, with optional indication filtering.

components.name: FDA get drugs by carcinogenic mutagenic fertility
components.description: Retrieve drug names from OpenFDA drug labeling data based on the presence of carcinogenic, mutagenic, or fertility impairment information, optionally filtered by indication.

components.name: FDA Get Effective Time by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve the effective time of an FDA drug labeling document by drug name. Accepts a required drug name and optional pagination controls, returning the labeling effective time.

components.name: FDA get environmental warning by drug name
components.description: Fetch environmental warnings for a specific drug based on its name.

components.name: FDA Get General Precautions by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieves the general precautions section from FDA drug labeling for a specified drug name from openFDA.

components.name: FDA Get Geriatric Use Info by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieves FDA drug labeling information about geriatric use for a specified drug name, with optional pagination controls for large result sets.

components.name: FDA health claims lookup
components.description: Retrieve health claims associated with a specific drug name from OpenFDA drug labeling data. Accepts a required drug name and returns matching health claim records.

components.name: FDA Get Inactive Ingredient Info by Drug Name
components.description: Fetch a list of inactive ingredients for a specific drug product based on the drug name. Accepts a drug name and returns the matching inactive ingredient list.

components.name: FDA get indications by drug name
components.description: Retrieve indications and usage information from FDA drug labeling for a specific drug name.

components.name: FDA Get Info for Nursing Mothers by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve information about nursing mothers for a specific drug from the FDA drug labeling database. Accepts a drug name and returns relevant nursing mothers safety information.

components.name: FDA owner caregiver drug information lookup
components.description: Retrieve specific owner or caregiver information for a given drug name from FDA drug labeling. Accepts a drug name and returns targeted owner/caregiver information.

components.name: FDA Get Info for Patients by Drug Name
components.description: Fetch patient-oriented drug information from openFDA based on a drug name.

components.name: FDA Get Ingredients by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve a list of drug ingredients based on a supplied drug name using openFDA drug labeling data.

components.name: FDA get instructions for use by drug name
components.description: Retrieve FDA instructions for use information by drug name from FDA drug labeling sources.

components.name: FDA Get Lab Test Interference Info by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve information about laboratory test interferences for a specific drug from FDA drug labeling data.

components.name: FDA Get Lab Tests by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieves laboratory test information associated with a given drug name from FDA drug labeling data via openFDA.

components.name: FDA get labor and delivery info by drug name
components.description: Retrieves information about a drug's use during labor or delivery from FDA drug labeling based on the supplied drug name.

components.name: FDA get manufacturer name NDC number by drug name
components.description: Retrieves detailed information for a drug name, including its active ingredient, FDA application number, manufacturer name, National Drug Code (NDC) number, and route of administration.

components.name: FDA Get Mechanism of Action by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve the mechanism of action information for a specific drug by its name from FDA drug labeling.

components.name: FDA get medication guide info by drug name
components.description: Retrieve medication guide information from the FDA drug labeling collection for a specified drug name, returning medication guide records.

components.name: FDA Get Microbiology Info by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve microbiology information from OpenFDA drug labeling records by drug name.

components.name: FDA Get Nonclinical Toxicology Info by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve nonclinical toxicology information based on drug names from FDA sources.

components.name: FDA nonteratogenic effects lookup by drug name
components.description: Retrieves information about nonteratogenic effects for a specified drug name from FDA drug labeling records.

components.name: FDA get other safety info by drug name
components.description: Retrieve FDA drug labeling safety information that may not be specified in other fields for a given drug name. The tool accounts for label format differences, returning warnings_and_cautions for PLR labels and warnings or precautions for legacy and OTC-monograph labels from openFDA drug/label.

components.name: FDA get overdosage info by drug name
components.description: Retrieve information about signs, symptoms, and laboratory findings of acute overdosage for a given drug name from FDA drug labeling data.

components.name: FDA Get Patient Package Insert from Drug Name
components.description: Retrieves patient package insert information from FDA drug labeling data based on a given drug name.

components.name: FDA pediatric use info by drug name
components.description: Retrieves pediatric use information for a drug specified by name from FDA drug labeling data. Accepts a drug name and returns matching pediatric use records.

components.name: FDA Get Pharmacodynamics by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve pharmacodynamics information for a given drug name from openFDA drug labeling data. Accepts a required drug name and optional limit and skip parameters.

components.name: FDA Pharmacogenomics Info by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve pharmacogenomics information from FDA drug labeling by drug name.

components.name: FDA get pharmacokinetics by drug name
components.description: Retrieve pharmacokinetics information such as absorption, distribution, elimination, metabolism, drug interactions, and specific patient populations for a specified drug by name.

components.name: FDA get population use info by drug name
components.description: Retrieve information about the use of a specified drug in specific populations based on the drug name from FDA drug labeling data.

components.name: FDA Get Precautions by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieves precaution information from FDA drug labeling for a given drug name, querying OpenFDA fields such as brand and generic names.

components.name: FDA pregnancy effects info by drug name
components.description: Retrieve FDA drug labeling information about the effects on pregnancy for a drug specified by name.

components.name: FDA pregnancy or breastfeeding info by drug name
components.description: Retrieves pregnancy or breastfeeding information from FDA drug labeling for a specified drug name.

components.name: FDA Get Principal Display Panel by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieves the content of the principal display panel of a drug product package based on a supplied drug name from FDA drug labeling data.

components.name: FDA Get Purpose Info by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieves FDA drug product indications for use matching a supplied drug name.

components.name: FDA get recent changes by drug name
components.description: Retrieve recent major changes in labeling for a specific drug from FDA's openFDA database. Accepts a drug name and returns records of recent labeling changes.

components.name: FDA Get Reference Info by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve reference information from openFDA for a given drug name.

components.name: FDA drug risk information lookup
components.description: Retrieves FDA drug labeling risk information, especially regarding pregnancy or breastfeeding, for a given drug name.

components.name: FDA Get Route Info by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieves route of administration information for a specified drug name from FDA drug labeling data, with optional limit and skip parameters for pagination.

components.name: FDA Get Safe Handling Warnings by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve safe handling warnings for a specific drug by name. Accepts a required drug_name and optional limit/skip pagination controls, and returns matching safe handling warning records.

components.name: FDA get safety summary by drug name
components.description: Retrieve a summary of safety and effectiveness information based on the drug name, specified by brand or generic name.

components.name: FDA Get SPL Indexing Data Elements by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieves Structured Product Labeling (SPL) indexing data elements based on a supplied drug name from the FDA.

components.name: FDA SPL unclassified section lookup by drug name
components.description: Retrieve SPL unclassified section information for a drug name from FDA structured product labeling data.

components.name: FDA Get Stop Use Info by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve FDA stop use information for a supplied drug name, returning drug safety labeling records from openFDA.

components.name: FDA Get Storage and Handling Info by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieves storage and handling information for a drug by name from FDA drug labeling data. Accepts a drug name and returns corresponding storage and handling details.

components.name: FDA get teratogenic effects by drug name
components.description: Retrieve teratogenic effects information for a specified drug by brand or generic name.

components.name: FDA get user safety warning by drug names
components.description: Retrieves FDA user safety warnings for specified drug names from openFDA drug labeling data, including section differences between modern PLR-format and legacy/OTC labels.

components.name: FDA get warnings and cautions by drug name
components.description: Retrieve the Warnings and Cautions section from FDA drug labeling for a specified drug name using openFDA.

components.name: FDA Get Warnings By Drug Name
components.description: Retrieves warning information for a specified drug name from FDA drug labeling records, returning associated drug safety warnings.

components.name: FDA get when using info
components.description: Retrieve information about side effects and substances or activities to avoid while using a specific drug from FDA drug labeling, given a drug name.

components.name: FDA list drug classes
components.description: List FDA pharmacological drug classes (Established Pharmacologic Class, EPC) and the number of drug products in each class. Classes include designations like 'Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitor [EPC]', 'Beta-Adrenergic Blocker [EPC]', 'HMG-CoA Reductase Inhibitor [EPC]' (statins), 'ACE Inhibitor [EPC]', etc. Use t…

components.name: FDA OrangeBook check generic availability
components.description: Check if generic versions are FDA-approved for a brand-name drug. Returns reference drug info, approved generics count, and TE codes from the FDA Orange Book.

components.name: FDA Orange Book Get Approval History
components.description: Retrieves the complete FDA approval history for a drug application, including original approval date, supplements, and review documents, and returns a submission timeline with links to approval letters and labels.

components.name: FDA Orange Book Get Exclusivity
components.description: Get drug exclusivity information (NCE, orphan, pediatric) from the FDA Orange Book by application number, returning exclusivity types such as 5-year NCE, 3-year clinical study, 7-year orphan, and 180-day generic for generic launch planning.

components.name: FDA Orange Book Get Patent Info
components.description: Get patent information for approved drugs from the FDA Orange Book. Accepts an FDA application number or brand name and returns guidance on accessing complete patent data, including numbers and expiration dates, for regulatory exclusivity planning.

components.name: FDA Orange Book get TE code
components.description: Get FDA Orange Book therapeutic equivalence (TE) codes for drug products by brand or generic name, returning codes and interpretation guidance for generic substitution decisions.

components.name: FDA Orange Book Search Drug
components.description: Search the FDA Drugs@FDA database by brand name, generic name, or application number to retrieve approval status, product details, and basic regulatory information.

components.name: FDA Pharmacogenomic Biomarkers
components.description: Retrieve pharmacogenomic biomarkers from FDA drug labels, allowing filtering by drug name or biomarker.

components.name: FDA Retrieve Device Use By Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve the intended use of a device from FDA drug labeling using a required drug name. Returns the matching device use record.

components.name: FDA Retrieve Drug Name by Device Use
components.description: Retrieves the drug name associated with a specified intended use of a device from FDA drug labeling data. Accepts an intended-use text query and returns matching drug names.

components.name: FDA Retrieve Drug Names by Patient Medication Info
components.description: Retrieves drug names based on patient medication information about safe use from FDA drug labeling data. Accepts a patient medication information string and returns matching drug names.

components.name: FDA Retrieve Patient Medication Info by Drug Name
components.description: Retrieve patient medication information about the safe use of a drug by name from FDA drug labeling records.

components.name: FDA Search Drug Labels
components.description: Search FDA-approved drug labels by drug name or medical indication, returning matching drug label summaries that include indications, dosing regimens, contraindications, warnings, interactions, and adverse reactions.

components.name: FDAGSRS get structure
components.description: Retrieve chemical structure data for FDA-regulated chemical substances by UNII code, including SMILES, molecular formula, InChIKey, molfile, molecular weight, stereochemistry, and optical activity from FDA GSRS. Only works for chemical substances and returns errors for proteins, mixtures, or non-chemical substances.

components.name: FDA GSRS Get Substance
components.description: Get full FDA substance record by UNII code from the FDA Global Substance Registration System (GSRS), including names, cross-references, structure, and approval status.

components.name: FDA GSRS substance relationships
components.description: Retrieves the FDA GSRS substance relationship graph and regulatory references for a substance by UNII, including relationship edges such as salt/solvate, impurity, metabolite, prodrug, active moiety, and related substance details.

components.name: FDA GSRS substance search
components.description: Search FDA GSRS for substances by name, UNII code, InChIKey, or molecular formula. Returns official FDA substance records with UNII identifiers, substance class, structure, and cross-references to DrugBank, WHO-ATC, CAS, EC/EINECS, and CFR.

components.name: FDA Purple Book Search Products
components.description: Search FDA's Purple Book of licensed biological products using filters such as proprietary name, proper name, or applicant, returning matching reference biologics, biosimilars/interchangeables, and exclusivity dates from the latest monthly snapshot.

components.name: FHIR Terminology Value Set Expansion
components.description: Expands a FHIR value set to its member codes using HL7's public FHIR Terminology Service, including SNOMED CT implicit subsumption value sets that return all descendant clinical codes of a given concept.

components.name: FHIR terminology code lookup
components.description: Resolve a code to its display name and synonyms using HL7's public FHIR Terminology Service. Accepts code system and code for SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, or ICD-10-CM, with SNOMED CT as the primary use case.

components.name: Figshare get article
components.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a Figshare research output by its article ID, returning title, description, authors, DOI, files, categories, tags, funding, license, citation, and download statistics.

components.name: Figshare search articles
components.description: Search Figshare for research outputs such as datasets, figures, code, papers, theses, and presentations by keyword. Returns article metadata including ID, title, DOI, resource type, publication date, and authors.

components.name: Finemap credible set
components.description: Computes single-causal-variant fine-mapping from user-provided per-SNP effect sizes and standard errors over a region, producing posterior inclusion probabilities and a 95% credible set using Wakefield approximate Bayes factors. LD-free and assumes one causal signal.

components.name: FinnGen get phenotype
components.description: Searches and browses FinnGen disease endpoint phenotypes by keyword or category and returns phenotype codes, case/control counts, and number of genome-wide significant loci.

components.name: FinnGen Get Region Associations
components.description: Retrieve genetic association results for a genomic region from the FinnGen study, using a phenotype code and region coordinates.

components.name: FinnGen variant fine-mapping lookup
components.description: Look up fine-mapping regions and associated phenotypes for a genomic variant in FinnGen. Accepts a chr:pos:ref:alt variant identifier and returns phenotypes where the variant appears in a credible set from statistical fine-mapping.

components.name: FinnGen list phenotypes
