components.description: Search and list FinnGen disease endpoints (phenotypes) by keyword or category, returning phenotype codes, case/control counts, and the number of genome-wide significant loci for each endpoint.

components.name: FlyBase gene lookup
components.description: Get detailed Drosophila melanogaster gene information from FlyBase via the Alliance of Genome Resources by FlyBase gene ID, returning gene symbol, name, synopsis, genomic location, synonyms, and cross-references.

components.name: FlyBase Get Gene Alleles
components.description: Retrieves alleles and variants for a Drosophila gene from FlyBase via the Alliance of Genome Resources. Accepts a FlyBase gene ID and returns allele symbols, categories, phenotypes, disease annotations, and variant details.

components.name: FlyBase Get Gene Disease Models
components.description: Retrieves genotype-based disease models involving a Drosophila gene from the Alliance of Genome Resources using a FlyBase gene ID, and returns associated human disease names and Disease Ontology IDs.

components.name: FlyBase get gene expression
components.description: Retrieves expression annotations for a Drosophila gene from the Alliance of Genome Resources, including developmental stage and anatomical location for each annotation and the total annotation count. Input is a FlyBase gene ID; output is a list of expression annotation records.

components.name: FlyBase Get Gene Interactions
components.description: Get molecular or genetic interactions for a Drosophila gene from the Alliance of Genome Resources using a FlyBase gene ID, returning interacting gene pairs with species and interaction type.

components.name: FlyBase gene orthologs
components.description: Retrieves orthologs of a Drosophila gene across species from the Alliance of Genome Resources, returning orthologous genes in human, mouse, zebrafish, worm, yeast and other model organisms with prediction method details and best-score indicators.

components.name: FlyMine search
components.description: Search FlyMine, an InterMine data warehouse for Drosophila melanogaster genomics data, across genes, proteins, publications, protein domains and gene ontology terms. Accepts a query string such as a gene symbol or protein name and returns matching records with category facets and relevance scores.

components.name: FlyMine gene search
components.description: Search FlyMine for Drosophila genes, returning gene symbols, FlyBase gene IDs, secondary identifiers, and organism information.

components.name: Foldseek get result
components.description: Retrieve results for a previously submitted Foldseek structure search job using its ticket ID, returning structural alignments when the job is complete or the current job status if it is still running.

components.name: Foldseek search structure
components.description: Search for structurally similar proteins using Foldseek by fetching a PDB structure from RCSB and querying AlphaFold DB or PDB100; returns structural alignments ranked by e-value.

components.name: FooDB get compound
components.description: Get a food constituent/chemical from FooDB by its FooDB compound ID. Returns chemical annotations including name, food occurrence, CAS number, molecular formula, structure identifiers, and cross-references to HMDB, KEGG, PubChem and ChEBI.

components.name: FoodData Central food lookup
components.description: Retrieve detailed food information by FDC ID from USDA FoodData Central, including nutrient profile, ingredients, serving size, and food attributes.

components.name: FoodData Central search foods
components.description: Search USDA FoodData Central for foods by keyword and return matching foods with nutrient data, brand info, and ingredients across Foundation, Branded, SR Legacy, and Survey data.

components.name: 4DN Get Download URL
components.description: Retrieve download URL and DRS API endpoint for a 4DN file using its file accession. Supports GA4GH DRS standard for programmatic file access and command-line download with curl.

components.name: 4DN Experiment Metadata
components.description: Retrieves metadata for 4DN experiments such as experimental design, biosource information, protocol details, and associated files using an experiment accession. Returns experiment type, cell type, processing status, and output file list.

components.name: FourDN file metadata lookup
components.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for specific 4DN files such as Hi-C contact matrices, TAD calls, A/B compartment annotations, and chromatin loop lists using a file accession, returning file type, format, size, associated experiment, and biosource information.

components.name: FourDN search data
components.description: Search the 4DN Data Portal for Hi-C chromatin conformation files and experiments. Accepts a query and optional item type, returning file metadata with download URLs.

components.name: FPbase Get Protein
components.description: Retrieve detailed fluorescent protein records from FPbase by slug, including protein sequence, spectral properties, PDB and UniProt IDs, aggregation state, and related publications.

components.name: FPbase Search by Spectrum
components.description: Search FPbase for fluorescent proteins by excitation wavelength, emission wavelength, or protein name and retrieve matching fluorescent protein records for imaging experiments.

components.name: G2P Download Panel
components.description: Download the full contents of a Gene2Phenotype (G2P) clinical panel as structured gene-disease records, including gene symbols, disease names, MIM and MONDO identifiers, allelic requirements, confidence, variant consequence, phenotypes, supporting publications, panels, and review dates.

components.name: G2P Get Gene
components.description: Get Gene2Phenotype information for a specific gene by symbol. Returns gene location, cross-references to HGNC/Ensembl/OMIM, gene synonyms, and genomic coordinates.

components.name: G2P get panel
components.description: Retrieves summary statistics for a specified Gene2Phenotype clinical panel, including panel name, description, last update date, total records, total genes, and confidence-level breakdown. Takes a panel name as input and returns panel metadata from the Gene2Phenotype curated resource.

components.name: G2P Get Record
components.description: Retrieves a detailed Gene2Phenotype record for a specified gene-disease association by stable ID, returning clinical genetics information such as locus, genotype/inheritance, variant consequences, molecular mechanism, disease details, confidence level, and publications.

components.name: Gene2Phenotype search
components.description: Search the Gene2Phenotype (G2P) database for expert-curated gene-disease associations using a gene symbol or disease name query. Returns gene-disease pairs with genotype, molecular mechanism, clinical panel assignment, and confidence level.

components.name: Gather disease profile
components.description: Gather a comprehensive disease profile from Orphanet, OMIM, DisGeNET, OpenTargets, and OLS in a single call. It takes a disease name and returns disease identifiers, associated genes with scores, inheritance pattern, prevalence, and ontology cross-references.

components.name: Gather drug profile
components.description: Gather a drug profile from ChEMBL, PubChem, OpenTargets and RxNorm using a drug name or ChEMBL identifier. Returns drug identity, structure, mechanism of action, approved indications and safety information, with documented cross-checks between structure and warning sources.

components.name: Gather Gene Disease Associations
components.description: Queries multiple gene-disease databases (DisGeNET, OMIM, OpenTargets, GenCC, ClinVar) in a single call and returns a cross-referenced comparison table with concordance scores indicating source agreement.

components.name: GDC clinical data retrieval
components.description: Retrieves detailed clinical data for cancer cases from NCI GDC/TCGA, including demographics, diagnoses, and treatments, with filtering by project, primary site, disease type, or vital status.

components.name: GDC get CNV data
components.description: Query copy number variation (CNV) files from GDC/TCGA projects by project identifier and optional gene symbol, returning CNV segment and gene-level copy number files for amplification/deletion analysis.

components.name: GDC get gene expression
components.description: Query RNA-Seq gene expression files from GDC/TCGA projects; returns file metadata for expression quantification data.

components.name: GDC mutation frequency
components.description: Retrieves pan-cancer mutation frequency statistics for a given gene symbol across all TCGA/GDC cancer projects, returning the total SSM occurrence count.

components.name: GDC mutation frequency by project
components.description: Get per-project somatic mutation frequency for a given gene from NCI GDC, returning mutated case counts and total case counts per TCGA/GDC project.

components.name: GDC get somatic mutations by gene
components.description: Retrieve somatic mutation records for a gene symbol across TCGA/GDC projects, returning mutation type, genomic coordinates, and amino acid changes. Useful for pan-cancer mutation analysis.

components.name: GDC get survival
components.description: Retrieves Kaplan-Meier survival data for a GDC/TCGA cancer cohort from GDC, returning time-to-event data with censoring status and survival estimates per patient, filterable by project and optionally by gene mutation status.

components.name: GDC List Files
components.description: Lists GDC files filtered by data_type and other fields, returning matching file records to identify downloadable artifacts such as expression quantification for analysis pipelines.

components.name: GDC list projects
components.description: Lists GDC projects such as TCGA and TARGET with case and file counts, optionally filtering by program name, to discover available cancer cohorts and data volume.

components.name: GDC search cases
components.description: Search cancer cohort cases in NCI GDC by project identifier. Retrieves case-level metadata for cohort construction and downstream file queries.

components.name: GenCC Get Classifications
components.description: Get summary statistics of gene-disease validity classifications from GenCC, returning counts per classification level with optional filters by gene symbol, disease name, or submitter organization.

components.name: GenCC search disease
components.description: Search GenCC by disease name or MONDO/OMIM identifier to find genes with curated validity evidence. Returns gene-disease validity classifications from multiple expert curators for clinical interpretation.

components.name: GenCC Search Gene
components.description: Get gene-disease validity classifications for a given HGNC gene symbol from GenCC, returning curated evidence levels from ClinGen, Ambry Genetics, Genomics England PanelApp, and Orphanet.

components.name: Genebass gene burden PheWAS
components.description: Queries Genebass (UK Biobank ~394K exomes, SAIGE-GENE+) to perform a gene-level burden PheWAS for a given gene, returning rare-variant burden associations across ~4,500 phenotypes. Accepts an Ensembl gene ID or gene symbol and a burden_set choice (pLoF, missense|LC, or synonymous).

components.name: GeneBe classify variant
components.description: Classifies germline variants under ACMG/AMP guidelines using the GeneBe API, taking chromosome, position, ref and alt alleles and genome build (hg38 or hg19) and returning ACMG verdict, score, triggered criteria, and annotations from ClinVar, dbSNP, gnomAD, and AlphaMissense.

components.name: GeneBe Classify Variants Batch
components.description: Batch-classify up to 1000 germline variants under ACMG/AMP guidelines using GeneBe. Accepts a JSON array of variants with chromosome, position, reference and alternate alleles on hg38/hg19 and returns the ACMG verdict, score, triggered criteria, per-gene HGVS, AlphaMissense, gnomAD allele frequency, and ClinVar classi…

components.name: GeneNetwork get dataset info
components.description: Retrieve metadata for a GeneNetwork expression profiling dataset by dataset name, including full name, data type, data scale, tissue, and public access status.

components.name: GeneNetwork get sample data
components.description: Retrieve expression or phenotype measurement values for a specific gene or trait across all samples in a GeneNetwork dataset. Returns measurement values with standard errors for each inbred strain or individual, useful for identifying strain differences and QTL analysis.

components.name: GeneNetwork get trait info
components.description: Get detailed information about a specific trait (probe/gene) in a GeneNetwork dataset, returning trait metadata including gene symbol, description, chromosome, megabase position, mean expression value, linkage statistics (LRS score, locus), additive effect, and p-value. Requires dataset name and trait name (probe ID).

components.name: GeneNetwork List Datasets
components.description: Lists all datasets available for a specific genetic cross population in GeneNetwork, returning dataset names, abbreviations, data types, and timestamps.

components.name: GeneNetwork list groups
components.description: List genetic cross populations (groups) available in GeneNetwork for a given species, returning group names, genetic types, and IDs used for QTL mapping and systems genetics.

components.name: GeneNetwork list species
components.description: List all species available in GeneNetwork, the open systems genetics database for behavioral, neural, and physiological phenotypes. Returns species names and taxonomy IDs for use with other GeneNetwork tools.

components.name: GenomeNexus annotate dbSNP
components.description: Annotates a dbSNP rsID variant using Genome Nexus, resolving it to genomic coordinates and returning aggregated annotation from VEP, SIFT, PolyPhen-2, AlphaMissense, and cancer hotspots, including transcript consequences, gene, genomic location, and HGVS protein notation.

components.name: GenomeNexus annotate mutation
components.description: Annotates a cancer mutation from genomic coordinates (chromosome, start, end, reference allele, variant allele) using the Genome Nexus service, returning comprehensive variant annotation including VEP consequences, SIFT, PolyPhen, AlphaMissense, cancer hotspots, and mutation assessor.

components.name: GenomeNexus annotate variant
components.description: Annotates a genomic variant in GRCh37/hg19 HGVS notation using Genome Nexus, which aggregates variant annotations from VEP, SIFT, PolyPhen-2, AlphaMissense, cancer hotspots, and mutation assessor. Returns the most severe consequence, transcript consequences with pathogenicity scores, cancer hotspot information, and an…

components.name: GenomeNexus Get Cancer Hotspots
components.description: Look up cancer mutation hotspot annotations from Genome Nexus for a specific GRCh37/hg19 HGVS genomic variant, returning the hotspot residue, tumor count, hotspot type, and gene symbol.

components.name: GenomeNexus get canonical transcript
components.description: Get the canonical transcript for a gene from Genome Nexus (MSK) using a HUGO gene symbol, returning the Ensembl transcript ID, protein ID, RefSeq mRNA ID, CCDS ID, and Pfam protein domain annotations.

components.name: Genomics England disease target score
components.description: Extracts disease-target association scores from Genomics England data using an EFO disease identifier, returning a 0-1 score with clinical genomics evidence.

components.name: GEO get dataset details
components.description: Retrieves full metadata for a specified GEO dataset accession, returning details such as title, summary, platform information, sample counts, and organisms.

components.name: Get GEO dataset info
components.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a GEO dataset by its ID (GDS or GSE), including title, summary and other dataset information from the GEO ESummary endpoint.

components.name: GEO sample information lookup
components.description: Get sample information for a GEO dataset, including sample characteristics and experimental conditions, using a GEO dataset ID.

components.name: GEO List Supplementary Files
components.description: Lists the actual downloadable supplementary/raw files of a GEO Series (GSE) or Sample (GSM), including per-file name, size, type, modification time, and direct download URL. For a Series it reads suppl/filelist.txt; for a Sample it parses the suppl/ directory listing.

components.name: GEO search ATAC-seq datasets

components.description: Get information about the velocyto package, which is used for RNA velocity analysis of single-cell RNA-seq data. The tool returns package metadata including name, description, and version.

components.name: Get ViennaRNA info
components.description: Retrieves comprehensive information about the ViennaRNA package for RNA structure prediction and analysis, optionally including usage examples and a quick start guide. Input is an optional include_examples flag and output is package documentation.

components.name: GIAB list directory
components.description: Lists directories and files in the NIST Genome in a Bottle benchmark release tree, returning file and directory records with direct download URLs for high-confidence variant and callable-region benchmark files.

components.name: GIN Guidelines Search
components.description: Search the Guidelines International Network (GIN) guidelines database by medical condition, treatment, or clinical topic, returning matching clinical guideline records.

components.name: GitHub get repository
components.description: Get detailed metadata for a specified GitHub public repository, including description, statistics, programming language, topics, license, README existence, and recent activity, using an owner/repo identifier.

components.name: GitHub search repositories
components.description: Search GitHub public repositories using GitHub's search API. Accepts a query string with optional qualifiers and returns repository metadata such as name, description, language, star count, fork count, topics, license, and creation/update dates.

components.name: GlyGen get glycan
components.description: Retrieves detailed glycan structure information from GlyGen by GlyTouCan accession, including mass, monosaccharide count, IUPAC/WURCS representations, species, glycoprotein associations, and publications.

components.name: GlyGen get glycoprotein
components.description: Retrieves detailed glycoprotein information from GlyGen by UniProt accession, including protein name, glycosylation sites, attached glycan structures, and associated diseases and pathways.

components.name: GlyGen get site
components.description: Get detailed information about a specific glycosylation site from GlyGen by site identifier, including amino acid position, flanking sequences, attached glycans, SNVs, phosphorylation, and mutagenesis data.

components.name: GlyGen search glycans
components.description: Search GlyGen for glycans by mass range, monosaccharide count, organism, or glycan type. Returns matching glycan accessions with mass, protein counts, and relevance scores.

components.name: GlyGen search glycoproteins
components.description: Search GlyGen for glycoproteins by organism taxonomy ID, glycosylation evidence type, protein name, or gene name. Returns matching proteins with glycosylation site counts and relevance scores.

components.name: GMrepo get phenotypes
components.description: List phenotypes and health conditions with gut microbiome data in the GMrepo database. Accepts an optional keyword query to filter phenotypes and returns MeSH disease IDs, sample counts, and species/genus diversity for matching phenotypes.

components.name: GMrepo search species
components.description: Search the GMrepo database for gut microbiome species by name and retrieve matching species records with NCBI taxon IDs, sample counts, prevalence across conditions, and associated phenotypes.

components.name: GnomAD constraint lookup
components.description: Retrieves gene-level constraint metrics from the Genome Aggregation Database (gnomAD) for a single gene specified by HGNC symbol or Ensembl gene ID. Returns pLI, LOEUF, Z-scores, and observed/expected LoF counts from the selected gnomAD release.

components.name: gnomad Get Gene
components.description: Retrieve gene constraint metrics from gnomAD for a gene symbol (GRCh38). Returns constraint fields under exac_constraint and gnomad_constraint, or mitochondrial_constraint for mitochondrial genes, including pLI, observed/expected counts, and oe ratios. Does not include LOEUF or missense/synonymous Z-scores.

components.name: GnomAD gene constraint lookup
components.description: Retrieves gene constraint metrics from the gnomAD database for a given gene symbol, returning fields such as pLI, observed/expected counts, and mitochondrial-specific constraint values. Supports GRCh37 and GRCh38 reference genomes.

components.name: Gnomad Get Region
components.description: Retrieve variant records from a specified genomic region using the gnomAD database, with configurable dataset selection and response metadata including dataset and reference genome.

components.name: Get structural variants by gene
components.description: Get structural variants (SVs) from gnomAD for a gene, returning deletions, duplications, inversions, translocations, and complex SVs with population allele frequencies, SV type, consequence, and homozygote counts.

components.name: gnomAD structural variant lookup by region
components.description: Get structural variants from gnomAD overlapping a genomic region, with support for GRCh38 and GRCh37 assemblies using the corresponding gnomAD SV callset. Returns DEL/DUP/INV/BND/CPX variants with allele frequencies and consequences for CNV interpretation in chromosomal regions.

components.name: gnomAD structural variant detail lookup
components.description: Get detailed information for a specific gnomAD structural variant by its ID, resolving against gnomAD v4 (GRCh38) or v2.1 (GRCh37) SV callsets by ID format. Returns SV coordinates, type, length, population allele frequency, consequence, and filter status.

components.name: GnomAD transcript lookup
components.description: Look up transcript records in gnomAD by transcript identifier, returning transcript metadata from the gnomAD data set.

components.name: gnomAD variant lookup
components.description: Retrieves variant information from the gnomAD database using a variant ID, returning matching variant records. Responses include the dataset and reference genome used, with gnomAD r3 (GRCh38) as the default.

components.name: gNOMAD variant population lookup
components.description: Retrieves population frequency data for genetic variants from gnomAD. Accepts a variant search query and dataset selector, returning allele frequencies across populations and echoed dataset/reference genome metadata.

components.name: gnomAD gene search
components.description: Search for genes in gnomAD by free-text query, typically a gene symbol, and retrieve matching Ensembl gene IDs and symbols with assembly context.

components.name: gnomAD variant search
components.description: Search gnomAD for variants using a free-text query such as an rsID, and return matching variant_id strings. The gnomAD variant_search endpoint only exposes variant_id; default dataset is gnomad_r3 (GRCh38, genomes only).

components.name: GNPS Compare Spectra
components.description: Compare two MS/MS spectra from the GNPS spectral library using Universal Spectrum Identifiers (USIs). Returns precursor m/z, peak counts for both spectra, and a link to an interactive mirror plot visualization, supporting assessment of spectral similarity between compounds in metabolomics workflows.

components.name: GNPS library record lookup
components.description: Retrieve a full GNPS library reference spectrum record by SpectrumID or CCMSLIB accession, returning compound annotation such as compound name, adduct, SMILES, InChI/InChIKey, instrument and contributing PI.

components.name: GNPS get spectrum
components.description: Retrieve a mass spectrometry (MS/MS) reference spectrum from the GNPS spectral library using a Universal Spectrum Identifier (USI), returning precursor m/z, charge, number of peaks, m/z range, and the top 20 peaks by intensity.

components.name: GNPS NP Classifier from SMILES
components.description: Classifies an arbitrary chemical structure from its SMILES string into predicted biosynthetic pathway, superclass, class, and an is_glycoside flag using the NP Classifier; works on any SMILES without library lookup.

components.name: GO Get Annotations for Gene
components.description: Finds Gene Ontology annotations for a specified gene or protein using GOlr search and returns one row per annotation as a paged result set. The tool accepts a gene/protein identifier and produces GO annotation records.

components.name: GO get genes for term
components.description: Finds genes/proteins annotated to a Gene Ontology term, including annotations to descendant terms via is_a/part_of closure, using the GO Solr index. Accepts a GO term ID and optional taxon filter and returns distinct gene records with evidence codes and annotation counts.

components.name: GO Get Term by ID
components.description: Retrieves basic Gene Ontology term information by GO term ID using GOlr search against the Gene Ontology database.

components.name: GO get term details
components.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific Gene Ontology term ID using the Gene Ontology API, including definition, synonyms, and annotations.

components.name: GO Search Terms
components.description: Searches Gene Ontology (GO) terms by keyword using the GOlr search engine, returning matching GO terms and related biological entities.

components.name: GOAPI Get Gene Functions
components.description: Retrieve Gene Ontology (GO) annotations for a specific gene using a CURIE identifier, returning GO terms with evidence types and literature references.

components.name: Get genes by function
components.description: Get genes annotated with a specific Gene Ontology (GO) term, optionally filtered by taxon. Accepts a GO term ID and returns matching gene/protein records with functional annotations.

components.name: GOAPI get term
components.description: Retrieves detailed information about a Gene Ontology term by its GO ID, including label, definition, synonyms, cross-references, and alternative IDs across biological process, molecular function, and cellular component domains.

components.name: GoaT get species
components.description: Look up genome sequencing status for a species using GoaT (Genomes on a Tree), which indexes Earth BioGenome Project, Darwin Tree of Life, Vertebrate Genomes Project, and ERGA data against NCBI taxonomy. Accepts a scientific name or NCBI taxon ID and returns assembly level, genome size, chromosome number, and ploidy.

components.name: GPCRdb get ligands
components.description: Retrieves ligands associated with a GPCR from GPCRdb, returning ligand names, types (agonist/antagonist), and binding data.

components.name: GPCRdb get mutations
components.description: Retrieve GPCR mutation data from GPCRdb, including mutation positions and effects on ligand binding and signaling, using a protein identifier.

components.name: GPCRdb get protein
components.description: Retrieves detailed GPCR protein information from GPCRdb, including receptor family, species, sequence, and classification, using a protein entry name or UniProt accession.

components.name: GPCRdb Get Structures
components.description: Retrieve GPCR crystal and cryo-EM structures from GPCRdb, returning PDB codes, resolution, receptor state, and bound ligands, optionally filtered by protein entry name or receptor state.

components.name: GPCRdb list proteins
components.description: Lists GPCR protein families or proteins within a specified family from GPCRdb using optional family or protein_class selectors. Returns matching protein or family records.

components.name: gProfiler annotate SNPs
components.description: Maps SNP rsIDs to genes and annotates their functional consequences using g:Profiler (g:SNPense). Given a list of SNP rsIDs, it returns chromosome, position, strand, associated Ensembl gene IDs, gene names, and predicted variant consequences with counts.

components.name: gProfiler Convert IDs
components.description: Convert gene identifiers between namespaces using g:Profiler (g:Convert). Accepts a list of gene identifiers and a target namespace, and returns converted identifiers for over 500 organisms including Ensembl, Entrez, UniProt, and RefSeq namespaces.

components.name: gProfiler enrichment
components.description: Performs functional enrichment analysis on a comma-separated gene list using g:Profiler (g:GOSt), identifying statistically overrepresented biological functions, pathways, and phenotypes across Gene Ontology, KEGG, Reactome, WikiPathways, Human Phenotype Ontology, miRNA targets, CORUM, and transcription factor targets…

components.name: Find orthologs
components.description: Find orthologous genes across species using g:Profiler (g:Orth), mapping a list of source organism gene identifiers to orthologs in a target organism using Ensembl orthology data.

components.name: GSA Get Accession
components.description: Look up a Genome Sequence Archive (GSA) accession by its CRA-format ID and return sequencing dataset metadata including title, linked BioProject accession, associated publication, file counts and sizes, and download URLs.

components.name: GSEA Prerank
components.description: Performs pre-ranked Gene Set Enrichment Analysis on a ranked gene list against user-supplied gene sets, returning enrichment scores, normalized enrichment scores, permutation p-values, and leading-edge genes.

components.name: GSVA Score
components.description: Performs Gene Set Variation Analysis (GSVA) on a genes-by-samples expression matrix using kernel cumulative distribution functions and a symmetric Kolmogorov-Smirnov walk, producing a gene-set-by-sample pathway-activity score matrix. Accepts log-scale expression data and gene sets such as those from MSigDB or Enrichr,…

components.name: GTDB get genome
components.description: Retrieve comprehensive genome metadata for a specific NCBI accession from GTDB, including nucleotide statistics, gene-level quality metrics, NCBI sample metadata, and taxonomic history across GTDB releases.

components.name: GTDB Get Species
components.description: Get detailed information about a GTDB species cluster, including all genomes assigned to that species. Returns the full list of genomes with accessions, NCBI organism names, NCBI taxonomy, and whether they are the GTDB species representative or NCBI type material.

components.name: GTDB Get Taxon Info
components.description: Retrieves taxonomic information for a GTDB taxon using its rank-prefixed identifier, returning rank, total genome count, higher-rank lineage, full lineage breakdown, and release history.

components.name: GTDB search genomes
components.description: Search for prokaryotic genomes in GTDB by organism name. Accepts an organism name query, performs exact multi-word matching with a loose fallback, and returns matching genome records.

components.name: GTDB search taxon
components.description: Search the Genome Taxonomy Database (GTDB) for prokaryotic taxa by partial name and return matching taxon names with GTDB rank prefixes.

components.name: GTEx Calculate eQTL
components.description: Calculates custom eQTL association statistics for user-specified gene-variant pairs in a given tissue, returning p-value, normalized effect size, t-statistic, and genotype data. Requires gene ID (GENCODE), variant ID, and tissue site detail ID.

components.name: GTEx dataset info
components.description: Get GTEx dataset metadata and version information, including GENCODE version, genome build (GRCh38/hg38), dbSNP build, sample counts, tissue counts, and release information. Lists the actual queryable datasets (gtex_v7, gtex_v8, gtex_v10, kids_first_harmonization) and shows GTEx V8 (2020) details by default.

components.name: GTEx eQTL genes lookup
components.description: Retrieve eQTL genes (eGenes) with significant cis-eQTLs from GTEx, optionally filtered by tissue, including allelic fold change, p-values, q-values (FDR < 0.05), and effect sizes. Useful for identifying genetic regulation of gene expression.

components.name: GTEx expression summary
components.description: Summarize tissue-specific gene expression (e.g., median TPM) for a gene across GTEx tissues, accepting gene symbols or Ensembl IDs and returning JSON from the GTEx Portal API.

components.name: GTEx Finemapping and Independent eQTL
components.description: Get GTEx statistical fine-mapping credible sets and conditionally-independent eQTLs for a gene and tissue, returning per-variant posterior inclusion probabilities and independent signals based on GTEx v8.

components.name: GTEx Get Gene Expression
components.description: Get sample-level gene expression data from GTEx, returning normalized TPM values for each sample, with optional subsetting by donor sex and age bracket.

components.name: GTEx median gene expression lookup
components.description: Retrieves median gene expression levels in TPM (Transcripts Per Million) from GTEx across 54 tissues for one or more genes, with optional tissue filtering and dataset version selection (GTEx V7, V8, V10).

components.name: GTEx median transcript expression
components.description: Retrieves GTEx transcript/isoform-level median expression values (TPM) for a given gene and tissue, based on GTEx v8, enabling isoform-usage and transcript-switching analysis.

components.name: GTEx multi-tissue eQTL lookup
components.description: Retrieves multi-tissue eQTL meta-analysis results from GTEx using Metasoft for a given gene-variant pair, returning m-values, effect sizes, p-values, and standard errors across tissues.

components.name: GTEx sample info lookup
components.description: Retrieves detailed GTEx sample and subject metadata, including sample IDs, tissue types, donor demographics, ischemic time, RIN scores, Hardy scale, pathology notes, and QC metrics. Supports filtering by sample ID, subject ID, tissue, demographics, or data type for sample selection, cohort design, and quality control.

components.name: GTEx single-nucleus expression
components.description: Retrieves single-nucleus RNA-seq gene expression resolved by cell type from the GTEx snRNA-seq pilot dataset. Takes a gene (GENCODE ID) and tissue, returning per-cell-type mean/median expression, cell counts, and zero counts, or a tissue-by-cell-type cell-count summary.

components.name: GTEx get single tissue eQTLs
components.description: Retrieve significant single-tissue eQTL associations from GTEx, including p-values, effect sizes (NES), and genomic positions. Users query by gene ID, variant ID, or tissue to identify genetic variants affecting gene expression in specific tissues.

components.name: GTEx single-tissue sQTL lookup
components.description: Retrieve GTEx single-tissue splicing QTLs (sQTLs) and sGenes from GTEx v8. The tool accepts a gene/tissue query and returns significant sQTL associations (variant, p-value, NES, phenotype ID) or genes with at least one significant sQTL when result_type='sgene'.

components.name: GTEx Get Tissue Sites
components.description: Retrieve available tissue site information from the GTEx project, optionally filtered by dataset version or specific tissue IDs, using pagination.

components.name: GTEx Get Top Expressed Genes
components.description: Retrieves top expressed genes in a specified tissue sorted by median expression from GTEx, returning a gene list with TPM expression levels. Optionally filters mitochondrial genes.

components.name: GTEx query eQTL
components.description: Query GTEx single-tissue eQTL associations for a gene by gene symbol or Ensembl ID, returning regulatory variants with variant ID, p-value, and effect slope.

components.name: GtoPdb disease association lookup
components.description: Retrieves curated disease-to-target and disease-to-ligand associations from the Guide to Pharmacology (GtoPdb/IUPHAR-BPS) for a given disease ID, returning target annotations (roles, references, ligand-target interactions) and ligand annotations (approval status, clinical-use notes).

components.name: GtoPdb get interactions
components.description: Get pharmacological interactions between targets and ligands from the Guide to Pharmacology database. Inputs include gene symbol, target ID, or ligand ID, and outputs include binding affinity, action type, species, and assay information.

components.name: Get ligand properties from GtoPdb
components.description: Get the chemical structure and computed molecular properties of a ligand from the Guide to Pharmacology (GtoPdb/IUPHAR-BPS) by ligand ID, including canonical SMILES, InChI, InChIKey, IUPAC name, molecular weight, logP, hydrogen-bond donors/acceptors, rotatable bonds, topological polar surface area, and Lipinski rule-o…

components.name: GtoPdb disease search
components.description: Search the Guide to Pharmacology (GtoPdb/IUPHAR-BPS) for diseases by name and retrieve curated disease IDs, names, synonyms, and cross-references to OMIM, Orphanet, and Disease Ontology. Results link diseases to relevant drug targets and ligands.

components.name: GtoPdb search ligands
components.description: Search the Guide to Pharmacology database by ligand name or INN and retrieve curated ligand records including type, approval status, and WHO essential medicine status.

components.name: GtoPdb search targets
components.description: Search the Guide to Pharmacology database for drug targets such as GPCRs, ion channels, nuclear receptors, enzymes, transporters, and catalytic receptors by name or gene symbol. Returns target records with IDs, names, abbreviations, types, and family classifications.

components.name: GWAS Get Association By ID
components.description: Get a specific GWAS association by its unique identifier. Accepts an association identifier and returns the matching GWAS association object.

components.name: GWAS Get Associations for SNP
components.description: Get all GWAS associations for a specific SNP identified by a dbSNP rs identifier, with optional sorting and pagination.

components.name: GWAS get associations for study
components.description: Retrieve all associations for a specified GWAS study accession identifier, sorted by p-value, with pagination controls for page and page size.

components.name: GWAS associations for trait
components.description: Retrieves genetic associations for a specified trait from the GWAS Catalog, sorted by p-value. The submitted trait text is resolved to an EFO or MONDO term and resolution details are disclosed in the response.

components.name: GWAS SNP Lookup by ID
components.description: Retrieve a specific GWAS SNP record by its dbSNP rs identifier. The tool returns a single SNP object with associated metadata.

components.name: GWAS SNPs for gene
components.description: Get all GWAS Catalog SNPs mapped to a specific gene by gene name, returning variant details such as rs IDs, chromosomal positions, and functional annotations.

components.name: GWAS studies for trait
components.description: Retrieves studies for a specified trait using a disease/trait name or EFO/OBA identifier. Optional filters include cohort, GxE interactions, and summary statistics.

components.name: Get GWAS Study by ID
components.description: Get a specific GWAS study by its unique GCST identifier (study_id or accession_id), returning the study record with associated metadata and API links for chaining to other GWAS tools.

components.name: GWAS variant lookup by trait
components.description: Search the GWAS Catalog for all genetic variants (SNPs) associated with a specified disease or trait, accepting free-text trait names, EFO ontology IDs, or EFO trait labels, and returning rsIDs, p-values, mapped genes, and genomic locations.

components.name: GWAS Search Associations
components.description: Searches the GWAS Catalog for genome-wide association study results by keyword or identifier, including disease/trait names, SNP rs IDs, EFO ontology IDs, and study accession IDs. Returns associated variants, p-values, odds ratios, mapped genes, and study metadata.

components.name: GWAS search associations by gene
components.description: Search GWAS Catalog associations by gene name, returning the strongest risk allele and p-value fields. Accepts a gene symbol and an optional maximum number of results.

components.name: GWAS SNP search
components.description: Search the GWAS Catalog for single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) by rs ID or mapped gene name and return SNP details including chromosomal location, mapped genes, and functional class.

components.name: GWAS study search
components.description: Searches GWAS study records by criteria such as disease trait, EFO term, cohort, GxE interactions, and summary statistics availability, returning matching study records.

components.name: GWASSumStats get region associations
components.description: Retrieve GWAS association results for a specified genomic region from EBI GWAS Catalog full summary statistics, filtering by study accession.

components.name: GWASSumStats get trait studies
components.description: Get GWAS studies with deposited summary statistics for a specific EFO trait, returning study accession IDs for studies that have full variant-level summary statistics.

components.name: GWASSumStats list studies
components.description: List GWAS studies that have deposited full summary statistics with the EBI GWAS Catalog. Returns study accession IDs that can be used as filters in GWASSumStats_get_region_associations.

components.name: Get experiment expression
components.description: Retrieves gene expression data for a specific Expression Atlas experiment, returning expression levels across tissues or conditions. The upstream endpoint returns a small default sample of genes and reports profiles_returned_by_upstream versus profiles_available_upstream.

components.name: GxA get experiment info
components.description: Retrieve metadata about a Gene Expression Atlas experiment, including species, number of genes and conditions, and experimental design, using an experiment accession.

components.name: GxA list experiments
components.description: Lists gene expression experiments from the EBI Gene Expression Atlas, with optional filters for species and experiment type (baseline or differential). Returns matching expression experiment records.

components.name: HAL search archive
components.description: Search the French HAL open archive via its public API using a text query (with Lucene syntax support) and retrieve document records containing title, authors, year, DOI, URL, abstract, and source.

components.name: Harmonizome Get Dataset
components.description: Retrieves detailed metadata and the gene-set catalog for a named dataset integrated in Harmonizome (Ma'ayan Lab), including description, association type, measurement method, attribute type, and PubMed references.

components.name: Harmonizome gene lookup
components.description: Get comprehensive gene information from Harmonizome, which integrates data from 100+ genomics datasets. Takes a gene symbol and returns gene symbol, name, NCBI Entrez ID, description, synonyms, and linked protein identifiers, with curated descriptions from RefSeq.

components.name: Harmonizome get gene set members
components.description: Retrieve Harmonizome association payloads. In gene_set mode, it returns member genes of a curated attribute set for a given attribute and dataset; in gene mode, it returns per-gene association data for a given gene symbol.

components.name: Harmonizome list datasets
components.description: List all 100+ integrated genomics datasets available in Harmonizome (Ma'ayan Lab). Returns dataset names that can be used to explore gene-gene set associations, covering gene expression, pathways, protein interactions, gene regulation, drug targets, disease associations, phenotypes, and more.

components.name: Harmonizome Search
components.description: Search Harmonizome across genes, datasets, or attributes by keyword. Accepts a query and entity_type selector, returning matching gene symbols with names and NCBI IDs, dataset catalog entries, or attribute auto-complete suggestions depending on the selected entity type.

components.name: Harmonizome Search Genes
components.description: Searches the Harmonizome gene catalog by keyword and returns matching gene symbols. Inputs include a search query and optional limit; output is a paginated list of gene symbols for downstream Harmonizome gene queries.

components.name: HCA Get File Manifest
components.description: Retrieves a list of downloadable files for a specific Human Cell Atlas (HCA) project identified by its Project ID.

components.name: Search HCA Projects
components.description: Searches for single-cell projects in the Human Cell Atlas Data Coordination Platform, optionally filtering by organ and disease state.

components.name: HCPCS search
components.description: Search US HCPCS Level II procedure and durable medical equipment billing codes using the NLM Clinical Table Search Service. Given a partial or full description, returns matching HCPCS codes with their official short descriptions.

components.name: Get County Health Rankings information
components.description: Get information about County Health Rankings data, including available datasets and access methods, with optional year and state filters.

components.name: Get SVI information
components.description: Get information about CDC Social Vulnerability Index (SVI) datasets, including available years, geographic levels, and download links from the CDC ATSDR website.

components.name: Health conditions search
components.description: Autocomplete health condition names using the NLM Clinical Table Search Service conditions table. Given a partial or full condition name, returns matching clinical conditions with primary name, consumer-friendly name, and ICD-10-CM and ICD-9-CM codes.

components.name: Hemolytik2 search peptides
components.description: Search the Hemolytik 2.0 database for experimentally validated hemolytic or toxic peptide records using a selected filter (nature, source, or sequence), returning peptide sequence, hemolytic activity, source organism, and other details.

components.name: HFInference classify image
components.description: Run image classification on any HuggingFace-hosted vision model via the serverless HF Inference provider, returning top predicted labels with confidence scores sorted high to low. Accepts an image as a public URL or a local file path and posts raw image bytes with the correct content type.

components.name: HFInference classify text
components.description: Runs text classification on any Hugging Face-hosted model via the serverless hf-inference provider, accepting a model ID and input text and returning a top label and a list of labels with confidence scores, sorted high to low.

components.name: Object detection via Hugging Face inference
components.description: Runs object detection on any HuggingFace-hosted vision model using the serverless hf-inference provider. Accepts an image as a public URL or local file and returns detected objects with label, confidence score, and bounding box, sorted by score.

components.name: HFInference embed text
components.description: Generates dense text embeddings via the serverless HuggingFace inference provider, forcing the feature-extraction pipeline and mean-pooling token-level outputs to a single vector. Accepts text and a HuggingFace model ID, supporting biomedical models such as PubMedBERT and SapBERT.

components.name: HFInference fill mask
components.description: Predict the most likely token(s) for a masked position in an input sequence using Hugging Face fill-mask models, including protein language models and biomedical text models. Requires a mask token and model identifier, and returns ranked token predictions.

components.name: HF Inference NER
components.description: Extracts named entities such as people, locations, organizations, and biomedical concepts from text using a specified Hugging Face token-classification/NER model, returning spans with entity type, confidence score, and character offsets.

components.name: HF Inference question answering
components.description: Extractive question answering over a supplied context passage using a selected HuggingFace question-answering model via serverless hf-inference. Given a question and a context, it returns the best answer span with its confidence score and character offsets.

components.name: HGNC fetch gene by ID
components.description: Fetches a full gene record from the HGNC database by HGNC ID, returning official symbol, name, location, and cross-references to other databases.

components.name: HGNC fetch gene by symbol
components.description: Fetch detailed gene information from HGNC by official gene symbol, returning HGNC ID, full name, chromosomal location, and cross-references to Ensembl, NCBI Entrez, UniProt, OMIM, and RefSeq. Retired symbols are resolved automatically and disclosed in metadata.

components.name: HGNC Fetch Gene Family Members
components.description: Enumerates all member genes of an HGNC gene family or group by numeric gene_group_id and returns the full HGNC record for each member, including approved symbol, full name, chromosomal location, locus type, and cross-references to Ensembl, Entrez, UniProt, OMIM, and RefSeq.

components.name: HGNC search by location
components.description: Search HGNC for genes at a specific cytogenetic band location. Accepts a chromosomal location string and returns all genes mapped to that region.

components.name: HGNC search genes
components.description: Search official HGNC gene records by HGNC gene symbol, including resolution of retired symbols, and return gene identifiers such as HGNC ID.

components.name: HLA Ligand Atlas benign peptide retrieval
components.description: Retrieves benign-tissue HLA-presented peptides (immunopeptidome) from the HLA Ligand Atlas (release 2020.12), supporting filtering by peptide sequence, HLA class, donor allele, and tissue of origin. Each returned record includes the peptide, HLA class, donor-allele presentation flags, and detected tissues.

components.name: HLALigandAtlas Get Donors
components.description: Retrieve the donor-to-HLA-allele mapping table from the HLA Ligand Atlas (release 2020.12). The tool accepts an optional donor identifier substring and returns rows pairing donor identifiers with their typed HLA alleles.

components.name: HOCOMOCO get motif
components.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific transcription factor binding motif from HOCOMOCO using a motif identifier. Returns gene names, UniProt IDs, TF classification, quality metrics, consensus sequence, and optionally the position weight matrix (PWM).

components.name: HOCOMOCO Search Motifs
components.description: Search HOCOMOCO v14 for transcription factor binding motifs by gene or protein name, returning motif IDs, quality scores, consensus sequences, and TF classification derived from ChIP-Seq data for human and mouse.

components.name: HPA Generic Search
components.description: Search the Human Protein Atlas with custom queries and retrieve selected columns of protein and gene records as JSON.

components.name: HPA biological processes by gene
components.description: Get biological process information for a gene from the Human Protein Atlas, with focus on key processes such as apoptosis and cell cycle. Accepts a gene name or symbol and returns biological process data.

components.name: HPA Get Cancer Prognostics by Gene
components.description: Retrieve prognostic value of a gene across various cancer types from the Human Protein Atlas, indicating whether its expression level correlates with patient survival outcomes. Returns prognostic summary, non-prognostic summary, and number of cancers assessed.

components.name: Comparative expression by gene and cell line
components.description: Compares gene expression levels between a specified cell line and healthy tissues using gene name and cell line name from the Human Protein Atlas API.

components.name: Human Protein Atlas comprehensive gene details lookup
components.description: Retrieves comprehensive gene page details from the Human Protein Atlas using an Ensembl Gene ID, including protein expression data, antibody information, and image URLs for tissue immunohistochemistry and subcellular immunofluorescence.

components.name: HPA contextual biological process analysis
components.description: Analyzes a gene's biological processes in a specified tissue or cell line by integrating functional annotation with expression data to determine functional relevance.

components.name: HPA disease expression by gene tissue disease
components.description: Compare expression level of a gene between disease and healthy states for a given tissue using gene name, tissue type, and disease name from the Human Protein Atlas.

components.name: HPA Gene Basic Info by Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieves gene basic information and expression data from the Human Protein Atlas using an Ensembl Gene ID via the proteinatlas.org JSON API.

components.name: HPA gene TSV data by Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieve detailed gene data in TSV format from the Human Protein Atlas using an Ensembl Gene ID. The tool accepts an Ensembl Gene ID and returns gene-associated data such as biological process annotations and RNA tissue-specific nTPM values.

components.name: HPA get protein interactions by gene
components.description: Retrieves protein-protein interaction partners for a given official gene symbol from the Human Protein Atlas. This tool is deprecated and non-functional because the HPA search API no longer exposes PPI data; use STRING or EBI Proteins for PPI partners.

components.name: HPA get RNA expression by source
components.description: Retrieves RNA expression data for a gene in a specified source context from the Human Protein Atlas. Returns expression levels and contextual conclusions computed from HPA nTPM values.

components.name: RNA expression in specific tissues
components.description: Query RNA expression levels (nTPM) for a specific gene in one or more user-specified tissues from the Human Protein Atlas, mapping common tissue names to HPA column names.

components.name: HPA get subcellular location
components.description: Get annotated subcellular locations for a protein from the Human Protein Atlas using a gene name, returning both main and additional locations.

components.name: Human Protein Atlas gene search
components.description: Search the Human Protein Atlas for matching genes by gene name, keywords, or cell line names and return a list of Ensembl IDs via the HPA API.

components.name: HPO get disease annotations
components.description: Retrieve the full curated HPO annotation profile for a disease using a disease ID (OMIM, ORPHA, or DECIPHER) from the JAX HPO network annotations. The profile includes MAxO medical actions, phenotype categories grouped by body system, and causative genes.

components.name: HPO Get Diseases by Phenotype
components.description: Get diseases that present with an HPO phenotype term from the JAX HPO network annotations, returning disease IDs (ORPHA/OMIM/DECIPHER), names, and cross-referenced MONDO IDs.

components.name: HPO get genes by phenotype
components.description: Get the genes associated with an HPO phenotype term from JAX HPO network annotations. Takes an HPO term and returns NCBI gene IDs and symbols for candidate disease genes, useful for phenotype-driven variant prioritization.

components.name: HPO Get Term
components.description: Get detailed information about a Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) term by its HP-prefixed identifier, including name, definition, synonyms, cross-references to UMLS and SNOMED, descendant count, and translations.

components.name: HPO Get Term Hierarchy
components.description: Get parent or child terms of a Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) term from the ontology hierarchy. Accepts an HPO term ID and direction, and returns broader or more specific phenotype terms in the directed acyclic graph.

components.name: HPO search terms
components.description: Searches the Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) by keyword to return matching phenotype terms with definitions, synonym counts, and descendant counts; useful for finding HPO identifiers for clinical phenotypes.

components.name: HuBMAP Get Dataset
components.description: Get detailed metadata for a specific HuBMAP dataset by its HuBMAP ID, including title, description, data type, organ, group, contacts, contributors, DOI, and data access level.

components.name: HuBMAP get dataset provenance
components.description: Retrieve a HuBMAP dataset's biological provenance lineage, returning the ordered chain of ancestor entities from Dataset through Sample sections to Donor, including entity type, HuBMAP ID, UUID, sample category, organ, and dataset type.

components.name: HuBMAP Get Sample
components.description: Retrieves HuBMAP sample metadata, optionally filtered by organ code, sample category, or whether the sample is spatially registered. Returns sample records indicating spatial registration status and donor link.

components.name: HuBMAP list organs
components.description: Lists available organ codes in the HuBMAP dataset, optionally filtering by organ, dataset type, free-text query, or status.

components.name: HuBMAP search datasets
components.description: Search HuBMAP (Human BioMolecular Atlas Program) published datasets by organ, assay type, or free text; returns matching dataset records from the HuBMAP data portal.

components.name: HuBMAP search donors
components.description: Search HuBMAP (Human BioMolecular Atlas Program) human donor records by owning group or free-text query and retrieve donor demographics such as age, sex, race, body mass index, and cause of death for cohort building.

components.name: HuBMAP search samples
components.description: Search HuBMAP biospecimen samples by organ and sample category, with optional restriction to spatially registered specimens, and return sample records including spatial registration status and donor links.

components.name: HuggingFace dataset search
components.description: Search the HuggingFace Hub for machine learning datasets by keyword query. Returns dataset metadata including IDs, authors, download counts, likes, tags, and descriptions.

components.name: HuggingFace search models
components.description: Searches the HuggingFace Hub for machine learning models by keyword, task type, or ML framework, returning model IDs, download counts, likes, tags, pipeline task, and library information.

components.name: HumanBase PPI Analysis
components.description: Retrieve tissue-specific protein-protein interactions and associated biological processes from HumanBase for a given gene list and tissue. Returns a NetworkX graph of protein-protein interactions and a list of Gene Ontology biological processes.

components.name: HumanMine Search
components.description: Search HumanMine, an InterMine-based data warehouse integrating 30+ biological data sources, for genes, proteins, pathways, diseases and other entities by keyword or biological term; returns matching entity records with IDs, types, names, symbols and organism information, with optional facet_Category filtering.

components.name: HumanMine gene search
components.description: Searches HumanMine for genes by symbol, name, or ID across human, mouse, and rat, integrating gene data from NCBI Gene, Ensembl, UniProt, and other sources. Returns gene symbols, Entrez IDs, Ensembl IDs, gene names, and organism information.

components.name: HumanMine search pathways
components.description: Search HumanMine specifically for biological pathways by name or Reactome ID, returning pathway names, identifiers, and associated organisms from integrated Reactome, KEGG, and other pathway data sources.

components.name: ICD code search
components.description: Search for ICD-10 or ICD-11 codes using UMLS. Accepts a query such as disease name, condition, or ICD code and returns matching codes with descriptions.

components.name: ICD-10 code lookup
components.description: Retrieves detailed ICD-10-CM code information, including full description, chapter, and category, for a supplied ICD-10-CM code from the 2026 ICD-10-CM release via NLM Clinical Tables.

components.name: ICD10 Search Codes
components.description: Search ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes by disease name or partial code using the NLM Clinical Tables API. Returns matching codes with full descriptions.

components.name: ICD11 browse hierarchy
components.description: Navigates the ICD-11 disease classification hierarchy by retrieving child entities under a specified parent category, returning the child disease categories and their relationships.

components.name: ICD11 Entity Lookup
components.description: Retrieves detailed information about an ICD-11 disease entity by its unique identifier or code, returning fields such as title, definition, inclusions, exclusions, parent/child relationships, diagnostic criteria, and clinical descriptions from the WHO ICD-11 API.

components.name: ICD11 Search Diseases
components.description: Search the WHO ICD-11 classification for diseases by name, symptom, or clinical term and return matching disease entities with codes, titles, and descriptions.

components.name: iCite Get Publications
components.description: Get citation metrics and research context for PubMed publications using NIH's iCite API, including citation counts, relative citation ratios (RCR), approximate potential to translate (APT) scores, NIH percentile rankings, research category flags, and the full list of citing PMIDs.

components.name: iCite Search Publications
components.description: Search PubMed publications by query and retrieve citation metrics from NIH's iCite API, including citation counts, NIH percentile rankings, approximate potential to translate (APT) scores, and research category flags.

components.name: IdentifiersOrg get namespace
components.description: Retrieve detailed metadata for a single Identifiers.org namespace by its database prefix, including the namespace name, identifier pattern regex, description, sample ID, and provider resources.

components.name: Identifiers.org list namespaces
components.description: List all registered biological database namespaces in the Identifiers.org registry with pagination. Returns database prefixes, names, ID patterns, and descriptions, enabling browsing of 800+ registered databases.

components.name: IdentifiersOrg resolve
components.description: Resolve a biological identifier to its resource URLs using the Identifiers.org service by supplying a namespace (e.g., 'uniprot') and local ID (e.g., 'P04637'). Returns all resolved URLs across different providers such as NCBI, EBI, and UniProt.

components.name: IdentifiersOrg search namespaces
components.description: Search Identifiers.org for available database namespace prefixes, returning matching namespace records.

components.name: IDR Get Image Map Annotations
components.description: Retrieves image IDs and names for a specified IDR dataset, with limit/offset pagination; the returned image IDs can be used to fetch further image annotations.

components.name: IDR Get Study
components.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a specific imaging study (project) in the Image Data Resource (IDR) by its project ID, including name, description, number of datasets, and links to associated imaging data.

components.name: Get IDR study datasets
components.description: Get datasets (image collections) within a specific IDR imaging study using a project/study ID, returning dataset names and IDs. Study IDs can be obtained from IDR_list_studies.

components.name: List IDR dataset images
components.description: Lists the individual images within a specified IDR dataset, returning their image IDs and names. Obtain dataset IDs from IDR_get_study_datasets; supports limit/offset pagination and provides total image count in meta.totalCount.

components.name: IDR list metadata keys
components.description: Search IDR (Image Data Resource) for images across studies by curated metadata key-value pairs, using an Elasticsearch-backed search engine. Returns images with their IDR image IDs, webclient URLs, and flattened key/value metadata pairs.

components.name: IDR list studies
components.description: List imaging studies (projects) from the Image Data Resource (IDR), a public repository for reference image datasets from published scientific studies. Returns study names, descriptions, IDs, and URLs to access datasets within each study.

components.name: IDR list values for key
components.description: Lists the distinct stored values for a specified metadata key in the Image Data Resource (IDR), returning the value list in lower case to support search queries. The tool accepts a metadata attribute key and outputs matching metadata values.

components.name: IDR search images
components.description: Search the Image Data Resource (IDR) for individual microscopy images across published studies by curated metadata such as gene symbol, organism, compound, cell line or phenotype. Results include image IDs, webclient URLs and flattened key/value metadata.

components.name: IDR search studies
components.description: Search the Image Data Resource (IDR) for studies, screens, and projects whose image metadata matches a key/value query, returning IDR container IDs, names, types, image counts, and study-level metadata.

components.name: IDT analyze oligo
components.description: Analyzes an oligonucleotide sequence using the IDT OligoAnalyzer API to calculate melting temperature, GC content, molecular weight, molar extinction coefficient, and nmol/OD260 and ug/OD260 yields under user-specified conditions for DNA or RNA oligos up to 200 bases.

components.name: IDT Check Self Dimer
components.description: Evaluates an oligonucleotide sequence for potential self-dimer or homodimer formation, useful for primer and probe design. Accepts a DNA or RNA sequence and optional salt concentrations and returns a self-dimer/homodimer assessment.

components.name: IEDB Get Epitope Antigens
components.description: Given an IEDB epitope structure ID, retrieve linked antigens from the IEDB Query API. Returned rows contain parent source antigen identifiers (parent_source_antigen_iri) that can be used for further filtering or searches.

components.name: IEDB Get Epitope MHC
components.description: Retrieve MHC restriction association rows from the IEDB Query API for a given epitope structure ID, returning rows that include elution IDs for the associations.

components.name: IEDB epitope references lookup
components.description: Retrieve literature references associated with an immune epitope in the IEDB using its structure_id. The tool queries the Immune Epitope Database and returns related reference records.

components.name: IEDB Epitope T-cell Assay Lookup
components.description: Retrieves T-cell assay data for a specific IEDB epitope structure ID, returning all T-cell assays that tested the given epitope to support T-cell immunogenicity analysis.

components.name: IEDB Predict Antigen Processing
components.description: Predicts MHC class I antigen processing using the IEDB next-generation tools API, combining NetCTLpan proteasomal cleavage/TAP transport predictions with MHC-I binding scores and returning ranked peptide predictions.

components.name: IEDB Predict B-cell Epitopes
components.description: Predicts linear B-cell epitopes from a protein sequence using the IEDB B-cell tool (default BepiPred), returning contiguous epitope regions and per-residue scores.

components.name: MHC class I binding prediction
components.description: Predicts MHC class I peptide binding from a protein sequence and HLA allele using NetMHCpan via the IEDB next-generation tools API. Returns scored peptide predictions with percentile rank, supporting human HLA-A/B/C and mouse H2 alleles.

components.name: IEDB Predict MHCII Binding
components.description: Predict MHC class II peptide binding using NetMHCIIpan via the IEDB next-generation tools API. Given a protein sequence and HLA-DR/DP/DQ allele, returns scored sliding-window peptide predictions sorted by percentile rank.

components.name: IEDB antigen search
components.description: Search antigen-related rows from the Immune Epitope Database (IEDB) Query API to discover antigen IRIs/IDs for use in other filters. Supports pagination, ordering, and field selection.

components.name: IEDB B-cell search
components.description: Search B-cell assay rows from the Immune Epitope Database (IEDB) Query API to discover bcell_id values and related epitope structure_id values.

components.name: IEDB BCR Sequence Search
components.description: Search B-cell receptor (BCR) and antibody sequence data from the IEDB, returning antibody sequences with heavy/light chain CDR3 sequences and cognate epitope information for antibody discovery and humoral immune response studies.

components.name: IEDB Search Epitopes
components.description: Search immune epitopes in the Immune Epitope Database (IEDB Query API) and retrieve matching epitope records including structure_id values, supporting optional sequence fragment and structure type filters.

components.name: IEDB search MHC
components.description: Search MHC-related assay rows in the IEDB Query API to discover epitope structure_id values involved in MHC restriction. The tool accepts search parameters and returns matching MHC restriction records, optionally selecting only a few fields for smaller responses.

components.name: IEDB search references
components.description: Search references/citations in the Immune Epitope Database (IEDB) Query API to discover reference IDs, PubMed IDs, and paper titles. Supports selecting fields, limiting, offset pagination, and ordering results.

components.name: IEDB T-cell assay search
components.description: Search T-cell assay data from the IEDB by peptide sequence, MHC class, source organism, or qualitative result, and retrieve T-cell response assays with epitope sequences, MHC restriction, and assay results.

components.name: IEDB TCR sequence search
components.description: Search T-cell receptor (TCR) sequence data from the IEDB, returning TCR sequences paired with their cognate epitopes and MHC restriction using sequence and MHC filters.

components.name: IGSR list data collections
components.description: List available data collections from the International Genome Sample Resource (IGSR), including the 1000 Genomes Project phases, 30x high-coverage resequencing, HGSVC, HPRC, and other related studies. Returns collection codes, titles, sample/population counts, and available data types such as sequence, alignment, and…

components.name: IGSR search populations
components.description: Search 1000 Genomes Project populations from the International Genome Sample Resource (IGSR), returning population codes, names, geographic coordinates, sample counts, and superpopulation assignments. Accepts an optional superpopulation filter to narrow the search.

components.name: IGSR search samples
components.description: Search samples from the 1000 Genomes Project by population, data collection, or sample name. Returns sample names, sex, BioSample IDs, population assignments, and available data collections.

components.name: IMGT gene info
components.description: Get information about IMGT databases, gene nomenclature, and analysis tools. Returns descriptions of IMGT resources (LIGM-DB, GENE-DB, V-QUEST) and gene naming conventions. Good starting point for immunogenetics research.

components.name: IMGT germline gene FASTA retrieval
components.description: Retrieves IMGT germline immunoglobulin (IG) and T-cell receptor (TR) gene reference sequences in FASTA format from IMGT/GENE-DB by gene type and species, returning labeled V/D/J-REGION records for antibody and TCR repertoire analysis.

components.name: IMGT get sequence
components.description: Get immunoglobulin/T cell receptor sequence from IMGT by accession number. IMGT is the reference for IG/TR/MHC gene sequences. Returns sequence in FASTA or EMBL format using EBI DBFetch.

components.name: IMGT search genes
components.description: Search IMGT GENE-DB for immunoglobulin and T cell receptor germline genes by gene name, type, and species; returns search URLs and gene type information for navigation.

components.name: ImmPort search studies
components.description: Search the ImmPort immunology database for studies by keyword, disease condition, assay method, or research focus, returning matching study records.

components.name: IMPC gene phenotype hits
components.description: Retrieve detailed statistical phenotype results from IMPC for a mouse gene by gene symbol or MGI accession, returning p-values, effect sizes, and classification tags for each phenotyping parameter, with an optional significant-only filter.

components.name: IMPC gene summary
components.description: Retrieves a mouse gene summary from the International Mouse Phenotyping Consortium (IMPC), including phenotyping status, viability, ortholog information, and Mammalian Phenotype (MP) and Human Phenotype (HP) term annotations. Query by mouse gene symbol or MGI accession ID.

components.name: IMPC Phenotypes by Gene
components.description: Retrieves phenotype annotations for a mouse gene from IMPC knockout screens, returning MP ontology terms grouped by physiological system.

components.name: IMPC search genes
components.description: Search IMPC for mouse genes by symbol, name, synonym, or MGI ID and return matching genes with their phenotyping and production status. Useful for finding the correct MGI ID before querying phenotypes.

components.name: INDRA evidence count
components.description: Retrieve the total number of literature evidence items in INDRA DB for a gene, protein, or chemical without fetching full statements, optionally filtering by statement type.

components.name: INDRA get statement by hash
components.description: Retrieves a specific INDRA statement by its hash with full evidence details. The tool takes a statement hash from INDRA_get_statements and returns the matching biological relationship statement and its evidence.

components.name: INDRA Get Statements
components.description: Retrieves literature-mined biological statements for a gene, protein, or chemical from INDRA DB, returning mechanistic relationships such as Activation, Inhibition, and Phosphorylation with supporting evidence from PubMed. Inputs an entity name and optionally a statement type or second agent, and outputs statements ag…

components.name: IntAct Get Complex Details
components.description: Get detailed information about a specific protein complex from IntAct by its complex AC (e.g., CPX-915), returning comprehensive details such as participants, functions, ligands, and associated diseases.

components.name: Intact get interaction details
components.description: Retrieves detailed information for molecular interactions from the IntAct database by interaction identifier. Accepts IntAct interaction IDs and returns detailed interaction records.

components.name: IntAct interaction lookup by identifier
components.description: Get all molecular interactions involving a specific protein or gene by supplying a UniProt ID, gene name, or IntAct identifier. Uses the EBI Search API against the IntAct domain and returns a list of interactions with interaction IDs.

components.name: IntAct get interactions
components.description: Retrieves molecular interaction records from the IntAct database using a UniProt identifier.

components.name: IntAct Get Interactions by Complex
components.description: Search the IntAct database for protein complexes by complex name, complex AC, or gene name and return complex information including AC, name, description, organism, and interactors. This tool searches complexes rather than interactions directly.

components.name: IntAct Get Interactions by Organism
components.description: Get all protein interactions for a specific organism by taxonomy ID using the IntAct database via the EBI Search API. Returns a list of interaction IDs for the organism.

components.name: IntAct get interactor
components.description: Get detailed information about a specific interactor from the IntAct molecular interaction database by IntAct identifier. Returns interactor details including names, aliases, organism, and cross-references.

components.name: IntAct Search Interactions
components.description: Searches the IntAct molecular interaction database via the EBI Search API using a query string, returning interaction entries with interaction IDs for further analysis.

components.name: Intent Analyzer Agent
components.description: Analyzes user research intent and creates comprehensive literature search plans from a query and optional context, returning the detected user intent and prioritized search plans with keywords.

components.name: InterMine run pathquery
components.description: Run an arbitrary InterMine PathQuery against HumanMine to traverse the data model graph (e.g., gene->pathways, gene->protein domains, region->features) and return results as JSON rows in the order of the view columns.

components.name: InterPro get clan members
components.description: Retrieves all member families in a Pfam clan (superfamily) using the InterPro API, given a Pfam clan accession. Returns member family accessions, names, types, and relationship scores.

components.name: InterPro domain details lookup
components.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific InterPro protein domain entry, including description, hierarchy, and member databases, using its InterPro accession.

components.name: InterPro entries for protein
components.description: Retrieves all InterPro domain and family entries annotated on a specified UniProt protein accession, returning the matching InterPro entry records.

components.name: InterPro get member signature
components.description: Retrieve detailed information for a single InterPro member-database signature using a member database slug and signature accession. Returns signature name, type, integrated InterPro entry, description, GO terms, and protein/structure/taxa counts.

components.name: InterPro protein domain architecture
components.description: Retrieves complete Pfam domain architectures for proteins from the InterPro API using a UniProt accession, returning all mapped Pfam domains with exact start/end coordinates, E-values, and integrated InterPro entries.

components.name: InterPro Get Protein Domains
components.description: Get protein domain annotations from InterPro database using a UniProt protein ID. Returns domain families, signatures, and functional annotations.

components.name: InterPro protein lookup by domain
components.description: Find proteins that contain a specific InterPro domain or family by reverse lookup from an InterPro accession to annotated UniProt proteins, with optional filtering for Swiss-Prot reviewed entries.

components.name: InterPro Get Residue Annotations
