components.description: Retrieve InterPro residue-level functional site annotations for a protein by UniProt accession, returning residue positions for binding sites, active sites, conserved residues, and post-translational modifications with descriptions and residue fragments.

components.name: InterPro get structures for domain
components.description: Find all PDB structures containing a specific Pfam domain using the InterPro API. Accepts a Pfam domain accession and returns experimental structures (X-ray, cryo-EM, NMR) with resolution and experiment type, sorted by most recent.

components.name: InterPro get structures for entry
components.description: Retrieve experimentally-solved PDB structures whose chains contain a given InterPro domain or family, using an integrated InterPro accession (IPR...). Returns structure identifiers, titles, experimental method, resolution, and total count.

components.name: InterPro list member databases
components.description: List the InterPro member-database catalog with entry counts, returning the number of signatures contributed by each member database (Pfam, CATH-Gene3D, SUPERFAMILY/ssf, PANTHER, CDD, PROSITE profiles/patterns, SMART, NCBIfam, PRINTS, HAMAP, PIRSF, SFLD, AntiFam) plus integrated, unintegrated, InterPro and overall tota…

components.name: InterPro list member signatures
components.description: List and paginate signatures from a selected InterPro member database, returning accession, name, type, and mapped InterPro entry along with total count. Optionally filter by entry type.

components.name: InterPro search domains
components.description: Search the InterPro database for protein domains and families by name or accession (e.g., kinase or IPR000719) and return matching domain entries with metadata.

components.name: InterPro search entries
components.description: Search InterPro entries (protein domains, families, and sites) by keyword and return matching entries with accession, name, type, and statistics such as protein, structure, and taxa counts.

components.name: InterProScan Get Job Results
components.description: Retrieve results from a completed InterProScan job using its job ID. Returns protein domain predictions, Gene Ontology annotations, and pathway mappings from InterProScan analysis.

components.name: InterProScan get job status
components.description: Check the status of an InterProScan protein sequence analysis job using its job ID, returning a status such as RUNNING, FINISHED, FAILURE, ERROR, or NOT_FOUND.

components.name: InterProScan scan sequence
components.description: Run InterProScan sequence analysis on a protein sequence to predict protein domains, families, functional sites, Gene Ontology terms, and pathway annotations.

components.name: InterVar classify variant
components.description: Classify a germline variant using ACMG/AMP 2015 standards (InterVar), returning the clinical significance category (Pathogenic, Likely Pathogenic, Uncertain Significance, Likely Benign, or Benign) and activation status of all 28 evidence criteria, from genomic coordinates in hg19 or hg38.

components.name: IntOGen Get Drivers
components.description: Get cancer driver genes for a specific cancer type from the IntOGen database, using computational methods (dNdScv, OncodriveFML, OncodriveCLUSTL, HotMAPS, smRegions, CBaSE, MutPanning) applied to somatic mutation data from thousands of tumors. Requires a cancer type code and returns driver gene records with gene symbo…

components.name: IntOGen Get Gene Info
components.description: Look up IntOGen cancer driver gene classifications for a given HUGO gene symbol, returning cancer types where the gene is a driver along with detection methods and mutation statistics.

components.name: IntOGen list cancer types
components.description: Queries IntOGen for driver genes associated with a specified cancer type code, returning genes identified by computational methods along with mutation and mutated sample counts across cohorts.

components.name: IntOGen list cohorts
components.description: List available cancer cohorts from IntOGen with sample counts, tumor types, and data sources, optionally filtered by cancer type.

components.name: IPD get HLA allele
components.description: Fetches the complete IPD-IMGT/HLA record for a single HLA allele by its IPD accession (e.g. 'HLA00001'), including allele name, locus, class, sequence, confirmation status, citations, CWD status, release history, and cross-references. Uses the keyless EMBL-EBI API and is intended to be called after IPD_search_hla_alle…

components.name: IPD search cells
components.description: Search IPD-IMGT/HLA reference cell lines via a keyless EMBL-EBI API by a query string against the primary name or another specified field, returning matching cells with their IPD cell ID and primary name.

components.name: IPD search HLA alleles
components.description: Search the IPD-IMGT/HLA database for human HLA alleles by allele name prefix or substring, returning matching alleles with IPD accession and full allele name.

components.name: iPTMnet Proteoform PPI
components.description: Retrieves proteoform-state-level protein-protein interactions from iPTMnet for a queried protein, returning records keyed by PRO ontology proteoform IDs with relation types, data sources, and PubMed references.

components.name: iPTMnet Get Proteoforms
components.description: Retrieves experimentally observed proteoform records for a protein from iPTMnet using a UniProt accession. Each proteoform includes its PRO ontology ID, modified sites, responsible enzyme if known, source database, and PubMed references.

components.name: iPTMnet PTM-dependent PPI retrieval
components.description: Retrieves post-translational modification (PTM)-dependent protein-protein interactions from iPTMnet using a UniProt accession. Returns interactions with PTM type, modified substrate site, interacting partner, association type, data source, and PubMed reference.

components.name: iPTMnet get PTM sites
components.description: Get all post-translational modification (PTM) sites for a protein from iPTMnet using a UniProt accession; returns residue, position, PTM type, confidence score, source databases, catalytic enzymes, and PubMed references for each site organized by protein isoform.

components.name: iPTMnet search
components.description: Search the iPTMnet database for proteins with post-translational modification data using gene name, protein name, or keyword queries, with optional role and PTM type filters. Returns UniProt IDs, PTM site counts, enzyme/substrate roles, and isoform counts, integrating data from PhosphoSitePlus, UniProt, PRO ontology,…

components.name: ISRCTN Trial Lookup
components.description: Retrieve a single ISRCTN clinical trial record by its ISRCTN ID, returning the full trial record including title, design, phase, conditions, interventions, outcomes, eligibility, sponsors, contacts, recruitment details, drug names, enrolment, IPD statement, and cross-reference identifiers such as DOI, EudraCT, and Cli…

components.name: ISRCTN search trials
components.description: Search the ISRCTN clinical trial registry by free-text query and return matching trial records with identifiers, titles, study design, and cross-reference IDs such as DOI, EudraCT, and ClinicalTrials.gov.

components.name: ISRCTN fielded trial search
components.description: Field-scoped search of the ISRCTN clinical trial registry using its boolean query DSL, returning detailed trial records such as interventions, outcomes, eligibility, sponsors, and funders.

components.name: IUPred3 predict disorder
components.description: Predict intrinsically disordered protein regions from a UniProt accession or ID using the IUPred3 algorithm. Returns per-residue disorder scores (0-1), predicted disordered region segments (score >= 0.5), and summary statistics; optional 'anchor' and 'redox' modes return ANCHOR2 protein-binding region scores or redox-…

components.name: JASPAR get matrix
components.description: Retrieves full details for a single JASPAR transcription factor binding matrix by matrix_id, including its metadata and PFM/PWM.

components.name: JASPAR get matrix versions
components.description: Retrieve all versions of a JASPAR transcription factor binding matrix by its base ID (e.g., MA0002), returning version records and metadata from the JASPAR database.

components.name: JASPAR Get Transcription Factors
components.description: Lists JASPAR transcription factor binding profiles (position weight matrices) from the JASPAR database, optionally restricted to a collection such as CORE with pagination; returns all matrices in JSON and does not support name-based filtering.

components.name: JASPAR list collections
components.description: List JASPAR collections (e.g., CORE, CNE) from the JASPAR API endpoint. Useful for filtering matrices by collection. Returns a JSON list of collections with count and results.

components.name: JASPAR list releases
components.description: List available JASPAR releases (database version history) for research reproducibility, with pagination controls for page and page size.

components.name: JASPAR list species
components.description: List species available in JASPAR, returning taxonomy IDs and names. Useful for filtering matrices by species.

components.name: JASPAR list taxa
components.description: List available taxonomic groups (taxa) in JASPAR (e.g., vertebrates, plants). Useful for filtering matrices by tax_group. Returns a JSON list of taxonomic groups used by JASPAR.

components.name: JASPAR search matrices
components.description: Search the JASPAR database for transcription factor binding profiles by transcription factor name. Returns matching matrix records in JSON format.

components.name: KEGG Convert IDs
components.description: Convert KEGG gene or compound identifiers to external database IDs (UniProt, NCBI Gene, NCBI Protein, ChEBI, PubChem) using the KEGG /conv API.

components.name: KEGG Find Compound
components.description: Search the KEGG COMPOUND database by exact mass, molecular weight, molecular formula, or name keyword to retrieve candidate KEGG compound IDs for metabolite identification.

components.name: KEGG Find Genes
components.description: Find genes in the KEGG database by keyword, optionally filtering by organism code.

components.name: KEGG BRITE hierarchy retrieval
components.description: Retrieves the full classification tree for a specified KEGG BRITE hierarchy, such as protein kinases, peptidases, transporters, transcription factors, G protein-coupled receptors, ion channels, cytokine receptors, CD molecules, compounds with biological roles, or KEGG pathway maps.

components.name: KEGG Get Compound
components.description: Retrieves KEGG compound/metabolite details by compound ID, including names, formula, molecular weight, associated pathways, enzymes, and database cross-references from the KEGG COMPOUND database.

components.name: KEGG disease search
components.description: Search the KEGG DISEASE database by keyword to find human disease entries and return disease IDs and names. KEGG DISEASE contains 2,600+ human disease entries with associated genes, pathways, drugs, and cross-references.

components.name: KEGG get disease genes
components.description: Retrieve KEGG gene IDs associated with a KEGG disease, optionally for a specified organism, returning genes linked through mutations, gene fusions, or other mechanisms.

components.name: KEGG Get Drug
components.description: Search the KEGG DRUG database by keyword to retrieve matching drug identifiers and names.

components.name: KEGG get drug targets
components.description: Get human gene targets for a given KEGG drug ID, returning raw KEGG gene IDs in hsa:XXXXX format. This tool supports drug-target interaction analysis and pharmacogenomics and is limited to human targets by default.

components.name: KEGG Get Enzyme
components.description: Retrieve a KEGG ENZYME entry by EC number, returning names, class hierarchy, systematic name, reaction, substrates/products, and gene orthology (KO) entries for enzyme annotation and pathway gene-function lookup.

components.name: KEGG Get Gene Info
components.description: Get detailed gene information from KEGG by gene ID, including sequence, function, and pathway associations.

components.name: KEGG get gene pathways
components.description: Retrieves all KEGG pathways associated with a given KEGG gene identifier (organism:id such as hsa:7157) or human gene symbol, returning pathway IDs and names. Example: human TP53 participates in 51 pathways including p53 signaling, apoptosis, cell cycle, and disease pathways.

components.name: KEGG module lookup
components.description: Retrieve a KEGG MODULE entry by its identifier and return its name, definition, class hierarchy, member reactions, compounds, orthology mappings, and parent pathways.

components.name: KEGG Get Network
components.description: Retrieves detailed KEGG network information including signaling pathway definitions, associated disease classes, linked diseases, drug targets, and pathway elements from a keyword query.

components.name: KEGG pathway gene lookup
components.description: Retrieves all gene IDs for members of a specified KEGG pathway using a KEGG pathway identifier, such as hsa04115 for the p53 signaling pathway.

components.name: KEGG Get Pathway Info
components.description: Retrieves detailed KEGG pathway information by pathway ID, returning pathway data including genes, compounds, and reactions.

components.name: KEGG Get Reaction
components.description: Retrieves a KEGG REACTION entry by R-number, returning the reaction name, definition, balanced equation, enzyme EC numbers, RCLASS codes, and parent pathways and modules. Useful for reaction stoichiometry and EC mapping in metabolic-network and flux modeling.

components.name: KEGG Get Variant
components.description: Searches the KEGG VARIANT database for human gene variants associated with disease by gene name, returning variant IDs, descriptions, and links to mutation details, ClinVar/dbSNP cross-references, and associated diseases or drugs.

components.name: KEGG link entries
components.description: Find cross-references between KEGG databases using the KEGG /link API: given a KEGG entry (gene, pathway, disease, drug, compound), return all linked entries in another KEGG database.

components.name: KEGG list BRITE hierarchies
components.description: List all available KEGG BRITE hierarchy classification files, which are hierarchical text (htext) files capturing functional hierarchies of various biological objects. Returns hierarchy IDs and names for categories such as KEGG Orthology, Enzymes, Protein kinases, Transporters, Transcription factors, and more.

components.name: KEGG list organisms
components.description: List all available organisms in the KEGG database, returning organism codes, names, and descriptions.

components.name: KEGG search disease
components.description: Search the KEGG DISEASE database by keyword to retrieve matching disease IDs and names. Supports case-insensitive partial matches and returns up to 100 results, with associated genes, pathways, drugs, and cross-references available through KEGG_get_disease.

components.name: KEGG search drug
components.description: Search the KEGG DRUG database by keyword to retrieve matching drug IDs and names from its curated collection of approved and investigational drugs.

components.name: KEGG search network
components.description: Searches the KEGG NETWORK database for signaling pathway networks by gene or keyword and returns matching network IDs and pathway names.

components.name: KEGG pathway search
components.description: Search KEGG pathways by keyword using the /find/pathway endpoint and return matching pathway IDs and descriptions.

components.name: KEGG search variant
components.description: Search the KEGG VARIANT database for human gene variants associated with disease by gene name, returning variant IDs and descriptions.

components.name: Keyword Extractor Agent
components.description: AI agent that extracts and refines search keywords for research plans, using plan title, description, current keywords, and context to return 5-8 specific academic search keywords.

components.name: KLIFS Get Kinase
components.description: Retrieves detailed information about a protein kinase from the KLIFS database by kinase ID, including kinase name, HGNC symbol, family/group classification, species, UniProt ID, IUPHAR ID, and the 80-residue KLIFS pocket sequence.

components.name: KLIFS Get Ligands
components.description: Get all co-crystallized ligands (inhibitors) bound to a specific kinase across KLIFS crystal structures using a KLIFS kinase ID, returning ligand PDB codes, names, SMILES, and InChIKeys.

components.name: KLIFS get structures
components.description: Retrieve annotated crystal structures for a specific kinase from KLIFS, including PDB IDs, ligand details, DFG-in/out conformation, alpha-C helix orientation, and binding pocket fingerprints for drug discovery.

components.name: KLIFS Get Structures by PDB
components.description: Get KLIFS kinase structure annotations for one or more PDB entries. Returns all kinase chains with DFG/alpha-C helix conformations, ligands, and pocket sequences for the specified PDB codes.

components.name: KLIFS List Kinases
components.description: List kinases from the KLIFS database, returning kinase identifiers, names, HGNC symbols, family/group classification, species, and UniProt IDs, with optional filtering by kinase group or species.

components.name: L1000FWD Signature Search
components.description: Searches the LINCS L1000 Connectivity Map by submitting up- and down-regulated gene sets to the L1000FWD Fireworks REST API and returns ranked L1000 perturbation records with combined scores, p-values, and q-values; supports similarity and opposite modes for applications such as computational drug repurposing.

components.name: LDlink get proxies
components.description: Find variants in linkage disequilibrium (LD proxies) with a query SNP, population-specific, via NIH LDlink's LDproxy module. Returns proxy rsIDs with R2, coordinates, alleles, MAF, and distance.

components.name: LINCS list libraries
components.description: Lists available LINCS signature libraries and associated metadata from LINCS SigCom, optionally filtered by keyword, returning library IDs, dataset identifiers, assay types, organisms, and descriptions.

components.name: LINCS search signatures
components.description: Search the LINCS database for drug perturbation gene expression signatures by drug or compound name, with optional cell-line filtering, returning signature IDs, doses, time points, tissue, disease context, and PubChem IDs.

components.name: LipidMaps Get Compound by ID
components.description: Retrieves lipid records from LIPID MAPS by LIPID MAPS ID (LMID), including structure, classification, physicochemical properties, and cross-references to external databases.

components.name: LipidMaps Get Compound by Xref
components.description: Look up a LIPID MAPS Structure Database (LMSD) record from an external cross-reference identifier, resolving common metabolite/lipid IDs such as KEGG, HMDB, ChEBI, PubChem CID, InChI Key, or structure-resolved abbreviations to the corresponding LM_ID and all cross-references.

components.name: LipidMaps get gene
components.description: Look up a lipid-metabolism gene in the LIPID MAPS Proteome Database (LMPD) by gene symbol, NCBI Gene ID, gene name, or LMP ID, and retrieve matching LMPD gene records with synonyms, chromosome, cytogenetic map location, NCBI summary, and species.

components.name: LIPID MAPS protein lookup
components.description: Look up a lipid-metabolism protein/enzyme in the LIPID MAPS Proteome Database (LMPD) by UniProt accession, gene symbol, NCBI Gene ID, RefSeq protein or mRNA ID, UniProt entry name, or LMPD ID. Returns the matching LMPD protein record including gene symbol/name, species, cross-references, and amino-acid sequence.

components.name: LipidMaps search by formula
components.description: Search the LIPID MAPS database for lipid records matching an exact lipid abbreviation (such as PC 34:1 or SM 34:1;O2), returning matching records with structures and classification.

components.name: LipidMaps search by name
components.description: Search LIPID MAPS Structure Database by exact lipid abbreviation and return matching lipid records with structures and classification.

components.name: Literature Context Reviewer
components.description: Assesses the coverage, relevance, and critical synthesis of a paper's literature review section and returns ratings, feedback, and missing-citation suggestions.

components.name: Literature Search Tool
components.description: Comprehensive literature search and summary tool that searches EuropePMC, OpenAlex, and PubTator and generates AI-powered summaries of research findings based on a research topic query.

components.name: Literature synthesis agent
components.description: AI agent that synthesizes literature findings for a given research topic and focus area, then returns evidence-based insights covering key findings, evidence quality, consensus, controversies, gaps, and clinical relevance.

components.name: LitVar get variant details
components.description: Get the full structured variant record from NCBI LitVar2 by dbSNP rsID, returning a normalized variant profile including ClinGen allele IDs, associated genes, HGVS notation, genomic position, clinical significance, and allele frequency.

components.name: LitVar get variant publications
components.description: Retrieves PubMed and PMC IDs for publications that mention a given genetic variant via NCBI LitVar2, using a dbSNP rsID as input.

components.name: LitVar search variants
components.description: Search the NCBI LitVar2 database for genetic variants by rsID, gene name, or HGVS notation and retrieve literature-linked variant summaries including identifiers, associated genes, HGVS nomenclature, publication counts, and clinical significance where available.

components.name: LNCipedia get lncRNA
components.description: Retrieves detailed lncRNA information from RNAcentral by RNAcentral ID, including full nucleotide sequence, species, gene associations, publication count, and source databases.

components.name: LNCipedia get lncRNA publications
components.description: Retrieves publications associated with a long non-coding RNA from RNAcentral using an RNAcentral URS identifier and returns publication titles, authors, PubMed IDs, DOIs, and journal information.

components.name: LNCipedia get lncRNA cross-references
components.description: Retrieve cross-references for a long non-coding RNA from RNAcentral using an RNAcentral URS identifier. Returns database links, external accession IDs, expert database URLs and species information from LNCipedia, NONCODE, LncBook, HGNC, RefSeq, GeneCards, MalaCards, Ensembl and other sources.

components.name: LNCipedia search lncRNA
components.description: Searches long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) records by name, accession, or keyword using EBI Search over RNAcentral. Returns RNAcentral IDs, descriptions, sequence lengths, and source databases, with optional species filtering.

components.name: LNCipedia search ncRNA by type
components.description: Search LNCipedia for non-coding RNA records by RNA type classification using the RNAcentral RNA type vocabulary. Accepts a query (gene name, keyword, or accession), RNA type, and optional species filter, returning matching ncRNA records with cross-references.

components.name: LOINC answer list lookup
components.description: Retrieves the published answer lists for a specified LOINC code, returning each matching code with its permissible coded values (answer code, display text, sequence and score where scored), datatype, and answer_lists_found count. Codes whose datatype is not CNE or CWE take free values and return no answer list.

components.name: LOINC Code Details Lookup
components.description: Get detailed information for a specific LOINC code from the LOINC terminology, including full name, component, property, system, scale, method, and clinical classification. Accepts a LOINC code identifier and returns structured code details for interpreting lab results or clinical data.

components.name: LOINC Code Search
components.description: Searches for LOINC codes using the UMLS API. Accepts a query string for test name, component, or LOINC code and returns matching codes with descriptions.

components.name: LOINC search forms
components.description: Search LOINC clinical forms, panels, and survey instruments by terms and return matching LOINC codes for use in electronic health records. Single questions and individual lab tests are excluded; use LOINC_search_tests for those.

components.name: LOINC Search Tests
components.description: Search LOINC (Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes) for laboratory tests, vital signs, and clinical measurements by name or keywords. Returns standardized LOINC codes for use in healthcare systems and research studies.

components.name: LOTUS Get Compound
components.description: Get detailed information about a specific natural product from LOTUS by its internal compound ID, including structure, molecular properties, drug-likeness metrics, chemical taxonomy, and source organism data.

components.name: LOTUS search by InChIKey
components.description: Search the LOTUS natural products database by InChIKey for exact structural matches. Accepts a 27-character InChIKey and returns matching natural product records.

components.name: LOTUS search natural products
components.description: Searches the LOTUS natural products database by compound name, SMILES, or InChIKey and returns matching natural product records with structures, molecular properties, and chemical taxonomy classifications.

components.name: LOVD get gene
components.description: Get gene information from LOVD (Leiden Open Variation Database) by HGNC gene symbol, returning HGNC ID, Entrez ID, chromosomal location, RefSeq transcripts, genomic build, curation details, and dates.

components.name: LOVD get variants
components.description: Retrieve all curated variants for a gene from the LOVD database by HGNC gene symbol. Returns variant records with HGVS notation, genomic positions, LOVD DBID, and reporting count.

components.name: LOVD search variants
components.description: Search variants in the LOVD database by LOVD variant DBID, HGVS DNA notation, or HGNC gene symbol. Returns matching variant records.

components.name: MAGICapp get guideline
components.description: Retrieves metadata for evidence-based clinical guidelines from the MAGICapp API, including guideline name, owner organization, publication date, recommendation count, and guideline IDs for detailed lookups.

components.name: MAGICapp get recommendations
components.description: Retrieves evidence-based clinical guideline recommendations from organizations like WHO, Stroke Foundation, and American Dental Association via the MAGICapp API. Returns guideline metadata including name, owner organization, publication date, recommendation count, and guideline IDs.

components.name: MAGICapp Get Sections
components.description: Get all sections (chapters) of a specific MAGICapp clinical guideline by numeric guideline ID, returning structural organization including section headings, text content, section types, and hierarchical ordering.

components.name: MAGICapp list guidelines
components.description: List all publicly available clinical guidelines from MAGICapp, returning metadata including name, owner organization, publication date, recommendation count, and guideline IDs.

components.name: MARRVEL get gene
components.description: Get aggregated identity and annotation for a human gene by symbol from MARRVEL, including cross-references (HGNC, Ensembl, Entrez, UniProt), chromosome location, gene type, aliases, previous symbols, and Entrez gene summary. Retired symbols or aliases are resolved via HGNC before re-querying.

components.name: MARRVEL Get OMIM Phenotypes
components.description: Retrieve OMIM phenotype associations for a given gene symbol, returning OMIM phenotype identifiers and descriptions for rare disease and Mendelian variant triage workflows.

components.name: MassBank get record by accession
components.description: Retrieve a MassBank record by its accession number, returning the full compound information for the corresponding entry in the MassBank database.

components.name: MassBank search by compound
components.description: Search MassBank Europe mass spectrometry spectral library by compound name, returning MS/MS spectra records with compound information, acquisition parameters, and spectral peaks.

components.name: MassBank search by formula
components.description: Search the MassBank Europe mass spectral library by molecular formula to retrieve matching mass spectra records for compounds.

components.name: MassBank search records advanced
components.description: Resolve a MassBank accession identifier into a fully annotated mass spectrum record, including compound metadata, spectral peaks with the SPLASH hash, and cross-references to external databases such as CAS, CHEBI, KEGG, and PubChem.

components.name: MassBank spectral similarity search
components.description: Identify an unknown metabolite by searching a query MS/MS peak list (m/z and intensity pairs) against the MassBank Europe reference library and return cosine-scored, ranked library matches with MassBank accessions and similarity scores.

components.name: MassIVE get dataset
components.description: Get detailed information about a specific MassIVE proteomics dataset by MSV or PXD accession, including title, summary, species, instruments, keywords, contacts, publications, and post-translational modifications.

components.name: MassIVE get protein identifications
components.description: Provides identification-level access to MassIVE proteomics datasets via the ProXI API, returning cross-dataset identification counts or peptide-spectrum matches for a supplied protein accession.

components.name: MassIVE search datasets
components.description: Search the MassIVE proteomics repository for mass spectrometry datasets, returning dataset accessions, titles, species, instruments, and keywords, with optional filtering by NCBI taxonomy ID.

components.name: MaveDB get clinical controls
components.description: Retrieve ClinVar clinical-control variants (pathogenic, benign, or VUS) that overlap a MaveDB score set for calibrating MAVE functional scores into clinical thresholds. Accepts a MaveDB score set URN and optionally filters by clinical significance, returning ClinVar entries and matched MaveDB variant URNs.

components.name: MaveDB get effect matrix
components.description: Fetches a MaveDB score set, parses HGVS into reference amino acid, position, and alternate amino acid, filters to single missense variants, optionally verifies numbering against a UniProt canonical sequence, and reshapes the data into a 20 amino acids by n positions effect matrix with position list and metadata.

components.name: MaveDB Get gnomAD Variants
components.description: Retrieves gnomAD population-frequency variants observed in a specified MaveDB score set, returning dbIdentifier, gnomAD version, allele count, allele number, and allele frequency linked to MaveDB mapped variants via a genomic VRS Allele; accepts a MaveDB URN and clinical controls flag.

components.name: MaveDB get mapped variants
components.description: Retrieves genomically-mapped variant coordinates (GA4GH VRS Allele and ClinGen Allele ID) for a MaveDB score set URN to translate raw MAVE scores into genome coordinates for downstream variant annotation.

components.name: MaveDB get score set
components.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific MaveDB score set by its URN identifier, including target gene, experimental methods, variant count, publications, and license. Score sets contain functional impact scores from deep mutational scanning or saturation genome editing experiments.

components.name: MaveDB get variant scores
components.description: Retrieves functional variant effect scores from MaveDB score sets, returning HGVS-annotated variants with functional scores from deep mutational scanning or other MAVE assays. Supports optional filtering by HGVS protein notation.

components.name: MaveDB search experiments
components.description: Search MaveDB for experiments by gene name, protein, or assay keywords, returning experiment URNs, titles, associated score sets, and publications.

components.name: MaveDB search score sets
components.description: Search MaveDB for variant effect score sets from Multiplexed Assays of Variant Effect (MAVE) experiments, including deep mutational scanning. Accepts gene names, protein names, or keywords and returns score set URNs, titles, variant counts, and publication dates.

components.name: MCSA entry lookup
components.description: Retrieve an enzyme's catalytic machinery from M-CSA by entry identifier, returning catalytic residues with PDB and UniProt numbering, mechanistic roles, EC number and reaction.

components.name: M-CSA enzyme search
components.description: Search M-CSA for enzymes by name, EC number prefix, or UniProt accession. Returns matching enzyme entries and scan metadata including entries_scanned, catalogue_size, and scan_complete.

components.name: Mcule compound lookup
components.description: Look up chemical compounds in the Mcule database by SMILES, InChIKey, or Mcule ID and retrieve matching Mcule IDs and SMILES structures.

components.name: Mcule database lookup
components.description: Retrieve detailed metadata for a specific Mcule compound database file by its ID, returning name, description, entry count, last updated date, and download file links with checksums. Public endpoint, no authentication required.

components.name: Mcule list databases
components.description: List available compound database files from Mcule for bulk download, including database names, descriptions, entry counts, last updated dates, and download links in SDF.gz and SMILES.gz formats. Useful for setting up local compound databases for virtual screening.

components.name: Mcule lookup compound
components.description: Look up purchasable compounds on Mcule using a SMILES string, InChIKey, or Mcule ID. Returns matching Mcule IDs and SMILES structures from Mcule's aggregated chemical-supplier database.

components.name: MDDB get project
components.description: Retrieve a molecular dynamics simulation project from the MDDB database by its accession and return the corresponding project record.

components.name: MDDB Search Projects
components.description: Search MDDB, an index of over 15,000 molecular dynamics simulation trajectories, by protein name or PDB id to return project accessions for use with MDDB_get_project.

components.name: MedGen Clinical Features
components.description: Retrieve HPO clinical features (phenotypes) associated with a genetic condition from NCBI MedGen using a MedGen UID or UMLS CUI. Returns feature names, HPO IDs, UMLS CUIs, and definitions.

components.name: MedGen get condition
components.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific genetic condition from NCBI MedGen by MedGen UID or UMLS CUI. Returns definition, associated genes, OMIM IDs, synonyms, modes of inheritance, and clinical features (HPO phenotypes).

components.name: MedGen search conditions
components.description: Search NCBI MedGen for genetic conditions, diseases, or syndromes by keyword and return matching condition names, definitions, OMIM IDs, and associated genes. MedGen aggregates data from OMIM, Orphanet, ClinVar, HPO, GTR, and GeneReviews.

components.name: MediaDive ingredient search
components.description: Search MediaDive's catalogue of over 1,200 media ingredients by name substring. Returns each match's ingredient_id and chemical identifiers (CAS, ChEBI, PubChem, formula) where known.

components.name: MediaDive get medium
components.description: Retrieve a full standardized microbial cultivation medium recipe from the MediaDive catalog by medium identifier.

components.name: MediaDive ingredient search
components.description: Searches MediaDive's catalogue of over 1,200 media ingredients by name substring and returns matching ingredient IDs and chemical identifiers (CAS, ChEBI, PubChem, formula) where known.

components.name: MediaDive search media
components.description: Search MediaDive's catalogue of over 3,300 standardized microbial cultivation media by name substring, returning each match's medium_id, source, pH range, and published reference. Use medium_id with MediaDive_get_medium to retrieve the full recipe.

components.name: Medical Literature Reviewer
components.description: Conducts systematic reviews of medical literature on specified topics. It takes a research topic and literature content and returns evidence-based conclusions with structured analysis and quality assessment.

components.name: Medical Term Normalizer
components.description: Identifies and corrects misspelled drug or disease names, returning a list of plausible standardized terms ordered by likelihood.

components.name: MedlinePlus Connect lookup by code
components.description: Look up MedlinePlus health information by medical code. Accepts drug or test codes and returns related health resources.

components.name: MedlinePlus genetics condition lookup
components.description: Retrieves a genetics condition record from MedlinePlus using a condition name as input.

components.name: MedlinePlus Get Genetics Gene by Name
components.description: Retrieves genetics information for a gene by name from MedlinePlus Genetics.

components.name: MedlinePlus genetics index download
components.description: Downloads the complete XML index file of all genetics entries in MedlinePlus in a single call, with no input parameters required. The returned data is parsed into a Python dictionary or OrderedDict and can be used for offline caching or batch processing.

components.name: MedlinePlus Search Topics by Keyword
components.description: Search MedlinePlus health topics by keyword using NLM's wsearch Web Service. The service currently returns health topics in English via healthTopics and Spanish via healthTopicsSpanish, while other historical database parameters return zero results.

components.name: MedRxiv get preprint
components.description: Retrieve full metadata for a specific medRxiv preprint by DOI, including title, authors, abstract, publication date, version, category, and URLs.

components.name: MEME discover motifs
components.description: Run de novo motif discovery on a set of DNA sequences using the MEME algorithm, identifying overrepresented ungapped sequence patterns such as transcription factor binding sites. Accepts at least two FASTA sequences and returns discovered motifs with consensus sequences, E-values, probability matrices, and site counts…

components.name: MEME FIMO scan
components.description: Scan DNA sequences for transcription factor binding motifs using FIMO from the MEME Suite. Accepts DNA sequences in FASTA format and a motif in MEME format, submits a job to meme-suite.org, and returns statistically significant binding sites with p-values, scores, strand, and matched sequences.

components.name: MEME list databases
components.description: Lists available motif databases for use with MEME suite tools, providing options such as JASPAR2026_vertebrates, JASPAR2026_all, JASPAR2024_vertebrates, and HOCOMOCO_v12.

components.name: MEME TOMTOM Compare
components.description: Compare a query motif in MEME format against known motif databases (JASPAR, HOCOMOCO, CIS-BP) using TOMTOM to identify similar transcription factor binding motifs. Returns matches ranked by E-value with query and target consensus sequences.

components.name: MeSH Get Descriptor
components.description: Retrieves detailed information for a MeSH descriptor by its ID, including label, type, annotation, tree numbers, date of introduction, and related terms.

components.name: MeSH subjects by pharmacological action
components.description: Find MeSH (Medical Subject Heading) subjects with matching pharmacological actions.

components.name: MeSH subject lookup by ID
components.description: Find MeSH (Medical Subject Heading) subjects matching a given subject ID (Descriptor UI) using the MeSH2025 XML dataset, returning matching MeSH descriptor records.

components.name: MeSH Get Subjects by Subject Name
components.description: Searches the MeSH controlled vocabulary for subject headings whose names, key concepts, or synonyms match a supplied query, using the agenticx/MeSH2025 dataset. Returns matching MeSH subject records with identifiers and related metadata.

components.name: MeSH subject scope/definition lookup
components.description: Search MeSH descriptor records by matching query text against subject scope or definition fields. Returns matching MeSH subjects with identifiers, names, and related pharmacological actions.

components.name: MeSH search descriptors
components.description: Search MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) descriptors by label using exact, contains, or startswith matching. Returns matching descriptor records with their unique identifiers for indexing biomedical literature.

components.name: MeSH search terms
components.description: Search MeSH terms (entry terms and synonyms) by label using exact, contains, or startsWith matching, returning matching preferred descriptors and alternative terms.

components.name: Meta-analysis run
components.description: Run a fixed-effects or random-effects meta-analysis from a set of effect sizes and standard errors, using inverse-variance weighting or the DerSimonian-Laird estimator, and return pooled effect size with 95% CI, p-value, heterogeneity statistics, per-study weights, and interpretation. Pure local computation with no ex…

components.name: MetaboAnalyst Biomarker Enrichment
components.description: Find statistically enriched metabolite sets (biomarker panels) from a list of metabolites using a hypergeometric test with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction against curated metabolite set libraries derived from SMPDB and HMDB.

components.name: MetaboAnalyst get pathway library
components.description: Lists KEGG metabolic pathways for a specified organism, returning pathway IDs, names, category, and the number of metabolites per pathway. Supports browsing pathway libraries before enrichment analysis.

components.name: MetaboAnalyst name to ID
components.description: Maps metabolite common names to standardized database identifiers (KEGG, PubChem, ChEBI) by resolving names against the KEGG compound database and retrieving cross-references; returns matched name, molecular formula, and exact mass for each metabolite. Useful for converting metabolite lists before pathway or enrichmen…

components.name: MetaboAnalyst Pathway Enrichment
components.description: Perform metabolite pathway enrichment analysis (over-representation analysis) using a hypergeometric test. Accepts a list of metabolite names, maps them to KEGG compound IDs, tests KEGG metabolic pathways for enrichment, and returns ranked pathways with p-value, fold enrichment, FDR, and hit metabolites.

components.name: MetaboLights reference compound lookup
components.description: Retrieves a record from the MetaboLights Reference Compound database using a compound ID (e.g., MTBLC10), returning curated compound details such as name, molecular formula, InChI/InChIKey, ChEBI ID, IUPAC names, species, cross-references, and available data flags.

components.name: MetaboLights Get Study
components.description: Get detailed information about a specific MetaboLights study by study identifier from the MetaboLights metabolomics repository.

components.name: MetaboLights Get Study Assays
components.description: Retrieves all assay metadata associated with a MetaboLights study by study ID, including assay types, protocols, and measurement details.

components.name: MetaboLights get study data files
components.description: Search for data files within a MetaboLights study using a study ID and file pattern, returning a list of matching file records from the MetaboLights repository.

components.name: MetaboLights Get Study Factors
components.description: Get experimental factors for a MetaboLights study by study ID, returning factor definitions such as treatment groups, time points, and disease states with controlled vocabulary annotations.

components.name: MetaboLights get study files
components.description: Retrieve file metadata for a MetaboLights study by study ID, including file names, types, and download links; falls back to extracting file information from the study endpoint when the files endpoint fails.

components.name: Get MetaboLights study protocols
components.description: Get experimental protocols used in a MetaboLights study by study ID. Returns protocol details including sample collection, extraction, chromatography, and data acquisition methods with controlled vocabulary annotations.

components.name: MetaboLights Get Study Samples
components.description: Retrieves all sample records and associated metadata for a given MetaboLights study ID, including sample names, characteristics, and factor values. Uses the MetaboLights REST API and falls back to the study ISA investigation structure if the samples endpoint fails.

components.name: MetaboLights list studies
components.description: List all MetaboLights studies with pagination. Returns a list of study IDs (e.g., 'MTBLS1', 'MTBLS2'). Use metabolights_get_study to get detailed information for a specific study ID.

components.name: MetaboLights search studies
components.description: Keyword-search MetaboLights studies through EBI Search and return a JSON array of matching study accessions (MTBLS###). Accepts a query string for organism, disease, metabolite, or free-text study content.

components.name: Metabolite Get Diseases
components.description: Retrieves curated chemical-disease associations for a metabolite from the Comparative Toxicogenomics Database (CTD) via the RENCI Automat CTD mirror, accepting HMDB IDs, compound names, or PubChem CIDs and returning disease names, MONDO IDs, and supporting PubMed IDs.

components.name: Metabolite get info
components.description: Retrieves compound information for a metabolite by HMDB ID, compound name, or PubChem CID from PubChem, returning common name, IUPAC name, molecular formula, molecular weight, canonical SMILES, and InChIKey.

components.name: Metabolite search
components.description: Searches PubChem for metabolites by compound name or molecular formula and returns up to 10 matching compounds with PubChem CID, name, formula, molecular weight, and SMILES.

components.name: Metabolomics Workbench find studies by phenotype
components.description: Discovers Metabolomics Workbench studies matching phenotype/experimental filters such as analysis type, species, sample source, disease, KEGG ID, and RefMet metabolite name, returning matching study IDs, titles, and species/source/disease context.

components.name: Get compound by PubChem CID
components.description: Retrieve metabolite information from Metabolomics Workbench by PubChem compound ID (CID), useful for cross-referencing with PubChem data. Returns details such as registry number, formula, exact mass, and InChI key based on the requested output item.

components.name: Metabolomics Workbench gene/protein annotation lookup
components.description: Looks up Metabolomics Workbench gene or protein (MGP) annotation records by entity, identifier type, and input value, returning annotation details linked to Metabolomics Workbench.

components.name: Metabolomics Workbench Get RefMet Info
components.description: Get RefMet standardized nomenclature for a metabolite by looking up a supplied metabolite name and returning standardized metabolite names and associated information from the RefMet resource.

components.name: Metabolomics Workbench study lookup
components.description: Retrieves metadata and information for a Metabolomics Workbench study by its study ID, returning a summary with title, subject species, analysis type, and metabolites; optional output_item can return factors, analysis methods, metabolite list, or full data matrix.

components.name: Metabolomics Workbench exact mass search
components.description: Search metabolites by exact molecular mass in the Metabolomics Workbench repository, using a required mass value in Daltons and optional tolerance, to identify unknown metabolites from high-resolution mass spectrometry.

components.name: Metabolomics Workbench search by m/z
components.description: Search the Metabolomics Workbench for metabolites matching a supplied m/z value and adduct, returning metabolite records for identification from mass spectrometry data.

components.name: Metabolomics Workbench search compound by name
components.description: Search for a metabolite/compound by its name using RefMet nomenclature, returning standardized compound information including formula, exact mass, and classification.

components.name: MetaCyc get compound
components.description: Get metabolite/compound details from MetaCyc by compound ID. Returns compound information and URL to compound page.

components.name: MetaCyc Get Pathway
components.description: Retrieves metabolic pathway details from MetaCyc by pathway ID, returning pathway information, a URL to the pathway diagram, and associated reactions and compounds. Requires a free BioCyc account.

components.name: MetaCyc reaction lookup
components.description: Retrieves reaction details from the MetaCyc database by reaction ID, including substrates, products, enzymes, and the reaction page URL. Requires a BioCyc account.

components.name: MetaCyc search pathways
components.description: Search MetaCyc for metabolic pathways by name or keyword and return pathway IDs and basic information.

components.name: Methodology Rigor Reviewer
components.description: Evaluates a research methods section for design appropriateness, variable clarity, sampling, and procedural transparency, returning ratings and recommended revisions.

components.name: MGI get gene
components.description: Searches the MGI database for mouse genes by symbol, name, keyword, or MGI ID via the Alliance of Genome Resources API, returning matching gene symbols, names, and MGI identifiers.

components.name: MGI gene search
components.description: Searches MGI (Mouse Genome Informatics) for mouse genes by gene symbol, name, keyword, or MGI ID and returns matching gene symbols, names, and MGI identifiers using the Alliance of Genome Resources API.

components.name: MGI gene search
components.description: Searches Mouse Genome Informatics (MGI) for mouse genes by gene symbol, name, keyword, or MGI identifier and returns matching gene symbols, names, and MGI identifiers using the Alliance of Genome Resources API.

components.name: MGnify Get Genome
components.description: Retrieve detailed genome information from the MGnify genome catalog using a genome accession, returning assembly quality metrics, taxonomy, geographic origin, rRNA and protein counts, pangenome statistics, and ENA cross-references.

components.name: MGnify get GO terms
components.description: Retrieve Gene Ontology (GO) functional annotations from an MGnify metagenomics analysis by providing an MGnify analysis accession. Returns GO terms with accession, description, gene count, and category (biological process, molecular function, or cellular component).

components.name: MGnify get InterPro
components.description: Retrieve InterPro protein domain annotations from an MGnify metagenomics analysis, returning InterPro identifiers with descriptions and gene counts ranked by abundance. Accepts an MGnify analysis accession and supports pagination via page size.

components.name: MGnify get samples
components.description: List biological sample records from MGnify (EBI Metagenomics), including accession, BioSample ID, geographic/host/environment provenance and ENVO biome metadata; supports fetching a single sample by sample_accession or paging with optional study_accession and biome filters.

components.name: MGnify study detail
components.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a specific MGnify metagenomics study by study accession, including study name, abstract, associated BioProject, centre, public/private status, sample count, and biomes.

components.name: MGnify get taxonomy
components.description: Retrieves taxonomic composition from an MGnify metagenomics analysis, returning detected organisms with abundance counts, taxonomic lineage (domain/phylum/class/order/family/genus/species), and rank for SSU (16S/18S) and LSU (23S/28S) rRNA marker genes.

components.name: MGnify list analyses
components.description: List analyses associated with a specified MGnify study accession, returning records for available taxonomic and functional results.

components.name: MGnify list analysis downloads
components.description: List download records for an MGnify analysis, allowing retrieval of available analysis download files from the MGnify metagenomics resource.

components.name: MGnify list biomes
components.description: Browse the MGnify biome hierarchy and return biome identifiers, names, and sample counts. The tool supports filtering by hierarchy depth and pagination to discover available metagenomic data across engineered and natural environments.

components.name: MGnify search genomes
components.description: Search the MGnify genome catalog for metagenome-assembled genomes and isolate genomes using a GTDB taxonomy lineage filter. Returns genome records with quality metrics, taxonomic assignment, and protein counts.

components.name: MGnify Search Studies
components.description: Search MGnify metagenomics and microbiome studies by biome identifier or keyword, returning study accessions, names, bioproject IDs, biome names, and analysis counts.

components.name: MHC Motif Atlas get allele ligands
components.description: Retrieve curated naturally-presented MHC ligand peptides for a specified MHC allele from MHC Motif Atlas, covering MHC class I and class II across human, mouse, cattle, and chicken; class II peptides include predicted binding cores and optional per-allele protein sequences.

components.name: MIBiG get stats
components.description: Get summary statistics from the MIBiG biosynthetic gene cluster repository, including counts by status, biosynthetic class, and source organism phylum.

components.name: MIBiG List Clusters
components.description: List biosynthetic gene clusters from the MIBiG repository, with optional client-side filtering by product name or organism via search_term. Returns BGC records including accession, product, biosynthetic class, organism, quality, and completeness.

components.name: miRBase get miRNA
components.description: Retrieve detailed miRNA information from RNAcentral using an RNAcentral URS ID, including RNA sequence, species, RNA type, gene associations, publication count, and source databases. Supports species-specific URS IDs or a base URS ID with an optional taxid.

components.name: miRBase get miRNA publications
components.description: Retrieves publications associated with a microRNA from RNAcentral using an RNAcentral URS identifier. Returns publication titles, authors, PubMed IDs, DOIs, and journal information.

components.name: miRBase get miRNA cross-references
components.description: Retrieves cross-references for a microRNA from RNAcentral using an RNAcentral URS identifier, returning database links from miRBase, TarBase, ENA, RefSeq, piRBase, LncBase and other sources with external accession IDs, URLs, species information and miRBase-specific fields.

components.name: miRBase search miRNA
components.description: Search for microRNAs by name, accession, gene name, or keyword using EBI Search over RNAcentral. Returns RNAcentral IDs, descriptions, sequence lengths, and source databases for matching miRNAs, with optional species and RNA type filters.

components.name: MobiDB get consensus
components.description: Fetches consensus disorder analysis for a protein from MobiDB and returns predicted and curated disorder regions, phase separation propensity, and binding mode transitions. Input is a protein accession (e.g., UniProt), supporting studies of signaling, condensate formation, and protein-protein interactions.

components.name: MobiDB get protein
components.description: Get comprehensive protein intrinsic disorder data from MobiDB for a UniProt accession, returning predicted and curated disordered regions, linear interacting peptides, PTM summaries, and subcellular localization. MobiDB integrates DisProt, MobiDB-lite, PDB, and PTM annotations.

components.name: ModelDB cell type lookup
components.description: Retrieve detailed information about a neuron or cell type by ID from ModelDB, including its name and morphology.

components.name: ModelDB Get Model
components.description: Retrieve full details for a specific computational neuroscience model from ModelDB by model ID. ModelDB is a curated repository of published computational neuroscience models, and this tool returns the complete model record for a given identifier.

components.name: ModelDB get paper
components.description: Retrieves metadata for a scientific paper from ModelDB by numeric paper ID, including title, citation, references, and associated computational neuroscience models.

components.name: ModelDB list celltypes
components.description: List all neuron/cell type IDs available in ModelDB, returning an array of cell type IDs that can be used with ModelDB_get_celltype for full details including name and morphology.

components.name: ModelDB list models
components.description: Lists all computational neuroscience model IDs from ModelDB, optionally filtered by simulation environment name. Returns an array of model IDs suitable for retrieving full model details.

components.name: MODOMICS Get Modification
components.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific RNA modification from MODOMICS by numeric ID, including chemical structure, molecular formula, masses, product ions, and LC elution data for mass spectrometry identification.

components.name: MODOMICS list modifications
components.description: List all known RNA modifications from the MODOMICS database, returning modification names, chemical formulas, molecular masses, SMILES structures, and reference moieties. The tool accepts an optional limit parameter to control the number of results returned.

components.name: MODOMICS search modifications
components.description: Search the MODOMICS database of 430+ RNA modifications by name, short name, or chemical formula and return matching modifications with their chemical details.

components.name: MolGlueDB get compound
components.description: Retrieves a single MolGlueDB molecular glue degrader compound by numeric compound_id, returning structural (SMILES/InChIKey/formula), pharmacophore/scaffold classification, degradation potency, and source-publication data.

components.name: MolGlueDB search compounds
components.description: Full-text search MolGlueDB for molecular glue degrader compounds using a keyword that matches target protein, recruiting protein, compound name, or other indexed fields, returning records with SMILES, pharmacophore/scaffold class, degradation potency, and recruiting protein.

components.name: Monarch association query
components.description: Query disease-gene-phenotype associations in the Monarch Initiative knowledge graph using a subject or object CURIE and optional category filter, returning association records for gene-phenotype, disease-phenotype, gene-disease, and gene-pathway links.

components.name: Monarch get entity
components.description: Retrieves detailed information for a biomedical entity in the Monarch Initiative knowledge graph by its CURIE identifier, including name, category, description, synonyms, cross-references, and species.

components.name: Monarch get gene diseases
components.description: Retrieves diseases associated with a gene from the Monarch Initiative knowledge graph using a gene CURIE.

components.name: Monarch get gene phenotypes
components.description: Retrieve gene-phenotype associations from the Monarch Initiative knowledge graph using a gene CURIE, returning phenotype records.

components.name: Monarch search
components.description: Search the Monarch Initiative knowledge graph for biomedical entities by name or keyword, returning matching genes, diseases, phenotypes and other entities with CURIE identifiers and categories. Supports optional category filtering (biolink:Gene, biolink:Disease, biolink:PhenotypicFeature) to narrow results.

components.name: Monarch search gene
components.description: Search the Monarch Initiative knowledge graph for genes by symbol or name, returning HGNC/NCBI Gene identifiers, cross-species orthologs, and gene metadata.

components.name: Monarch Association Lookup
components.description: Query cross-species associations between biomedical entities in the Monarch Initiative knowledge graph, supporting gene-phenotype, disease-phenotype, gene-disease and gene-pathway associations. Accepts entity identifiers as subject and/or object with an optional Biolink association category and integrates data from OM…

components.name: MonarchV3 get entity
components.description: Look up detailed information about any biomedical entity in the Monarch Initiative knowledge graph by CURIE identifier. Returns entity name, category, description, synonyms, cross-references, and species.

components.name: MonarchV3 Get Histopheno
components.description: Retrieves the phenotype profile of a disease from the Monarch Initiative, grouped by anatomical body system. Accepts a disease identifier (e.g., MONDO ID) and returns counts of HPO phenotype terms per affected system, sorted descending.

components.name: MonarchV3 get mappings
components.description: Retrieves cross-ontology equivalence mappings for a biomedical entity CURIE from the Monarch Initiative. Given an entity identifier, it returns mappings between ontology systems such as MONDO, OMIM, ICD10CM, SNOMED CT, NCIT, MESH, DOID and Orphanet.

components.name: MonarchV3 Phenotype Profile Compare
components.description: Compares two explicit phenotype profiles (HPO term sets) pairwise using Monarch Initiative semantic similarity, returning overall similarity scores and per-term best matches in both directions.

components.name: MonarchV3 phenotype similarity search
components.description: Finds diseases that best match a set of HPO phenotypes using semantic similarity from the Monarch Initiative. Given a patient phenotype profile as a list of HPO IDs, returns diseases ranked by AncestorInformationContent-based phenotype overlap score.

components.name: Monarch V3 search
components.description: Search the Monarch Initiative knowledge graph by name or keyword to find matching genes, diseases, phenotypes, and other biomedical entities, returning their CURIE identifiers and categories.

components.name: Mondo get disease
components.description: Search the Mondo Disease Ontology by disease name or keyword and return matching disease entries with Mondo IDs, descriptions, and cross-references.

components.name: Mondo get disease phenotypes
components.description: Searches the Mondo disease ontology by disease name or keyword and returns matching disease entries with MONDO IDs, descriptions, and cross-references.

components.name: Mondo Disease Search
components.description: Search the Mondo Disease Ontology for diseases by name or keyword and return matching disease entries with Mondo IDs, descriptions, and cross-references.

components.name: MouseMine search
components.description: Search MouseMine, an InterMine data warehouse for mouse genomics data from MGI, across genes, alleles, proteins, publications, gene ontology terms, and protein domains. Takes a search query and returns matching records with category facets and relevance scores.

components.name: MouseMine Search Alleles
components.description: Searches MouseMine specifically for mouse alleles and mutants, returning allele symbols, names, MGI identifiers, allele types, and attribute strings from Mouse Genome Informatics (MGI). Useful for finding knockout/knockin, spontaneous, and transgenic alleles for specific genes.

components.name: MouseMine search genes
components.description: Search MouseMine specifically for mouse protein-coding genes using a gene symbol, gene name, or keyword; returns gene symbols, MGI identifiers, and organism information from Mouse Genome Informatics.

components.name: MPD get phenotype data
components.description: Search ENCODE experiment records mentioning a given mouse strain. Accepts a mouse strain query and returns matching experiment records; the phenotype_category parameter is retained but not applied.

components.name: MR_estimate
components.description: Computes two-sample Mendelian randomization causal estimates from harmonized genetic instrument summary statistics (SNP-exposure and SNP-outcome betas and standard errors). Returns IVW, MR-Egger, weighted-median estimates, and Cochran's Q / I^2 heterogeneity; pure compute without external API.

components.name: MSigDB Check Gene in Set
components.description: Check whether a specific gene belongs to a named MSigDB gene set, including transcription factor targets, miRNA targets, oncogenic signatures, hallmark sets, and other collections for human and mouse.

components.name: MSigDB get gene set members
components.description: Get all gene members of an MSigDB gene set by exact name, returning a parsed gene list. Supports human and mouse collections and covers over 33,000 gene sets including pathways and oncogenic signatures.

components.name: MSigDB get gene set
components.description: Retrieves a specific gene set from MSigDB by its exact name, returning gene symbols, systematic name, PMID, collection, and URLs. Supports human and mouse collections through a species parameter.

components.name: MSigDB Get Hallmark Geneset
components.description: Retrieve a Hallmark gene set from the MSigDB Hallmark collection (H), which contains 50 gene sets representing well-defined biological states and processes. Supports human and mouse collections via a species parameter and returns the matching gene set.

components.name: Multi-agent literature search
components.description: Multi-agent literature search system that uses AI agents to analyze intent, extract keywords, execute parallel searches, and summarize results. Accepts a research query and returns an LLM-generated comprehensive summary of all literature search results in markdown format.

components.name: Mutalyzer back translate
components.description: Converts a protein-level HGVS variant description to possible DNA-level variant descriptions using Mutalyzer, accounting for codon degeneracy.

components.name: Mutalyzer normalize variant
components.description: Validates and normalizes HGVS variant descriptions using Mutalyzer, accepting coding DNA, genomic, protein, or RNA notation and returning normalized HGVS, predicted protein effect, RNA description, and gene symbol.

components.name: Mutalyzer Parse HGVS
components.description: Parse an HGVS variant description into a structured model using the Mutalyzer service, returning the reference sequence ID, coordinate system, variant type, and exact positions.

components.name: MyChem chemical annotation
components.description: Get detailed annotation for a chemical or drug by its InChIKey, DrugBank ID, or ChEMBL ID, returning comprehensive drug information such as mechanisms, targets, interactions, and indications from sources including DrugBank, ChEBI, PubChem, ChEMBL, DrugCentral, and AEOLUS.

components.name: MyChem query chemicals
components.description: Search for chemicals and drugs by name, structure (InChIKey, SMILES), or database ID, and return annotations from sources such as DrugBank, ChEMBL, ChEBI, and PubChem.

components.name: MyDisease get disease
components.description: Retrieves comprehensive disease annotations from MyDisease.info using a disease identifier such as MONDO, DOID, OMIM, or MESH. Returns standardized disease identifiers, definitions, cross-references, associated chemicals, pathways, phenotypes, and gene-disease associations from MONDO, Disease Ontology, CTD, HPO, and D…

components.name: MyDisease Search Diseases
components.description: Search for diseases by keyword in MyDisease.info, which aggregates disease data from MONDO, Disease Ontology, CTD, HPO, and DisGeNET. Returns matching disease identifiers with names and basic annotations.

components.name: MyGene batch query
components.description: Query multiple genes at once using a list of gene identifiers to retrieve annotations or perform ID mapping between different gene ID types via MyGene.info.

components.name: MyGene Gene Annotation
components.description: Retrieve detailed gene annotation for a specific gene using an Entrez or Ensembl gene ID. Returns gene ontology terms, biological pathways, protein domains, and literature references.

components.name: MyGene query genes
components.description: Search for genes by keyword, symbol, name, or identifiers and return gene annotations from sources such as Entrez Gene, Ensembl, UniProt, and HGNC.

components.name: MyVariant Get Pathogenicity Scores
components.description: Retrieves comprehensive pathogenicity prediction scores for a genetic variant from dbNSFP, including REVEL, CADD, AlphaMissense, SIFT, PolyPhen-2, MetaRNN, GERP, PhyloP, and PhastCons, using an HGVS variant ID or genomic coordinates with configurable assembly.

components.name: MyVariant variant annotation lookup
components.description: Get detailed annotations for a specific variant by its HGVS ID or rsID from dbSNP, ClinVar, CADD, and other sources via the MyVariant API. Coordinates default to hg19/GRCh37 and can be set to hg38/GRCh38.

components.name: MyVariant query variants
components.description: Search for genetic variants by rsID, gene, chromosome position, or clinical significance and return variant annotations from dbSNP, ClinVar, gnomAD, and CADD.

components.name: NCA Calculate Bioavailability
components.description: Calculates absolute oral bioavailability (F) from paired intravenous and oral AUC values and doses using F = (AUC_PO × Dose_IV) / (AUC_IV × Dose_PO), and classifies the result as High, Moderate, Low, or Very Low.

components.name: NCA compute parameters
components.description: Performs Non-Compartmental Analysis (NCA) on time-concentration pharmacokinetic data to compute standard PK parameters such as Cmax, Tmax, AUC, half-life, clearance, and volume of distribution using the linear-log trapezoidal method. Accepts arrays of time points and concentrations and returns PK parameter estimates w…

components.name: NCA fit one compartment
components.description: Fit a one-compartment IV bolus pharmacokinetic model to plasma concentration-time data using nonlinear least squares, returning estimated parameters such as C0, elimination rate constant, half-life, and optionally volume of distribution and clearance.

components.name: NCATS Translator query associations
components.description: Queries biomedical associations for a Translator-normalized entity CURIE and returns matching association records.

components.name: NCATS Translator resolve entity
components.description: Resolve a free-text biomedical name to Translator-normalized identifiers (CURIEs) via SRI Name Resolution, returning ranked matches with biolink categories, species, and synonym samples.

components.name: NCBI fetch accessions
components.description: Search NCBI nucleotide databases (GenBank, EMBL, RefSeq) by organism, gene, strain, and sequence type to discover DNA/RNA sequence identifiers. Returns GenBank UIDs and EMBL/GenBank/RefSeq accession numbers for matching sequences.

components.name: NCBI get sequence
components.description: Retrieve DNA/RNA sequence data from NCBI by accession number, returning sequences in specified format (FASTA, GenBank, EMBL) with annotations depending on format.

components.name: NCBI Search Nucleotide
components.description: Search NCBI Nucleotide (GenBank/EMBL/RefSeq) by organism, gene name, or keywords and return nucleotide accession identifiers, with optional filters for organism, gene, strain, and sequence type.

components.name: NCBI SRA get download URLs
components.description: Retrieves FTP, AWS S3, and web download URLs for SRA runs from accession numbers, enabling programmatic access to public sequencing data.

components.name: NCBI SRA get run info
components.description: Get detailed metadata for SRA run accessions from NCBI SRA, including sequencing platform, instrument model, library strategy, sample and study details, organism, and data statistics.

components.name: NCBI SRA link to BioSample
components.description: Links SRA sequencing run accessions or UIDs to their associated BioSample records and returns BioSample UIDs for retrieving sample metadata, including sample attributes, tissue type, cell line, treatment conditions, donor information, and collection details.

components.name: NCBI SRA Locate Run Files
components.description: Resolve the current verified cloud download location(s), exact byte size, and md5 checksum for an SRA run accession using the NCBI SRA Data Locator (SDL) service. Accepts SRR/ERR/DRR run accessions and returns S3/GCP URLs, storage region, and modification date.

components.name: NCBI SRA Search Runs
components.description: Search NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) for NGS/RNA-seq sequencing runs by study accession, organism, sequencing strategy, platform, or library source, returning SRA UIDs for downstream metadata and download retrieval.

components.name: NCBI Datasets get gene
components.description: Retrieve comprehensive gene information from NCBI Gene by numeric Gene ID, returning gene symbol, description, chromosomal location, genomic coordinates, cross-references to UniProt/Ensembl/OMIM, synonyms, and annotation details for all organisms.

components.name: NCBI Datasets get gene by symbol
components.description: Look up gene information by gene symbol and organism from the NCBI Gene database. Accepts a gene symbol and optional species (common name or taxonomy ID, defaulting to human) and returns gene records with taxonomic details.

components.name: NCBI Datasets genome assembly metadata lookup
components.description: Retrieves genome assembly metadata for a RefSeq GCF_ or GenBank GCA_ accession from the NCBI Datasets v2 API, including organism, strain, assembly statistics, submitter, BioProject and annotation provider.

components.name: NCBI Datasets Get Orthologs
components.description: Get orthologous genes across species for a given NCBI Gene ID using NCBI's Ortholog pipeline, returning ortholog records with gene symbols, species, and gene types.

components.name: NCBI Datasets Get Sequence Reports
components.description: Get per-sequence reports for a genome assembly via the NCBI Datasets v2 API, returning chromosome/plasmid/scaffold names, roles, location types, RefSeq and GenBank accessions, lengths, GC%, and pagination metadata.

components.name: NCBI Datasets get taxonomy
components.description: Retrieves detailed NCBI Taxonomy information for a given taxonomy ID, including organism name, rank, lineage, gene/assembly/RNA counts, and child taxa.

components.name: List genomes by taxon
components.description: List genome assemblies available for a taxon (NCBI tax id or scientific name) via the NCBI Datasets v2 API, returning summary records with accession, assembly level, RefSeq category, release date, total length, N50, and GC percent.

components.name: NCBI Datasets Suggest Taxonomy
components.description: Searches NCBI Taxonomy for organism names matching a partial query and returns matching scientific names, taxonomy IDs, common names, and ranks.

components.name: NCBI Gene summary retrieval
components.description: Retrieve detailed summary information for NCBI Gene records using Entrez Gene IDs via the E-utilities API.

components.name: NCBI Gene search
components.description: Search the NCBI Gene database through E-utilities to resolve gene symbols, names, or keywords combined with an organism filter into standardized Entrez Gene IDs.

components.name: NCBI Protein get summary
components.description: Get protein record summary from the NCBI Protein database by GI number or accession using the E-utilities ESummary API. Returns protein title, organism, accession version, sequence length, molecular type, source database, and creation/update dates.

components.name: NCBI Variation ALFA frequencies by rsID
components.description: Retrieves ALFA per-ancestry allele frequencies and allele counts for a dbSNP rsID from NCBI Variation Services, resolving population/ancestry information and aggregating dbGaP subjects. Accepts rsID with or without the 'rs' prefix and returns frequencies broken down by population/ancestry.

components.name: HGVS to SPDI conversion
components.description: Converts an HGVS variant description to SPDI notation using NCBI Variation Services, accepting genomic, coding, or RNA HGVS expressions and returning the equivalent SPDI representation(s).

components.name: NCBIVariation rsID lookup
components.description: Look up a dbSNP rsID and retrieve variant details including GRCh38 coordinates, associated genes, ClinVar clinical significance, citations, and MANE Select transcript IDs. Accepts rsID with or without the 'rs' prefix and returns a structured summary of the variant.

components.name: NCBI Variation SPDI canonical
components.description: Normalizes a variant given in SPDI notation to its canonical form using the top-level chromosome sequence, returning a single normalized representation for variant deduplication and consistent storage.

components.name: NCBI Variation SPDI equivalents
components.description: Get all equivalent SPDI representations of a variant across different reference sequences and genome assemblies (GRCh37/GRCh38, RefSeqGene, transcript) given one SPDI. Returns the same variant mapped to available coordinate systems for liftover and cross-referencing variants described on different reference sequences.

components.name: NCBI Variation SPDI to HGVS
components.description: Converts a variant from SPDI notation to HGVS genomic notation using NCBI Variation Services, taking an SPDI string such as NC_000001.11:230710047:A:G and returning the equivalent HGVS description.

components.name: NCBI Variation SPDI to rsIDs
components.description: Reverse lookup from a normalized SPDI variant (SeqID:Position:Deleted:Inserted) to co-located dbSNP rsID(s) using NCBI Variation Services /spdi/{spdi}/rsids; returns a list of integer rsIDs.

components.name: VCF to SPDI conversion
components.description: Convert a raw VCF four-field variant (RefSeq accession, position, reference allele, alternate allele) to a normalized contextual SPDI on a RefSeq sequence using NCBI Variation Services.

components.name: NCCN Get Patient Guideline
components.description: Fetches and scrapes a specified NCCN Guidelines for Patients page using a URL obtained from NCCN_list_patient_guidelines, returning title, content sections, and PDF download links organized by section.

components.name: NCCN list patient guidelines
