components.description: Lists all NCCN (National Comprehensive Cancer Network) Guidelines for Patients available on nccn.org, which are free, publicly accessible cancer treatment guides organized by cancer type, detection/prevention, supportive care, and specific populations. Returns cancer type names, URLs, and category, covering over 70 ca…

components.name: NCCN search guidelines
components.description: Search NCCN clinical practice guidelines and related publications via PubMed using a free-text query. Returns matching records with cancer type, URL, and category metadata from JNCCN and other NCCN publications.

components.name: NCI Drug Dictionary browse by letter
components.description: Browse the NCI Drug Dictionary by first letter and return all cancer drugs and drug aliases starting with that letter, including drug name, preferred name, type, and pretty URL name for detailed lookups.

components.name: NCI Get Drug by Name
components.description: Looks up detailed cancer drug information from the NCI Drug Dictionary by pretty URL name (slug), returning definition, aliases, NCI concept ID, and links to drug information summaries.

components.name: NCI Search Cancer Resources
components.description: Searches the NCI Resources for Researchers collection for cancer research tools, databases, datasets, and clinical research resources using a free-text query and returns matching resource descriptions, links, tool types, research areas, and research types.

components.name: NCICACTUS Resolve
components.description: Converts chemical identifiers using the NCI CACTUS Chemical Identifier Resolver. Accepts chemical names, SMILES, InChI, InChIKey, or CAS registry numbers and resolves them to supported representations such as SMILES, IUPAC name, molecular formula, molecular weight, CAS number, standard InChI, InChIKey, or synonyms.

components.name: NCI Drug Dictionary get drug
components.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific drug from the NCI Drug Dictionary by term ID, including definition, NCI concept ID, aliases, and a summary link. Use NCIDrugDict_search first to find term IDs.

components.name: NCI Drug Dictionary search
components.description: Search the NCI Drug Dictionary for cancer drugs, agents, and therapeutic compounds by name, brand name, or chemical name; returns drug names, definitions, NCI concept IDs, aliases, and links to drug information summaries.

components.name: NCI EVS get concept
components.description: Retrieve a biomedical concept record from NCI Enterprise Vocabulary Services by terminology and concept code, returning structured concept metadata for downstream use.

components.name: NCIEVS search terminology
components.description: Searches NCI EVS clinical and biomedical terminologies by keyword term and returns matching concept codes for further retrieval with NCIEVS_get_concept.

components.name: NCI Thesaurus Get Children
components.description: Get the direct child concepts of an NCI Thesaurus concept code, returning immediate subcategories/subtypes in the NCI ontology hierarchy for navigating cancer terminology.

components.name: NCI Thesaurus get concept
components.description: Get detailed information about an NCI Thesaurus concept by its code, including name, definition, synonyms, semantic types, and cross-references to SNOMED, MedDRA, and CDISC. Useful for standardized cancer terminology and finding related concepts.

components.name: NCI Thesaurus concept maps
components.description: Retrieves cross-vocabulary maps for an NCI Thesaurus concept code, returning mappings to MedDRA, SNOMED-CT, GDC, ICD and other clinical terminologies.

components.name: NCI Thesaurus Get Parents
components.description: Get the direct parent concepts of an NCI Thesaurus concept code, walking upward in the NCIt polyhierarchy to superconcepts and drug-class parents. Accepts an NCI Thesaurus concept code and returns the immediate parent concepts.

components.name: NCI Thesaurus search
components.description: Search the NCI Thesaurus (NCIt) by term to retrieve matching biomedical concepts with NCI codes, names, and semantic types.

components.name: NDEx get network
components.description: Retrieve a network record from NDEx using a network UUID and return its metadata, including name, description, owner, and node/edge counts.

components.name: NDEx get network summary
components.description: Retrieve summary information for a specified network from the NDEx database using its UUID, returning metadata such as name, description, owner, and node count.

components.name: NDEx Search Networks
components.description: Searches the NDEx biological network repository by keyword to find published networks such as protein-protein interaction, signaling, gene regulatory, and metabolic networks, returning network names, node/edge counts, DOIs, and UUIDs.

components.name: NEB Tm calculate
components.description: Calculates primer melting temperature (Tm) and annealing temperature (Ta) using the NEB Tm Calculator API, applying nearest-neighbor thermodynamics with polymerase-specific salt corrections. Accepts primer sequences and a polymerase selection, and returns Tm and Ta values.

components.name: NEB Tm list polymerases
components.description: Lists available polymerase product codes for use with NEB Tm calculation tools, including common codes such as q5-0, phusion-0, taq-0, and onetaq-0.

components.name: Network proximity
components.description: Calculates network proximity between two node sets on a user-supplied network using closest, shortest, or separation measures, returning the proximity value, degree-matched random Z-score, and empirical p-value.

components.name: NeuroMorpho get field values
components.description: Retrieve available values for a specified metadata field from the NeuroMorpho database of neuron reconstructions. Given a field name such as species or brain_region, it returns the values present in the database.

components.name: NeuroMorpho Get Literature
components.description: Retrieve literature records from NeuroMorpho.Org using a query over publication metadata fields such as article ID, DOI, PMID, journal, title, authors, or species. Returns matching source-publication records.

components.name: NeuroMorpho morphometry lookup
components.description: Retrieves morphometric measurements for a neuron from NeuroMorpho.Org using a numeric neuron ID or neuron name, returning properties such as surface area, volume, bifurcations, branches, and fractal dimension.

components.name: NeuroMorpho Get Neuron
components.description: Retrieves detailed neuron reconstruction data from NeuroMorpho.Org by neuron ID or name, including species, brain region, cell type, staining method, reconstruction software, morphological attributes, and associated publications.

components.name: NeuroMorpho get persistence vector
components.description: Retrieves the persistence vector (Topological Morphology Descriptor, TMD) for a NeuroMorpho neuron by numeric neuron_id, returning a 100-coefficient shape signature and scaling factor for ML clustering and classification of neuronal morphology.

components.name: NeuroMorpho search literature
components.description: Search NeuroMorpho source-publication records linked to neuron reconstructions by neuroscience-specific fields, returning publication metadata along with associated species, brain region, cell type, and tracing system.

components.name: NeuroMorpho Search Neurons
components.description: Search NeuroMorpho.Org for neuron reconstructions by species, brain region, cell type, or other attributes and return a paginated list of matching neurons.

components.name: NeuroVault get atlas
components.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a labeled anatomical brain atlas map from NeuroVault by atlas ID, including atlas name, NIfTI label image URL, label description file URL, parent collection, and acquisition metadata.

components.name: NeuroVault Get Collection
components.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a NeuroVault neuroimaging collection by its ID, including title, DOI, authors, journal, imaging parameters, study design information, and number of statistical map images.

components.name: NeuroVault get image
components.description: Get detailed metadata for a specific brain statistical map image in NeuroVault by image ID. Returns map type, cognitive paradigm and contrast annotations from Cognitive Atlas, analysis level, modality, and a file download URL in NIfTI format.

components.name: NeuroVault list atlases
components.description: List labeled anatomical brain atlas maps (parcellation/label images) hosted on NeuroVault. Each atlas is a label image (NIfTI) paired with a label-description file (XML/text) that names each parcel/region. Returns metadata including name, the .nii.gz file URL, the label_description_file URL, and the parent collection.…

components.name: NeuroVault list collection images
components.description: Lists all statistical map images in a specified NeuroVault collection, returning image metadata including name, map type, cognitive paradigm/contrast annotations, and file download URLs.

components.name: NeuroVault list collections
components.description: List and browse neuroimaging statistical map collections from NeuroVault, returning collections of brain images (fMRI, PET, EEG) with metadata about studies, DOIs, authors, and imaging parameters. Supports pagination via limit and offset parameters.

components.name: Nextstrain get dataset
components.description: Get metadata and phylogenetic summary for a Nextstrain pathogen dataset, including title, last update date, number of sequences, data provenance, maintainers, root node attributes, and available coloring options.

components.name: Nextstrain list datasets
components.description: Lists available pathogen phylogenetic datasets from Nextstrain, grouped by pathogen with dataset counts. Accepts an optional pathogen name filter and can list all datasets by setting datasets_per_pathogen=0.

components.name: NHANES Download and Parse
components.description: Download and parse NHANES XPT data files from the CDC into structured JSON (DataFrame-ready) records. The tool accepts NHANES cycle and dataset identifiers, optional variable selection and age filtering, and returns column metadata, summary statistics, and the first 5000 rows as JSON records.

components.name: NHANES dataset info
components.description: Get information about NHANES (National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey) datasets, including available datasets, years, and download links. Accepts an optional NHANES cycle year and returns dataset metadata from the CDC-hosted survey data repository.

components.name: NHANES dataset search
components.description: Search NHANES datasets by keyword, with an optional NHANES cycle filter. Returns metadata about matching datasets including download links.

components.name: NICE Clinical Guidelines Search
components.description: Search NICE (National Institute for Health and Care Excellence) clinical guidelines and evidence-based recommendations by medical condition, treatment, or clinical topic, returning matching guideline records.

components.name: NICE Guideline Full Text
components.description: Fetch complete full text content from a NICE clinical guideline page by URL, extracting all sections, recommendations, and complete guideline text.

components.name: NIH DSLD product search
components.description: Searches the NIH Dietary Supplement Label Database (DSLD) by product name, brand, or ingredient and returns matching supplement product records including product ID, brand, product type, and market status. Accepts a query and optional result limit.

components.name: NIHDSLD search products
components.description: Search the NIH Dietary Supplement Label Database (DSLD), covering over 200,000 US supplement product labels, by product name, brand, or ingredient. Returns each match's product_id, brand, product type, and market status.

components.name: NIH RePORTER project search
components.description: Full-text search NIH RePORTER, NIH's public database of approximately 3 million funded research projects since 1985, across project title, terms, and abstract. Accepts a free-text query with optional fiscal year and organization filters, and returns project numbers and application IDs.

components.name: NIH Reporter project search
components.description: Full-text search of NIH RePORTER's public database of funded research projects by query across project title, terms, and abstract, with optional filters for fiscal year and organization, returning project identifiers.

components.name: Norine Get Peptide
components.description: Look up non-ribosomal peptide (NRP) records from Norine by peptide name or Norine ID. Returns curated peptide structure, molecular formula/weight, SMILES, biological activity, source organism, and literature references.

components.name: NPAtlas get compound
components.description: Get the full NPAtlas record for a microbial natural product by its NPAID, including chemical identifiers, structure, source organism, literature reference, synonyms, and external database IDs.

components.name: NPAtlas search compounds
components.description: Search the Natural Products Atlas (NPAtlas) for microbial natural products by compound name, InChIKey, molecular formula, or SMILES, and retrieve matching compounds with identifiers, chemical properties, and source organism.

components.name: NPIProvider search
components.description: Search the NPPES NPI Registry through the NLM Clinical Table Search Service by provider or organization name, returning matches with NPI, specialty/type, and practice address.

components.name: NVIDIA NIM AlphaFold2
components.description: Predict protein 3D structure from an amino acid sequence using DeepMind's AlphaFold2 via NVIDIA NIM, returning PDB format. Supports MSA search with jackhmmer or mmseqs2 and sequence databases uniref90, mgnify, and small_bfd.

components.name: NVIDIA NIM AlphaFold2 Multimer
components.description: Predicts multi-chain protein complex structures from 1-6 protein sequences using AlphaFold2-Multimer via NVIDIA NIM, returning predicted complex structures with PDB coordinates, confidence scores, and model metrics; runs as an asynchronous operation.

components.name: NvidiaNIM Boltz2
components.description: Predicts 3D structures of multi-molecular complexes containing proteins, DNA, RNA, and ligands using Boltz2 via NVIDIA NIM. Accepts polymer sequences and ligand identifiers and returns predicted structures in PDB format through a long-running asynchronous operation.

components.name: NVIDIA NIM DiffDock
components.description: Blind molecular docking using DiffDock via NVIDIA NIM. Predicts ligand binding poses without specifying a binding pocket from a protein PDB structure and ligand SDF/MOL block, returning docking poses with per-pose confidence scores.

components.name: ESM2-650M Protein Embedding
components.description: Generate protein sequence embeddings using the ESM2-650M language model via NVIDIA NIM. Accepts an array of protein sequences and returns embedding vectors as NPZ or JSON.

components.name: NvidiaNIM ESMFold
components.description: Fast alignment-free protein structure prediction using ESMFold via NVIDIA NIM. Accepts an amino acid sequence (max 1024 characters) and returns a PDB structure.

components.name: NVIDIA NIM Evo2
components.description: Generates DNA sequences from an input DNA sequence using the NVIDIA-hosted Evo 2 genome foundation model. Supports selectable model sizes (evo2-40b or evo2-7b) and optional per-nucleotide probability output.

components.name: NVIDIA NIM GenMol
components.description: Generate molecules from SMILES/SAFE templates with masked regions using GenMol via NVIDIA NIM, returning generated molecules with property scores.

components.name: NvidiaNIM MAISI
components.description: Generate synthetic CT images with segmentation masks using MAISI via NVIDIA NIM, a 3D Latent Diffusion Model for medical imaging data augmentation. Inputs include body region, anatomy list, controllable anatomy size, and output size; returns a ZIP archive of NIfTI/NRRD images and labels.

components.name: NvidiaNIM MolMIM
components.description: Generates molecules with optimized properties based on a reference SMILES string using MolMIM via NVIDIA NIM. Accepts a reference molecule, number of molecules, and algorithm, and returns generated molecules with property scores such as QED or LogP.

components.name: Nvidia NIM MSA search
components.description: GPU-accelerated multiple sequence alignment search using ColabFold/MMseqs2 via NVIDIA NIM. Accepts a protein sequence and returns MSA alignments in a3m/fasta format for structure prediction pipelines. Long-running async operation.

components.name: NvidiaNIM OpenFold2
components.description: Predict protein 3D structure from an amino acid sequence and pre-computed MSA alignments using OpenFold2 via NVIDIA NIM, returning PDB format structure with pLDDT confidence in B-factor.

components.name: NvidiaNIM OpenFold3
components.description: Predicts biomolecular complex structures for proteins, DNA, RNA and ligands using OpenFold3 via NVIDIA NIM. It performs AlphaFold3-style prediction from molecule inputs and returns structures with PDB coordinates and model quality metrics.

components.name: NvidiaNIM ProteinMPNN
components.description: Designs protein sequences for a given backbone structure using ProteinMPNN via NVIDIA NIM (inverse folding). Accepts PDB structure text and returns designed sequences in Multi-FASTA format with log-probabilities.

components.name: NVIDIA NIM RFdiffusion
components.description: Generates de novo protein designs, binders, or scaffold motifs using RFdiffusion via NVIDIA NIM. Accepts contig DSL, optional input PDB for scaffolding, and hotspot residues for binding site design, and returns designed sequences in Multi-FASTA format with per-residue log-probabilities.

components.name: NVIDIA NIM VISTA-3D
components.description: Segments 3D medical images (CT scans) into organ and structure masks using VISTA-3D via NVIDIA NIM. Accepts an image URL (NIfTI/NRRD), class prompts, and optional point prompts, and returns a ZIP file of segmentation masks.

components.name: ODPHP item list
components.description: Browses and returns available topics and categories from the ODPHP item list endpoint, using language and type parameters to help narrow broad requests.

components.name: ODPHP MyHealthfinder
components.description: Provides personalized preventive-care recommendations based on age, sex, and pregnancy status, returning metadata, plain-language sections, and dataset links to full articles.

components.name: ODPHP Outlink Fetch
components.description: Retrieves personalized preventive-care recommendations from ODPHP MyHealthfinder based on age, sex, and pregnancy status, returning metadata, plain-language sections, and links to full recommendation articles.

components.name: ODPHP Topic Search
components.description: Searches ODPHP (Office of Disease Prevention and Health Promotion) topics by query and returns full topic content.

components.name: OLS Get EFO Ontology Info
components.description: Retrieves metadata about the EFO ontology itself, including version, status, number of terms, and title/description.

components.name: OLS Get EFO Term
components.description: Retrieve an Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO) term from the Ontology Lookup Service (OLS) using its IRI or OBO ID.

components.name: OLS get EFO term children
components.description: Retrieve child terms of a specified Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO) term using its IRI or OBO ID via the Ontology Lookup Service (OLS).

components.name: OLS get EFO term descendants
components.description: Lists transitive descendant terms of an Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO) term given an IRI or OBO ID, returning descendant terms and a total count via the OLS REST API.

components.name: OLS get ontology info
components.description: Retrieve detailed information about an ontology by ontology ID or abbreviation from the Ontology Lookup Service (OLS).

components.name: OLS get term ancestors
components.description: Get ancestor terms of a specific ontology term using either a CURIE term ID or a full term IRI plus ontology.

components.name: OLS Get Term Children
components.description: Get child terms of a specific ontology term using the Ontology Lookup Service (OLS). Accepts a CURIE term ID or an explicit term IRI with ontology and returns the matching child terms.

components.name: OLS term info lookup
components.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific ontology term from the Ontology Lookup Service (OLS) using an ontology term ID or IRI.

components.name: OLS get term cross-references
components.description: Retrieves cross-references (obo_xref) for an ontology term from the Ontology Lookup Service (OLS). Accepts a CURIE-style term ID (e.g., EFO:0004611) and returns mapped identifiers and resolver URLs in external vocabularies such as DOID, OMIM, MeSH, and SNOMED.

components.name: OLS List Ontologies
components.description: List available ontologies in OLS (not limited to EFO). Useful to discover ontology IDs, sizes, and status. Takes an optional size parameter to limit the number of ontologies returned.

components.name: OLS Search EFO Terms
components.description: Search the Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO) through the Ontology Lookup Service (OLS) v4 to find term IRIs and OBO IDs for a free-text concept query. Accepts a required query string and optional maximum result count, returning matching ontology terms.

components.name: OLS Search Ontologies
components.description: Search for ontologies in OLS using a text query and return matching ontology records.

components.name: OLS Search Terms
components.description: Search for terms in OLS (Ontology Lookup Service) by keyword query, with optional ontology filtering, returning matching ontology term records.

components.name: OMA get genome pair orthologs
components.description: Retrieve the complete set of pairwise orthologs between two whole genomes (proteome-vs-proteome) from OMA by supplying species codes or NCBI taxon IDs. Each returned pair includes OMA identifiers, relationship type, evolutionary distance, and alignment score for comparative-genomics and synteny analyses.

components.name: OMA Get Group
components.description: Get OMA Group details including member proteins, using an OMA group ID. Returns strict 1:1 orthologs across genomes, with group fingerprint, description, and members from species such as fish, mammals, and other vertebrates.

components.name: OMA get HOG
components.description: Retrieve Hierarchical Orthologous Group (HOG) information from the OMA orthology database using a HOG identifier. Returns HOG details such as gene family membership, taxonomic range, completeness score, and child HOGs.

components.name: OMA Get Orthologs
components.description: Retrieves pairwise orthologs for a protein entry from the OMA (Orthologous MAtrix) Browser, returning orthologous proteins across species with relationship type, evolutionary distance, and alignment score.

components.name: OMA Get Protein
components.description: Retrieve protein information from the OMA (Orthologous MAtrix) database by UniProt accession or OMA ID, returning species, genomic location, OMA group membership, and Hierarchical Orthologous Group (HOG) assignment.

components.name: OMA get protein GO
components.description: Retrieves Gene Ontology (GO) annotations for a protein from the OMA database using an OMA protein identifier.

components.name: OMA Resolve Xref
components.description: Resolve gene names, gene symbols, UniProt entry names, or other cross-reference identifiers to OMA protein entries, returning OMA identifiers and associated genome information.

components.name: OmicsDI get dataset
components.description: Get detailed information about a specific omics dataset in OmicsDI by accession number and source database, returning full metadata including description, protocols, instruments, organisms, tissues, diseases, publication IDs, and download links.

components.name: OmicsDI get statistics
components.description: Get statistics about the OmicsDI omics data repositories, returning counts of datasets across domains, organisms, and tissue types based on a stat_type parameter.

components.name: OmicsDI Search Datasets
components.description: Search across multiple omics repositories integrated in OmicsDI, including GEO, ArrayExpress, PRIDE, MetaboLights, MetabolomicsWorkbench, and PeptideAtlas, by query text and optional omics type, organism, tissue, or date filters. Returns omics dataset records with IDs, titles, sources, organisms, omics types, and cita…

components.name: OMIM get clinical synopsis
components.description: Retrieves the clinical synopsis (phenotype features) for an OMIM phenotype entry, returning structured clinical features organized by body system. Accepts an OMIM phenotype MIM number as input.

components.name: OMIM Get Entry
components.description: Retrieves detailed Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man (OMIM) entries by MIM number, returning comprehensive information such as text description, clinical features, inheritance, molecular genetics, and references.

components.name: OMIM Gene Map Lookup
components.description: Retrieves OMIM gene-disease mapping information by MIM number or chromosome, returning genes mapped to chromosomal locations with associated phenotypes and inheritance patterns.

components.name: OMIM Search
components.description: Search the OMIM database for Mendelian diseases and genes using gene names, disease names, or phenotype keywords. Returns MIM numbers, titles, and entry types.

components.name: OmniPath Get Annotation Resource Geneset
components.description: Retrieves the entire annotated gene/protein set for a specified OmniPath annotation resource, returning a list of all genes/proteins in that resource. Input is an annotation resource identifier; output is the corresponding gene/protein members.

components.name: OmniPath cell communication annotations
components.description: Retrieves cell-cell communication annotations for proteins from OmniPath, including databases such as CellPhoneDB, CellChatDB, CellTalkDB, and ICELLNET. Returns ligand/receptor roles, signaling pathway assignments, and categories for queried proteins.

components.name: OmniPath Get Complexes
components.description: Retrieve protein complex compositions from OmniPath's comprehensive complex database, integrating data from CORUM, CellPhoneDB, CellChatDB, ComplexPortal, PDB, Guide2Pharma, SIGNOR, KEGG, and other resources. Returns complex names, component proteins with gene symbols, stoichiometry, and database identifiers.

components.name: OmniPath Get DoRothEA Regulon
components.description: Retrieves the DoRothEA regulon for a given transcription factor from OmniPath, returning target genes with mode of regulation, confidence levels, and source databases. Supports optional filtering by DoRothEA confidence levels A, B, and C.

components.name: OmniPath get enzyme substrate
components.description: Retrieves enzyme-substrate (post-translational modification) interactions from OmniPath, integrating data from PhosphoSite, phosphoELM, dbPTM, SIGNOR, HPRD, KEA, and other PTM databases. Returns kinase/phosphatase-substrate relationships with residue positions, modification types, and supporting evidence.

components.name: OmniPath intercellular communication roles
components.description: Retrieve intercellular communication roles for proteins from the OmniPath database, including functional categories such as ligand, receptor, adhesion, and transporter, locational annotations, consensus scores, and supporting database evidence.

components.name: OmniPath get ligand receptor interactions
components.description: Retrieves ligand-receptor interaction pairs from OmniPath, an integrated intercellular communication database combining CellPhoneDB, CellChatDB, CellTalkDB, connectomeDB, Ramilowski2015, Guide2Pharma, HPMR, and other curated resources. Accepts gene or protein queries and returns source/target proteins with directional…

components.name: OmniPath signaling interactions
components.description: Get intracellular signaling pathway interactions from OmniPath curated datasets, including literature-curated directed protein-protein interactions, pathway activity flow from Reactome/KEGG/WikiPathways, and kinase-substrate relationships from PhosphoSite/dbPTM. Returns directed, signed interactions with stimulation/i…

components.name: OmniPath TF target interactions
components.description: Retrieve transcription factor to target gene interactions from OmniPath DoRothEA and CollecTRI regulons, querying by TF gene symbol or target gene, and return directed pairs with regulation mode, DoRothEA confidence levels, and supporting evidence.

components.name: OncoKB annotate copy number
components.description: Annotates gene copy number alterations, such as amplification and deletion, using OncoKB to return evidence of oncogenic potential in cancer.

components.name: OncoKB annotate mutations
components.description: Annotates a cancer mutation using OncoKB, accepting a mutation query string such as 'BRAF V600E' or separate gene and protein variant parameters, and returns oncogenicity, mutation effect, and FDA-approved therapies.

components.name: OncoKB annotate variant
components.description: Annotates cancer mutations using the OncoKB knowledge base. Accepts a query string or separate gene and variant parameters and returns oncogenicity, mutation effect, and FDA-approved therapies.

components.name: OncoKB get cancer genes
components.description: Retrieves the list of all cancer genes curated in OncoKB, including genes classified as oncogenes and/or tumor suppressors. Useful for checking if a gene is a known cancer driver. Requires ONCOKB_API_TOKEN environment variable.

components.name: OncoKB gene info lookup
components.description: Get gene-level oncogenic information from OncoKB by gene symbol. Returns whether the gene is an oncogene, tumor suppressor, or both, together with curated background information.

components.name: OncoKB_get_levels
components.description: Get OncoKB evidence level definitions, returning descriptions of all therapeutic actionability levels (1, 2, 3A, 3B, 4, R1, R2) with level 1 being FDA-approved, level 2 standard care, and level 3A compelling clinical evidence.

components.name: OncoTree get type
components.description: Retrieve detailed information about an OncoTree cancer type by exact code, including name, main type, tissue, hierarchy parent and level, MSK visualization color, revision history, and cross-references to UMLS and NCI Thesaurus.

components.name: OncoTree list tissues
components.description: List all tissue categories in the OncoTree cancer hierarchy, returning the unique set of tissue/organ names used as top-level groupings from the OncoTree database. Accepts an optional OncoTree version to select the dataset release.

components.name: OncoTree Search
components.description: Search the OncoTree cancer type ontology by name, code, main type, or tissue to return standardized cancer type codes with UMLS and NCI Thesaurus cross-references.

components.name: Open Deep Research Agent
components.description: Accepts a research task and coordinates a web researcher and synthesizer to gather and validate facts, then returns a concise, unit-aware final answer with citations.

components.name: OpenAIRE search datasets
components.description: Search OpenAIRE for research datasets from the European open science ecosystem, including EU-funded projects and national repositories. Accepts keyword queries with optional funder and country filters, and returns matching dataset records.

components.name: OpenAIRE project search
components.description: Searches OpenAIRE for funded research projects and grants, returning details such as grant code, title, funder, dates, amount, and website.

components.name: OpenAIRE search publications
components.description: Search OpenAIRE Explore for research products, including publications, datasets, and software, using a keyword query and optional type and max_results filters. Returns matching research product records.

components.name: OpenAlex Get Author
components.description: Fetches author details from OpenAlex using an Author ID (A...).

components.name: OpenAlex institution lookup
components.description: Fetch detailed metadata for a single OpenAlex institution by its institution ID, returning the institution record from the OpenAlex database.

components.name: OpenAlex get source
components.description: Searches OpenAlex for scholarly sources (journals, repositories) by name or ISSN and returns source records with citation counts, open-access status, and summary metrics such as h-index and 2-year mean citedness.

components.name: OpenAlex Get Work
components.description: Search OpenAlex for scholarly works using a search query and optional filter string, returning matching work records that include OpenAlex work IDs and DOIs.

components.name: OpenAlex Get Work by DOI
components.description: Retrieves a scholarly work record from the OpenAlex database by DOI, returning metadata such as open access links and content URLs when available.

components.name: OpenAlex Guidelines Search
components.description: Search for clinical practice guidelines using the OpenAlex scholarly database by medical condition or clinical topic, returning guideline records with citation metrics and institutional affiliations.

components.name: OpenAlex literature search
components.description: Search academic literature through OpenAlex using keyword queries, returning paper metadata and, when available, open-access links or content URLs.

components.name: OpenAlex search authors
components.description: Search OpenAlex authors by name via the /authors endpoint to discover author identifiers and records. Accepts an author name query and pagination options, and returns matching author records.

components.name: OpenAlex Institution Search
components.description: Searches OpenAlex institutions by name using the /institutions endpoint and returns matching institution records. Useful for discovering OpenAlex Institution IDs for subsequent detail retrieval.

components.name: OpenAlex search sources
components.description: Search OpenAlex sources (journals, conferences, repositories) by name or ISSN and return source-level bibliometric impact metrics including Source ID, display name, ISSN-L and ISSNs, publisher, works_count, cited_by_count, open-access status, and summary statistics such as h-index, i10-index, and 2-year mean citedness.

components.name: OpenAlex Search Works
components.description: Search OpenAlex works (papers) via the /works endpoint, supporting general keyword search and optional full-text-index filtering, to discover Work IDs and DOIs for follow-up retrieval.

components.name: OpenCitations Get Citation Count
components.description: Retrieves the total citation count for a scientific article by DOI from the OpenCitations COCI index, faster than fetching the full citation list.

components.name: OpenCitations get citations
components.description: Get the list of papers that cite a given scientific article, including citation count and citing papers, using the OpenCitations COCI index. Accepts a DOI and returns citing records and citation count.

components.name: OpenCitations get references
components.description: Retrieves the list of papers cited by a given scientific article (its reference list) from the OpenCitations COCI index using a DOI as input, returning citation links with DOIs, publication dates, and time spans between publications.

components.name: OpenCRAVAT annotate variant
components.description: Annotates a single genomic variant with OpenCRAVAT, accepting chromosome, GRCh38 position, reference and alternate alleles, and returning gene name, amino acid change, consequence type and requested annotator results from sources such as ClinVar, gnomAD, SIFT, PolyPhen-2, REVEL, AlphaMissense, SpliceAI, GERP, PhastCon…

components.name: OpenCRAVAT list annotators
components.description: Lists available annotation modules on the OpenCRAVAT server, including variant effect predictors, population and clinical databases, and conservation scores, with an optional category filter.

components.name: OpenFDA approval history
components.description: Retrieves the complete FDA submission and approval history for a specific drug, returning chronological submissions with dates, review priority, submission types, and linked FDA review documents.

components.name: OpenFDA get approved products
components.description: Get FDA-approved product details for a drug, including marketed formulations, active ingredients, strengths, dosage forms, administration routes, therapeutic equivalence codes, and marketing status. Returns the full list of products under an FDA application.

components.name: OpenFDA veterinary adverse event search
components.description: Search the FDA animal and veterinary adverse-event database via openFDA for reports of adverse drug experiences involving veterinary drugs. Accepts a search query and returns affected animal species/breed, reactions (VeDDRA terms), involved drugs, number of animals affected/treated, outcome/health assessment, and date…

components.name: OpenFDA 510(k) Device Search
components.description: Search the FDA 510(k) premarket notification database via openFDA using a Lucene query to retrieve medical device clearance records, including device names, applicant companies, decision dates, advisory committee classifications, and FDA decision types.

components.name: OpenFDA search device adverse events
components.description: Search the FDA MAUDE medical-device adverse-event database via openFDA for reports of device-associated injuries, malfunctions, and deaths, returning event type, device name, manufacturer, patient outcomes, and report dates.

components.name: OpenFDA search device enforcement
components.description: Search the FDA medical device enforcement (recall) database via openFDA using Lucene query syntax and return recall details such as product description, reason for recall, and distribution pattern.

components.name: OpenFDA Search Device Recalls
components.description: Search the FDA medical-device recall database via openFDA, returning recall records with product description, recalling firm, status, cause, classification, associated 510(k)/PMA numbers, product code, and key dates for device safety research and corrective action tracking.

components.name: OpenFDA search drug approvals
components.description: Searches the FDA Drugs@FDA database for drug approval records by drug name, sponsor, or application number, returning application details such as NDA/ANDA/BLA numbers, sponsor names, dosage forms, active ingredients, and approval dates.

components.name: OpenFDA search drug enforcement
components.description: Search the FDA drug enforcement recall database via openFDA using Lucene query syntax, returning recall details such as reason, product description, classification, firm, and dates.

components.name: OpenFDA Drug Event Search
components.description: Search the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) via openFDA for drug safety reports using drug name, reaction term, or raw Lucene query, returning serious adverse event records with outcomes.

components.name: OpenFDA search drug labels
components.description: Search the FDA drug label (SPL) database via openFDA using Lucene query syntax. Returns label text sections and openFDA cross-references for approved prescription and OTC drug labels.

components.name: OpenFDA Search Drug NDC
components.description: Search the FDA National Drug Code (NDC) Directory via openFDA with a Lucene query and return matching drug product records, including product/package codes, brand/generic names, dosage forms, routes of administration, active ingredients, and marketing information.

components.name: OpenFDA search drug shortages
components.description: Searches the FDA drug shortages database via openFDA and returns current and resolved U.S. drug shortages with generic name, dosage form, presentation, shortage status, reported reason, therapeutic category, manufacturer, and availability information. Designed for supply-chain monitoring, formulary planning, and ident…

components.name: OpenFDA search food adverse events
components.description: Search the FDA CAERS database via openFDA for reported adverse events and product complaints related to foods, dietary supplements, and cosmetics. Accepts a search query and returns reported reactions (MedDRA terms), patient outcomes, product details, and dates.

components.name: OpenFDA Device Classification Lookup
components.description: Looks up US FDA regulatory classification for a medical device by device name, returning device class, FDA product code, review panel, and CFR regulation number using the openFDA database.

components.name: OpenFDA Device 510(k) Search
components.description: Search the openFDA 510(k) premarket notification database by medical device name to retrieve clearance records including K number, applicant, decision date, outcome, and clearance type.

components.name: OpenFDA Device search adverse events
components.description: Search openFDA's MAUDE database of medical device adverse event reports by device generic name. Returns each report's device brand/generic name and manufacturer, event type, date, product problems, and patient problems.

components.name: OpenFDA Device PMA Search
components.description: Search openFDA's Premarket Approval (PMA) database by device trade name and return PMA number, applicant, trade name, decision date, and approval-order summary for higher-risk Class 3 medical devices.

components.name: OpenFDA Device search recalls
components.description: Search openFDA's medical device recall database by device name, recalling firm, or free text, returning recall details including product description, recalling firm, reason, root cause, status, and date initiated.

components.name: OpenFDA Device UDI Search
components.description: Search the openFDA Unique Device Identifier (UDI) database by brand name, company, or free text. Returns device brand name, company, description, primary device identifier (DI), GMDN terms, and regulatory device class.

components.name: OpenGenes gene profile lookup
components.description: Retrieves the aging/longevity profile for a human gene by symbol from the Open Genes curated database, including aging mechanisms, functional clusters, associated disease categories, curator confidence level, expression change with age, and evidence-count summaries across study types.

components.name: OpenGenes search genes
components.description: Browse the Open Genes catalog of human aging/longevity genes (paginated). Returns a page of aging-gene summaries (symbol, name, aging mechanisms, functional clusters, confidence level, expression change) plus the total count of curated aging genes. Use to enumerate aging-associated genes or sample the catalog. No API…

components.name: OpenGWAS get MR instruments
components.description: Assemble harmonized two-sample Mendelian randomization instruments from the IEU OpenGWAS database for a given exposure and outcome GWAS study pair. Fetches genome-wide significant LD-clumped SNP instruments for the exposure and their effects in the outcome, aligning effects to a common allele for use in MR estimators.

components.name: OpenNeuro advanced search
components.description: Faceted search across OpenNeuro neuroimaging datasets, returning matching dataset IDs and the archive-wide total participant count. Accepts facet filters such as species, diagnosis, modality, and tasks.

components.name: OpenNeuro get dataset
components.description: Get detailed metadata for a specific neuroimaging dataset on OpenNeuro by its dataset ID, returning modalities, tasks, subject list, BIDS version, authors, DOI, README, and download statistics.

components.name: OpenNeuro Get Dataset Snapshots
components.description: Get all version snapshots of a specific OpenNeuro dataset, returning the snapshot id, tag, and creation date for every published version.

components.name: OpenNeuro get snapshot files
components.description: Lists files in a specific snapshot (version) of an OpenNeuro dataset, returning filenames, sizes, directory flags, and direct download URLs. Requires an OpenNeuro dataset ID and a snapshot tag.

components.name: OpenNeuro snapshot validation
components.description: Retrieves BIDS validation results for a specific snapshot of an OpenNeuro dataset, including whether the dataset passes the BIDS validator and counts of errors and warnings. Requires an OpenNeuro dataset ID and a snapshot tag.

components.name: OpenNeuro list datasets
components.description: List publicly available neuroimaging datasets on OpenNeuro, which hosts 1000+ BIDS-formatted brain imaging datasets (fMRI, MRI, EEG, MEG, PET). Returns dataset metadata including modalities, subject counts, file counts, and download statistics, with cursor-based pagination support.

components.name: OpenNeuro search by modality
components.description: Search OpenNeuro neuroimaging datasets by imaging modality (MRI, EEG, iEEG, MEG, PET). Returns matching dataset IDs, names, creation dates, and total count from OpenNeuro's BIDS-formatted collection.

components.name: OpenNIH activity code distribution
components.description: Breaks NIH or one Institute/Center portfolio into research, career, training, center, contract, intramural, and other mechanism classes. Returns project-row counts and recorded totals for an optional fiscal-year window.

components.name: OpenNIH fetch
components.description: Fetches one canonical NIH project record from the OpenNIH service using a full NIH project number returned by OpenNIH_search. Returns citation-ready id, title, text, public URL, and metadata.

components.name: OpenNIH funding growth
components.description: Calculates annual competitive Research Project Grant (RPG) funding growth and compound annual growth rate (CAGR) for all NIH or a single resolved institution using OpenNIH data. Accepts an optional institution entity ID and fiscal year start and end, and returns funding growth metrics.

components.name: OpenNIH funding trend
components.description: Returns annual NIH funding totals and project-row counts for all NIH or filtered by institute/center, activity code, or institution, with partial current years flagged.

components.name: OpenNIH get institution profile
components.description: Retrieves a resolved institution's funding history, mechanism mix, and top PIs for an optional fiscal-year window using a canonical institution identifier obtained from OpenNIH_rank_institutions.

components.name: OpenNIH get PI profile
components.description: Retrieves NIH grant rows and shared-award contacts for a principal investigator profile identified by a numeric profile_id, with optional fiscal-year filtering. Profile counts and total funding are row-level and not deduplicated; collaborators indicate shared awards only.

components.name: OpenNIH IC topic cross
components.description: Measures one research topic within one NIH Institute/Center (IC) or across all ICs, using official RCDC categories or title-text matching, and returns grant topic metrics such as total_grants and no_match_note.

components.name: OpenNIH search
components.description: Search NIH project-year rows covering FY1985-present by topic, project number, PI, institution, Institute/Center, activity code, or fiscal-year window, and return matching grant records, distinct-award counts, funding totals, IDs, and provenance.

components.name: OpenNIH search grants
components.description: Searches NIH project-year grant rows from OpenNIH, filterable by topic, project number, principal investigator, institution, Institute/Center, activity code, or fiscal-year window. Returns matching rows, distinct-award counts, recorded funding totals, IDs, and provenance.

components.name: OpenTargets Drug Pharmacogenomics Data
components.description: Retrieve pharmacogenomics data for a specific drug from Open Targets using a ChEMBL ID, including evidence levels and genotype annotations.

components.name: OpenTargets get approved indications by drug chemblId
components.description: Retrieve approved disease indications for a single drug from the Open Targets Platform using its ChEMBL ID as input.

components.name: OpenTargets get associated diseases by drug ChEMBL ID
components.description: Retrieves diseases associated with a drug ChEMBL ID from Open Targets, using clinical trial and post-marketed drug data.

components.name: OpenTargets known drugs by disease EFO ID
components.description: Retrieve known drugs associated with a specific disease by its EFO ID from Open Targets.

components.name: OpenTargets Get Associated Drugs by Target Ensembl ID
components.description: Get known drugs and associated information (ID, name, mechanism of action, clinical trial phase) for a target specified by its Ensembl ID from Open Targets.

components.name: OpenTargets get associated phenotypes by disease EFO ID
components.description: Find HPO phenotypes associated with a specified disease EFO ID using the OpenTargets platform. Takes a disease EFO identifier and returns associated phenotype records.

components.name: OpenTargets get associated targets by disease efoId
components.description: Find targets associated with a specific disease or phenotype using an EFO identifier. Results are paginated with 50 targets per call by default, and size and index parameters page through the complete Open Targets association list.

components.name: Open Targets associated targets by drug ChEMBL ID
components.description: Retrieve the list of targets linked to a specific drug ChEMBL ID based on its mechanism of action from Open Targets. Accepts a ChEMBL ID and returns target records.

components.name: Open Targets biological mouse models by Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieves biological mouse models, including allelic compositions and genetic backgrounds, for a specific target identified by an Ensembl ID from Open Targets.

components.name: OpenTargets get chemical probes by target Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieve chemical probes associated with a specific target from the Open Targets Platform using its Ensembl ID.

components.name: OpenTargets get credible set colocalisation
components.description: Retrieve GWAS/QTL colocalisation evidence for a credible set by studyLocusId from OpenTargets, returning colocalisation count and rows with method, posterior probabilities, number of colocalising variants, and the other colocalising study locus.

components.name: Open Targets credible set detail
components.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific GWAS credible set (fine-mapped locus) from Open Targets, including lead variant, study, fine-mapping method, L2G predictions, and colocalization evidence.

components.name: Open Targets disease ancestors parents by EFO ID
components.description: Retrieves disease ancestors and parents from the Open Targets disease ontology using a supplied EFO ID. Returns disease record fields including ID, name, ancestors, and parents.

components.name: Open Targets disease descendants and children by EFO ID
components.description: Retrieves disease descendants and children from the Open Targets ontology for a supplied disease EFO ID.

components.name: OpenTargets get disease description by EFO ID
components.description: Retrieves disease description, name, database cross references, obsolete terms, and therapeutic area status from OpenTargets using an EFO ID.

components.name: OpenTargets disease ID description lookup
components.description: Retrieve the EFO identifier and additional disease details from Open Targets by disease name.

components.name: OpenTargets disease ID cross-reference
components.description: Given a disease ID such as a MONDO ID, retrieves all cross-referenced external disease IDs including EFO, OMIM, MeSH, MedDRA, NCIt, ICD10, Orphanet, and UMLS from the OpenTargets GraphQL service.

components.name: OpenTargets Get Disease IDs by Name
components.description: Queries Open Targets GraphQL full-text search with a disease or phenotype name and returns up to five ranked candidate diseases with cross-referenced external identifiers from databases such as OMIM, MONDO, MeSH, ICD10, UMLS, MedDRA, NCIt, and Orphanet.

components.name: OpenTargets get disease locations by EFO ID
components.description: Retrieve the direct and indirect location disease terms and IDs for a disease specified by EFO ID from the Open Targets Platform.

components.name: Open Targets get disease synonyms by EFO ID
components.description: Retrieves disease synonyms for a given EFO ID from Open Targets.

components.name: Get disease therapeutic areas by EFO ID
components.description: Retrieve the therapeutic areas associated with a specific disease by submitting its EFO identifier. Outputs the disease ID, name, and associated therapeutic areas.

components.name: OpenTargets diseases/phenotypes by target Ensembl
components.description: Find diseases or phenotypes associated with a specific target using its Ensembl gene ID. Returns paginated associated disease rows with total count and truncation metadata.

components.name: Open Targets drug adverse events by ChEMBL ID
components.description: Retrieves significant adverse event signals for a drug specified by ChEMBL ID, ranked by log-likelihood ratio, with pagination support to fetch all reported events from Open Targets.

components.name: OpenTargets Drug Approval Status by ChEMBL ID
components.description: Retrieves the approval status of a drug by its ChEMBL ID using the OpenTargets platform. Accepts a ChEMBL ID and returns approval-related information for that drug.

components.name: OpenTargets drug blackbox status by ChEMBL ID
components.description: Retrieves withdrawn and black-box warning statuses for a specific drug using its ChEMBL ID from Open Targets.

components.name: OpenTargets get drug ChEMBL ID by generic name
components.description: Fetch a drug's ChEMBL ID and description from Open Targets using its generic name.

components.name: OpenTargets drug description by ChEMBL ID
components.description: Retrieve drug information including name, year of first approval, type, cross references, and max clinical trial phase for a specified ChEMBL ID from OpenTargets.

components.name: OpenTargets get drug ID description by name
components.description: Fetches the ChEMBL ID and description for a drug based on its generic name from Open Targets.

components.name: OpenTargets Get Drug Indications by ChEMBL ID
components.description: Fetch drug indications (treatable phenotypes/diseases) for a drug identified by its ChEMBL ID from the Open Targets Platform.

components.name: OpenTargets get drug mechanisms of action by chemblId
components.description: Retrieve the mechanisms of action associated with a specific drug from OpenTargets using its ChEMBL ID.

components.name: OpenTargets get drug names by ChEMBL ID
components.description: Retrieves drug generic names, brand names, and synonyms from ChEMBL using a ChEMBL ID.

components.name: Open Targets get drug synonyms by ChEMBL ID
components.description: Retrieve the synonyms associated with a specific drug using its ChEMBL ID from the Open Targets Platform. Returns the drug name and each synonym with its label and source.

components.name: OpenTargets get drug trade names by ChEMBL ID
components.description: Retrieves trade names associated with a specific drug ChEMBL ID from the Open Targets Platform.

components.name: OpenTargets get drug warnings by ChEMBL ID
components.description: Retrieve safety warnings for a specific drug using its ChEMBL ID. The tool queries Open Targets and returns drug warning records with details such as warning type, description, country, and year.

components.name: OpenTargets get evidence by datasource
components.description: Retrieves target-disease association evidence records from Open Targets Platform, filtered by a specified data source, with pagination via a size parameter.

components.name: OpenTargets Gene Ontology Terms by GO ID
components.description: Retrieve Gene Ontology terms associated with a supplied list of GO IDs.

components.name: Open Targets GWAS study lookup
components.description: Retrieve detailed metadata for a GWAS study from Open Targets Platform using a GCST accession ID, including trait information, sample sizes, publication details, disease mappings, cohorts, LD population structure, and availability of summary statistics.

components.name: OpenTargets get known drugs by drug ChEMBL ID
components.description: Get a drug's known clinical information for a specified ChEMBL ID, including approved and investigational indications with maximum clinical phase, mechanisms of action with molecular targets, and safety warnings.

components.name: OpenTargets get parent and child molecules by ChEMBL ID
components.description: Retrieves parent and child molecules for a drug specified by its ChEMBL ID from the Open Targets platform.

components.name: OpenTargets get publications by disease EFO ID
components.description: Retrieve publications related to a disease EFO ID, including PubMed IDs and publication dates. The tool returns the first 25 publications and supports narrowing by startYear, endYear, and additionalIds.

components.name: OpenTargets get publications by drug ChEMBL ID
components.description: Retrieve publications related to a drug ChEMBL ID from Open Targets, returning PubMed IDs and publication dates. The tool returns the first 25 publications without pagination and supports narrowing by start year, end year, or additional IDs.

components.name: OpenTargets get publications by target Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieve publications associated with a target Ensembl ID from Open Targets, returning up to 25 publication records with PubMed IDs and publication dates; startYear, endYear, and additionalIds can narrow the query.

components.name: Open Targets get similar entities by disease EFO ID
components.description: Retrieve similar entities for a given disease EFO identifier from the Open Targets API using a similarity model trained on PubMed. The tool takes a disease EFO ID and optional threshold and size parameters and returns matching similar entities.

components.name: OpenTargets similar entities by drug ChEMBL ID
components.description: Retrieves similar entities for a given drug ChEMBL ID using a similarity model trained on PubMed. Accepts a ChEMBL ID and optional threshold and size parameters, returning entities above the similarity threshold.

components.name: OpenTargets get similar entities by target Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieve similar entities for a given target Ensembl ID from Open Targets using a similarity model trained on PubMed. Returns entities above a configurable similarity threshold.

components.name: Open Targets get study credible sets
components.description: Get all credible sets (fine-mapped GWAS loci) for a specific GWAS study from Open Targets, returning lead variants, fine-mapping details, p-values, effect sizes, and locus-to-gene predictions for each locus.

components.name: OpenTargets get target cancer hallmarks
components.description: Retrieve cancer hallmark annotations and role-in-cancer attributes for a target gene using its Ensembl gene ID, sourced from the COSMIC Cancer Gene Census and Hanahan-Weinberg hallmarks.

components.name: Open Targets get target classes by Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieve the target classes associated with a specific Ensembl gene ID from Open Targets.

components.name: Open Targets target constraint info by Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieve genetic constraint information for a target gene by Ensembl ID from Open Targets, including expected and observed values and scores.

components.name: OpenTargets get target DepMap essentiality
components.description: Retrieve DepMap CRISPR gene essentiality for a target specified by Ensembl gene ID, including the overall isEssential flag and per-tissue cell-line Chronos scores and gene expression.

components.name: OpenTargets get target enabling packages by Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieve Target Enabling Packages (TEPs) associated with a target gene using its Ensembl ID from Open Targets.

components.name: OpenTargets target expression by Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieve baseline expression summary statistics for a target across tissues and cell types by Ensembl gene ID from GTEx, Tabula Sapiens, and other bulk/single-cell sources.

components.name: OpenTargets get target Gene Ontology by Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieves Gene Ontology annotations for a target identified by Ensembl ID from Open Targets.

components.name: OpenTargets Get Target Genomic Location by Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieves genomic location data for a specific target using an Ensembl ID, returning chromosome, start, end, and strand from Open Targets.

components.name: Open Targets get target homologues by Ensembl ID
components.description: Fetch homologues for a specific target by Ensembl ID using the Open Targets GraphQL API. Returns homologue records for the given Ensembl identifier.

components.name: OpenTargets target ID description lookup
components.description: Accepts a target name and returns the corresponding Ensembl gene ID and description from Open Targets. The tool queries Open Targets to resolve target names to their gene identifiers and textual annotations.

components.name: Open Targets target info by Ensembl ID
components.description: Get core information about a drug target from Open Targets by Ensembl gene ID, including approved symbol and name, biotype, UniProt/protein cross-reference IDs, genomic location, and curated function descriptions.

components.name: OpenTargets target interactions by Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieve interaction data for a target specified by Ensembl ID from Open Targets, returning interaction partners, evidence, and pagination metadata.

components.name: OpenTargets get target pathways by Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieves Reactome pathway membership for a target gene specified by Ensembl gene ID, returning each pathway's Reactome ID, name, and top-level term.

components.name: OpenTargets target prioritisation
components.description: Retrieve OpenTargets target prioritisation scores for a target by Ensembl gene ID, returning approximately 16 weighted metrics for therapeutic tractability and safety, such as geneticConstraint, hasPocket, hasLigand, hasHighQualityChemicalProbes, and hasSafetyEvent.

components.name: OpenTargets target safety profile by Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieve known target safety liabilities for a specific target Ensembl ID from Open Targets. The tool returns a safety profile for the requested target.

components.name: Open Targets target subcellular locations by Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieve subcellular location information for a specific target using its Ensembl ID from Open Targets.

components.name: Open Targets target synonyms by Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieve synonyms for a specified target, including alternative names and symbols, using a given Ensembl ID from the Open Targets Platform.

components.name: OpenTargets get target tractability by Ensembl ID
components.description: Retrieve tractability assessments, including modality and values, for a specific target Ensembl ID from Open Targets.

components.name: Open Targets variant credible sets
components.description: Get GWAS credible sets (fine-mapped loci) associated with a genetic variant from Open Targets. Returns studies where the variant appears in a fine-mapped credible set, with locus-to-gene predictions, p-values, effect sizes, and the fine-mapping method used.

components.name: OpenTargets get variant effect predictions
components.description: Retrieve in-silico functional effect predictions for a variant specified in chrom_pos_ref_alt format from OpenTargets. Returns one record per prediction method with an assessment and numeric score.

components.name: Open Targets variant info
components.description: Retrieve detailed information about a genetic variant from the Open Targets Platform, including genomic coordinates, rsIDs, allele frequencies from gnomAD, functional consequences, transcript consequences, and HGVS notation, given an Open Targets variant ID.

components.name: OpenTargets variant pharmacogenomics lookup
components.description: Retrieve variant-level pharmacogenomics annotations for a variant ID from OpenTargets (PharmGKB-derived), returning one record per PGx association with drug, phenotype, evidence level, genotype annotation, category, and source.

components.name: OpenTargets get variant transcript consequences
components.description: Retrieve per-transcript consequences for a variant ID (chrom_pos_ref_alt) from OpenTargets, returning one record per affected transcript with transcript ID, target gene, amino acid change, consequence score, impact and canonical/distance transcript flag.

components.name: OpenTargets map any disease ID to all other IDs
components.description: Given any known disease or phenotype identifier (EFO, OMIM, MONDO, UMLS, ICD10, MedDRA, etc.), returns all known cross-referenced identifiers including the EFO ID using the Open Targets GraphQL API.

components.name: OpenTargets multi entity search by query string
components.description: Performs a multi-entity search across the Open Targets platform using a query string, with optional entity name filtering and pagination settings. Accepts a text query and returns matching entity records.

components.name: Open Targets search category counts by query string
components.description: Searches Open Targets to return the number of entries in each entity category (disease, target, drug) matching a query string.

components.name: Open Targets search GWAS studies by disease
components.description: Search Open Targets for GWAS studies associated with a disease or trait using disease ontology IDs (EFO, MONDO). Returns matching GWAS studies with metadata including sample sizes, traits, publications, and associated diseases; enableIndirect=true can include child disease terms.

components.name: OpenTargets target disease evidence
components.description: Explore IntOGen somatic driver evidence for a target-disease association. Accepts gene symbols or Ensembl IDs and disease names or EFO IDs (auto-resolved via OpenTargets search), returning paginated evidence records from IntOGen; returns empty data for non-cancer diseases.

components.name: OPM search structures
components.description: Search the Orientations of Proteins in Membranes (OPM) database for solved membrane protein structures. Returns measured properties including hydrophobic thickness, tilt angle, transfer free energy, membrane type and protein family.

components.name: OPSIN name to structure
components.description: Converts a systematic IUPAC chemical name into a chemical structure using the OPSIN name parser, returning SMILES, standard InChI, and InChIKey.

components.name: ORCID get works
components.description: Get a list of publications and works for an ORCID researcher, returning titles, publication types, dates, journal names, and external identifiers such as DOI and PubMed ID.

components.name: Orphadata get disorder
components.description: Retrieve a rare disease record from Orphadata by ORPHAcode, including synonyms, disorder type, and cross-references to OMIM, ICD-10, ICD-11, MeSH, UMLS, and MedDRA.

components.name: Orphadata get epidemiology
components.description: Retrieve Orphanet prevalence and epidemiology estimates for a rare disease by ORPHAcode, including prevalence class, geographic area, point/birth prevalence type, and validation status. Useful for rare-disease burden and trial feasibility questions.

components.name: Orphadata get phenotypes
components.description: Retrieves HPO phenotype annotations for a rare disease specified by ORPHAcode, including each phenotype's frequency and whether it is a diagnostic criterion.

components.name: Orphadata search by name
components.description: Retrieves a rare disease record from Orphadata/Orphanet using an ORPHAcode, including synonyms, disorder type, and cross-references to OMIM, ICD-10, ICD-11, MeSH, UMLS, and MedDRA.

components.name: Orphanet get classification
components.description: Get disease classification hierarchy from Orphanet using an Orphanet code, returning parent and child disease categories for a rare disease.

components.name: Orphanet Get Disease
components.description: Get detailed information about a rare disease by ORPHA code from Orphanet. Returns disease name, definition, synonyms, and classification.

components.name: Orphanet epidemiology lookup
components.description: Retrieves epidemiology data for rare diseases from Orphanet using an ORPHAcode, returning prevalence and incidence estimates by geographic region and type, including validation status and literature sources.

components.name: Orphanet gene diseases
components.description: Get rare diseases associated with a gene from Orphanet using gene symbols or name keywords. Returns disease ORPHA codes, gene symbols, association types, and genomic locus information.

components.name: Orphanet_get_genes
components.description: Retrieve genes associated with a rare disease from Orphanet using an ORPHA code. Returns gene symbols, names, and association types such as causative, modifier, or susceptibility.

components.name: Orphanet ICD mapping
components.description: Retrieve cross-references between Orphanet ORPHA codes and medical coding systems such as ICD-10, ICD-11, OMIM, and SNOMED-CT for a supplied ORPHA code, returning mapping relationships and validation status.

components.name: Orphanet natural history lookup
components.description: Get natural history data for a rare disease from Orphanet by ORPHA code, returning average age of onset and type of inheritance.

components.name: Orphanet get phenotypes
components.description: Get HPO (Human Phenotype Ontology) phenotypes associated with a rare disease from Orphanet, identified by ORPHA code. Returns HPO terms with frequency annotations and diagnostic-criteria flags.

components.name: Orphanet search by name
components.description: Search for rare diseases by exact or partial name match in Orphanet, returning ORPHA codes and disease names. Supports exact matching mode for disambiguation.

components.name: Orphanet search diseases
components.description: Search Orphanet for rare diseases by keyword. Accepts a disease name or keyword and returns matching disease names, ORPHA codes, and synonyms without authentication.

components.name: OrthoDB get group details
components.description: Retrieve detailed information for an OrthoDB orthologous group by group ID, including KEGG pathway associations, GO terms, and InterPro domain annotations.

components.name: OrthoDB group FASTA retrieval
components.description: Retrieves member protein sequences in FASTA format for an OrthoDB orthologous group, optionally restricted to a species by NCBI taxon ID. Returns one record per member protein with parsed metadata from FASTA headers and full amino-acid sequence, suitable for multiple sequence alignment or phylogenetics.

components.name: OrthoDB Get Orthologs
components.description: Retrieves orthologous genes from an OrthoDB group, optionally filtered by species. Returns gene IDs, organism names, and descriptions for all members of an orthologous group.

components.name: OrthoDB Search Groups
components.description: Search OrthoDB v12 for orthologous groups by gene or protein name, optionally filtering by NCBI taxonomy species ID, and return orthologous group IDs that can be queried for details, enabling evolutionary analysis of gene conservation.

components.name: OSDR study search
components.description: Search NASA OSDR studies related to spaceflight and microgravity by free-text query and optional organism filter, returning study records that may include cross-referenced external datasets such as GEO.

components.name: OSDR List Files
components.description: List files associated with a NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) study, returning file records for downstream analysis.

components.name: OSDR Search Studies
components.description: Performs full-text search of NASA's Open Science Data Repository for space biology studies, taking a free-text query and optional organism filter and returning matching study records with cross-referenced external datasets such as GEO.

components.name: OSF Search Preprints
components.description: Search OSF Preprints for research preprints and working papers using keyword queries across titles and abstracts, with optional provider filtering and result limits.

components.name: Get EFO ID by disease name
components.description: Legacy helper to find an Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO) term ID from a disease name using EMBL-EBI OLS search, returning the best match as {efo_id, name} or null when no results are found.

components.name: Overall Summary Agent
components.description: Generates a comprehensive overall summary of multi-agent literature search results, taking a user query, intent, metrics, plan summaries, and context, and returning an LLM-generated text summary with quality assessment and improvement suggestions.

components.name: OxO get ontology mappings
components.description: Look up cross-reference mappings for ontology terms using the EBI Ontology Xref Service (OxO), accepting a term identifier and returning mapped terms across biomedical ontologies such as HPO, MeSH, SNOMED-CT, UMLS, and others.

components.name: OxO Search Ontology Mappings
components.description: Search for cross-reference mappings for multiple ontology terms at once using the EBI OxO service. Accepts comma-separated ontology term IDs and returns equivalent terms from other biomedical ontologies, with optional filtering by target ontology prefix.

components.name: PanelApp get panel
components.description: Search Genomics England PanelApp for curated gene panels used in clinical genetic testing. Returns panel IDs, names, disease groups, status, version, and gene count statistics.

components.name: PanelApp search genes
components.description: Searches Genomics England PanelApp for gene panels by panel name or disease, returning matching panel metadata with diagnostic evidence ratings. The search matches panel-level metadata only, not gene-level phenotype text.

components.name: PanelApp search panels
components.description: Search Genomics England PanelApp for curated gene panels used in clinical genetic testing. Accepts a query against panel name or disease group and returns matching panel metadata including ID, name, disease group, status, version and gene count statistics.

components.name: PanglaoDB cell types for gene
components.description: Reverse cell-type lookup for a gene in PanglaoDB: given an official human gene symbol, returns cell types for which that gene is a curated marker, including organ, canonical-marker flag, and human/mouse sensitivity/specificity, with optional species filter.

components.name: PanglaoDB list cell types
components.description: Retrieves marker genes for a specified PanglaoDB cell type, including canonical-marker flags, ubiquitousness indices, and human/mouse sensitivity/specificity, to annotate scRNA-seq clusters. Requires a cell_type label and optionally filters by species, organ, or canonical markers.

components.name: PanglaoDB markers for cell type
components.description: Retrieve curated marker genes for a specified single-cell type from PanglaoDB, including canonical-marker flags, ubiquitousness index, and sensitivity/specificity for human and mouse.

components.name: PANTHER enrichment
components.description: Performs gene set enrichment (overrepresentation) analysis using PANTHER, accepting a gene list and returning statistically enriched GO terms, PANTHER pathways, Reactome pathways, or protein classes with Fisher's exact test and FDR correction.

components.name: PANTHER gene info
components.description: Look up gene classification and functional annotation from PANTHER by gene identifier, returning protein family/subfamily, Gene Ontology annotations, protein class, and pathway membership.

components.name: PANTHER ortholog
components.description: Find orthologs of a gene across species using PANTHER evolutionary classification. Returns matching ortholog records with persistent IDs, gene symbols, and ortholog types such as LDO, O, P, X, and LDX.

components.name: Pathoplexus count sequences
components.description: Count and aggregate open pathogen genome sequences from Pathoplexus (LAPIS) for genomic-epidemiology surveillance, returning sequence counts for selected organisms with optional filters by country and lineage.

components.name: Pathoplexus Get Mutations
components.description: Retrieves characteristic amino-acid or nucleotide mutations for a specified Pathoplexus organism above a proportion threshold, optionally filtered by country or lineage, for surveillance of mutation prevalence in emerging pathogens. Returns each mutation with gene, position, from/to residue, proportion, count, and cov…

components.name: Pathoplexus get sequence details
components.description: Lists individual sequence records from a selected Pathoplexus organism via the LAPIS /details endpoint, returning per-sequence metadata such as accession, country, collection date, host, lineage, and clade. Supports optional filtering by country and lineage and field selection for organisms including west-nile, ebola-…

components.name: Pathoplexus get sequences FASTA
components.description: Downloads actual genome sequences (FASTA) from Pathoplexus/LAPIS for surveilled pathogens, returning unaligned or aligned nucleotide or amino-acid sequences as FASTA text, optionally filtered by country and lineage. Supports organisms such as west-nile, ebola-zaire, ebola-sudan, cchf, and mpox.

components.name: Pathway Commons get neighborhood
components.description: Get the interaction neighborhood for a query gene from Pathway Commons, returning protein-protein, regulatory, catalytic, and complex membership interactions with partner genes, interaction types, data sources, and PubMed references from 22 integrated databases.

components.name: Pathway Commons get pathway
components.description: Search Pathway Commons for molecular entities and pathways across integrated databases such as Reactome, KEGG, and WikiPathways using a gene symbol, protein name, or keyword. Returns pathway URIs, names, data sources, and participant/process counts.

components.name: Pathway Commons paths between
components.description: Find mechanistic interaction paths connecting a set of genes or proteins in Pathway Commons across integrated databases. Given two or more gene symbols, returns the directed or undirected interaction edges that link them, parsed as source, relation, target triples.

components.name: Pathway Commons Search
