components.description: Search Pathway Commons for pathways, interactions, and molecular entities across 22 integrated databases by gene symbol, protein name, or keyword, with optional BioPAX entity type and data source filters; returns pathway URIs, names, data sources, and participant/process counts.

components.name: Pathway Commons Get Interactions
components.description: Retrieves the interaction network (neighborhood) for a specified list of genes from Pathway Commons, returning interactions in Simple Interaction Format (SIF).

components.name: Pathway Commons pathway search
components.description: Searches Pathway Commons for biological pathways matching a supplied keyword and returns the matching pathway records.

components.name: PDB-REDO structure quality lookup
components.description: Retrieves re-refined structure quality metrics from PDB-REDO for a given PDB entry. Accepts a lowercase PDB ID and returns over 200 crystallographic quality metrics for X-ray structures, such as R-factor, R-free, resolution, and Ramachandran Z-score.

components.name: PDB-REDO Get Version Info
components.description: Get PDB-REDO re-refinement version and provenance metadata for a PDB entry using a lowercase PDB ID. Returns the versions.json record including PDB-REDO pipeline version, mmCIF coordinate and reflection revisions, edit flags, Foldit-player provenance, and supporting crystallographic program versions.

components.name: PDB Search Similar Structures
components.description: Search the RCSB Protein Data Bank for protein structures similar to a supplied PDB ID, amino acid sequence, or text keyword using sequence-, structure-, or text-based similarity search. Returns matching protein structure records.

components.name: PDBe Get Bound Molecules
components.description: Retrieves all bound molecules such as ligands, cofactors, and drugs for a PDB structure from the PDBe Graph API, returning chemical component IDs, chain locations, and entity information.

components.name: PDBe get compound details
components.description: Get detailed chemical compound information from the PDBe Graph API by chemical component ID (3-letter PDB code), including chemical formula, molecular weight, SMILES, InChI, InChIKey, systematic names, stereoisomer information, and cross-references to DrugBank, PubChem, and ClinicalTrials.

components.name: PDBe get compound structures
components.description: Get PDB structures containing a specified chemical compound (ligand/cofactor/ion) from PDBe. For a given compound ID, returns compound details and a list of PDB entry IDs where the compound appears.

components.name: PDBe compound summary lookup
components.description: Retrieves detailed chemical compound information from PDBe using a PDB chemical component ID (3-letter code). Returns molecular formula, weight, formal charge, compound type, InChI, InChI key, SMILES representations, systematic IUPAC names, and cross-references to PubChem, DrugBank, EPA CompTox, ClinicalTrials, and ot…

components.name: PDBe Get Entry Assemblies
components.description: Given a PDB entry ID, retrieves biological assembly information for that entry from PDBe, including assembly IDs, symmetry operations, and assembly composition, with automatic fallback to the summary endpoint when the assemblies endpoint returns 404.

components.name: PDBe Get Entry Experiment
components.description: Retrieves experimental details for a PDB entry from PDBe, including experimental method, resolution, R-factors, completeness, refinement software, space group, and unit cell parameters. Accepts a PDB entry ID and returns structured experimental metadata for structure determination.

components.name: PDBe Get Entry Molecules
components.description: Retrieves molecule records for a PDB entry from PDBe, including molecule type, entity ID, chain information, mutations, molecular weight, and gene names.

components.name: PDBe get entry observed residues ratio
components.description: Retrieves the observed residues ratio for each chain in a PDB entry from PDBe, providing per-chain structure completeness metrics such as observed and partial residue ratios. Accepts a PDB ID and returns chain-level information including struct_asym_id, chain_id, number of residues, observed ratio, and partial ratio.

components.name: Get entry publications
components.description: Get publication information associated with a PDB entry including authors, journal, DOI, and citation details from PDBe.

components.name: PDBe entry quality
components.description: Get quality metrics and validation information for a PDB entry from PDBe, including resolution, R-free, Ramachandran statistics, and validation scores.

components.name: PDBe Entry Related Publications
components.description: Get publications related to a PDB entry from PDBe, including PubMed IDs, titles, journals, authors, and citation counts, given a PDB ID.

components.name: PDBe get entry secondary structure
components.description: Get secondary structure information for a PDB entry, including helix, sheet, and turn assignments, using the PDBe REST API.

components.name: PDBe get entry status
components.description: Retrieve status information for a PDB entry from the PDBe API, including release date, status code, authors, experimental method, and whether the entry has been superseded or obsoleted.

components.name: PDBe Entry Summary
components.description: Retrieves summary information for a PDB entry from PDBe, including title, authors, release date, and basic structure metadata, using a PDB ID as input.

components.name: PDBe get FunPDBe annotations
components.description: Retrieves per-residue functional annotations from FunPDBe for a given PDB structure, returning confidence-scored and classified annotations such as residue depth and conservation scores.

components.name: PDBe Residue Listing
components.description: Get per-residue information for a PDB structure, optionally filtered by chain, including PDB and author residue numbers, residue names, and observed electron density ratio. Useful for analyzing protein chain composition and identifying disordered or missing regions.

components.name: PDBe get structure ligands
components.description: Retrieves all ligands (drug-like molecules, cofactors, ions) bound in a PDB crystal structure, including chemical component IDs, names, molecular weights, chain assignments, drug-likeness annotations, and interacting protein entities, given a PDB entry ID.

components.name: PDBe get UniProt mappings
components.description: Retrieve UniProt-to-PDB chain mappings for a PDB structure from the PDBe Graph API, returning for each UniProt accession the chain mappings with residue-level alignment details such as start/end positions, identity, and coverage.

components.name: PDBe get UniProt structure coverage
components.description: Uses the PDBe Graph API to retrieve all PDB structures mapped to a given UniProt protein accession, ranked by quality and coverage, returning the best chain per PDB entry with residue coverage, resolution, experimental method, mutations, and ligands.

components.name: PDBe KB get interface residues
components.description: Retrieves protein-protein interaction interface residues for a UniProt protein from PDBe-KB, returning residue positions in UniProt numbering, interaction partners, and PDB structures where interfaces were observed.

components.name: PDBe-KB get ligand sites
components.description: Get ligand binding site residues for a UniProt protein from PDBe-KB, returning all known binding ligands, specific residue positions, PDB structures, and ligand metadata.

components.name: PDBe KB get summary stats
components.description: Get aggregated structural summary statistics for a UniProt protein from PDBe-KB, including counts of PDB structures, unique ligands, interaction partners, annotations, and similar proteins.

components.name: PDBe KB Get Superposition Clusters
components.description: Retrieves structural superposition clusters for a UniProt protein from PDBe-KB, grouping protein segments with structurally aligned PDB chains by 3D structural similarity and returning representative and member structures.

components.name: PDBePISA Get Assemblies
components.description: Predicts biological assemblies from a crystal structure PDB ID using PDBePISA, analyzing crystal packing to return oligomeric state, stability scores, dissociation energy, surface areas, and composition.

components.name: PDBePISA get interfaces
components.description: Given a PDB entry ID, analyzes protein-protein and protein-ligand interfaces in the crystal structure using PDBePISA and returns interface area, solvation energy, p-value, hydrogen bonds, salt bridges, disulfide bonds, and per-molecule contributions for each interface.

components.name: PDBePISA get monomer analysis
components.description: Analyze solvent-accessible surface area and interface participation for each chain in a PDB structure using PDBePISA, returning per-chain total interface area, number of interface contacts, and detailed interface participations.

components.name: PDBe compound lookup
components.description: Retrieve PDB ligand/compound information such as chemical name, formula, molecular weight, InChI, InChI key, SMILES, and systematic names by three-letter compound ID from PDBe.

components.name: PDBe Structure Search by Organism
components.description: Search PDB protein structure records through PDBe's Solr search, combining a keyword query with organism name filtering to return species-specific structures.

components.name: PDBeSearch structure search
components.description: Search PDB structures through PDBe's Solr search interface by keyword, protein name, or gene name, returning PDB IDs, titles, resolution, experimental methods, deposition dates, and organisms sorted by resolution.

components.name: PDBe SIFTS Get All Structures
components.description: Retrieves all PDB structures for a specified UniProt protein from PDBe SIFTS, grouped by PDB entry with chain details and sorted by resolution. Supports pagination with limit and offset.

components.name: PDBe SIFTS get best structures
components.description: Retrieves the best available PDB structures for a UniProt protein accession, ranked by coverage and resolution from PDBe SIFTS. Returns PDB IDs with chain mapping, resolution, experimental method, and UniProt sequence coverage, with paged access via limit and offset.

components.name: PDBe SIFTS PDB to UniProt mapping
components.description: Maps PDB entry chains to UniProt protein accessions using PDBe SIFTS cross-referencing, returning protein presence, chain correspondence and residue-level numbering for a given PDB ID.

components.name: PDBeSIFTS Get SCOP Mapping
components.description: Retrieve the SCOP structural classification for a PDB entry from PDBe SIFTS, including class, fold, superfamily, SCCS code, SCOP domain identifiers, and per-chain residue-range mappings that locate protein domain boundaries.

components.name: PDBe Validation get outlier residues
components.description: Get residue-level validation outliers for a PDB structure from PDBe. Accepts a PDB ID and returns problematic residues with geometry problems such as Ramachandran outliers, sidechain rotamer outliers, and bond angle/length deviations, organized by molecule/chain.

components.name: PDBe Validation Get Quality Scores
components.description: Retrieve global quality validation scores for a PDB structure from PDBe, including percentile rankings for Ramachandran outliers, rotamer outliers, and clashscore.

components.name: PDBTM get topology
components.description: Retrieves structure-derived transmembrane topology for a PDB entry from PDBTM, including per-chain classification (alpha-helical, beta-barrel, or non-membrane) and transmembrane segment count computed from coordinates. Accepts a 4-character PDB identifier.

components.name: PDC Clinical Data Lookup
components.description: Retrieves clinical metadata for patient cases in a cancer proteomics study from the NCI Proteomics Data Commons (PDC) using a PDC study accession number. Returns paginated clinical data including case IDs, disease type, primary site, and demographic information.

components.name: PDC Get Gene Protein
components.description: Retrieves protein information and proteomics study coverage for a gene from the NCI Proteomics Data Commons (PDC). Given a gene symbol, it returns gene description, gene identifiers, associated protein accessions, and spectral count data across PDC studies where the protein was detected.

components.name: PDC Get Quant Data Matrix
components.description: Retrieves quantitative data matrices for specified PDC study IDs from the NCI Proteomic Data Commons.

components.name: PDC get study summary
components.description: Retrieve a study summary from PDC using a PDC study ID; returns summary information for the selected study.

components.name: PDC list programs
components.description: List all programs and projects in the NCI Proteomics Data Commons (PDC), returning the complete hierarchy of programs such as CPTAC, ICPC, APOLLO, CBTN, Georgetown, and Broad Institute, along with their constituent projects. The tool takes no input parameters and outputs program and project identifiers that can be use…

components.name: PDC search studies
components.description: Search the NCI Proteomics Data Commons (PDC) for cancer proteomics studies using free-text queries matched against curated study metadata and titles, returning studies with matched fields.

components.name: PepCalc peptide properties
components.description: Calculate physicochemical properties for a peptide with optional N-terminal and C-terminal chemical modifications using the Pep-Calc.com API, returning molecular formula, monoisotopic and average molecular weight, isoelectric point, and 280 nm extinction coefficient.

components.name: PEPlife2 peptide search
components.description: Search PEPlife 2.0 for experimentally measured peptide half-life and proteolytic-stability records. Accepts filters for linear/cyclic form, origin organism/incubation media, or sequence, and returns records including peptide sequence, half-life value/units, protease, incubation conditions, modifications, PubMed ID, an…

components.name: PeptideAtlas get observed peptides
components.description: Query the PeptideAtlas database to retrieve mass-spectrometry-observed peptides for a protein or gene, optionally constrained by a UniProt accession or biosequence name. Each record includes peptide sequence, observation counts, sample counts, and PeptideProphet/proteotypic scores.

components.name: Pfam family detail lookup
components.description: Retrieves detailed annotation for a Pfam protein family by accession from the Pfam database, including family name, description, type, member counts, clan membership, representative 3D structure, Wikipedia link, and GO terms.

components.name: Pfam Get Family Proteins
components.description: Retrieves proteins containing a specified Pfam domain, optionally filtered by species or SwissProt review status, and returns protein accessions, names, gene names, lengths, organisms, and domain start/end positions.

components.name: Pfam get family proteomes
components.description: Retrieves the distribution of a Pfam protein family across reference proteomes, returning organism names, taxonomy identifiers, and reference proteome status for each proteome containing proteins with the domain.

components.name: Pfam Get Protein Annotations
components.description: Get all Pfam domain annotations for a specific protein by its UniProt accession, returning every Pfam domain with start/end residue positions, E-values, short names, and integrated InterPro entries.

components.name: Pfam search clans
components.description: Search and list Pfam clan records by keyword query, returning protein superfamily groupings and related Pfam families from the Pfam database. If no query is given, returns a general listing of clans.

components.name: Pfam search families
components.description: Search Pfam protein family entries by keyword through the InterPro API and return matching Pfam family accessions, names, types, and integrated InterPro entries.

components.name: PGS Catalog get performance metrics
components.description: Retrieve published validation and evaluation performance metrics for a polygenic score from the PGS Catalog by its PGS ID. Returns records per evaluation sample set with effect sizes, classification accuracy, other metrics, ancestry, sample size, covariates, and source publication.

components.name: PGSCatalog get score
components.description: Search the PGS Catalog for traits or phenotypes matching a query term and return matching trait IDs, labels, descriptions, and published polygenic score counts.

components.name: PGSCatalog get scores by trait
components.description: Searches the PGS Catalog for traits or phenotypes matching a query term and returns matching trait identifiers (EFO/MONDO), labels, descriptions, and counts of published polygenic scores.

components.name: PGS Catalog trait search
components.description: Search the PGS Catalog (pgscatalog.org, EMBL-EBI) for traits and phenotypes matching a text query, returning matching trait identifiers, labels, descriptions, and associated polygenic score counts.

components.name: PharmacoDB gene-compound biomarker associations
components.description: Get gene-compound biomarker associations from PharmacoDB showing how gene expression or other molecular features correlate with drug sensitivity. Filters by compound, gene, tissue, and molecular data type; returns statistical associations including effect estimate, p-values, FDR, sensitivity statistic, molecular data…

components.name: PharmacoDB cell line lookup
components.description: Get detailed information about a cancer cell line from PharmacoDB, including tissue of origin, disease annotations, dataset-specific synonyms, and accession IDs, using a cell line name or PharmacoDB cell ID. PharmacoDB harmonizes cell line identifiers across 10 pharmacogenomics datasets.

components.name: PharmacoDB get compound
components.description: Get detailed information about a compound/drug from PharmacoDB, including chemical annotations, profiled datasets, and molecular targets with associated genes. Look up by compound name or PharmacoDB compound ID.

components.name: PharmacoDB drug-target query
components.description: Query PharmacoDB drug-target relationships in multiple directions: retrieve molecular targets for a given gene (by HGNC symbol or ID), list targets for a compound (by name or ID), or page through the full compound-to-target table when neither gene nor compound is specified.

components.name: PharmacoDB get experiments
components.description: Get drug sensitivity experiments from PharmacoDB with dose-response curves and pharmacological profiles. Filter by compound name, cell line name, and/or dataset; returns raw dose-response measurements and fitted parameters (IC50, EC50, AAC, Hill slope, Einf, DSS1/2/3), integrating data from CCLE, CTRPv2, FIMM, GDSC1,…

components.name: PharmacoDB get molecular profiling
components.description: Get the per-cell-line molecular profiling inventory from PharmacoDB. Given a cell line name or ID, returns which molecular data types are available in pharmacogenomics datasets such as CCLE, CTRPv2, FIMM, GDSC1/2, and gCSI, with profile counts.

components.name: PharmacoDB list datasets
components.description: List all cancer pharmacogenomics datasets available in PharmacoDB, returning dataset names and IDs for the integrated collection including CCLE, CTRPv2, FIMM, GDSC1/GDSC2, GRAY, NCI60, PRISM, UHNBreast, and gCSI.

components.name: PharmacoDB search
components.description: Search PharmacoDB for compounds, cell lines, tissues, or genes by name. Returns matching entities with PharmacoDB UIDs and type, using cancer pharmacogenomics data integrated from 10 datasets.

components.name: PharmGKB clinical annotation lookup
components.description: Get PharmGKB clinical annotations with gene-drug-phenotype relationships and variant-level clinical significance data using an annotation ID.

components.name: PharmGKB get dosing guidelines
components.description: Retrieves pharmacogenetic dosing guidelines from PharmGKB using a ClinPGx guideline identifier. Returns the matching CPIC or DPWG dosing guideline record.

components.name: PharmGKB Get Drug Details
components.description: Get detailed information for a drug from PharmGKB using its PharmGKB Chemical ID. Returns structural information, cross-references, and related genes.

components.name: PharmGKB drug label annotations
components.description: Retrieves regulatory drug-label pharmacogenomic annotations from PharmGKB/ClinPGx, listing FDA label annotations by default and supporting filtering by drug name or source, with full annotation details available by label ID.

components.name: PharmGKB gene details
components.description: Get detailed information for a gene from PharmGKB using its PharmGKB Accession ID, returning chromosomal location, cross-references, and other metadata.

components.name: PharmGKB get pathway
components.description: Get a curated pharmacogenomic pathway from PharmGKB/ClinPGx by pathway ID. Returns pathway name, authors, biopaxLink, and an HTML description of the pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic pathway.

components.name: PharmGKB get variant annotations
components.description: Get variant-level literature annotations from PharmGKB/ClinPGx filtered by gene or chemical PharmGKB Accession ID, returning allele/genotype, phenotype category, drug context, significance, and source literature. Results are capped by a limit.

components.name: PharmGKB search drugs
components.description: Search for drugs in PharmGKB by name or PharmGKB ID, returning drug name, ID, and basic metadata.

components.name: PharmGKB search genes
components.description: Search for genes in PharmGKB by name, symbol, or ID and return PharmGKB Gene ID and basic gene metadata.

components.name: PharmGKB search variants
components.description: Search PharmGKB for genetic variants by rsID or name and return matching variant IDs and associated gene information.

components.name: PharmVar get alleles
components.description: Get all star allele definitions for a pharmacogene from PharmVar. Given a gene symbol, returns star allele names, functional status, activity scores, variant details, and evidence levels.

components.name: PharmVar list genes
components.description: Lists all pharmacogenes curated by PharmVar (Pharmacogene Variation Consortium), the authoritative repository for pharmacogene allele nomenclature and variant data. Returns 15+ genes with their allele counts and descriptions, including genes like CYP2D6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2B6, and DPYD.

components.name: Pharos get disease targets
components.description: Get drug targets associated with a disease from Pharos, returning targets with TDL classification to identify druggable vs understudied proteins. Supports optional TDL filtering.

components.name: Pharos ligand target retrieval
components.description: Retrieve all protein targets for a drug or ligand from Pharos/TCRD by name or Pharos ligand ID. Returns SMILES, target count, and recorded bioactivities including target gene, development level, protein family, activity type and value, and mechanism of action.

components.name: Pharos Get Target
components.description: Get detailed drug target information from Pharos/TCRD by gene symbol or UniProt ID, returning target development level, protein family, novelty score, publication count, associated diseases with MONDO IDs, and ligand/drug counts with top ligands.

components.name: Pharos get target expression
components.description: Retrieves GTEx baseline tissue RNA expression (per-tissue TPM) for a drug target from Pharos/TCRD using a gene symbol or UniProt ID, returning one record per tissue with TPM and gender stratification when available.

components.name: Pharos target ligands
components.description: Retrieve ligand and drug records targeting a protein from Pharos using a gene symbol or UniProt accession.

components.name: Pharos get TDL summary
components.description: Get Target Development Level statistics from Pharos. Returns counts of human proteome targets at each TDL: Tclin (approved drugs), Tchem (chemical probes), Tbio (biological annotations), Tdark (understudied). Use to understand druggable genome coverage.

components.name: Pharos drug target search
components.description: Searches the Pharos database for drug targets by gene name, protein name, or keyword, with optional Target Development Level filtering, and returns target development level, protein family, and novelty scores.

components.name: Plant Reactome search pathways
components.description: Search Plant Reactome (Gramene) for plant biological pathways by keyword query and optional species filter, returning matching pathways with their stable IDs and species.

components.name: PMC search papers
components.description: Search for full-text biomedical literature in PubMed Central using a text query and return matching paper records.

components.name: PomBase get gene
components.description: Get detailed gene information from PomBase for fission yeast (Schizosaccharomyces pombe) by systematic gene identifier. Returns gene name, protein product, InterPro domain annotations, deletion viability, UniProt cross-reference, and transmembrane domain coordinates.

components.name: PomBase get gene phenotypes
components.description: Get phenotype annotations for a fission yeast (S. pombe) gene from PomBase using a systematic gene identifier. Returns deletion viability, FYPO (Fission Yeast Phenotype Ontology) term annotations with evidence codes.

components.name: PomBase get GO annotations
components.description: Retrieve Gene Ontology annotations for a specified fission yeast gene from PomBase, returning per-aspect counts and resolved term names across biological process, molecular function, and cellular component.

components.name: PomBase get interactions
components.description: Retrieves physical and genetic interaction records for a specified fission-yeast (S. pombe) gene from PomBase, including evidence method, reference PMID, throughput, and source database.

components.name: PomBase Get Orthologs
components.description: Retrieves human and S. cerevisiae orthologs for a fission-yeast (S. pombe) gene from PomBase, accepting a PomBase systematic gene ID and returning ortholog IDs with taxon information.

components.name: PomBase search genes
components.description: Search PomBase for fission yeast (Schizosaccharomyces pombe) genes by name, systematic ID, or protein product keyword and return matching gene records with systematic IDs, gene names, and protein products.

components.name: PopGen Fst
components.description: Calculate the Weir-Cockerham (1984) theta Fst estimator between two populations from allele frequencies and sample sizes, applying the n_c sample-size correction to measure allele-frequency divergence.

components.name: PopGen haplotype count
components.description: Estimates distinct haplotypes after recombination across generations for a region with multiple biallelic SNPs, reporting maximum theoretical haplotypes, expected crossovers per gamete, recombination probability, and haplotype diversity based on linkage disequilibrium decay.

components.name: PopGen HWE test
components.description: Tests Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium for a biallelic locus from observed genotype counts (AA, Aa, aa), computing allele frequencies, expected genotype counts, chi-square statistic with 1 df, and p-value, and reports HWE status and heterozygote excess or deficit.

components.name: PopGen inbreeding
components.description: Computes the inbreeding coefficient F for a selected pedigree type over one or more generations using the recurrence F_t = base_F + (1-base_F)*F_{t-1}. Reports per-generation F, cumulative F, and retained heterozygosity.

components.name: PRIDE get project
components.description: Retrieve comprehensive project metadata for a PRIDE Archive proteomics dataset by accession ID, including experimental design, sample information, instruments, data processing methods, publication links, protein identifications, quantification data, and file download URLs.

components.name: PRIDE Get Project Files
components.description: Get the complete list of data files for a PRIDE Archive project, including raw mass spectrometry files, search results, FASTA databases, and supplementary data, returning file metadata with names, types, sizes, download URLs, and checksums.

components.name: PRIDE get projects for protein
components.description: Reverse lookup tool that lists PRIDE Archive project accessions for a given UniProt protein accession, returning the protein identifier and all PXD project identifiers where it was reported. It enables finding proteomics datasets containing a specific protein.

components.name: PRIDE search proteomics
components.description: Search the PRIDE Archive for proteomics experiments and mass spectrometry datasets by keyword query and return project metadata, including accession IDs, species, tissue types, instruments, publication dates, and file counts.

components.name: Progenetix CNV search
components.description: Search for cancer biosamples with copy number variations (CNVs) in a specific genomic region using the Progenetix database, combining disease filters with RefSeq genomic coordinates to return matching biosamples.

components.name: Progenetix Get CNV Frequencies
components.description: Retrieves genome-wide aggregate copy number variation (CNV) gain and loss frequencies for a cancer type from Progenetix, selected by an NCIt code.

components.name: Progenetix list cohorts
components.description: Lists available cohorts in the Progenetix cancer CNV database, returning cohort IDs, labels, sample counts, and data types.

components.name: Progenetix list filtering terms
components.description: Lists available filtering terms (ontology codes) in the Progenetix cancer CNV database, returning NCIt cancer type codes, EDAM operation codes, or other ontology terms with counts of matching samples. Accepts an ontology prefix to filter terms.

components.name: Progenetix Search Biosamples
components.description: Search cancer tumor biosamples in the Progenetix database by NCIt disease ontology code using the GA4GH Beacon v2 protocol. Returns biosample IDs, histological diagnosis, pathological stage, and external references.

components.name: Progenetix search individuals
components.description: Searches individuals (patients) in the Progenetix cancer CNV database by NCIt disease ontology code, returning patient IDs, sex, disease diagnosis, age at onset, and study references for cancer genomics cohort characterization.

components.name: PROSITE entry lookup
components.description: Retrieve a PROSITE protein motif/domain entry by its accession number. Returns the entry name, description, type, consensus pattern, functional site annotations, UniProt cross-references, and documentation links.

components.name: PROSITE scan sequence
components.description: Scan a raw protein amino acid sequence against all PROSITE patterns and profiles to find matching motifs and domains, returning PROSITE signature accessions, names, positions, and confidence scores. This is the sequence-based alternative to ScanProsite_scan_protein; frequent low-information patterns are skipped by def…

components.name: PROSITE search
components.description: Search the PROSITE database for protein motifs, domains, and functional site patterns by keyword using the EBI InterPro API, returning accession numbers, names, types, and InterPro cross-references.

components.name: ProtacDB Get PROTAC
components.description: Get detailed information about a specific PROTAC compound from PROTAC-DB by its PROTAC-DB ID, returning SMILES structure, warhead, linker, E3 ligand, target protein, DC50 values, Dmax, cell lines, and literature references.

components.name: Search PROTAC compounds
components.description: Search PROTAC-DB 3.0 for PROTAC compounds by target protein and/or E3 ligase. Returns PROTAC structures with DC50, Dmax, SMILES, cell line, and pharmacological data.

components.name: ProtacDB search targets
components.description: Search PROTAC-DB 3.0 for PROTAC target proteins by gene symbol or protein name and return target protein names (short and long).

components.name: Get protein comments
components.description: Get functional annotations and comments for one or more proteins from the Proteins API using accession identifiers. Supports batch operations and returns curated comments on function, subcellular location, disease involvement, and other annotations.

components.name: Proteins API Get Epitopes
components.description: Retrieves B-cell and T-cell epitope sequences and antigenicity predictions for one or more UniProt protein accessions. Returns epitope features and immunology comments extracted from the UniProt protein endpoint.

components.name: Proteins API get features
components.description: Retrieves detailed sequence feature annotations for UniProt proteins by accession, including domains, regions, motifs, and modified residues. Supports batch requests via a list or comma-separated accession string.

components.name: Proteins API Get Genome Mappings
components.description: Retrieves reference genome mappings for proteins from the UniProt Proteins API, accepting protein accessions (or comma-separated accession lists) and returning cross-references to Ensembl, RefSeq, EMBL, and GenBank.

components.name: Get protein information
components.description: Retrieves comprehensive protein information from Proteins API by UniProt accession, including annotations, sequences, features, and cross-references, with support for batch accessions.

components.name: Proteomics data retrieval
components.description: Get proteomics data for a protein using UniProt protein accessions, including mass spectrometry evidence, PTM sites, and expression data. Supports batch retrieval of multiple accessions and returns PTM comments, modified residues, and related features.

components.name: Proteins API get publications
components.description: Retrieves literature references associated with UniProt protein accessions from the Proteins API. Accepts a single accession or batch of accessions and returns publication metadata including PubMed IDs and citation details.

components.name: Proteins API get variants
components.description: Retrieves protein variation data from UniProt, including disease-associated variants, natural variants, and population data. Accepts one or more UniProt protein accessions and returns variant information such as positions, amino acid changes, disease associations, and evidence.

components.name: Proteins API Get Cross-References
components.description: Retrieves database cross-references for UniProt protein accessions from the Proteins API, including links to Ensembl, PDB, Reactome, EMBL, and RefSeq. Supports batch requests by accepting a list or comma-separated accessions.

components.name: Proteins API search
components.description: Search proteins in Proteins API by gene name, protein name, or accession, returning matching proteins with full annotations; defaults to human proteins for gene/name searches unless an organism override is provided.

components.name: ProteinsPlus binding site similarity analysis
components.description: Analyzes protein binding site similarity and generates structural ensembles using SIENA (Structural Interaction fingerprint for ENsemble Analysis). Accepts a PDB ID and ligand identifier, returning aligned structures, binding site similarity scores, and structural ensembles for ensemble docking, virtual screening, or…

components.name: Generate protein-ligand interaction diagram
components.description: Generate 2D protein-ligand interaction diagrams using PoseView. The tool accepts a PDB ID and ligand identifier and returns diagrams in PNG, PDF, and SVG formats showing hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic contacts, pi-stacking, and salt bridges.

components.name: ProteinsPlus Predict Binding Sites
components.description: Predicts druggable binding sites and pockets in protein structures using the DoGSiteScorer algorithm. Accepts a PDB identifier or uploaded PDB file content and returns predicted pockets with druggability scores, volume, surface area, and residue composition.

components.name: ProteinsPlus predict binding sites v3
components.description: Predict druggable protein binding sites using the DoGSite3 algorithm with optional ligand-biased grid calculations. Accepts a PDB ID and optional reference ligand and returns predicted pockets with druggability scores, geometric properties, and subpocket analysis.

components.name: ProteinsPlus profile structure quality
components.description: Assesses protein structure quality and profiles protein-ligand complexes using StructureProfiler. Performs geometry checks, stereochemistry analysis, clash detection, and ligand binding site quality assessment; supports Astex, Iridium, Platinum, and combined validation criteria and returns detailed structure quality r…

components.name: ProteinsPlus protonate structure
components.description: Adds hydrogen atoms and optimizes protonation states of protein-ligand complexes using ProtoSS (Protonation Structure Solver) on ProteinsPlus. Accepts a PDB ID or raw PDB content and returns URLs to protonated protein PDB, protonated ligand SDF, and log files.

components.name: ProteomeXchange get dataset
components.description: Retrieve detailed metadata for a ProteomeXchange proteomics dataset by PX identifier, including title, species, instruments, publications, file count, and cross-references to partner repositories such as PRIDE, MassIVE, PeptideAtlas, and jPOST.

components.name: ProteomeXchange get spectrum by USI
components.description: Retrieve a single mass spectrum (PSM) from ProteomeXchange by Universal Spectrum Identifier (USI) via the PROXI v0.1 interface, returning scan number, charge state, precursor m/z, peptide sequence, CV-term attributes, and peak list (m/z + intensity pairs capped to the first 200 peaks).

components.name: ProteomeXchange search datasets
components.description: Search ProteomeXchange proteomics datasets through the MassIVE PROXI interface using a query string, returning dataset accessions, titles, and species. ProteomeXchange aggregates data from PRIDE, MassIVE, PeptideAtlas, jPOST, and iProX.

components.name: ProteomicsDB Get Expression Summary
components.description: Retrieves a tissue expression summary for a protein from ProteomicsDB using a UniProt accession, returning the top tissues/cell lines/body fluids ranked by mass-spectrometry-based iBAQ expression level along with detection counts. Complements antibody-based tissue expression from HPA.

components.name: ProteomicsDB Get Peptides for Protein
components.description: Get peptide-level mass spectrometry identification evidence for a protein from ProteomicsDB using a UniProt accession. Returns per-peptide records including peptide sequence, uniqueness, q-values, score, search engine, sequence positions, and source experiment/project/PubMed ID.

components.name: ProteomicsDB get protein expression
components.description: Retrieves mass spectrometry-based protein expression data from ProteomicsDB by UniProt accession, returning quantitative log10 intensity values for each human tissue, cell line, or body fluid source where the protein was detected, with optional filtering by tissue category and calculation method.

components.name: ProteomicsDB protein meltome
components.description: Get thermal proteome profiling (meltome/TPP) melting curves and associated apparent melting temperature and fit quality for a protein from ProteomicsDB by gene symbol or UniProt accession.

components.name: ProteomicsDB list tissues
components.description: Lists all available tissues, cell lines, and body fluids in ProteomicsDB, optionally filtered by category, returning their BTO ontology IDs, names, categories, and anatomical groupings.

components.name: ProteomicsDB search proteins
components.description: Search ProteomicsDB for proteins by gene symbol, UniProt accession, or protein name, returning matching protein entries with identifiers, names, and molecular masses.

components.name: ProtocolOptimizer
components.description: Reviews an initial research protocol and returns targeted revisions with ratings, feedback, and a prioritized action-item checklist for clarity, feasibility, risk mitigation, and evaluation metrics.

components.name: ProtParam calculate
components.description: Calculate physicochemical properties of a protein from an amino acid sequence, including molecular weight, isoelectric point, amino acid composition, extinction coefficients, instability index, aliphatic index, and GRAVY, with no external API required.

components.name: ProtVar Get Function
components.description: Get functional annotations at a specific amino acid position from ProtVar, including overlapping UniProt features (domains, active sites, binding sites, PTMs), the protein's function description, and structural context. Inputs are a UniProt accession and an amino acid position.

components.name: ProtVar population data lookup
components.description: Get population observation data for a protein variant position from ProtVar. Accepts a UniProt accession and amino acid position and returns co-located variants with population allele frequencies from gnomAD and 1000Genomes, ClinVar clinical significance, and SIFT/PolyPhen computational predictions.

components.name: ProtVar variant mapping
components.description: Map a human protein variant to genomic coordinates and retrieve pathogenicity predictions (AlphaMissense, EVE, ESM, conservation) via ProtVar; accepts protein accession/change, dbSNP rsID, or VCF-style genomic variant identifiers and returns isoform mappings, consequence type, and variant effect scores.

components.name: PubChem get assay active compounds
components.description: Retrieve PubChem Compound IDs (CIDs) of compounds that are active in a PubChem BioAssay, given an assay ID, returning IDs that passed the activity threshold for hit identification from high-throughput screens.

components.name: PubChem get assay description
components.description: Retrieves PubChem BioAssay description and metadata by AID, returning assay name, source, protocol, target information, activity outcomes, and data columns. Helps understand what an assay measures before retrieving results.

components.name: PubChem get assay dose response
components.description: Retrieves dose-response data for a PubChem BioAssay ID from the PubChem PUG REST dose-response endpoint, returning concentration-response curves for tested compounds.

components.name: PubChem assay summary
components.description: Retrieves summary statistics for a PubChem BioAssay by AID, including active/inactive compound counts, target information, and assay metadata.

components.name: PubChem Get Assay Targets
components.description: Retrieves protein and gene targets for a given PubChem BioAssay ID (aid), returning GI numbers, protein names, gene IDs, and gene symbols via the PubChem BioAssay REST API.

components.name: PubChem get assays for compound active
components.description: Retrieves PubChem BioAssay IDs (AIDs) where a queried compound is active, returning a list of assay identifiers for target profile analysis.

components.name: PubChem Get Associated Patents by CID
components.description: Retrieve patent records associated with a PubChem compound ID (CID) using the PubChem PUG View API, returning a JSON record with patent sections.

components.name: PubChem CID lookup by compound name
components.description: Search PubChem by chemical or drug name to retrieve associated PubChem Compound IDs (CIDs). Accepts a compound name or IUPAC name and returns matching CID(s).

components.name: PubChem get CID by SMILES
components.description: Retrieve corresponding PubChem compound identifiers (CIDs) from a SMILES string using PubChem's chemical structure lookup endpoint.

components.name: PubChem compound 2D image lookup
components.description: Retrieves a 2D structure image (PNG format) of a PubChem compound by its CID. Accepts a compound CID and optional image size, and returns the corresponding chemical structure image.

components.name: PubChem get compound bioactivity
components.description: Get bioassay results summary for a compound by PubChem CID, returning all assays the compound was tested in, activity outcomes (active/inactive), and target information.

components.name: PubChem compound properties by CID
components.description: Retrieve specified molecular properties for a PubChem compound by CID, including molecular weight, IUPAC name, and SMILES representations.

components.name: PubChem Get Compound Synonyms by CID
components.description: Retrieves the complete list of synonyms recorded in PubChem for a compound specified by its PubChem CID. Accepts an integer CID and returns a JSON object containing the synonyms.

components.name: PubChem Compound XRefs by CID
components.description: Get external cross-references for a PubChem compound by CID, returning links to external databases such as ChEBI, DrugBank, and KEGG.

components.name: PubChem substance lookup by SID
components.description: Retrieve a PubChem Substance (SID) record by Substance ID, returning the depositor submission including source name, source identifier, synonyms, comments (often SMILES/InChI), cross-references, and linked compound CIDs; returns found=false when the SID does not exist.

components.name: PubChem Get Substances by Source
components.description: List all PubChem substance SIDs deposited or offered by a specified chemical vendor or data source, using an exact source name. Returns the depositor's full substance (SID) catalog from PubChem.

components.name: PubChem list substance sources
components.description: Lists the registered substance sources (vendors) in PubChem, which can be used to validate or normalize vendor names for subsequent substance catalog lookups.

components.name: PubChem search assays by target gene
components.description: Search PubChem BioAssay records by target gene symbol and return the AIDs of assays that screen against the specified gene.

components.name: PubChem Search Assays by Type
components.description: Search PubChem bioassays by assay type (screening, confirmatory, doseresponse, summary, cellbased, biochemical, invivo, invitro) and retrieve matching assay IDs (AIDs).

components.name: PubChem Search Compounds by Similarity
components.description: Search PubChem for compounds similar to a given SMILES molecule using Tanimoto coefficient similarity, returning a list of compound identifiers (CIDs) above a configurable threshold.

components.name: PubChem search compounds by substructure
components.description: Search PubChem for compound identifiers (CIDs) whose chemical structure contains a supplied SMILES substructure. Accepts a SMILES string and returns matching PubChem CIDs.

components.name: PubChem BioAssay assay lookup
components.description: Retrieves detailed PubChem BioAssay records by Assay ID (AID), including assay name, description, protocol, targets, and source information.

components.name: PubChem BioAssay summary lookup
components.description: Retrieves summary and molecular target information for a PubChem BioAssay by AID, including assay name, source, method type, scoring details, and target gene/protein data.

components.name: PubChem BioAssay concise activity table
components.description: Get the assay-wide concise bioactivity table for a PubChem BioAssay (AID), returning one row per tested compound with activity outcome, potency, target accession and target gene ID.

components.name: PubChem BioAssay search by gene
components.description: Searches PubChem BioAssay for assays that target a specified human gene, returning matching assay IDs and summaries. Accepts a gene symbol as input.

components.name: PubChemTox get acute effects
components.description: Retrieves acute toxicity effects for a chemical compound from PubChem, including symptoms, clinical observations, and effects from oral, inhalation, and dermal exposure routes. Data is drawn from toxicological databases and clinical case reports.

components.name: PubChemTox get carcinogen classification
components.description: Get carcinogen classification data from PubChem for a chemical compound, including classifications from IARC, NTP, EPA, and other authoritative bodies.

components.name: PubChemTox get ecotoxicity values
components.description: Get aquatic/environmental ecotoxicity values for a chemical compound from PubChem, including LC50/EC50 lethal- and effect-concentration data for organisms such as fish, crustaceans, and protozoa sourced largely from HSDB.

components.name: PubChemTox get GHS classification
components.description: Retrieves Globally Harmonized System (GHS) hazard classification for a chemical compound from PubChem using a PubChem CID or compound name. Returns hazard pictograms, signal words, GHS hazard statements, and precautionary statements.

components.name: PubChemTox get human toxicity values
components.description: Get human toxicity values for a chemical compound from PubChem, including estimated fatal oral doses, fatal air concentrations, and IDLH thresholds sourced largely from HSDB.

components.name: PubChemTox get target organs
components.description: Retrieves target organs and body systems affected by a toxic chemical compound from PubChem, based on toxicological studies and clinical evidence.

components.name: PubChemTox get toxicity summary
components.description: Get a comprehensive toxicity data summary for a chemical compound from PubChem. Returns an overview of all available toxicity data sections and subsections, including toxicological and ecological information, acting as a table of contents for the compound's toxicological data.

components.name: PubChem toxicity values lookup
components.description: Get non-human toxicity values (LD50, LC50, etc.) for a chemical compound from PubChem, returning lethal dose/concentration data from animal studies. Data is sourced from HSDB and other toxicological databases.

components.name: PubMed get article
components.description: Fetch article metadata from PubMed using a PMID, including title, authors, author count, and complete author list with affiliations.

components.name: PubMed get cited by
components.description: Get a list of PubMed articles that cite a specific PMID using NCBI E-utilities. Input is a PubMed ID (PMID); output is a list of citing article PMIDs.

components.name: PubMed get links
components.description: Retrieves external links (LinkOut) for a PubMed article by its PMID via NCBI ELink, returning URLs to full-text providers, supplementary data, related resources, and clinical trials.

components.name: PubMed get related
components.description: Get related PubMed articles for a specific PMID using NCBI E-utilities elink. Returns a list of computationally similar articles based on title, abstract, and MeSH terms.

components.name: PubMed Guidelines Search
components.description: Search PubMed for peer-reviewed clinical practice guidelines using NCBI E-utilities, returning matching guideline records for a supplied medical topic or condition.

components.name: PubMed search articles
components.description: Search PubMed biomedical literature database using NCBI E-utilities (esearch + esummary). Accepts a query string with keywords, author names, journal names, or MeSH terms and returns article records with PMID, title, authors, journal, publication year, DOI, article type, and PubMed URL.

components.name: PubTator3 Entity Autocomplete
components.description: Provides best-matching PubTator3 standardized IDs for a partial biomedical term such as a gene, disease, chemical, or variant, converting free-text names into stable @IDs for use with other PubTator APIs.

components.name: PubTator3 get annotations
components.description: Extracts biomedical entity annotations from PubMed articles using NCBI PubTator3. Accepts one or more PubMed IDs as a comma-separated string and returns text-mined entities including genes, diseases, chemicals, species, mutations, and cell lines with normalized identifiers and text positions.

components.name: PubTator3 Get Entity Relations
components.description: Query the NCBI PubTator3 relation knowledge graph for a normalized biomedical entity and return ranked relation edges with relation types, source/target entities, and supporting publication counts from PubMed.

components.name: PubTator3 Literature Search
components.description: Search PubMed articles by keyword, PubTator entity ID, or entity-to-entity relation expression using PubTator3. Returns matching PubMed article records.

components.name: QualityCheckerAgent
components.description: AI agent that evaluates current literature search plans and result quality, then suggests improvements, new search strategies, and additional search plans based on a supplied plans analysis and search context.

components.name: QuickGO annotations by gene
components.description: Search Gene Ontology (GO) annotations for a specific gene product using the EBI QuickGO browser. Accepts a UniProtKB accession and returns GO terms annotated to the protein or gene with evidence codes, qualifiers, and annotation sources.

components.name: QuickGO annotations by GO term
components.description: Search for all gene products annotated with a specific Gene Ontology (GO) term using the EBI QuickGO browser. Returns the associated proteins/genes with their evidence codes and annotation sources, optionally filtered by species (taxon_id).

components.name: QuickGO Get Term Children
components.description: Get child terms (direct descendants) of a Gene Ontology (GO) term from the EBI QuickGO browser. Accepts a GO term accession and returns child term IDs, names, relationship types, and whether each child has further children.

components.name: QuickGO get term detail
components.description: Get detailed information about a specific Gene Ontology (GO) term from the EBI QuickGO browser, including name, definition, aspect, synonyms, cross-references, and child term count. Accepts a GO term accession such as GO:0006915 and returns the term record.

components.name: RCSB get chemical component
components.description: Get detailed chemical component information from the RCSB Protein Data Bank by 3-letter component ID, returning chemical name, formula, molecular weight, type, InChI/SMILES descriptors, and synonyms.

components.name: RCSB PDB sequence motif search
components.description: Search RCSB PDB for protein structures containing a specified sequence motif pattern using PROSITE patterns, regular expressions, or simple patterns. Input is a sequence motif pattern and output is polymer entity identifiers (PDB ID and entity number).

components.name: RCSB Advanced Search Structures
components.description: Advanced search of RCSB Protein Data Bank structures using combined attribute filters such as organism, resolution, experimental method, polymer description, and deposition date, with optional free-text query. Returns PDB IDs sorted by resolution or date.

components.name: RCSBData get assembly
components.description: Get biological assembly details for a PDB structure from the RCSB Data API, including oligomeric state, stoichiometry, entity counts, symmetry operations, and evidence for biological relevance.

components.name: RCSB Data Get Entry
components.description: Get comprehensive structure metadata for a PDB entry from the RCSB Data API, including experimental method, resolution, deposition/release dates, entity counts, molecular weight, assembly count, space group, and unit cell dimensions. Takes a PDB entry ID and returns detailed entry metadata.

components.name: RCSB Data nonpolymer entity lookup
components.description: Retrieves non-polymer entity (ligand, cofactor, ion) details from a PDB structure using the RCSB Data API, given a PDB ID and entity ID. Returns chemical name, component ID, formula weight, chain assignments, and any DrugBank or other database annotations.

components.name: Ligand information lookup
components.description: Get detailed chemical component (ligand) information from the Protein Data Bank via the RCSB Data API, including name, molecular formula, molecular weight, SMILES, InChIKey, type, and known drug targets with actions from DrugBank. Input is a PDB chemical component ID (3-letter code).

components.name: RCSB GraphQL get polymer entity
components.description: Retrieve detailed polymer entity information from PDB structures using a PDB ID, including amino acid sequence, chain IDs, polymer type, source organism, and functional annotations such as Pfam domains and GO terms.

components.name: RCSB PDB structure summary
components.description: Get comprehensive structure summary for one or more PDB entries using the RCSB PDB Data API (GraphQL), returning metadata such as title, resolution, molecular weight, experimental method, deposition/release dates, primary citation, atom count, entity counts, and unit cell dimensions.

components.name: Matched molecular pair transformation
components.description: Computes the matched molecular pair transformation between two SMILES compounds using the Hussain-Rea single-cut fragmentation algorithm (rdMMPA). Returns the common core, side-chain substituents, transformation string, Tanimoto similarity, and property deltas for structure-activity relationship analysis.

components.name: RDKit pharmacophore features
components.description: Extract pharmacophore feature centers from a molecule provided as SMILES using RDKit SMARTS matching. Identifies six feature types and optionally computes 3D coordinates via MMFF optimization, supporting pharmacophore profiling and drug design.

components.name: Re3data repository search
components.description: Search the re3data.org registry of research data repositories worldwide using keyword queries; returns matching repository names, identifiers, and DOIs for further retrieval of detailed metadata.

components.name: Re3data search repositories
components.description: Search the re3data.org global registry of research data repositories by keyword to find repository names, IDs, and DOIs that host datasets for a specified research topic, data type, or discipline.

components.name: Reactome disease target score
components.description: Extracts disease-target association scores from Reactome pathway data, taking an EFO disease identifier as input and returning a pathway-based numeric score.

components.name: Reactome get complex
components.description: Get detailed information about a protein complex from Reactome by its Stable ID, returning comprehensive complex data including subunits, compartments, and related information.

components.name: Reactome database version
components.description: Get the current Reactome database version number as an integer using the Reactome REST API.

components.name: Reactome get diseases
components.description: Retrieves disease pathways or Disease Ontology IDs (DOIDs) annotated in Reactome, returning disease-related pathway information including database identifiers, definitions, and names.

components.name: Reactome get entity compartment
components.description: Get compartment information for a Reactome entity by stable ID (e.g., R-HSA-73817). The tool queries the Reactome API and returns TSV data parsed into structured JSON with compartment ID, name, and type.

components.name: Reactome Get Entity Events
components.description: Retrieves reactions and subpathways associated with a Reactome entity stable ID via the Reactome hasEvent endpoint, returning TSV event data converted to structured JSON.

components.name: Reactome get event ancestors
components.description: Retrieves ancestor events (parent pathways) for a given Reactome pathway or reaction stable ID using the /data/event/{stId}/ancestors endpoint.

components.name: Reactome get events hierarchy
components.description: Retrieves the event hierarchy for supplied Reactome event identifiers using Reactome's /data/query/ids endpoint. Species and type filtering are not supported server-side.

components.name: Reactome Get Interactor
components.description: Retrieve detailed Reactome information about an interactor (protein, complex, or small molecule) by its Stable ID, including reference entities, compartments, and related pathways.

components.name: Reactome Get Participant Reference Entities
components.description: Retrieves reference entities (UniProt proteins, ChEBI chemicals, etc.) associated with participants of a Reactome reaction or event by stable ID, returning database identifiers and names.

components.name: Reactome get participants
components.description: Retrieve Reactome database entities by stable identifier using the unified query endpoint. Accepts complex, pathway, or reaction stIds and returns the matching entity record with database ID, display name, and stable ID.

components.name: Reactome get pathway
components.description: Queries Reactome for all reactions and subpathways contained in a pathway identified by a stable ID, returning the contained events with their metadata and relationships.

components.name: Get pathway hierarchy
components.description: Retrieves the hierarchy of parent pathways for a given Reactome pathway stable ID using the Reactome REST API, returning a list of parent pathways.

components.name: Reactome get pathway reactions
components.description: Queries Reactome for all reactions and subpathways contained under a specified pathway using its Pathway Stable ID, returning event metadata and relationships.

components.name: Reactome Get Pathways Low Entity
components.description: Query the Reactome database for low-level pathways (most specific pathways) that contain a specified entity stable ID, such as a pathway, reaction, or physical entity, and return the matching pathway records.

components.name: Reactome get reaction
components.description: Get detailed information about a specific reaction or event in the Reactome database by its Stable ID, including inputs, outputs, regulation, literature references, and participants.

components.name: Reactome list species
components.description: Lists available species in the Reactome database, returning species names and taxonomy IDs for use in pathway queries.

components.name: Reactome List Top Pathways
components.description: List top-level pathways from the Reactome pathway database for a specified species, returning pathway records with stable identifiers and names.

components.name: Reactome map UniProt to pathways
components.description: Maps a UniProt protein identifier to Reactome pathways, returning the corresponding pathway records.

components.name: Reactome map UniProt to reactions
components.description: Map a UniProt protein identifier to the set of Reactome reactions in which that protein participates using the Reactome REST API.

components.name: Reactome query by IDs
components.description: Query Reactome by a list of Reactome stable identifiers and return detailed information about matching pathways, reactions, or other entities. This endpoint requires Reactome stable IDs; external IDs must be mapped to Reactome IDs first.

components.name: ReactomeAnalysis expression analysis
components.description: Maps tab-delimited gene-value expression data onto Reactome pathways, returning each pathway with the matched expression values and summary statistics such as column names and min/max values.

components.name: Reactome Analysis not found identifiers
components.description: Retrieves the explicit list of submitted identifiers that failed to map to any Reactome entity for a given analysis token, along with the count of unmapped identifiers. This mapping QC tool takes a Reactome analysis token and returns unmapped identifier strings from the Reactome knowledgebase.

components.name: ReactomeAnalysis Pathway Enrichment
components.description: Perform pathway overrepresentation (enrichment) analysis using the Reactome Analysis Service. Submit a list of gene symbols, UniProt IDs, or Ensembl IDs to identify statistically enriched Reactome pathways ranked by p-value with FDR correction, entity counts, and reaction coverage.

components.name: Reactome analysis pathway found entities
components.description: Retrieves the specific submitted identifiers that matched a given Reactome pathway for an analysis token, along with their Reactome cross-references (e.g., UniProt and ENSEMBL IDs); it requires an analysis token and a pathway stable ID, and returns the list of matched entities.

components.name: ReactomeAnalysis species comparison
components.description: Perform Reactome pathway analysis with cross-species projection by submitting protein or gene identifiers; Reactome maps them via orthology to human pathways and returns enriched human Reactome pathways with mapping statistics such as FDR and entity coverage.

components.name: ReactomeAnalysis species comparison v2
components.description: Performs true cross-species pathway comparison via Reactome's /species/{source}/{target} endpoint, comparing entire pathway sets of a source species against a target species by orthology projection. Returns analysis_type=SPECIES_COMPARISON, total pathways found, and identifier counts.

components.name: Reactome Analysis Token Result
components.description: Retrieve previously computed Reactome pathway analysis results using an analysis token. Tokens are returned from pathway_enrichment or species_comparison analyses and allow access to results without rerunning; results include pathway rankings by FDR or p-value and coverage metrics.

components.name: Reactome content get contained events
components.description: Retrieves the complete hierarchy of sub-pathways and biochemical reactions contained within a Reactome pathway given a stable identifier, returning counts and lists of sub-pathways and reactions.

components.name: Reactome enhanced pathway lookup
components.description: Retrieve enhanced Reactome pathway details, including curated descriptions, literature references, Gene Ontology biological process terms, and direct sub-events, using a Reactome pathway identifier.

components.name: Reactome Content Search
components.description: Search Reactome for pathways, reactions, and biological entities by keyword. Takes a search query and optional species or entity type filters, and returns matching Reactome records with paging information.

components.name: ReactomeInteractors Get Entity Pathways
components.description: Find Reactome biological pathways that contain a specific molecular entity. Accepts a Reactome stable identifier for an entity and returns pathway stable IDs, names, and disease-association flags.

components.name: ReactomeInteractors get protein interactors
components.description: Retrieve protein-protein interaction partners for a specific protein from Reactome's IntAct-derived interaction data, returning interactor accessions, gene names, confidence scores, and evidence counts.

components.name: Reactome Interactors search entity
components.description: Search Reactome for molecular entities and return their Reactome stable identifiers for use in downstream pathway queries.

components.name: REBASE get enzyme
components.description: Look up a restriction enzyme in REBASE by name and retrieve its recognition sequence with cut point, blunt or sticky ends, source organism, methylation sensitivity, commercial availability, and isoschizomers.

components.name: REBASE list isoschizomers
components.description: Lists every restriction enzyme sharing the same recognition specificity as a named enzyme, with commercially available enzymes listed first.

components.name: REBASE search by site
components.description: Search REBASE for restriction enzymes that recognize a supplied recognition site or cut a supplied DNA sequence, returning matching enzymes and the number of cut sites each produces. IUPAC ambiguity codes in enzyme sites are expanded, and results can optionally be restricted to commercially available enzymes.

components.name: RegulomeDB query variant
components.description: Query RegulomeDB for regulatory variant annotations by dbSNP rsID and return JSON annotation records.

components.name: ReMap get peaks in region
components.description: Retrieve all ChIP-seq transcriptional-regulator binding peaks from the ReMap catalog that overlap a supplied genomic interval (chrom:start-end). Returns overlapping peaks with their genomic coordinates, bound transcription factor, cell line/tissue biotype, and source GEO/ENCODE accession.

components.name: ReMap transcription factor binding
components.description: Retrieve transcription factor binding sites for a given gene symbol and optional cell type from the ReMap database. Returns matching transcription factor binding site records.

components.name: ReMap list datasets for target
components.description: List ReMap ChIP-seq datasets for a transcription factor, returning one row per dataset with optional filtering by GEO/ENCODE experiment accession and optional peak count retrieval.

components.name: Resolve identifier for gene or protein
components.description: Resolves an unknown gene or protein identifier across namespaces by detecting whether it is a symbol, Ensembl, UniProt, Entrez, RefSeq or HGNC identifier. Queries MyGene, UniProt ID Mapping, g:Profiler, BridgeDb and Ensembl to return equivalent identifiers and the sources that agree on them.

components.name: Result Summarizer Agent
components.description: Summarizes literature search results for a research plan by synthesizing plan details and paper texts into a concise 300-500 word summary covering key findings, themes, important papers, gaps, and overall assessment.

components.name: Rfam accession to ID
components.description: Converts an Rfam RNA family accession (e.g., RF00360) to its human-readable family ID/name (e.g., snoZ107_R87). The tool performs a simple lookup and returns a plain text response useful for cross-referencing and data integration.

components.name: Rfam get alignment
components.description: Retrieves curated RNA family seed alignments from Rfam in Stockholm, Pfam, FASTA, or ungapped FASTA format, with optional gzip compression. The tool takes an RNA family identifier and returns a multiple sequence alignment showing conserved positions and base pairing.

components.name: Rfam covariance model retrieval
components.description: Retrieve the Infernal covariance model for an RNA family from Rfam. Accepts an RNA family identifier and returns the CM file in Infernal format, capturing sequence and structure conservation for downstream RNA sequence analysis.

components.name: Rfam RNA family lookup
components.description: Retrieves comprehensive RNA family metadata from the Rfam database by RF accession or family name, returning description, RNA type, sequence count, species coverage, and structure source.

components.name: Rfam get sequence regions
components.description: Retrieves all genomic regions containing members of a specified RNA family from Rfam, returning sequence IDs, coordinates, scores, and species in tab-delimited, JSON, or XML format.

components.name: Rfam get structure mapping
components.description: Retrieve mapping between Rfam RNA families and PDB 3D structures, returning correspondence between RNA family, EMBL sequence regions, and PDB residues. The tool outputs tab-delimited records with PDB IDs, chains, residue ranges, and alignments for structural annotation and sequence-structure integration.

components.name: Rfam Get Tree Data
components.description: Retrieve the phylogenetic tree for an RNA family from Rfam in NHX format, based on seed alignment, with species names and sequence annotations for evolutionary and taxonomic studies.

components.name: Rfam ID to accession
components.description: Convert an Rfam family ID or name to its stable RF accession. Takes a family identifier such as snoZ107_R87 and returns the corresponding Rfam accession such as RF00360.

components.name: Rfam search sequence
components.description: Search an RNA sequence against all Rfam families using Infernal cmscan. It submits the sequence to a batch search server and returns hits with family matches, positions, scores, and E-values.

components.name: RGD get annotations
components.description: Retrieves disease, phenotype, pathway, and Gene Ontology annotations for a rat gene from the Rat Genome Database, returning curated annotations with ontology terms, evidence codes, and qualifiers.

components.name: RGD Get Gene
components.description: Retrieve detailed rat gene information from the Rat Genome Database using an RGD ID, including gene symbol, name, description with AGR functional summary, gene type, and Ensembl cross-reference.

components.name: RGD Get Orthologs
components.description: Get orthologs of a rat gene across species (human, mouse, chinchilla, dog, pig, etc.) from RGD using an RGD gene ID. Returns ortholog gene symbols, RGD IDs, names, and species for cross-species comparison.

components.name: RGD Get QTLs in Region
components.description: Retrieves QTLs overlapping a genomic region from the Rat Genome Database using chromosome, start/stop coordinates, and an assembly map key. Returns QTL symbol, name, RGD ID, LOD score, p-value, and inheritance type.

components.name: RGD get strain
components.description: Get the full Rat Genome Database (RGD) record for a single rat strain by exact strain symbol, returning identifier, name, substrain, strain type, genetics, origin, background strain, and description.

components.name: RGD get strain annotations
components.description: Retrieves curated disease, phenotype, and variant-trait ontology annotations for a rat strain from the Rat Genome Database by strain symbol, with optional category filtering.

components.name: RGD resolve symbol or region
components.description: Resolve a rat gene symbol to its native RGD gene record and identifier, or list genes overlapping a specified genomic region on a rat chromosome. Returns RGD gene records including RGD key, ID, name, and type.

components.name: Rat Genome Database gene search
components.description: Search the Rat Genome Database for rat, human, and mouse genes by symbol or keyword, returning matching gene records with RGD IDs, symbols, names, types, and descriptions.

components.name: RGD Search Strains
components.description: Search the Rat Genome Database (RGD) rat strain catalog by keyword and/or strain type, returning matching strains with their RGD ID, symbol, name, type, genetics, and origin.

components.name: Rhea get reaction
components.description: Fetches the full structured detail of a single Rhea biochemical reaction by its Rhea identifier, including the chemical equation, reactants and products with identifiers, stoichiometry and compartments, EC enzyme numbers, cross-references, and curation flags. Use it after finding reactions with Rhea search tools.

components.name: Rhea get reaction participants
components.description: Retrieve structured reactants and products for one Rhea biochemical reaction by its Rhea identifier, returning participant identifiers, names, stoichiometric coefficients, and transport compartments for metabolic network construction or annotation.

components.name: Rhea search by ChEBI
components.description: Search Rhea for biochemical reactions involving a specified ChEBI compound. Accepts a ChEBI identifier and returns matching reactions, including substrates, products, cofactors, balanced equations, and EC numbers.

components.name: Rhea search by EC
components.description: Search biochemical reactions in the Rhea database by Enzyme Commission (EC) number and retrieve all reactions catalyzed by enzymes in a given EC class.

components.name: Rhea Search Reactions
components.description: Search for biochemical reactions in the Rhea knowledgebase by compound name, reaction description, or keyword. Returns matching curated reaction records with associated enzyme and compound references.

components.name: RNAcentral get by accession
components.description: Retrieve a single RNAcentral entry by accession for detailed annotations and source cross-references, supporting RNA ID mapping and metadata retrieval from the RNAcentral database.

components.name: RNAcentral get genome locations
components.description: Retrieve genomic coordinates for a non-coding RNA from RNAcentral using an RNAcentral URS identifier and NCBI taxonomy ID, returning chromosome, strand, start, end, UCSC/Ensembl assembly, and GCA accession.

components.name: RNAcentral region ncRNA lookup
components.description: List non-coding RNA transcripts and exon features overlapping a specified genomic region using RNAcentral aggregated data from 50+ member databases. Accepts species and either a region string or chromosome/start/end coordinates, and returns overlapping ncRNAs with biotype, strand and coordinates.

components.name: RNAcentral get sequence
components.description: Retrieve the nucleotide sequence (FASTA) of a non-coding RNA from RNAcentral using an RNAcentral URS identifier. Returns the FASTA header, the sequence string, and its length.

components.name: RNAcentral Get Cross-references and Publications
components.description: Retrieve resolved per-source cross-references and publications for an RNAcentral entry using its URS accession, returning external database mappings and supporting literature.

components.name: RNAcentral search
components.description: Search aggregated ncRNA records (miRNA, rRNA, lncRNA, etc.) across sources via RNAcentral by keyword, accession, or sequence-based query, returning accessions, types, species, and descriptions for ncRNA analysis.

components.name: RNAseq edgeR/limma differential expression
components.description: Bulk RNA-seq differential expression analysis using edgeR (QL-F) or limma-voom on a count matrix and sample metadata with a specified contrast, returning DEG counts at multiple filtering thresholds and optional per-gene logFC/FDR and a full ranked table on disk.

components.name: ROC analysis
components.description: Performs ROC/AUC diagnostic-accuracy analysis from continuous prediction scores and binary labels supplied inline or as a CSV. Returns AUC with a bootstrap 95% confidence interval, Youden-optimal cutoff and associated sensitivity/specificity, optional metrics at a fixed cutoff, and a downsampled ROC curve using pure N…

components.name: Run Borzoi Predict
components.description: Predict multi-omic coverage tracks (RNA-seq, CAGE, ATAC, DNase, ChIP) directly from a DNA sequence using the Borzoi model. Returns central-bin values for requested tracks or top-signal tracks, with the sequence center-cropped or N-padded to 524,288 bp.

components.name: Run Borzoi variant effect
components.description: Score a genetic variant with Borzoi by predicting coverage for reference and alternate sequences of 524,288 bp centered on the variant and computing the central-bin delta per track, suited to RNA-seq and splicing-proximal variants.

components.name: Run Cell2location Deconvolution
