components.description: Deconvolves spatial transcriptomics data into per-location cell-type abundances using cell2location, a Bayesian model that estimates reference cell-type signatures from an annotated single-cell reference and maps them onto spatial data to return a summary of mean cell-type abundance across spots.

components.name: Run CellRank fate
components.description: Map single-cell fate with CellRank 2: build a Markov transition matrix over cells with a selectable kernel (connectivity, pseudotime, or RNA-velocity), coarse-grain it with GPCCA to identify terminal states, and compute each cell's probability of reaching each terminal state. Accepts a server-accessible .h5ad file and…

components.name: CellTypist annotation
components.description: Annotates single-cell expression data with CellTypist using a provider-converted model archive. Takes an .h5ad file of log1p-normalized expression and returns predicted cell type annotations.

components.name: Run ChromBPNet predict
components.description: Predicts chromatin accessibility (ATAC/DNase) from a DNA sequence using a trained ChromBPNet model. Accepts a DNA sequence and returns predicted log total counts, total counts, and a base-resolution accessibility profile.

components.name: Run ChromBPNet Variant Effect
components.description: Score non-coding regulatory variants with ChromBPNet (Pampari 2025) by predicting accessibility for reference and alternate sequences (each 2,114 bp, variant at center) and returning count log2 fold-change and profile Jensen-Shannon divergence for interpreting non-coding GWAS/eQTL variants.

components.name: Run COMPASS prediction
components.description: Predicts immune-checkpoint-inhibitor response from one-sample gene expression data using the official COMPASS architecture and a pinned provider artifact.

components.name: Run DESeq2 analysis
components.description: Run R DESeq2 differential expression analysis on a count matrix and sample metadata, returning gene counts, significance statistics, and dispersion estimates. Supports custom design formulas, contrasts, reference levels, log fold-change shrinkage, and Cook's distance refitting; an enrichGO operation can perform GO enr…

components.name: Enformer Genomic Track Prediction
components.description: Predict genomic track activity (CAGE/DNase/ATAC/ChIP; 5,313 human or 1,643 mouse tracks) from a DNA sequence using the Enformer model, which captures long-range regulatory interactions. The sequence is center-cropped or N-padded to 196,608 bp, and the tool returns central-bin predictions for requested tracks or top-si…

components.name: Run Enformer variant effect
components.description: Scores a regulatory variant with Enformer by predicting tracks for reference and alternate sequences (each 196,608 bp, variant at center) and returning the central-bin delta (alt - ref) per track as the variant effect on expression.

components.name: Run Harmony integrate
components.description: Integrates single-cell data across batches or samples using the Harmony batch-correction method. Takes a server-accessible .h5ad AnnData file and a batch key, computes or reuses a PCA embedding, and returns the batch-corrected PCA embedding (X_pca_harmony).

components.name: Run LDSC genetic correlation
components.description: Estimate the genetic correlation (rg) between two traits from GWAS summary statistics using cross-trait LD Score regression (Bulik-Sullivan 2015) with the NCI CBIIT/ldsc Python-3 engine. Accepts two munged .sumstats(.gz) files and returns rg with standard error and p-value.

components.name: Run LDSC Heritability
components.description: Estimate SNP-heritability from GWAS summary statistics using LD Score regression. Inputs a munged .sumstats(.gz) file and returns observed-scale h2 with standard error, LD-score-regression intercept, and ratio.

components.name: Run LIANA CellPhoneDB
components.description: Infer cell-cell communication from single-cell RNA-seq data using LIANA's CellPhoneDB permutation-test method. Takes an .h5ad file of log1p-normalized expression with cell-type labels and returns top ligand-receptor interactions between cell types scored by magnitude and specificity.

components.name: Run MACS3 callpeak
components.description: Call ChIP-seq or ATAC-seq peaks from alignment or fragment data using MACS3 callpeak, returning peak counts, top scoring peaks, and summary statistics parsed from narrowPeak output.

components.name: Run Milo differential abundance
components.description: Tests single-cell differential abundance using Milo: builds a kNN graph, assigns cells to overlapping neighbourhoods, counts cells per biological sample, and fits a negative-binomial GLM to test abundance shifts across a condition. Takes a server-accessible .h5ad file and returns summary counts of significant, enriche…

components.name: Run MOFA factors
components.description: Runs MOFA+ multi-omics factor analysis to integrate multiple omics views measured on the same samples into unsupervised latent factors. Accepts a views object mapping view names to feature value arrays per sample and returns a per-sample factor matrix with per-view variance explained.

components.name: Run Monocle3 pseudotime
components.description: Infer single-cell pseudotime with Monocle3 from an .h5ad file of raw counts using the preprocess, UMAP, cluster, learn graph, and order cells pipeline, returning each cell's pseudotime along a learned principal graph.

components.name: Run PAGA trajectory
components.description: Runs PAGA (Partition-based Graph Abstraction) on a single-cell AnnData file to estimate cluster connectivity and sketch trajectory backbone. Takes an .h5ad file path and cluster key, builds a neighbors graph if absent, then returns a cluster-by-cluster connectivity matrix and the strongest connected cluster pairs.

components.name: PINNACLE PPI Retrieval
components.description: Retrieves cell-type-specific protein-protein interaction embeddings from PINNACLE. Accepts a cell type and returns dense vector embeddings that represent functional relationships between proteins.

components.name: Run scANVI annotate
components.description: Transfer cell-type labels to unlabeled single cells using scANVI. Takes an .h5ad raw UMI count matrix with known labels in a labels_key column and an unlabeled_category sentinel, and returns cell-type predictions for unlabeled cells after scVI pretraining and semi-supervised refinement.

components.name: Run Scrublet doublets
components.description: Run Scrublet doublet detection on a single-cell RNA-seq count matrix in H5AD format. The tool simulates synthetic doublets from observed transcriptomes and returns per-cell doublet scores and boolean predicted doublet calls for filtering before clustering or annotation.

components.name: Run scVelo velocity
components.description: Run scVelo RNA velocity (Bergen et al., Nature Biotechnology 2020) on a single-cell AnnData file containing spliced and unspliced layers. The tool applies filter_and_normalize, moments, velocity, velocity_graph, and returns velocity-derived cell pseudotime ordering, per-cell velocity confidence, and optionally mean ps…

components.name: Run scVI differential expression
components.description: Trains scVI on a single-cell count matrix from an .h5ad file of raw UMI counts and runs Bayesian differential expression between two groups of cells, returning per-gene log-fold-changes and probabilities of differential expression.

components.name: Run scVI integration
components.description: Trains scVI on a single-cell RNA-seq count matrix from a server-accessible .h5ad file and returns the batch-corrected low-dimensional latent representation of cells, optionally using a batch key to correct batch effects.

components.name: SingleR annotate
components.description: Annotates single cells with SingleR by correlating each cell against a labeled reference transcriptome and assigning the best-matching cell-type label. Accepts a query .h5ad of log-normalized expression and returns per-cell labels plus label counts, using built-in celldex references or a user-supplied labeled .h5ad.

components.name: Run Slingshot trajectory
components.description: Infer single-cell lineages and pseudotime with Slingshot from a low-dimensional embedding and cluster labels in a server-accessible .h5ad file. The tool orders clusters into smooth lineages using a minimum spanning tree and simultaneous principal curves, returning lineage structure and per-cell pseudotime assignments.

components.name: Run Squidpy neighborhood enrichment
components.description: Run Squidpy neighborhood enrichment on spatial single-cell data: builds a spatial neighbors graph from cell coordinates in adata.obsm['spatial'] and permutation-tests which pairs of cluster categories are co-localized or segregated. Takes a server-accessible .h5ad file with a cluster key and returns a category-by-cate…

components.name: Run Tangram deconvolution
components.description: Deconvolve a spatial transcriptomics assay into per-spot cell-type proportions using Tangram. Accepts single-cell reference and spatial AnnData files and returns each spot's cell-type composition and dataset-wide mean proportions.

components.name: Transcriptformer embedding retrieval
components.description: Retrieves pre-computed contextualized gene embeddings from Transcriptformer models using disease state and cell type context. The embeddings capture gene expression patterns learned from single-cell RNA sequencing data.

components.name: RxClass find classes
components.description: Searches the NLM RxClass drug classification database by keyword and returns matching drug class IDs, names, and types such as ATC, EPC, and MoA.

components.name: RxClass get class hierarchy
components.description: Traverse the NLM RxClass drug-class hierarchy for a given class ID using classGraph. Returns the ordered parent chain with class nodes and edges, including a precomputed ancestor_path, defaulting to the ATC source.

components.name: RxClass get class members
components.description: List all drugs belonging to a specific drug class by class ID using NLM RxClass. Returns RXCUIs and drug names for all member ingredients.

components.name: RxClass get disease relations
components.description: Get MED-RT drug-disease relations from NLM RxClass in either direction: pass a drug name or RxCUI to retrieve related disease classes, or pass a MeSH-style disease class ID to retrieve related ingredient drugs.

components.name: RxClass get drug classes
components.description: Retrieves drug classifications from NLM RxClass for a drug name or RXCUI, returning ATC codes, Established Pharmacologic Class, mechanism of action, and VA drug classes.

components.name: RxNorm find RXCUI
components.description: Resolve a drug name to its RxNorm RXCUI (RxNorm Concept Unique Identifier) using the NLM RxNorm API. Accepts a generic, brand, or synonym drug name and returns one or more matching RXCUIs needed for subsequent RxNorm lookups.

components.name: RxNorm Get Drug Info
components.description: Fetch comprehensive drug properties from NLM RxNorm by RXCUI or drug name. Returns the canonical name, term type, synonyms, and language.

components.name: RxNorm Get Drug Names
components.description: Standardize a drug name to its RxNorm concept unique identifier (RXCUI) and associated names using the NLM RxNorm API.

components.name: RxNorm get exact concepts
components.description: Look up exact matches for a drug name in active RxNorm and return all matching concepts with their names, term types, suppression status, and an explicit resolution indicating whether the match is unique, requires identity review, multiple, or absent.

components.name: RxNorm NDC properties
components.description: Retrieves product and package identification metadata for a National Drug Code (NDC) from the NLM RxNorm ndcproperties API, including pill imprint, color, shape, labeler, marketing category, packaging description, RxCUI, and linked DailyMed SPL setid.

components.name: RxNorm NDC status history
components.description: Retrieves the historical status and RxCUI remapping timeline for an 11-digit National Drug Code from the NLM RxNorm ndcstatus API, returning current status, RxCUI, concept name, and history periods.

components.name: RxNorm get related drugs
components.description: Given an RxNorm drug identifier (RXCUI) or drug name, returns related drug products grouped into ingredient, brand name, semantic clinical drug, and semantic branded drug categories using the NLM RxNorm API.

components.name: RxTerms search drugs
components.description: Searches RxTerms via the NLM Clinical Table Search Service for drug names or prefixes and returns matching prescribable drug display names with strengths, dose forms, and corresponding RxNorm RxCUI identifiers. Useful for medication entry, dose-form lookup, and resolving drug names to RxCUIs.

components.name: SAbDab Get Structure
components.description: Retrieve structured antibody data from the Structural Antibody Database (SAbDab) for a given PDB ID, returning structural information about the antibody.

components.name: SAbDab get structure summary
components.description: Retrieves curated per-structure antibody annotations from the Structural Antibody Database (SAbDab) for a specified PDB ID. Returns summary rows including antigen details, chain species and IMGT V-gene subclass, resolution, experimental method, affinity data, and PMID when curated.

components.name: SAbDab get summary
components.description: Get SAbDab database summary and statistics. Returns information about database content, features, and access URLs. Good starting point for exploring antibody structural data.

components.name: SAbDab search structures
components.description: Search the SAbDab structural antibody database using a text query (antigen name, species, or keywords) and return a direct browse URL to matching antibody structures.

components.name: SABIO-RK search reactions
components.description: Search the SABIO-RK database for biochemical reaction kinetic parameters such as Km, kcat, Vmax, and Ki, returning values with substrate specificity, organism, and literature references. Accepts queries by EC number, enzyme name, substrate, organism, or product.

components.name: SASBDB get entries by tag
components.description: Find SASBDB small-angle scattering entries associated with a specific tag shortcode using the SASBDB REST API.

components.name: SASBDB get entries by UniProt
components.description: Find SASBDB small-angle scattering entries associated with a UniProt protein accession and return a list of matching SASBDB entry codes.

components.name: SASBDB Get Entry
components.description: Retrieve full small-angle scattering entry details from the SASBDB database using a specific entry code.

components.name: SASBDB list instruments
components.description: List all beamlines and instruments in the SASBDB database used for small-angle scattering experiments.

components.name: SASBDB search
components.description: Search SASBDB small-angle scattering database by query term or UniProt accession to retrieve matching entries or a listing of published entries.

components.name: SASBDB search entries
components.description: Search SASBDB for small-angle scattering entries by molecular type (protein, RNA, DNA, heterocomplex, other) or list all entries, returning entry codes and publication status.

components.name: ScanProsite find proteins with motif
components.description: Reverse PROSITE motif scan: given a PROSITE signature accession, enumerate all UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot proteins containing that motif, returning each matching protein's UniProt accession, entry name, and start/stop positions.

components.name: ScanProsite scan protein
components.description: Scan a protein sequence by UniProt accession against PROSITE to identify matched protein motifs, domains, and families, returning PROSITE signature accessions, IDs, and start/end positions.

components.name: SciCrunch Resolve RRID
components.description: Resolves Research Resource Identifiers (RRIDs) against SciCrunch's registry. Returns resource metadata such as name, description, and citation for software tools, cell lines, model organisms, plasmids, and other resource types.

components.name: Scientific Text Summarizer
components.description: Summarizes biomedical research texts, abstracts, or papers with configurable summary length and focus area, using AI to extract key findings, methodology, and conclusions.

components.name: Scite Get Tallies
components.description: Get smart citation tallies for a scientific paper using scite.ai. Accepts a DOI and returns counts of supporting, contradicting, and mentioning citations, total citing publications, and supporting-to-contradicting ratios.

components.name: SCP get study
components.description: Search SCP single-cell studies by query terms, returning accession, title, cell count, gene count, and study URL for matching studies.

components.name: List Single Cell Portal Studies
components.description: Lists public Single Cell Portal studies sorted by cell count descending, with optional filtering by minimum cell count or keyword against title and description. Returns accession, title, cell count, gene count, and study URL.

components.name: SCP search studies
components.description: Keyword search across the Broad Institute Single Cell Portal, which indexes over 1000 single-cell studies. Accepts a query string and returns matching study records with accession, title, cell count, gene count, and URL.

components.name: SCREEN get cCRE by accession
components.description: Look up candidate cis-Regulatory Elements (cCREs) in the ENCODE SCREEN registry by SCREEN accession, returning element classification, genomic coordinates, the underlying representative DNase hypersensitive site accession, and CTCF-bound status.

components.name: SCREEN get regulatory elements
components.description: Retrieve candidate cis-regulatory elements (cCREs) from the SCREEN database by gene symbol, with optional filtering by element type such as promoter, enhancer or insulator.

components.name: SCREEN search cCREs by region
components.description: Query the ENCODE SCREEN Registry for candidate cis-Regulatory Elements (cCREs) overlapping a given genomic region, returning element type annotations and chromatin signal z-scores aggregated across ENCODE biosamples.

components.name: SCXA get cluster marker genes
components.description: Retrieve computed marker genes per cell cluster or cell type for a Single Cell Expression Atlas experiment, including gene names, cell-group values, expression values, p-values and units.

components.name: SCXA list experiments
components.description: Lists single-cell RNA-seq experiments from EBI Single Cell Expression Atlas, returning curated datasets with species, cell counts, technology, and experimental factors, filterable by species or keyword.

components.name: SCXA search gene
components.description: Search the EBI Single Cell Expression Atlas for single-cell experiments where a specified gene is expressed. Accepts gene symbols or Ensembl IDs and returns matching scRNA-seq experiments with cell counts, technology, PubMed IDs, and DOIs.

components.name: Search clinical trials
components.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov for clinical trials by disease, intervention, or free-text keywords; returns NCT IDs and brief trial descriptions with pagination, limited to trials beyond phase 1.

components.name: Semantic Scholar get author
components.description: Retrieves a detailed author profile from Semantic Scholar by author ID, returning scholarly metadata such as name, h-index, citation count, paper count, and affiliations.

components.name: Get author papers from Semantic Scholar
components.description: Lists an author's complete publication bibliography from Semantic Scholar using a Semantic Scholar author ID, returning one record per paper with citation counts, publication years, venues, and identifiers.

components.name: Semantic Scholar paper metadata lookup
components.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a specific paper from Semantic Scholar using an identifier such as Semantic Scholar paper ID, DOI, PMID, arXiv, or CorpusId. Returns title, abstract, TLDR summary, authors, citation and reference counts, journal, publication types, fields of study, open access PDF link, and external IDs.

components.name: Semantic Scholar get paper citations
components.description: Lists papers that cite a given paper from Semantic Scholar, including citation intents, influential flags, and citing sentence contexts. Accepts a Semantic Scholar paper ID or a prefixed DOI, PMID, ArXiv, or CorpusId identifier.

components.name: SemanticScholar get paper references
components.description: Retrieve the list of papers cited by a given paper from the Semantic Scholar API, including citation intent, isInfluential flag, and citing sentence contexts for each reference. Accepts a Semantic Scholar paper ID or DOI/PMID/ArXiv/CorpusId prefixed identifier and returns cited-paper records.

components.name: SemanticScholar get PDF snippets
components.description: Fetch a paper's open-access PDF from Semantic Scholar by paper ID or direct open-access PDF URL, convert it to markdown, and return bounded text snippets around query terms. Useful for extracting methods and experimental details from full text.

components.name: Semantic Scholar get recommendations
components.description: Retrieves paper recommendations from Semantic Scholar for a given paper ID, returning papers similar or related to the input based on Semantic Scholar's recommendation algorithm for literature discovery.

components.name: Semantic Scholar author search
components.description: Search for researchers or authors on Semantic Scholar by name, returning author IDs, names, h-index, citation count, paper count, and affiliations. Use the returned authorId to fetch detailed profiles with SemanticScholar_get_author.

components.name: Semantic Scholar search papers
components.description: Search for academic papers on Semantic Scholar using natural language keywords and return paper details including title, abstract, TLDR summary, fields of study, publication year, journal, and URL.

components.name: Sequence count residues
components.description: Counts occurrences of a specific amino acid or nucleotide residue in a protein or nucleotide sequence, accepting raw sequence or UniProt accession, and reports count, fraction, percentage, and 1-based positions via UniProt REST API.

components.name: Sequence dN/dS
components.description: Computes dN/dS (Ka/Ks) between two codon-aligned coding sequences using the Nei-Gojobori (1986) estimator with Jukes-Cantor correction, returning dN, dS, the ratio, per-site counts, and interpretation. Pure Python, no API key.

components.name: Sequence GC Content
components.description: Calculates GC content of a DNA or RNA sequence and reports GC count, GC fraction, GC percentage, and full nucleotide composition, excluding ambiguous bases (N) from the denominator. Useful for primer design, genome characterization, and codon usage analysis.

components.name: Sequence reverse complement
components.description: Returns the reverse complement of a DNA sequence, supporting A, T, C, G, and N bases. Accepts a DNA sequence string and outputs the reverse-complemented DNA sequence for primer design, probe design, and strand orientation analysis.

components.name: Sequence stats
components.description: Compute basic statistics for a DNA, RNA, or protein sequence. Accepts a sequence string or UniProt accession, auto-detects sequence type, and reports length, full composition, and type-specific metrics such as GC% for nucleotides and monoisotopic molecular weight for proteins.

components.name: SGD Gene Disease Annotations
components.description: Retrieves curated gene-disease associations for a yeast gene from SGD, including Disease Ontology identifier, annotation type, evidence, and references; associations are inferred by orthology to human genes.

components.name: SGD Gene Lookup
components.description: Retrieves a yeast gene/locus overview from SGD by SGD locus identifier, returning gene name, systematic name, description, UniProt ID, aliases, and functional annotations for Saccharomyces cerevisiae genes.

components.name: SGD Get GO Annotations
components.description: Get Gene Ontology annotations for a yeast gene from SGD. Accepts an SGD locus identifier and returns GO terms, evidence codes, qualifiers, and references.

components.name: SGD get interactions
components.description: Get genetic and physical interactions for a yeast gene from SGD using an SGD locus identifier. Returns interaction type, experiment type, interacting gene names, and references.

components.name: SGD get literature
components.description: Get categorized literature references for a budding-yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) gene from the Saccharomyces Genome Database (SGD). Accepts a gene name, systematic name, or SGD ID and returns reference counts per curation category and a capped list of the most relevant references with citation, PubMed ID, year, an…

components.name: SGD Get Phenotypes
components.description: Retrieves curated phenotype annotations for a yeast gene from the Saccharomyces Genome Database, including observable phenotypes, mutant types, experimental methods, strain backgrounds, and chemical conditions.

components.name: SGD get protein domains
components.description: Retrieves mapped protein domain annotations for a Saccharomyces cerevisiae gene from SGD using a gene name, ORF identifier, or SGD ID. Returns domain hits from Pfam, InterPro, SMART, PROSITE, CDD, Gene3D, SUPERFAMILY, PANTHER, and PRINTS, including accession, description, source database, and residue coordinates.

components.name: SGD Get PTM Sites
components.description: Get curated post-translational modification (PTM) sites for a budding-yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) gene from the Saccharomyces Genome Database (SGD) using a standard gene name, systematic name, or SGD ID. Returns modified residues with modification type, residue position, and supporting reference.

components.name: SGD Get Regulation
components.description: Get the transcriptional regulation network for a yeast gene from SGD, including curated regulator-target relationships with evidence, direction, and references. Accepts an SGD locus identifier and returns pairs where the queried gene is regulator or target.

components.name: SGD get sequence
components.description: Retrieve genomic DNA, coding DNA, and protein sequences plus genomic coordinates for a yeast gene from SGD using an SGD locus identifier such as S000000364.

components.name: SGD Search
components.description: Search the Saccharomyces Genome Database (SGD) across multiple data types including genes, GO terms, phenotypes, references, alleles, diseases, complexes, and pathways. Returns matching entries with categories, descriptions, and links, optionally filtered by category.

components.name: SIDER get drug indications
components.description: Get therapeutic indications for a drug from SIDER using either a drug name or SIDER drug ID, returning MedDRA-coded conditions with descriptions extracted from the indications and usage sections of drug labels.

components.name: SIDER Get Drug Side Effects
components.description: Retrieves known side effects for a drug from the SIDER database using either a drug name or SIDER drug ID, returning side effect records with frequency data, MedDRA codes, and placebo-arm rates when available.

components.name: SIDER Get Drugs for Side Effect
components.description: Find all drugs associated with a specific side effect in SIDER using a side effect name or MedDRA code, returning matching drugs and frequency information when available.

components.name: SIDER drug search
components.description: Search the SIDER drug side effects database by drug name and return matching drugs with SIDER IDs and related side effects. SIDER contains adverse drug reaction data extracted from drug labels for marketed medicines.

components.name: SIDER search side effect
components.description: Search SIDER for side effects by name and return matching side effects with MedDRA codes (UMLS CUIs). Use this to find the correct MedDRA code before querying SIDER_get_drugs_for_side_effect.

components.name: SIGN list guidelines
components.description: Lists SIGN (Scottish Intercollegiate Guidelines Network) clinical guidelines, optionally filtered by clinical topic or specialty, returning up to a specified limit of guideline records.

components.name: SIGN search guidelines
components.description: Search SIGN clinical guidelines by keyword, returning matching guideline records with number, title, topic, publication year, and URL.

components.name: SIGNOR connect proteins
components.description: Finds the curated causal signaling sub-network connecting a set of proteins in the SIGNOR database using two or more UniProt accessions, returning causal relationships with effect, mechanism, direction, and literature via shortest signaling paths.

components.name: SIGNOR get interactions
components.description: Retrieve causal signaling interactions for a protein or entity from the SIGNOR database, including upstream regulators, downstream targets, effect type, mechanism, affected residue, and supporting literature, using UniProt or SIGNOR entity IDs.

components.name: SIGNOR get pathway
components.description: Retrieves a curated signaling pathway from the SIGNOR database by pathway ID.

components.name: SIGNOR list pathways
components.description: List curated signaling pathways from the SIGNOR database, optionally filtering by a keyword query, and return pathway IDs for use with SIGNOR_get_pathway.

components.name: SKEMPI get mutation
components.description: Retrieve the measured binding effect of one specific substitution in a protein-protein complex from SKEMPI, given a PDB ID and mutation notation. Returns wild-type and mutant Kd and derived ddG in kcal/mol.

components.name: SKEMPI search by protein
components.description: Searches SKEMPI for complexes and binding affinity measurements involving a named protein, matched case-insensitively against both binding partners. Returns the measurements, a summary of the ddG distribution, and the list of PDB structures involved.

components.name: SKEMPI search by structure
components.description: Lists experimentally measured binding-affinity mutations for a protein-protein complex in SKEMPI 2.0 by PDB ID, returning wild-type and mutant dissociation constants and derived ddG values.

components.name: SmartAPI get API
components.description: Searches SmartAPI's registry of OpenAPI-described web APIs, including NCATS Translator components, by keyword or field-scoped query; returns matching API metadata such as api_id, title, base URL, and tags.

components.name: SmartAPI search APIs
components.description: Search the SmartAPI registry of biomedical web APIs using a keyword or field-scoped Lucene query. Returns matching API records including identifier, title, base URL, and tags.

components.name: SMILES Verify
components.description: Parses a SMILES string without RDKit and computes molecular properties including molecular weight, molecular formula, atom counts, valence electrons, formal charge, ring count, and degrees of unsaturation; optionally verifies computed values against expected constraints.

components.name: SNOMED CT concept search
components.description: Search SNOMED CT concepts via the UMLS REST API using a concept name or SNOMED CT code, returning matching concepts with descriptions.

components.name: SpliceAI Get Max Delta
components.description: Get simplified maximum SpliceAI delta score and pathogenicity interpretation for a genomic variant in chr-pos-ref-alt format. Returns a single max delta score across splice effects (AG/AL/DG/DL) with interpretation based on score thresholds.

components.name: SpliceAI predict pangolin
components.description: Predict splice-altering effects using the Pangolin model, an alternative to SpliceAI. Accepts a variant in chr-pos-ref-alt format and returns splice effect scores per transcript.

components.name: SpliceAI predict splice
components.description: Predict splice-altering effects of genetic variants using the SpliceAI deep learning model. Accepts a variant in chr-pos-ref-alt or colon-separated format and returns delta scores for acceptor gain/loss and donor gain/loss.

components.name: SPrediXcan associate
components.description: Performs S-PrediXcan transcriptome-wide association analysis by combining per-SNP eQTL prediction weights with GWAS z-scores to test a gene for trait association. Returns the gene TWAS z-score and p-value.

components.name: SRA get experiment
components.description: Get detailed metadata for a specific SRA experiment by accession number. Accepts SRA experiment, study, or sample accessions and returns experiment title, organism, sequencing platform, library information, study details, and run statistics.

components.name: SRA search experiments
components.description: Search the NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) for sequencing experiments by keyword, organism, library strategy, or sequencing platform. Returns matching SRA experiment records.

components.name: ssGSEA score
components.description: Computes single-sample GSEA scores for each sample and gene set from an expression matrix, producing a gene_set x sample signature-score matrix. Pure compute; gene sets may be supplied from MSigDB or Enrichr.

components.name: StarAlleles search
components.description: Search star allele definitions using the NLM Clinical Table Search Service. Given a gene or allele prefix such as CYP2D6*4, returns matching star allele designations with their defining nucleotide change, alternate/historical name, and resulting protein change.

components.name: Statistics test
components.description: Perform basic statistical tests using pure Python, including chi-square goodness-of-fit, Fisher's exact test, simple linear regression, and Welch's t-test. Accepts numeric data or contingency tables and returns p-values, test statistics, and regression summaries.

components.name: STITCH chemical-protein interactions
components.description: Retrieves known and predicted chemical-protein interactions from the STITCH database using chemical names, drug names, or STITCH identifiers, with optional species and confidence score filters. Returns interaction records with confidence scores.

components.name: STITCH get interaction partners
components.description: Get all interaction partners (chemicals and proteins) for a given chemical or protein identifier from the STITCH database, returning a network of related molecules.

components.name: STITCH Resolve Identifier
components.description: Resolve a chemical or protein name to STITCH database identifiers, optionally scoped by NCBI taxonomy ID.

components.name: STRING functional enrichment
components.description: STRING functional enrichment performs statistical enrichment analysis of a protein set against Gene Ontology, KEGG, Reactome and other annotation databases using the STRING database, returning significantly enriched biological functions and pathways with FDR-corrected p-values.

components.name: STRING Get Enrichment
components.description: Performs functional enrichment analysis on a set of proteins using the STRING database, testing for enrichment of Gene Ontology terms, KEGG pathways, Reactome pathways, and other functional categories. Accepts newline-separated protein identifiers and returns enriched terms with p-values, FDR-corrected q-values, and m…

components.name: STRING get functional annotations
components.description: Get comprehensive functional annotations for a protein from the STRING database using a protein identifier and species taxonomy ID. Returns per-protein annotations across Gene Ontology, pathways, domains, phenotypes, disease associations, tissue expression, and subcellular localization.

components.name: STRING Get Interaction Partners
components.description: Retrieve interaction partners for a single protein from the STRING database using a protein identifier (gene name or STRING ID); returns a ranked list of interacting proteins with confidence scores by evidence type.

components.name: STRING get network
components.description: Get the protein-protein interaction network for one or more proteins from the STRING database, returning all interactions (edges) between the query proteins and their neighbors with confidence scores broken down by evidence type.

components.name: STRING get protein interactions
components.description: Retrieves protein interaction records from the STRING database using a list of protein identifiers and an optional species taxonomy ID.

components.name: STRING Map Identifiers
components.description: Maps protein identifiers such as gene symbols, UniProt IDs, or Ensembl IDs to STRING database internal identifiers. Accepts a list of protein names and returns the corresponding STRING IDs, enabling batch conversion and validation for network analysis.

components.name: STRING PPI enrichment
components.description: Tests whether a set of proteins has more protein-protein interactions than expected by chance using STRING, returning enrichment p-values and observed vs expected interaction counts.

components.name: Structure annotate per residue
components.description: Annotates each residue in a PDB protein structure with binding-interface, ligand-pocket, buried/solvent-exposed, relative SASA, and optional secondary structure labels. Computes per-residue distances and SASA with Biopython and FreeSASA, optionally fetching secondary structure from PDBe REST.

components.name: Survival Cox Regression
components.description: Fit a Cox proportional hazards regression model to assess the effect of covariates on survival, returning hazard ratios with 95% confidence intervals and p-values for each covariate.

components.name: Survival Kaplan-Meier
components.description: Computes Kaplan-Meier survival estimates from time-to-event data, returning survival probability at each event time, number at risk, events, censored observations, and median survival time. Supports optional stratification by group for visual comparison.

components.name: Survival Log Rank Test
components.description: Perform Mantel-Cox log-rank test to compare survival between two groups, testing the null hypothesis that survival curves are identical, and return chi-squared statistic, p-value, and observed vs expected events per group.

components.name: SwissADME calculate ADME
components.description: Computes ADMET properties, drug-likeness, and medicinal chemistry friendliness of a small molecule from its SMILES string using SwissADME. Returns 49 properties across six categories: physicochemical properties, lipophilicity, water solubility, pharmacokinetics, drug-likeness, and medicinal chemistry.

components.name: SwissADME Check Druglikeness
components.description: Quick drug-likeness assessment of a small molecule using SwissADME, evaluating the molecule against five standard filters (Lipinski, Ghose, Veber, Egan, Muegge) and returning per-rule violation counts, pass/fail, PAINS/Brenk alerts, bioavailability score, and synthetic accessibility from a SMILES input.

components.name: SwissDock check job status
components.description: Check the status of a SwissDock docking job using its session ID and return the current job status such as RUNNING, FINISHED, ERROR, or NOT_FOUND.

components.name: SwissDock protein-ligand docking
components.description: Perform protein-ligand molecular docking using SwissDock with AutoDock Vina or Attracting Cavities 2.0 engines, accepting a ligand SMILES and PDB ID to predict binding modes, poses, and energies.

components.name: SwissDock retrieve results
components.description: Retrieve results for a completed SwissDock docking job using a session ID. Returns a download URL and metadata for the docking output archive containing predicted binding poses, docking scores, cluster information, and visualization files.

components.name: SwissLipids get children
components.description: List the direct children of a SwissLipids hierarchy node using a parent SwissLipids ID, returning child entities with identifiers, names, types, formulas, masses and InChIKeys.

components.name: SwissLipids Get Lipid
components.description: Search SwissLipids by lipid name or shorthand abbreviation and retrieve matching entries with SwissLipids ID, name, type, and position in the lipid structural hierarchy.

components.name: SwissLipids search
components.description: Search SwissLipids for lipids by name or shorthand abbreviation and return matching entries with SwissLipids ID, name, type, and position in the lipid structural hierarchy.

components.name: SWISS-MODEL PDB download
components.description: Downloads 3D atomic coordinates in PDB format from the SWISS-MODEL Repository for a given UniProt accession, returning ATOM/HETATM records as text with optional sort, provider, template, and range selectors.

components.name: SwissModel Get Models
components.description: Get pre-computed protein structure models from the SWISS-MODEL Repository for a UniProt accession, including homology models and experimental PDB structures with template, coverage, quality scores, and coordinate download links.

components.name: SWISS-MODEL Batch Model Lookup
components.description: Batch SWISS-MODEL Repository lookup that accepts up to 250 UniProt accessions and returns sequence length, model count, and up to 30 flattened homology models per accession.

components.name: SwissModel get summary
components.description: Retrieve protein structure model summaries from SWISS-MODEL by UniProt accession, optionally filtered by residue range or provider (SWISS-MODEL homology models or PDB experimental structures).

components.name: SwissTargetPrediction organisms
components.description: List the organisms (proteomes) supported by SwissTargetPrediction. Returns organism names with their parameter values, common names, and NCBI taxonomy IDs. Currently supports 5 species: human, mouse, rat, cow, and pig.

components.name: SwissTargetPrediction predict
components.description: Predicts the most probable protein targets of a small molecule from a SMILES string using SwissTargetPrediction. Returns ranked target predictions with probability scores, UniProt IDs, ChEMBL IDs, target classes, and known active compound counts. Supports human, mouse, rat, cow, and pig proteomes.

components.name: SynBioHub get collections
components.description: List all public collections available on SynBioHub, including curated sets of genetic parts and designs such as the iGEM Parts Registry, CIDAR Lab parts, Free Genes feature libraries, and organism-specific collections. Returns collection names, descriptions, URIs, and member counts.

components.name: SynBioHub get part
components.description: Retrieves a synthetic biology part record from SynBioHub using a part URI. Returns part metadata including description, version, SBOL type, and functional role.

components.name: SynBioHub Search Parts
components.description: Search the SynBioHub synthetic biology parts repository by keyword to retrieve genetic parts and designs, including part IDs, names, descriptions, SBOL types, and functional roles. SynBioHub hosts the iGEM Registry and other public SBOL collections.

components.name: SYNERGxDB biomarker association
components.description: Correlates per-cell-line gene expression (RNA-seq FPKM) with measured drug-combination synergy scores (Bliss, Loewe, HSA, ZIP) in SYNERGxDB for a queried HGNC gene symbol, returning one row per cancer cell line with FPKM and synergy metrics.

components.name: Get combination matrix
components.description: Retrieves dose-response matrix data for a specific drug combination experiment from SYNERGxDB using combo_id and source_id. Returns concentration pairs, raw viability, and synergy matrices (Bliss, Loewe, HSA, ZIP).

components.name: SYNERGxDB get combo stats
components.description: Get per-dataset combination statistics from SYNERGxDB, returning the number of unique drug combinations, total experiments, and data points for each screening study.

components.name: SYNERGxDB drug lookup
components.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific drug from SYNERGxDB by database ID, including drug name, ATC code, PubChem ID, and DrugBank ID.

components.name: SYNERGxDB list cell lines
components.description: Lists cell lines from the SYNERGxDB database, optionally filtered by cell line ID or tissue name, and supports pagination.

components.name: SYNERGxDB list datasets
components.description: Lists available datasets in SYNERGxDB, a database of drug combination screening data, with optional filtering by cancer type and pagination controls.

components.name: SYNERGxDB list drugs
components.description: Lists drugs from the SYNERGxDB database, providing drug IDs and names for use in drug combination searches.

components.name: SYNERGxDB search combos
components.description: Search drug combination synergy scores in SYNERGxDB, returning synergy metrics (Bliss, Loewe, HSA, ZIP) for drug pairs across cancer cell lines. Users filter by drug IDs, cell line/tissue, and dataset; use list_drugs first to find drug IDs.

components.name: T3DB Get Toxin
components.description: Retrieve detailed toxin information from the Toxin and Toxin-Target Database (T3DB) by T3DB ID, including chemical properties, mechanism of toxicity, health effects, route of exposure, and protein/gene targets.

components.name: T3DB toxin search
components.description: Search the T3DB toxin-target database by toxin name or keyword and return matching toxin IDs and names. Covers pollutants, pesticides, drugs, food toxins, and environmental chemicals.

components.name: TargetMine Search
components.description: Search the TargetMine InterMine data warehouse for genes, proteins, pathways, disease terms, drugs, and biomarkers using free-text queries, and retrieve matching entity records. TargetMine integrates data from UniProt, PDB, ChEMBL, Reactome, KEGG, DrugBank, and TTD for drug target discovery and prioritization.

components.name: TargetMine gene search
components.description: Searches TargetMine for genes relevant to drug target discovery, returning gene symbols, NCBI Gene IDs, organism information, and gene names. Accepts a gene query string such as a gene symbol or keyword and returns matching gene records filtered to the Gene category.

components.name: Tark get MANE transcripts
components.description: Look up MANE (Matched Annotation from NCBI and EMBL-EBI) transcript records for a gene by HGNC gene symbol, Ensembl transcript ID, or RefSeq transcript ID, returning MANE Select and MANE Plus Clinical pairings from the Ensembl Tark transcript archive.

components.name: Tark Get Transcript
components.description: Get an archived transcript record from the Ensembl Tark transcript archive using an Ensembl transcript stable ID. The record includes assembly, biotype, genomic location, sequence checksum, and Ensembl release versions to resolve transcript identity across releases.

components.name: TCDB Get Transporter
components.description: Look up a membrane transporter protein in the Transporter Classification Database by UniProt accession and return TC classification, family description, associated PDB structures, and human gene information when available.

components.name: TCDB search by substrate
components.description: Search the Transporter Classification Database (TCDB) for transporters that transport a given substrate by name. Returns TC numbers, family descriptions, and matching substrate ChEBI IDs.

components.name: TCDB search family
components.description: Search TCDB transporter families by TC family ID prefix or family name text and return matching family descriptions and member counts.

components.name: TCIA Get Body Part Values
components.description: Retrieves the body parts examined in TCIA imaging collections, optionally filtered by collection name or imaging modality. Returns body part names for use in filtering series queries.

components.name: TCIA Get Manufacturer Values
components.description: Retrieves distinct scanner manufacturer values present in a TCIA collection, optionally filtering by modality or body part. Accepts a TCIA collection name and optional modality/body part filters, returning manufacturer names from The Cancer Imaging Archive.

components.name: TCIA get modality values
components.description: Get imaging modalities available in a specific TCIA collection or across all collections, optionally filtered by body part examined. Returns modality codes such as CT, MR, PT, CR, DX, US, and NM.

components.name: TCIA_get_patient_studies
components.description: Get study information for patients in The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA), returning study metadata such as study date, description, and patient details, with optional filtering by collection name or patient ID.

components.name: TCIA Get Patients
components.description: List patients (subjects) in a TCIA imaging collection, returning patient-level fields including PatientId, PatientName, Phantom, and SpeciesCode/SpeciesDescription. Filter by collection name to enumerate subjects and distinguish human from phantom or animal cases.

components.name: TCIA Get Series
components.description: Retrieve imaging series metadata from The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) using filters such as collection name, patient ID, study UID, modality, or body part. Returns series records including modality, body part, patient ID, image count, and file size.

components.name: TCIA Get Series Metadata
components.description: Get detailed DICOM metadata for a specific imaging series in The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) by Series Instance UID, returning equipment information, acquisition parameters, and series attributes.

components.name: TCIA Get Series Size
components.description: Get the total file size in bytes and DICOM object count for a specific imaging series in The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) using a Series Instance UID, useful for estimating download sizes.

components.name: TCIA get SOP instance UIDs
components.description: List the SOP Instance UIDs of every DICOM image slice within a TCIA imaging series, taking a SeriesInstanceUID and returning the individual image instance identifiers.

components.name: TCIA list collections
components.description: Lists all publicly available imaging collections in The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA), a large archive of medical images of cancer available for public download. Returns collection names for use with other TCIA tools.

components.name: TDC list datasets
components.description: Lists available dataset names for a specified Therapeutics Data Commons (TDC) problem, such as ADME or Tox, to support downstream dataset loading and discovery.

components.name: TDC_load_dataset
components.description: Loads a named Therapeutics Data Commons (TDC) benchmark dataset locally via the PyTDC package and returns a summary with row and column counts, label statistics, split sizes, and a small sample of rows. Supports ADME, Tox, HTS, DTI, DDI, PPI, and other TDC problem datasets.

components.name: TDC predict oracle score
components.description: Score one or more molecules supplied as SMILES with pretrained Therapeutics Data Commons (TDC) oracles, including QED, SA, penalized LogP, and GSK3B, JNK3, and DRD2 bioactivity scorers. Returns numeric oracle scores or probabilities for molecular property prediction and optimization.

components.name: TheraSAbDab get all therapeutics
components.description: Get a summary of all therapeutic antibodies in the Thera-SAbDab database, including counts by format (IgG, bispecific, ADC) and clinical phase, for landscape analysis of antibody therapeutics.

components.name: TheraSAbDab therapeutic sequence retrieval
components.description: Retrieves full curated therapeutic antibody records from Thera-SAbDab by WHO INN name, including VH/VL amino-acid sequences, isotype, target antigen, PDB structural coverage, originator companies, and approved/active/discontinued conditions.

components.name: TheraSAbDab search by target
components.description: Search TheraSAbDab for therapeutic antibodies that target a specified antigen, returning clinical and approved antibody records for competitive landscape analysis.

components.name: TheraSAbDab search therapeutics
components.description: Search Thera-SAbDab therapeutic antibody records by antibody name and return WHO INN name, target antigen, format (IgG, bispecific, ADC), clinical phase, and associated PDB structures.

components.name: ThreeDBeacons Get Annotations
components.description: Retrieves residue-level structural and functional annotations for a protein's 3D models from the 3D Beacons Hub, returning feature descriptions, source and evidence, residue lists, and start/end regions for selected annotation types such as domains or active sites.

components.name: 3D Beacons structure summary
components.description: Retrieves a summary of available 3D structure models for a UniProt protein accession from the 3D Beacons Hub, returning total structure counts broken down by provider (PDBe, AlphaFold DB, SWISS-MODEL, PED, AlphaFill, isoform.io) and model category.

components.name: ThreeDBeacons Get Structures
components.description: Get detailed list of 3D structure models for a protein from the 3D Beacons Hub. Accepts a protein accession and returns individual structure entries with model identifier, provider, category, coverage, resolution, confidence score, and download URL, with optional filtering by category or provider.

components.name: TIMER2 gene correlation
components.description: Analyze Spearman correlation between two genes across TCGA cancer samples using cBioPortal data and return correlation coefficient and p-value.

components.name: TIMER2 immune estimation
components.description: Estimates immune cell abundance in TCGA cancer samples using TIMER-equivalent marker gene expression from cBioPortal. Accepts a TCGA cancer type and optional gene, returning infiltration proxies for six immune cell types based on canonical marker genes.

components.name: TIMER2 survival association
components.description: Analyzes overall survival association of gene expression in TCGA cancer patients using cBioPortal data. Performs a log-rank test comparing high vs low gene expression groups and returns p-value, median survival times, and event counts.

components.name: TogoID Convert
components.description: Convert biological identifiers between databases using the TogoID service. Accepts source identifiers, source dataset name, and target dataset name, and returns converted identifiers in the target namespace.

components.name: TogoID list datasets
components.description: Lists the available TogoID dataset names used as source and target identifiers for cross-database identifier conversion, supporting datasets such as ensembl_gene, uniprot, ncbigene, hgnc, pubchem_compound, chebi, and pdb.

components.name: TopDB get topology
components.description: Retrieve experimentally curated transmembrane topology for a protein from TopDB using a protein identifier. Returns sequence regions labeled membrane, inside, or outside with residue ranges, transmembrane region count, reliability score, and experimental evidence records.

components.name: TPMI PheWAS by variant
components.description: Perform a phenome-wide association study (PheWAS) lookup for a single genetic variant in the Taiwan Precision Medicine Initiative (TPMI) PheWeb, a large Han Chinese biobank. Accepts an rsID or explicit GRCh38 chr:pos:ref:alt variant and returns associated phenotypes sorted by p-value.

components.name: TRIP Database Guidelines Search
components.description: Search TRIP Database (Turning Research into Practice) for evidence-based clinical guidelines using a clinical query, returning matching guideline records.

components.name: TumorHope2 search peptides
components.description: Search the TumorHoPe 2 database from Raghava lab (IIITD) for tumor-homing peptide records used in drug delivery. Filter by peptide source, target tumor, name source, or conjugate, and retrieve records containing sequence, target, receptor/biomarker, modifications, motif, phage-display origin, in-vitro/in-vivo evidence…

components.name: UCSC Get CpG Islands
components.description: Get CpG island annotations for a genomic region from UCSC Genome Browser, including locations, length, CpG count, GC content, and observed/expected CpG ratio to support methylation analysis and regulatory landscape characterization.

components.name: UCSC ENCODE cCRE lookup
components.description: Get ENCODE4 candidate cis-Regulatory Elements (cCREs) for a genomic region from the UCSC Genome Browser, returning classified regulatory elements with epigenetic signal scores.

components.name: UCSC get sequence
components.description: Retrieves DNA sequence from the UCSC Genome Browser for a specified genomic region, accepting a locus string or chromosome coordinates with a genome assembly, and returns the nucleotide sequence plus the resolved region. Useful for primer design, sequence analysis, and regulatory element inspection.

components.name: UCSC get TF binding clusters
components.description: Retrieves Transcription Factor ChIP-seq clusters from ENCODE3 for a specified genomic region via the UCSC Genome Browser. Returns clusters of TF binding sites across 340 factors and 129 cell types, including factor name, peak score, and source experiment count.

components.name: UCSC get track
components.description: Retrieves data from a specified UCSC Genome Browser annotation track for a genome assembly; use UCSC_list_tracks to discover valid track names.

components.name: UCSC List Tracks
components.description: Lists available UCSC Genome Browser annotation tracks for a specified genome assembly and can return the column schema for a chosen track. Supports substring filtering of track names, short labels, and long labels; outputs track metadata or column schema details.

components.name: UCSC search
components.description: Searches the UCSC Genome Browser for genes, transcripts, SNPs, or other genomic features by name and returns their genomic positions across annotation tracks for a chosen assembly.

components.name: UCSC Cell Browser get dataset
components.description: Retrieve detailed metadata for a UCSC Cell Browser dataset by name, including its abstract, organisms, body parts, diseases, parent collections, and any child datasets.

components.name: UCSC Cell Browser list facets
components.description: Search the UCSC Cell Browser catalog of 300+ curated single-cell datasets, filtering by organism, body part, disease, or keyword. Returns dataset name, label, organisms, body parts, diseases, and browser URL.

components.name: UCSC Cell Browser search datasets
components.description: Search the UCSC Cell Browser catalog of 300+ curated single-cell datasets by organism, body part, disease, or keyword. Returns matching dataset records including name, label, organisms, body parts, diseases, and browser URL.

components.name: UKB-TOPMed PheWAS by variant
components.description: Phenome-wide association study lookup for a single genetic variant in the UKB-TOPMed PheWeb. Accepts an rsID or GRCh38 variant and returns associated phenotypes sorted by p-value from UK Biobank European-ancestry samples.

components.name: Get UMLS concept details
components.description: Get detailed information about a UMLS concept by its CUI, returning concept details, atoms, definitions, relations, and mappings to other terminologies. Requires a free UMLS API key.

components.name: UMLS Search Concepts
components.description: Search UMLS (Unified Medical Language System) for biomedical concepts by concept name or term, optionally filtering by source abbreviation, and return matching UMLS concepts.

components.name: UniBind dataset search
components.description: Search UniBind for transcription factor binding site datasets by TF gene symbol, species, cell type/tissue, and collection, returning paginated records with TF name, total peak count, and dataset_id. UniBind provides motif-anchored, base-pair-resolution direct binding sites derived from ChIP-seq via DAMO/ChIP-eat with…

components.name: UniBind transcription factor catalog
components.description: Lists the catalog of transcription factors (TFs) profiled in the UniBind database of direct TF-DNA binding sites, optionally filtered by a case-insensitive substring of the TF gene symbol, and returns a sorted, de-duplicated list of TF gene symbols.

components.name: UniBind search datasets
components.description: Search the UniBind catalog of curated direct transcription factor (TF)-DNA binding-site datasets derived from ChIP-seq. Filters by TF gene symbol, species, cell type, and collection; returns paginated dataset summaries with TF name, peak count, and dataset_id.

components.name: UniChem Connectivity Search
components.description: Performs connectivity-based cross-source search in UniChem: given a chemical structure query, finds all compounds across source databases that share the same connectivity layer (salts, stereoisomers, tautomers, and charge/protonation/isotope variants). Returns matched compound records with per-match comparison flags s…

components.name: UniChem list sources
components.description: Lists the available source databases in UniChem, providing their source IDs and names for use with compound identifier lookups.

components.name: UniChem compound search
components.description: Search UniChem, EBI's unified chemical cross-referencing service, by InChIKey, source compound ID, or UCI and return cross-references to the compound across 40+ chemical databases including ChEMBL, DrugBank, PubChem, and KEGG.

components.name: UniParc entry lookup
components.description: Get a UniParc protein sequence entry by its stable UPI identifier. Returns active database cross-references, InterPro domain annotations, and the full sequence with length, weight, and checksums.

components.name: UniParc search
components.description: Retrieve a UniParc entry by its UPI, returning the protein sequence and cross-references to Swiss-Prot, TrEMBL, RefSeq, Ensembl, and PDB.

components.name: UniProt alternative names lookup
components.description: Retrieves alternative protein names for a UniProtKB entry by accession from the UniProt REST API. Accepts a UniProtKB accession and returns the alternative full name strings from the entry's protein description.

components.name: UniProt disease variants by accession
components.description: Retrieve disease-associated variants for a UniProtKB protein entry using its UniProt accession.

components.name: UniProt get entry by accession
components.description: Retrieves the complete JSON record for a specified UniProtKB accession, including protein sequence, function, organism, subcellular location, disease variants, and post-translational processing. Accepts a UniProtKB accession and optional compact flag, and returns the full or bounded entry from UniProtKB.

components.name: UniProt Get Features by Accession
components.description: Extracts all annotated sequence features (domains, active/binding sites, motifs, modified residues, signal peptides, transmembrane regions) from a UniProtKB protein entry by accession. Returns each feature's type, start/end positions, and description.

components.name: UniProt get function by accession
components.description: Retrieve the functional annotation for a specified UniProtKB accession. The main output is the protein function annotation associated with the accession.

components.name: UniProt get isoform IDs by accession
components.description: Extract all splice isoform IDs from a UniProtKB entry by accession. Takes a UniProtKB accession and returns the list of isoform identifiers recorded in the entry's alternative products annotation.

components.name: UniProt get organism by accession
components.description: Retrieves the organism associated with a UniProtKB protein accession.

components.name: UniProt get proteome
components.description: Retrieves comprehensive proteome information from UniProt using a proteome ID, including taxonomy, components, gene and protein counts, and annotation scores.

components.name: UniProt PTM/processing by accession
components.description: Retrieves post-translational modification and processing annotations for a UniProtKB entry by its accession number. Returns JSON data, optionally as a compact summary, from the UniProt REST API.

components.name: UniProt get recommended name by accession
components.description: Retrieves the recommended protein name for a UniProtKB entry by its accession number.

components.name: UniProt get sequence by accession
components.description: Retrieves the protein sequence from UniProtKB for a given accession. The tool accepts a UniProtKB accession and returns the corresponding sequence.

components.name: UniProt get subcellular location by accession
components.description: Retrieves subcellular location annotations from UniProtKB for a given protein accession, returning a bounded summary by default.

components.name: UniProt get UniParc entry
components.description: Get a UniParc entry by UniParc ID (UPI), returning the protein sequence, cross-references, and sequence features from the UniParc non-redundant protein sequence archive.

components.name: UniProt UniRef cluster lookup
components.description: Retrieve UniRef cluster information by cluster ID from UniProt, including cluster metadata, representative member, member count, and member list.

components.name: UniProt ID mapping
components.description: Map identifiers between biological databases such as Ensembl and UniProt, supporting batch mapping and asynchronous task processing.

components.name: UniProt search
components.description: Search UniProtKB protein database with flexible query syntax, returning protein entries with accession numbers and metadata.

components.name: UniProt search proteomes
components.description: Search the UniProt Proteome database for complete sets of proteins expressed by organisms, supporting queries by organism name, taxonomy ID, BUSCO completeness, and proteome type, and returning proteome IDs, gene counts, organism information, and quality metrics.

components.name: UniProt search UniParc
components.description: Retrieve a UniParc entry by its UniParc ID (UPI) from the UniProt REST API, returning protein sequence, cross-references, and sequence features.

components.name: UniProt Search UniRef
components.description: Retrieves UniRef cluster information by cluster ID from the UniProt REST API, including representative member, member count, and member list.

components.name: UniProt ID Mapping Convert IDs
components.description: Converts protein and gene identifiers between databases using the UniProt ID Mapping service, accepting comma-separated identifiers and a source database and returning mapped ID pairs.

components.name: Gene to UniProt ID mapping
components.description: Converts gene names or symbols to UniProt accessions using the UniProt ID Mapping service, with optional species restriction via taxonomy ID. Returns canonical and isoform UniProt protein IDs.

components.name: UniProt ID Mapping database list
components.description: Lists all available database identifiers supported by the UniProt ID Mapping service, returning grouped databases with display names and source/target usability for ID conversion.

components.name: UniProt ID Map to PDB
components.description: Convert UniProt accessions to PDB structure IDs using the UniProt ID Mapping service, returning all PDB entries associated with each UniProt accession for structural biology workflows.

components.name: UniProt subcellular location lookup
components.description: Look up detailed UniProt subcellular location information by its SL-XXXX ID, returning name, definition, category, Gene Ontology mappings, associated keywords, protein counts, hierarchical relationships, and synonyms.

components.name: UniProtLocations search
components.description: Search UniProt subcellular location entries by name or keyword and return matching locations with identifiers, definitions, categories, Gene Ontology mappings, and protein count statistics.

components.name: UniProt disease lookup
components.description: Look up detailed disease information from the UniProt controlled disease vocabulary by UniProt disease ID, including definition, alternative names, cross-references to OMIM/MeSH/MedGen/SNOMED, and protein association counts.

components.name: UniProtRef_get_keyword
components.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific UniProt keyword by its KW-XXXX identifier, including definition, category, parent keywords, GO term mappings, and annotated protein counts.

components.name: UniProt reference proteome lookup
components.description: Get reference proteome information from UniProt by proteome ID, returning proteome description, organism taxonomy, assembly information, chromosome-level protein counts, and genome annotation sources.

components.name: UniProtRef search diseases
components.description: Searches the UniProt controlled disease vocabulary for disease definitions and returns matching disease entries with OMIM, MeSH, MedGen, and SNOMED cross-references and associated reviewed protein counts.

components.name: UniProtRef Search Keywords
components.description: Search the UniProt keyword controlled vocabulary for standardized terms annotating protein functions, biological processes, cellular components, diseases, and technical features; returns keyword IDs, categories, definitions, and protein counts.

components.name: UniProt Reference Proteome Search
components.description: Searches UniProt reference proteomes by organism name, taxon ID, or keyword and returns matching proteome IDs, organism names, proteome types, and total protein counts.

components.name: UniProt Taxonomy Get Taxon
components.description: Get detailed taxonomy information for a species by NCBI taxonomy ID from UniProt, including scientific name, common name, taxonomic rank, mnemonic code, full lineage, and protein statistics.

components.name: UniProt Taxonomy search
components.description: Search UniProt taxonomy entries and return details such as scientific names, common names, mnemonics, ranks and lineage information.

components.name: UniRef cluster lookup
components.description: Retrieve detailed information about a UniProt UniRef protein sequence cluster by its cluster ID, including member count, representative member details, common taxon, seed sequence, update date, and full protein sequence.

components.name: UniRef search clusters
components.description: Searches UniProt UniRef protein sequence clusters by protein name, gene, organism, or keyword to find protein families and representative sequences, with UniRef90 clustering used by default.

components.name: Unpaywall check OA status
components.description: Query Unpaywall by DOI to check open-access status and OA locations. Returns whether an article is open access, its OA status, and best OA location.

components.name: Unpaywall get full text URL
components.description: Retrieves full-text PDF and landing page URLs for a scholarly article by DOI using the Unpaywall service, returning the best open-access PDF link, landing page URL, all available OA locations with host types, and basic article metadata such as title, journal, and publisher.

components.name: VariantValidator format genomic to transcripts
components.description: Projects a genomic variant (HGVS or pseudo-VCF) onto every overlapping RefSeq transcript in one call using the VariantValidator VariantFormatter endpoint, returning per-transcript coding and protein HGVS consequences, gene information, pseudo-VCF representation, and MANE Select/RefSeq Select flags.

components.name: VariantValidator gene2transcripts
components.description: Get all transcripts for a gene using VariantValidator, including MANE Select and MANE Plus Clinical transcript annotations, Ensembl and RefSeq transcript identifiers, genomic coordinates, and cross-references, with an optional filter for MANE transcripts only or all transcripts.

components.name: VariantValidator validate variant
components.description: Validate and convert HGVS-formatted genetic variant descriptions using VariantValidator. Returns validated variant descriptions with genomic context, transcript context, protein consequence, and cross-references against RefSeq sequences and the LOVD syntax checker.

components.name: VCF count variants
components.description: Counts variants in a local VCF/BCF file after applying filters via bcftools, returning total records plus SNP/indel/MNP breakdown. Supports PASS-only, region, min QUAL, and custom bcftools include expressions.

components.name: VCF Normalize
components.description: Normalizes a local VCF/BCF file with bcftools norm, optionally left-aligning indels against a reference FASTA, and reports SNP, indel, and record counts before and after normalization.

components.name: VCF summary statistics
components.description: Compute canonical variant statistics for a local VCF or BCF file using bcftools stats, returning records, SNPs, indels, MNPs, multiallelic sites, ts/tv ratio, and per-sample het/hom/missing counts with optional filters.

components.name: VDJDB get antigen specificity
components.description: Search VDJdb by epitope peptide sequence to find T-cell receptors with confirmed antigen specificity, returning CDR3 sequences, V/J gene usage, MHC restriction and confidence scores, with filters for species, TCR chain, MHC class and minimum confidence.

components.name: VDJDB get database summary
components.description: Get VDJdb database metadata and statistics including total record count, available columns (gene, cdr3, v.segm, j.segm, species, MHC, antigen, etc.), and their data types. Useful for understanding the database schema and current data coverage before querying.

components.name: VDJDB CDR3 Search
components.description: Searches VDJdb for TCR/BCR CDR3 amino acid sequences linked to antigen specificity, returning matching records with epitope, MHC, V/J gene usage, species, and confidence scores. Supports exact, fuzzy, and pattern matching, with optional filters for species and TCR chain, and integrates IMGT and IEDB data.

components.name: VEP predict pathogenicity
components.description: Predicts missense variant pathogenicity using the Ensembl VEP REST API with AlphaMissense, SIFT, and PolyPhen-2, accepting a dbSNP rsID, HGVS notation, or genomic locus and returning per-transcript predictions including gene, amino acid change, pathogenicity scores, and most severe consequence.

components.name: VEuPathDB gene record lookup
components.description: Retrieves a gene record from a VEuPathDB pathogen-genome database using a gene identifier and a selected member site (project), returning attributes including protein product, organism, gene type, genomic location, chromosome, and transcript count.

components.name: VEuPathDB list gene searches
components.description: Lists all available gene search strategies in VEuPathDB, returning search types that can be used to query genes across pathogen, vector, and host genomes. Each search includes a URL segment, display name, description, and accepted parameters.

components.name: VEuPathDB list organism searches
components.description: List all available organism search strategies in VEuPathDB, covering 785+ pathogen, vector, and host organism genomes. Returns the search types that can be used to query organisms in the VEuPathDB database, including AllOrganisms, GenomeDataTypes, GeneMetrics, and OrganismsByText.

components.name: VEuPathDB list record types
components.description: Lists all available record types in VEuPathDB, a unified bioinformatics resource for eukaryotic pathogen and host genomics. Returns record types such as gene, transcript, organism, and genomic-sequence that can be queried through VEuPathDB's search API.

components.name: VEuPathDB search genes by organism
components.description: Search a VEuPathDB pathogen-genome database for all genes belonging to a given organism or strain using the EuPathDB WDK GenesByTaxonGene search. Takes a VEuPathDB project and a full organism name as input and returns one row per gene with gene ID, protein product, organism, gene type, and genomic location.

components.name: Visualize Molecule 2D
components.description: Visualize 2D molecular structures using RDKit from SMILES, InChI, or molecule names, and return PNG, SVG, or interactive HTML images. Molecule names are resolved to SMILES via PubChem.

components.name: Visualize molecule 3D
components.description: Visualizes three-dimensional molecular structures from SMILES, MOL, or SDF content using RDKit and py3Dmol with interactive viewing and selectable styles.

components.name: Visualize Protein Structure 3D
components.description: Visualize 3D protein structures using py3Dmol, accepting a PDB identifier or raw PDB file content and rendering the structure in styles such as cartoon, surface, and stick. Produces an interactive three-dimensional molecular visualization.

components.name: Web search
components.description: General web search using DDGS (Dux Distributed Global Search) across multiple engines including Google, Bing, Brave, Yahoo, and DuckDuckGo. Accepts a query string and returns ranked web results; optional opt-in Parallel Search MCP sends queries to a hosted third-party service.

components.name: WHO Guideline Full Text
components.description: Fetch full text content from a WHO guideline publication page, extracting available web content and PDF download links from a given WHO publication URL.

components.name: WHO Guidelines Search
components.description: Search WHO official clinical guidelines and health recommendations by query. The tool searches WHO curated health-topic pages and the WHO IRIS institutional repository, returning matching WHO publications with the matched source indicated.

components.name: WHOGHO get indicator data
components.description: Retrieves actual data values for a WHO Global Health Observatory (GHO) health indicator using an indicator code via the ODATA API. Indicator codes can be found with WHOGHO_search_indicators.

components.name: WHO GHO list dimension values
components.description: Decode WHO Global Health Observatory (GHO) dimension codes into human-readable labels and country-to-region hierarchy. Accepts a dimension code such as COUNTRY, REGION, or SEX and returns the corresponding code titles and parent-code rollups.

components.name: WHO GHO Search Indicators
components.description: Searches WHO Global Health Observatory (GHO) health indicators by name using an OData filter string, returning indicator codes and names covering mortality, disease, nutrition, maternal health, mental health, and more.

components.name: Find pathways by gene
components.description: Find all WikiPathways pathways containing a specific gene, accepting HGNC symbols, Entrez IDs, or Ensembl IDs and returning matching pathway records. Useful for exploring the biological context of a gene across curated pathway databases and supports multiple species.

components.name: WikiPathways Get Pathway
