components.description: Fetch pathway content by WPID from WikiPathways. Accepts a WikiPathways identifier and optional format (JSON or GPML), returning pathway nodes, edges and metadata for enrichment reporting or network visualization.

components.name: WikiPathways get pathway genes
components.description: Retrieves the genes involved in a specified WikiPathways pathway, including gene products, symbol labels, and gene count. Accepts a pathway identifier and optionally filters results by an identifier system such as Entrez Gene or Ensembl.

components.name: WikiPathways Pathway Metabolites
components.description: Retrieve metabolite and compound participants from a specified WikiPathways pathway, returning small-molecule records with cross-reference identifiers from HMDB, ChEBI, KEGG, and ChemSpider.

components.name: WikiPathways Search
components.description: Search community-curated biological pathways in WikiPathways by free-text query, optionally filtered by organism, and retrieve matching pathway identifiers for retrieval or visualization.

components.name: WormBase Get Expression
components.description: Retrieves expression data for a C. elegans gene from WormBase, returning tissues where the gene is expressed, developmental stages, subcellular localization, and expression clusters. Data is curated from GFP reporters, antibody staining, RNA in situ, and microarray experiments.

components.name: WormBase get gene
components.description: Retrieve detailed gene overviews from WormBase for C. elegans by WormBase gene ID, including gene name, sequence name, species, description, gene type, and status.

components.name: WormBase Get Human Diseases
components.description: Retrieves human disease models (Disease Ontology / DOID) associated with a C. elegans gene from WormBase using a WBGene ID or gene name, inferred by orthology to human disease genes.

components.name: WormBase gene interactions
components.description: Retrieves physical and genetic interactions for a C. elegans gene from WormBase using a WBGene ID or gene name. Returns interactor names, IDs, interaction types, and citations, split into physical and genetic lists.

components.name: WormBase get orthologs
components.description: Queries WormBase to retrieve orthologs, homologs, and within-worm paralogs for a C. elegans gene using a WBGene ID or gene name, returning related gene records across species.

components.name: WormBase Get Phenotypes
components.description: Retrieves phenotype annotations for a specified C. elegans gene from WormBase, including observed and not observed phenotypes from RNAi, mutation, and transgene experiments, along with total counts. Phenotype data uses the WormBase Phenotype Ontology (WPO).

components.name: Xenbase gene lookup
components.description: Retrieves detailed Xenopus gene information from Xenbase through the Alliance of Genome Resources, returning gene symbol, name, synopsis, genomic location, synonyms, cross-references, and species details for Xenopus tropicalis and Xenopus laevis genes using a Xenbase gene ID.

components.name: Xenbase search genes
components.description: Search for Xenopus (frog) genes in Xenbase via the Alliance of Genome Resources API using a gene symbol or name, and return matching gene records including IDs, symbols, names, and species for X. tropicalis and X. laevis.

components.name: ZFIN Get Allele
components.description: Get detailed information about a specific zebrafish allele from ZFIN via the Alliance of Genome Resources by allele ID, returning allele symbol, associated gene, alteration type, species, and synonyms.

components.name: ZFIN get gene
components.description: Get detailed Danio rerio (zebrafish) gene information from ZFIN via the Alliance of Genome Resources using a ZFIN gene ID. Returns gene symbol, name, synopsis, genomic location, synonyms, and cross-references.

components.name: ZFIN get gene alleles
components.description: Get alleles and variants for a zebrafish gene from ZFIN via the Alliance of Genome Resources using a ZFIN gene ID, returning mutant alleles with variant types, molecular consequences, and phenotype/disease associations.

components.name: ZFIN gene expression lookup
components.description: Retrieves expression annotations for a zebrafish gene from the Alliance of Genome Resources, returning per-annotation developmental stage and anatomical location records plus total count. Accepts a ZFIN gene ID with or without the ZFIN: prefix.

components.name: ZFIN gene orthologs
components.description: Retrieves orthologs of a zebrafish gene from the Alliance of Genome Resources using a ZFIN gene ID. Returns orthologous genes in human, mouse, fly, worm, yeast, and other model organisms.

components.name: ZFIN get gene phenotypes
components.description: Retrieves phenotype annotations for a zebrafish gene from ZFIN via the Alliance of Genome Resources, including affected anatomical structures and phenotype statements for mutated or knocked out genes.

components.name: ZFIN search
components.description: Search for zebrafish (Danio rerio) genes in ZFIN by keyword (gene symbol or name). Returns matching genes with their ZFIN IDs, symbols, and names.

components.name: ZINC get compound
components.description: Retrieve structure and computed properties for a ZINC22 compound by ZINC ID via the CartBlanche22 API. Returns SMILES, molecular formula, weight, LogP, atom counts, ring count, InChI, InChIKey, source database, and vendor catalog count.

components.name: ZINC get purchasable
components.description: Returns the full vendor and price list for a ZINC compound identified by its ZINC ID, using the ZINC database.

components.name: ZINC search by properties
components.description: Stub tool for molecular-property-range search (filtering by MW, LogP, HBD, HBA, or rotatable-bond ranges) against ZINC22. The operation is unsupported by CartBlanche22 and returns a clean error directing users to ZINC_search_by_smiles followed by client-side filtering.

components.name: ZINC search by smiles
components.description: Search the ZINC database by SMILES structure to find matching ZINC compound identifiers.

components.name: ZINC search compounds
components.description: Attempts free-text or compound-name search against ZINC22 (CartBlanche22), but the endpoint is unsupported and returns an error directing users to structure search by SMILES or lookup by ZINC ID.

components.name: ZOOMA annotate text
components.description: Maps free-text biomedical terms to standardized ontology terms using EBI ZOOMA, returning matched ontology term IRIs with confidence ratings, evidence type, and OLS lookup links.

components.name: ZOOMA list datasources
components.description: List the curated annotation datasources that EBI ZOOMA draws on when mapping free text to ontology terms. Returns each datasource's short name, type (DATABASE or ONTOLOGY), and home URI. Takes no arguments.

components.name: Google Search
components.description: Performs web searches through the Serper API using a text query and returns search results with metadata, including organic results, related searches, people-also-ask results, and knowledge graph information.

components.name: Sogou Search
components.description: Performs web searches through the Tencent Cloud SearchPro API using the Sogou search engine. It accepts a required query and result-count option and returns JSON search results including titles, URLs, passages, dates, and sites.

components.name: Get ontology info
components.description: Get detailed information about a specific ontology by its ontology ID and return ontology metadata such as details for identifiers like go, uberon, and chebi.

components.name: Get terms from ontology
components.description: Retrieves classes/terms from a specified ontology by ontology ID, with optional filters for IRI, short form, or OBO ID, and returns a list of matching term records from the ontology.

components.name: Search all ontologies
components.description: Searches across all ontologies in the Ontology Lookup Service (OLS) using a query term and optional ontology filter, returning matching term information.

components.name: Debug shell
components.description: Runs one shell command through the plugin shell path and returns its exit code, timeout status, standard output, standard error, and sandbox facts.

components.name: Deep research
components.description: Performs one round of deep research for a question using fused web search, coverage analysis, cross-source corroboration statistics, coverage gaps, and suggested follow-up queries. Accepts a research query with optional goals and query variants, and returns analyzed sources and evidence coverage for iterative synthesi…

components.name: Fetch Page
components.description: Fetches and extracts the full text of a single HTTP(S) URL, using Jina Reader markdown first and local HTML extraction as a fallback. An optional focus topic narrows the returned paragraphs and context.

components.name: Fused search
components.description: Performs multi-engine fused web searches using Tavily, Brave, Exa, Bing, and DeepSeek with a required search query and optional query variants, engine selection, domain filters, recency, complexity, and score threshold. Returns ranked search results with titles, URLs, domains, snippets, scores, engine provenance, publ…

components.name: Research parallel
components.description: Conducts parallel multi-agent research for a question by running independent sub-queries, then merging the resulting findings and source URLs. Accepts an optional research goal, sub-queries, time budget, and source limit.

components.name: Search stats
components.description: Reports search-boost statistics including cache size, cache hits and misses, tier distribution, engine errors, and recent searches. It is intended for checking search cost and diagnosing search-engine failures.

components.name: Database info
components.description: Provides AACT database connection information, including server time, PostgreSQL version, schema name, and clinical-trials table count. It also reports that AACT data is refreshed weekly from ClinicalTrials.gov.

components.name: Describe Table
components.description: Describe a table in the AACT clinical trials database using its table name. Returns the table name, approximate row count, column names and SQL data types, total distinct counts, and sample values for low-cardinality columns.

components.name: Fetch rows
components.description: Retrieves a page of rows from a previously buffered query result in the AACT clinical trials database using a query identifier. The tool reads from server memory and returns row data with pagination metadata.

components.name: Get Column Values
components.description: Retrieves distinct non-null values from a specified column in an AACT clinical trials database table, with occurrence counts. Results are limited and sorted by frequency.

components.name: List tables
components.description: Lists available tables in the AACT clinical trials database's ctgov schema with table names and approximate row counts. Use the results to discover tables before inspecting columns or writing queries.

components.name: Read query
components.description: Execute a read-only SQL query against the AACT clinical trials database and return a result summary with a preview of matching rows. The tool supports SELECT, WITH, and EXPLAIN queries with configurable row buffering and preview limits.

components.name: Search columns
components.description: Search the AACT clinical trials database schema for columns matching a case-insensitive keyword, optionally restricted to a single table. Returns matching table names, column names, and data types.

components.name: Health query
components.description: Execute SQL SELECT queries on Apple Health data and return matching health records.

components.name: Health report
components.description: Generate structured health reports for a specific period from Apple Health data.

components.name: Health schema
components.description: Get information about available Apple Health data tables, their structure, and sample data to help write SQL queries.

components.name: Search clinical evidence
components.description: Search clinical evidence by disease, therapy, molecular profile, phenotype, evidence type, and direction. Returns a detailed report with summary statistics, a top 10 evidence listing, citation sources, and a disclaimer.

components.name: Compare Labels
components.description: Compare US FDA Prescribing Information versus UK/EU SmPC for a given drug, mapping equivalent sections and returning paired content with source URLs where available.

components.name: Find related articles
components.description: Finds related PubMed articles for a given PMID using NCBI ELink neighbor score, returning similar papers ranked by relevance.

components.name: Format citation
components.description: Format a citation for a PubMed article in APA, Vancouver, Harvard, or BibTeX style using a supplied PMID.

components.name: Get abstract
components.description: Get the full structured abstract and metadata for a PubMed article by PubMed ID, returning abstract sections (background, methods, results, conclusions), keywords, MeSH terms, and PMC ID.

components.name: Get Full Text
components.description: Get the full text of an open-access article from PubMed Central using a PMID or PMCID, returning article sections, figure/table captions, and reference count.

components.name: Get SmPC
components.description: Get UK/EU Summary of Product Characteristics (SmPC) for a drug from eMC (medicines.org.uk). Returns structured labelling sections.

components.name: Get trial
components.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific clinical trial from ClinicalTrials.gov, including eligibility criteria, study design, arms, outcomes, locations, and associated PubMed IDs.

components.name: USPI Lookup
components.description: Get FDA US Prescribing Information (USPI) for a drug from openFDA (cited to DailyMed). Returns structured labelling sections with LOINC codes.

components.name: Resolve drug name
components.description: Resolves a brand or generic drug name to its corresponding generic name and US brand names, along with drug class and common indications, using RxNorm and openFDA.

components.name: Search by indication
components.description: Find drugs approved for a medical condition by searching US FDA labelling for the condition and then checking UK eMC availability for each drug found.

components.name: Search Europe PMC
components.description: Searches Europe PMC, a biomedical literature corpus that also indexes preprints, patents, and agricultural/biomedical databases, and returns result records with abstract snippets, citation counts, open-access status, and preprint indicators.

components.name: Search PubMed
components.description: Searches PubMed for biomedical literature using a query string and optional filters. Returns article summaries with PMIDs, titles, authors, journals, and DOIs from PubMed.

components.name: Search Trials
components.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov for clinical trials using condition, intervention, or term filters. Returns trial summaries including NCT IDs, status, sponsors, and enrollment information.

components.name: Trending papers
components.description: Search recent or trending papers on a topic in PubMed, sorted by date, with optional filtering to high-impact journals. Takes a topic query and returns matching paper records.

components.name: Autocomplete
components.description: Autocomplete biomedical entities by label using a text query and return matching entity results.

components.name: Compare termsets
components.description: Compare two sets of biomedical terms by calculating pairwise similarity between subject and object terms. The comparison supports a selectable similarity metric, with ancestor information content as the documented default.

components.name: Find similar terms
components.description: Searches a specified termset for terms similar to a group of entities, supporting entity-label autocomplete.

components.name: Get associations
components.description: Retrieves biomedical association records through the generic /association endpoint, with optional subject, predicate, object, entity, and category selectors.

components.name: Get associations advanced
components.description: Queries associations using optional subject, object, predicate, category, namespace, taxon, entity, facet, and filter criteria, returning association records.

components.name: Get chemical disease associations
components.description: Retrieves disease associations for a chemical identifier, with paginated entity lookup parameters.

components.name: Get chemical information
components.description: Retrieves chemical entity information using a chemical identifier. The tool is described as providing autocomplete for entities by label.

components.name: Get chemical pathway associations
components.description: Looks up pathway associations for a specified chemical identifier and returns the associated data. The tool supports paginated results.

components.name: Get chemicals for disease
components.description: Autocomplete chemical entities associated with a specified disease identifier by label, returning chemical records.

components.name: Get disease gene associations
components.description: Retrieves a table of genes associated with a specified disease identifier.

components.name: Get disease inheritance
components.description: Get the inheritance pattern for a disease using its disease identifier. The Tool returns disease inheritance information.

components.name: Get disease phenotype associations
components.description: Retrieves a table of phenotypes associated with a specified disease identifier.

components.name: Get disease treatments
components.description: Get treatments for a disease identified by a disease ID. Returns treatment records for the specified disease.

components.name: Get disease variants
components.description: Retrieves genetic variants associated with a disease using a disease identifier.

components.name: Get diseases by gene
components.description: Retrieves diseases caused by or associated with a gene using a gene identifier, providing a reverse lookup from gene to disease records.

components.name: Get diseases treated by chemical
components.description: Find disease entities treated by a supplied chemical identifier, returning matching disease records through an entity-label autocomplete interface.

components.name: Get diseases with phenotype
components.description: Retrieves diseases associated with a specified phenotype identifier and returns matching disease entities.

components.name: Get entities batch
components.description: Retrieves information for multiple entities at once using a list of entity identifiers. The tool returns an array of entity records.

components.name: Get entity
components.description: Retrieves the entity with the specified ID and supports entity autocomplete by label. Accepts an entity identifier and returns an entity object.

components.name: Get entity associations by category
components.description: Retrieves association data for a specified biomedical entity and association category, with optional filtering, faceting, sorting, pagination, and ortholog traversal.

components.name: Get gene disease associations
components.description: Get diseases associated with a specified gene identifier. The tool returns gene-disease association results for the requested gene.

components.name: Get Gene Expression Associations
components.description: Retrieves gene expression association data for a specified gene identifier, with optional limit and offset pagination.

components.name: Get gene interactions
components.description: Retrieves gene-gene interaction records for a supplied gene identifier, with support for paginated results.

components.name: Get gene orthologs
components.description: Get orthologous gene records across species using a supplied gene identifier. The tool also supports label-based entity autocomplete.

components.name: Get gene pathways
components.description: Retrieve pathways involving a specified gene using a gene identifier. The Tool returns pathway records for the selected gene.

components.name: Get gene phenotype associations
components.description: Retrieves phenotypes associated with a gene using a gene identifier and client context, returning gene–phenotype association results.

components.name: Get gene variants
components.description: Provides gene variant entity autocomplete for a supplied gene identifier, returning matching gene variant records.

components.name: Get Genes With Phenotype
components.description: Retrieve genes associated with a specified phenotype using a phenotype identifier. The tool returns matching gene records.

components.name: Get histopheno
components.description: Retrieves histopheno data for a specified biomedical entity ID and returns the resulting data as an object.

components.name: Get mappings
components.description: Retrieves mappings for entities using optional subject, predicate, object, entity, and mapping-justification identifiers, returning mapping records.

components.name: Get phenotype disease associations
components.description: Retrieves diseases associated with a specified phenotype identifier. The tool supports paginated association retrieval using limit and offset controls.

components.name: Get phenotype gene associations
components.description: Retrieve genes associated with a specified phenotype identifier. The tool returns phenotype-gene association results and supports paginated retrieval.

components.name: Get protein functions
components.description: Retrieves protein function information using a protein identifier. The tool supports entity autocomplete by label and returns structured protein-related records.

components.name: Get protein info
components.description: Autocomplete protein entities by label using a supplied protein identifier or label, returning protein entity information.

components.name: Get protein interactions
components.description: Autocomplete protein-related entities by label using a protein identifier and return protein interaction results.

components.name: Get protein locations

components.description: List credible sets that include a specified variant from OpenTargets, optionally filtered by study type and with pagination.

components.name: Variant evidence lookup
components.description: Retrieves evidence strings linking a variant identifier to target or disease associations from Open Targets. Supports optional filtering by datasource and cursor-based pagination.

components.name: Get Variant Info
components.description: Retrieve core metadata and functional annotations for a variant from Open Targets using a variant ID.

components.name: Get variant intervals
components.description: Retrieve enhancer-to-gene (E2G) predictions that overlap a supplied genetic variant, returning linked regulatory regions and predicted target genes from the ENCODE-rE2G model.

components.name: Get Variant Pharmacogenomics
components.description: Retrieves pharmacogenomic annotations for a given variant identifier from Open Targets, including evidence levels, datasources, and associated targets and drugs for drug response interpretation.

components.name: Get variant protein coordinates
components.description: Retrieve protein-level consequences for a given variant ID, mapping coding variants to amino acid changes and affected protein positions to support structural biology analyses.

components.name: GraphQL batch query
components.description: Executes one GraphQL query against many variable sets in the OpenTargets GraphQL API, returning an aggregated success/warning/error summary.

components.name: GraphQL query
components.description: Executes a raw read-only GraphQL query against the Open Targets platform, taking a GraphQL query string with optional variables and returning a query result envelope containing status, result, and optional message.

components.name: GraphQL schema
components.description: Retrieves the GraphQL schema in SDL format from the Open Targets GraphQL API, useful for discovering fields not covered by specialized tools.

components.name: Map IDs
components.description: The map_ids tool maps free-text terms such as gene symbols, disease names, and compound aliases to canonical Open Targets identifiers using the Open Targets API.

components.name: Search entities
components.description: Search Open Targets entities by free-text query and resolve synonyms to canonical IDs, returning ranked entity hits with identifiers and names.

components.name: Search facets
components.description: Search facets returns aggregated facet counts for Open Targets Platform search results, enabling dynamic filtering by data source, entity type, and category. It accepts an optional query string, category identifier, and entity names, and returns a dictionary of facet counts.

components.name: Search suggestions
components.description: Returns autocomplete suggestions for partially typed queries against the Open Targets platform, accepting a query prefix and an optional list of entity names, and outputs matching search suggestions.

components.name: Calculate
components.description: Runs a selected evidence-backed clinical calculator by canonical ID using supplied inputs and returns the calculation result. No external data sources are named.

components.name: Calculate panel
components.description: Runs one or more already-selected clinical calculators as a panel and isolates each calculator result. Accepts a list of calculator ids with optional shared inputs and overrides; duplicates and unrequested overrides are rejected.

components.name: Describe calculator
components.description: Returns the declared inputs, outputs, evidence, safety limits, and version metadata for one clinical calculator identified by its calculator id without the calculate_ prefix.

components.name: Find calculator
components.description: Finds clinical calculators by clinical intent, population, model, or known name, returning up to three relevant matches by default. Accepts a query string and optional limit; does not calculate when clarification is needed.

components.name: Batch map concepts from CSV
components.description: Processes a CSV file of keywords, maps each row to standardized OMOP concepts, and returns a CSV with appended mapping columns such as concept_id, code, name, domain, and vocabulary.

components.name: Find OMOP concept
components.description: Find OMOP concepts for a given clinical term, table, and field, returning multiple candidate concepts for an LLM to choose from based on context.

components.name: RAG query
components.description: Runs a natural-language query against a selected managed code package and returns an answer together with relevant source files.

components.name: Calculate BMI
components.description: Calculate Body Mass Index (BMI) from height in meters and weight in kilograms.

components.name: Clinical Trials Search
components.description: Search for clinical trials using a medical condition or disease and optional trial status, returning matching clinical trial records.

components.name: Extract DICOM Metadata
components.description: Extract metadata from a DICOM file provided by path. The Tool returns metadata associated with the medical imaging file.

components.name: FDA drug lookup
components.description: Look up drug information from the FDA database using a drug name, with support for general information, labeling, or adverse-event information.

components.name: Health topics
components.description: Provides health information for a specified topic, with optional English or Spanish language selection.

components.name: Lookup ICD Code
components.description: Look up ICD-10 codes using a code or medical condition description and return matching ICD-10 code records.

components.name: MedRxiv search
components.description: Searches medRxiv for preprint articles using a text query and returns matching biomedical literature records.

components.name: NCBI Bookshelf Search
components.description: Searches the NCBI Bookshelf for biomedical books and documents using a text query and returns matching records.

components.name: PubMed search
components.description: Search for medical literature in the PubMed database using a text query and return matching article records.

components.name: Download ArXiv
components.description: Downloads the PDF of an arXiv paper using its paper ID and returns the path to the downloaded file.

components.name: Download BASE
components.description: Download a PDF for a BASE paper using its paper identifier and an optional save directory. Returns the path to the downloaded PDF.

components.name: Download bioRxiv
components.description: Download a bioRxiv paper PDF using its DOI and return the path to the downloaded file.

components.name: Download CiteSeerX
components.description: Downloads a paper PDF from CiteSeerX using a paper identifier and optional save directory, returning the path to the downloaded file or an error message.

components.name: Download CrossRef
components.description: Attempts to download a PDF for a CrossRef paper using its DOI and an optional save directory. CrossRef does not provide direct PDF downloads, so the tool returns a status message directing users to access the paper through the publisher.

components.name: Download DBLP
components.description: Attempts to download a PDF for a paper identified by its DBLP paper identifier and returns a status message. The documented implementation notes that DBLP does not provide direct PDF access.

components.name: Download DOAJ
components.description: Download a PDF for a paper identified by its DOAJ paper identifier. The tool returns the path to the downloaded PDF.

components.name: Download HAL
components.description: Downloads a PDF for a paper from HAL using its paper identifier and returns the path to the downloaded file. An optional save directory can be specified.

components.name: Download IACR
components.description: Downloads a PDF of an IACR ePrint paper using its IACR paper ID and returns the path to the downloaded file.

components.name: Download IEEE
components.description: Downloads a paper PDF from IEEE Xplore using a paper identifier and saves it to a specified directory. The tool returns the saved file path or an error message.

components.name: Download medRxiv paper
components.description: Downloads a medRxiv paper PDF using its DOI and returns the path to the downloaded file. The output is saved to a specified directory, defaulting to ./downloads.

components.name: Download OpenAIRE
components.description: Downloads the PDF for an OpenAIRE paper identified by its paper ID and returns the downloaded file path or an error message.

components.name: Download OpenAlex
components.description: Download a PDF for an OpenAlex paper using its paper identifier and an optional save directory. The tool returns a status or error message, including when direct downloading is not supported.

components.name: Download PubMed
components.description: Attempt to download the PDF associated with a PubMed paper using its PMID and return a status message.

components.name: Download Sci-Hub
components.description: Download a paper PDF via Sci-Hub using a DOI, title, PMID, or paper URL, returning the downloaded PDF path or an error message.

components.name: Download semantic
components.description: Download the PDF of an academic paper from Semantic Scholar using a paper identifier such as a Semantic Scholar ID, DOI, arXiv ID, PMID, or URL. The tool returns the path to the downloaded PDF file.

components.name: Download with fallback
components.description: Downloads an academic paper PDF using a source-specific paper identifier, with DOI or title fallback support. It attempts source-native and open-access repository downloads, Unpaywall, and optionally Sci-Hub, returning a downloaded PDF path or an explanatory error message.

components.name: Get CrossRef Paper by DOI
components.description: Retrieve metadata for a specific academic paper from the CrossRef database using its Digital Object Identifier (DOI). The tool returns the paper metadata as a dictionary or an empty result when no paper is found.

components.name: Read arXiv paper
components.description: Reads an arXiv paper identified by its paper ID and extracts the text content from its PDF. The paper may be saved to a specified directory before extraction.

components.name: Read bioRxiv paper
components.description: Reads a bioRxiv paper PDF identified by its DOI and extracts its text content.

components.name: Read Crossref Paper
components.description: Attempts to read and extract text from a paper identified by a CrossRef DOI, with an optional directory for PDF storage. The tool returns a status message and documents that CrossRef does not provide direct paper content.

components.name: Read DBLP paper
components.description: Attempt to read and extract text content from a paper identified by its DBLP paper identifier. DBLP does not provide direct paper content access, so the tool returns an informative message.

components.name: Read DOAJ paper
components.description: Reads a DOAJ paper identified by its paper identifier and extracts its text content. The tool can use a specified save directory for the paper PDF.

components.name: Read HAL paper
components.description: Read a paper identified by its HAL paper ID, optionally saving or locating the PDF in a specified directory, and return its extracted text content.

components.name: Read IACR Paper
components.description: Reads an IACR ePrint paper identified by its paper ID and extracts the text content from its PDF.

components.name: Read IEEE Paper
components.description: Downloads an IEEE Xplore paper using its paper identifier and returns the extracted text content. An optional directory can be provided for saving the PDF.

components.name: Read medRxiv paper
components.description: Read a medRxiv paper identified by DOI and extract its text content from the paper PDF, optionally saving the file to a specified directory.

components.name: Read OpenAIRE paper
components.description: Reads an OpenAIRE paper identified by its paper identifier and extracts its text content. The tool accepts an optional save path and returns extracted text or an error message.

components.name: Read OpenAlex Paper
components.description: Attempts to read and extract text from an OpenAlex paper using its paper identifier, with an optional download directory. The tool returns a message indicating the result or that direct paper reading is not supported natively.

components.name: Read PubMed paper
components.description: Reads a PubMed paper identified by its PMID and returns a string containing extracted paper content or a message indicating that direct paper reading is unsupported.

components.name: Read Semantic Paper
components.description: Reads and extracts text content from a Semantic Scholar paper identified by a Semantic Scholar ID, DOI, arXiv ID, MAG ID, ACL ID, PMID, PMCID, or URL. The tool returns the extracted paper text and can use a specified download directory.

components.name: Read SSRN paper
components.description: Attempts to read paper content from SSRN using a paper identifier. The SSRN connector is metadata-only, so the tool returns an error message rather than extracted paper text.

components.name: Read Zenodo paper
components.description: Reads a Zenodo paper identified by its paper ID, saving or locating the PDF and extracting its text content.

components.name: Search ACM
components.description: Searches the ACM Digital Library for academic papers using a query string and optional maximum result count, returning a list of paper records.

components.name: Search arXiv
components.description: Search academic papers from arXiv using a query string and return paper metadata. Results can be limited and sorted by relevance, submission date, or last update date.

components.name: Search BASE
components.description: Search academic papers in BASE (Bielefeld Academic Search Engine) using a text query and return matching paper metadata records.

components.name: Search bioRxiv
components.description: Search bioRxiv for academic paper metadata using a DOI, date range, category name, or an empty query for recent papers. Returns a list of matching paper metadata records.

components.name: Search CiteSeerX
components.description: Searches the CiteSeerX digital library for academic papers using a query string and returns matching paper metadata records.

components.name: Search CORE
components.description: Search academic papers from CORE using a text query and return matching paper metadata. The tool supports a maximum-results control.

components.name: Search Crossref
components.description: Searches the CrossRef database for academic papers using a query string and returns matching paper metadata. Optional filters, sorting, ordering, and result limits can refine the search.

components.name: Search DBLP
components.description: Searches the DBLP computer science bibliography for academic papers using a text query and returns matching paper metadata records.

components.name: Search DOAJ
components.description: Searches the Directory of Open Access Journals (DOAJ) for academic papers using a query and returns paper metadata.

components.name: Search Europe PMC
components.description: Search academic papers from Europe PMC using a text query and return matching paper metadata.

components.name: Search Google Scholar
components.description: Searches Google Scholar for academic papers using a query string and returns paper metadata, with an optional maximum result count.

components.name: Search HAL
components.description: Search academic papers from the HAL open archive using a text query and return a list of paper metadata records.

components.name: Search IACR
components.description: Search academic papers in the IACR ePrint Archive using a query string, with optional result limits and detailed paper information. Returns matching paper metadata.

components.name: Search IEEE
components.description: Searches IEEE Xplore for academic papers using a text query and returns matching paper records as dictionaries.

components.name: Search medRxiv
components.description: Search medRxiv for biomedical preprints using a category-name query, with results returned as paper metadata. The medRxiv API filters by category within the last 30 days rather than performing full-text keyword search.

components.name: Search OpenAIRE
components.description: Search academic papers in the OpenAIRE European Open Access infrastructure using a text query and return paper metadata records, with an optional maximum-results limit.

components.name: Search OpenAlex
components.description: Search academic papers in OpenAlex using a text query, with optional result limits and OpenAlex filter expressions. Returns matching paper metadata.

components.name: Search papers
components.description: Searches multiple academic literature sources using a query, optional source selection, and an optional year filter, returning aggregated, deduplicated paper records with per-source results and statistics.

components.name: Search PMC
components.description: Search academic papers in PubMed Central using a text query and return matching paper metadata.

components.name: Search PubMed
components.description: Search academic papers in PubMed using a query string and return paper metadata. Results can be limited and sorted by relevance or publication date.

components.name: Semantic paper search
components.description: Searches Semantic Scholar for academic papers using a query and optional publication-year filter, returning paper metadata records.

components.name: Search SSRN
components.description: Search SSRN for academic paper metadata using a text query and return matching paper metadata records. The SSRN connector is metadata-only and does not support direct PDF downloads.

components.name: Search Unpaywall
components.description: Look up a DOI or text containing a DOI in Unpaywall and return open-access paper metadata, with at most one record per request.

components.name: Search Zenodo
components.description: Search academic papers in the Zenodo open repository using a text query and return matching paper metadata records.

components.name: Batch query Open Targets GraphQL
components.description: Batch-query the Open Targets Platform GraphQL API to retrieve biomedical data. Accepts one or more GraphQL queries and returns the corresponding GraphQL JSON responses.

components.name: Query Open Targets GraphQL
components.description: Executes GraphQL queries against the Open Targets Platform API to retrieve integrated biomedical data.

components.name: PubMed detect fulltext
components.description: Check if a PubMed article has freely available full-text (Open Access) by checking PMC, Unpaywall, and publisher sources. Returns OA status, available sources, and download URL if found.

components.name: PubMed download fulltext
components.description: Downloads full-text PDFs for Open Access PubMed articles using a single PMID or an array of up to 10 PMIDs. Uses platform-native download tools (wget/curl/PowerShell) and only works with OA articles.

components.name: PubMed extract info
components.description: Extract specific structured sections from a PubMed article, including basic info, authors, abstract summary, keywords, and DOI link, using a PMID as input.

components.name: PubMed find related
components.description: Find articles related to a given PubMed article, discovering similar papers or review articles to build a comprehensive literature picture.

components.name: PubMed get details
components.description: Retrieve complete metadata for specific PubMed articles by PMID, accepting a single PMID or array of PMIDs (up to 20). Returns full article records including abstract, authors, journal, DOI, and MeSH terms.

components.name: PubMed manage cache
components.description: View cache statistics or perform maintenance on the PubMed cache, including checking hit rates and storage usage, removing expired entries, or wiping a specific cache layer.

components.name: PubMed search
components.description: Search the PubMed biomedical literature database, returning articles matching a query with metadata, abstracts, and citations. Supports Boolean operators, MeSH terms, and field tags, with options for result count, recency, sorting, and response detail level.

components.name: PubMed system status
components.description: Check system environment, API key pool health, and download tool availability for the PubMed MCP server. Reports platform info, available download tools, API key status, and recommendations for diagnosing issues with downloads or API connectivity.

components.name: ChEMBL find drugs by indication
components.description: Find all drugs for a disease or indication from ChEMBL using a disease name or MeSH heading, returning a JSON list of drug-indication pairs.

components.name: Find drugs by target
components.description: Searches ChEMBL for drugs and compounds that target a specified protein, accepting a ChEMBL target ID or target name and returning matching molecules as JSON.

components.name: ChEMBL Bioactivity Lookup
components.description: Retrieve bioactivity data from ChEMBL using optional target_chembl_id or molecule_chembl_id filters, returning JSON with standard values, standard types, and assay information.

components.name: ChEMBL Get Drug Indications
components.description: Get all indications (diseases) for a specific drug by its ChEMBL molecule ID, returning a JSON list of indications.

components.name: ChEMBL Get Mechanism
components.description: Retrieves mechanism of action data for a molecule from ChEMBL using a ChEMBL molecule ID, returning target, action type, and mechanism description.

components.name: ChEMBL get molecule
components.description: Retrieve molecule (drug/compound) information from ChEMBL by ChEMBL ID, including name, type, max phase, approval date, and properties.

components.name: chembl_get_target
components.description: Get target (protein) information from ChEMBL by ChEMBL target ID, returning details including name, type, and organism.

components.name: ChEMBL search molecules
components.description: Search ChEMBL for molecules (drugs/compounds) by name or synonym. Accepts a query string and optional result limit, and returns JSON with a list of matching molecules.

components.name: ChEMBL Search Targets
components.description: Searches ChEMBL for protein targets by name or synonym using a query string and returns matching target records.

components.name: Get clinical trial study
components.description: Get a single clinical trial study from ClinicalTrials.gov by NCT ID, returning complete study data including conditions, interventions, outcomes, and eligibility.

components.name: ClinicalTrials.gov study metadata
components.description: Retrieves the ClinicalTrials.gov data model metadata, including available field names, types, and descriptions, from the ClinicalTrials.gov API.

components.name: Search clinical trials by condition
components.description: Search clinical trials by condition or disease using ClinicalTrials.gov, returning study records that match the condition query.

components.name: Clinical trial search by intervention
components.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov for clinical trial records by intervention or treatment name, with optional condition and status filters to narrow results.

components.name: Clinical trial search
components.description: Search clinical trials from ClinicalTrials.gov by condition, intervention, and status, returning matching clinical trial records.

components.name: Every Cure KG Execute Cypher
components.description: Executes read-only Cypher queries against the Every Cure Matrix Knowledge Graph, with optional query parameters and database version selection.

components.name: EveryCure KG find diseases for drug
components.description: Find diseases associated with a drug using metapaths in the EveryCure knowledge graph, returning indications, contraindications, or adverse events for a given drug identifier.

components.name: Everycure KG find drugs for disease
components.description: Find drugs associated with a disease by querying the EveryCure knowledge graph using predefined metapaths. Accepts a disease identifier and returns drug-disease paths with optional indirect relationships via targets and pathways.

components.name: EveryCure KG find paths by custom metapath
components.description: Find paths between two nodes in the EveryCure knowledge graph using a custom Biolink Model metapath pattern, returning matching paths and path lengths.

components.name: EveryCure KG find paths by metapath
components.description: Finds paths between two nodes in the EveryCure knowledge graph using a predefined metapath, taking source and target node IDs and a metapath name, and returns the matching path records.

components.name: EveryCure KG neighborhood lookup
components.description: Get the neighborhood of a node in the EveryCure knowledge graph, optionally filtering by relationship types, neighbor node labels, and maximum hops. Returns connected neighbor records for a supplied node identifier.

components.name: EveryCure KG neighborhood statistics
components.description: Get neighborhood statistics for a node in the EveryCure KG, including total degree, relationship type distribution, and neighbor label distribution, using a node identifier and optional max hops and database version.

components.name: EveryCure KG Get Schema
components.description: Retrieve the schema of the EveryCure knowledge graph, including node labels, relationship types, and property keys; accepts an optional database version and returns JSON schema information.

components.name: EveryCure KG statistics
components.description: Retrieve node and relationship counts from the EveryCure knowledge graph, optionally for a specified database version.

components.name: EveryCure KG get supported metapaths
components.description: Lists all supported metapaths for path finding in the EveryCure knowledge graph. Each metapath includes a name, description, pattern of node and relationship types, and hop count, and is used to prevent path explosion in the highly connected graph.

components.name: Get supported types
components.description: Returns lists of supported node types and relationship types from the Every Cure knowledge graph, including curated common lists filtered for meaningful biomedical pathway discovery.

components.name: EveryCure KG weighted neighborhood
components.description: Retrieves the weighted neighborhood of a given node identifier in the EveryCure knowledge graph, returning neighbors sorted by evidence strength or by relationship/publication count.

components.name: FDA Orphan Get Application
components.description: Retrieves FDA drug application details from the FDA drugsfda database using drug name, active ingredient, or application number. Returns the sponsoring NDA/BLA number, sponsor name, and product list.

components.name: FDA orphan search exclusivity
components.description: Search the FDA Orange Book for orphan drug exclusivity (ODE) records by drug name, active ingredient, or application number, returning applications with 7-year orphan market exclusivity grants.

components.name: FDA orphan product designation search
components.description: Search the FDA Orphan Products Designation (OOPD) database for orphan designation records by drug name, disease/indication, or both (AND-filter). Returns orphan designation records including pre-approval designations.

components.name: GWAS Get Association
components.description: Retrieves a GWAS association record from the NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog by association ID and returns validated association information.

components.name: GWAS Get Study
components.description: Retrieve study information from the GWAS Catalog by study ID. Accepts a GWAS study ID such as GCST90132222 and returns study metadata.

components.name: GWAS Get Trait
components.description: Retrieves trait information from the GWAS Catalog by EFO trait ID.

components.name: GWAS get variant
components.description: Get single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) information from the GWAS Catalog by rsId. Accepts an rsId such as rs3093017 and returns SNP details including chromosomal location, functional class, and genomic contexts.

components.name: GWAS search associations
components.description: Search the GWAS Catalog for genetic associations using optional query, variant ID, study ID, or trait filters, returning association records.

components.name: GWAS Search Studies
components.description: Search for studies in the GWAS Catalog using optional query text or trait names, returning matching study records.

components.name: GWAS Search Traits
components.description: Search for traits in the GWAS Catalog using a trait name query, returning matching trait records.

components.name: GWAS search variants
components.description: Searches the GWAS Catalog single nucleotide polymorphisms endpoint for SNPs/variants that match an rsId query and returns matching SNP records with pagination information.

components.name: KEGG find diseases
components.description: Search KEGG diseases by keyword query and return matching disease records from the KEGG database.

components.name: KEGG Find Genes
components.description: Find genes in the KEGG database by keyword query, optionally restricted by an organism code, and return matching gene records.

components.name: KEGG Find Pathways
components.description: Find pathways in the KEGG database matching a query keyword, returning matching pathway records such as identifiers and names.

components.name: KEGG Get Disease
components.description: Get disease information from KEGG by KEGG disease ID (e.g., H00001). The tool calls the KEGG API and returns the disease record for the given identifier.

components.name: Kegg Get Gene
components.description: Retrieve gene information from the KEGG database using a KEGG gene ID and return the matching gene record.

components.name: KEGG Pathway Info Lookup
components.description: Get pathway information from the KEGG database by pathway ID. Accepts a KEGG pathway ID as input and returns the corresponding pathway information.

components.name: KEGG link pathway genes
components.description: Retrieves genes linked to a KEGG pathway given a pathway ID and returns a tab-delimited list of gene IDs.

components.name: KEGG List Pathways
components.description: Lists pathways from the KEGG PATHWAY database. Accepts an optional KEGG organism code to list organism-specific pathways; otherwise lists reference pathways.

components.name: MyChem Get Drug
components.description: Get drug or chemical information from MyChem.info by drug ID or name, returning matched records.

components.name: MyDisease get disease
components.description: Get disease information from MyDisease.info by disease ID or name, returning validated disease records.

components.name: MyGene gene lookup
components.description: Get gene information from MyGene.info by gene ID or symbol, returning matching gene records.

components.name: MyVariant Get Variant
components.description: Retrieve comprehensive variant annotation details for a given variant ID from the MyVariant API, including optional external data sources.

components.name: MyVariant Search Variants
components.description: Search genetic variants using MyVariant.info by gene, HGVS protein or transcript notation, rsID, clinical significance, allele frequency and CADD score thresholds. Returns matching variant records.

components.name: NCI Get Trial
components.description: Retrieves detailed clinical trial information from the National Cancer Institute (NCI) using a trial ID.

components.name: NCI Search Trials
components.description: Search NCI clinical trials for cancer research by conditions, interventions, trial phase, and recruiting status, returning matching trial records.

components.name: Get allowed conflations
components.description: Retrieves the available conflation types that can be applied during entity normalization, including gene/protein conflation and drug/chemical conflation.

components.name: Get CURIE prefixes
components.description: Retrieves the list of all CURIE prefixes supported by the Node Normalization database, along with usage counts for each semantic type. This helps determine the correct prefix format when constructing CURIEs for normalization.

components.name: NodeNorm get normalized nodes
components.description: Normalize one or more CURIEs by calling the Node Normalization API. Given comma-separated CURIEs, it returns the preferred CURIE, equivalent identifiers across databases, and BioLink Model semantic types for each entity.

components.name: Get semantic types
components.description: Retrieves all BioLink semantic types for which Node Normalization has been attempted, returning a dictionary mapping semantic types to their metadata.

components.name: OMIM Entry Lookup
components.description: Retrieves OMIM entry information by MIM number, with optional inclusion of fields such as text, allelic variant list, and gene map.

components.name: OMIM Get Gene
components.description: Retrieve gene information from the OMIM database by gene symbol using the OMIM API, returning gene map records by default.

components.name: OMIM Get Phenotype
components.description: Retrieves phenotype information from the Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man (OMIM) database by MIM number, returning an OMIM entry with the requested fields (text by default).

components.name: OMIM Search Entries
components.description: Search entries in the OMIM database using a query string and return matching records from the OMIM API.

components.name: OMIM Search Genes
components.description: Search genes in the Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man (OMIM) catalog using a gene search query and return matching gene map records.

components.name: OMIM phenotype search
components.description: Search phenotype records in the OMIM database using a text query, returning matching phenotypes with optional field selection and pagination.

components.name: OpenFDA Get Adverse Event
components.description: Retrieves a detailed adverse event report from OpenFDA by safety report ID, returning patient, drug, reaction, and summary information in JSON.

components.name: OpenFDA Get Drug Label
components.description: Retrieves full drug label and prescribing information by set ID from OpenFDA, optionally returning only requested sections.

components.name: OpenFDA adverse event search
components.description: Searches FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) records via OpenFDA using drug name and adverse reaction term, with optional seriousness filtering, returning matching adverse event reports.

components.name: OpenFDA search device events
components.description: Search FDA device adverse event reports (MAUDE) by device name, manufacturer, or device problem and return matching adverse event report records from the MAUDE database.

components.name: OpenFDA Search Drug Labels
components.description: Search FDA drug product labels (SPL) from OpenFDA by drug name, indication, or label section, returning matching label records.

components.name: OpenTargets get associations
components.description: Get target-disease associations from the Open Targets Platform using optional target or disease identifiers.

components.name: OpenTargets get evidence
components.description: Retrieve evidence linking a target and disease from OpenTargets using target and disease identifiers.

components.name: OpenTargets search
components.description: Search OpenTargets entities including targets, diseases, and drugs using a text query and optional entity type filter.

components.name: Patent Exclusivity Lookup
components.description: Retrieve non-patent exclusivity records from FDA drugs@FDA by application number or active ingredient.

components.name: Patent Search Orange Book
components.description: Search FDA Orange Book patent data via Drugs@FDA by drug name, active ingredient, or application number and return matching patent records.

components.name: Pathway Commons Get Pathway by URI
components.description: Get pathway information from Pathway Commons by URI, accepting a pathway URI and optional response format (JSON, XML, or BioPAX). Returns pathway data from the Pathway Commons API.

components.name: Pathway Commons Graph
components.description: Retrieves pathway graphs and networks from the Pathway Commons database using its v2 POST API. Accepts source and optional target entities in CURIE format and returns graph data for neighborhood, paths-between, paths-from-to, or common-stream queries.

components.name: Pathway Commons search
components.description: Search Pathway Commons for biological pathways, proteins, and other entities using a free-text query and optional entity type and data source filters. Returns matching records from the Pathway Commons database.

components.name: Pathway Commons top pathways
components.description: Retrieves top-level root Pathway objects from Pathway Commons, optionally filtered by a gene symbol or ID query and datasource, using the Pathway Commons v2 POST API.

components.name: Pathway Commons Traverse
components.description: Traverse Pathway Commons biological pathway data using the v2 POST API. Accepts a pathway or entity URI and a graph path expression, returning traversed BioPAX elements in JSON or XML.

components.name: PubMed Get Article
components.description: Retrieve detailed article information from PubMed by PubMed ID or DOI, including title, abstract, authors, journal, date, and optionally full text.

components.name: PubMed Search Articles
components.description: Search biomedical articles from PubMed/PubTator3 using gene, disease, chemical, keyword, and variant filters with pagination controls.

components.name: PubMed search preprints
components.description: Searches preprint articles from bioRxiv and medRxiv via Europe PMC based on a query string, returning preprint records with DOI, title, authors, journal, date, and abstract.

components.name: Reactome get disease pathways
components.description: Retrieves pathways associated with a disease from the Reactome API. It accepts a disease name and returns a list of associated pathways, or an empty list if none are found.

components.name: Reactome get pathway
components.description: Get detailed pathway information from the Reactome API using a Reactome pathway ID, returning pathway data including name, species, GO terms, sub-pathways and related entities in JSON format.

components.name: Reactome Get Pathway Participants
components.description: Retrieves all participants (genes, proteins, small molecules) in a Reactome pathway by stable identifier, returning a JSON list of participants or pathway information when the direct endpoint is unavailable.

components.name: Reactome query pathways
components.description: Query Reactome pathways by keyword, gene symbol, or protein name with an optional species filter, returning matching pathway records in JSON.

components.name: UniProt disease association lookup
components.description: Get disease associations for a protein by UniProt accession, returning associated disease records from the UniProt API.

components.name: UniProt Protein Lookup
components.description: Retrieves protein information from UniProt by accession. Accepts a UniProt accession and returns a protein record, with optional JSON, FASTA, or XML response format and optional field selection.

components.name: UniProt get protein sequence
components.description: Retrieves the protein sequence for a given UniProt accession and returns it in FASTA format.

components.name: UniProt Map IDs
components.description: Map identifiers between databases using UniProt ID mapping. Accepts source and target database names plus a list of identifiers and returns mapped identifiers, polling asynchronously for results.

components.name: UniProt protein search
components.description: Search proteins in UniProtKB using a query string, returning matching protein records in JSON, TSV, or FASTA format.

components.name: USPTO ODP Get Application
components.description: Retrieves USPTO patent application status and metadata from the USPTO Open Data Portal using a patent application number and API key.

components.name: Patent assignment lookup
components.description: Retrieves patent ownership and assignment records for a United States patent application from the USPTO Open Data Portal using an application number and API key.

components.name: USPTO ODP Get Continuity
components.description: Retrieves USPTO patent family and continuity data for a given application number, including parent and child applications, continuation-in-parts, and divisionals. Requires a USPTO ODP API key and returns continuity records from the USPTO Open Data Portal.

components.name: USPTO ODP Get Transactions
components.description: Retrieves prosecution history or transaction records for a U.S. patent application from the USPTO Open Data Portal using an application number and API key.

components.name: USPTO ODP search applications
components.description: Search USPTO patent applications by assignee, inventor, patent number, application number, or filing date range via the USPTO Open Data Portal.

components.name: USPTO PPUBS Search Applications
components.description: Search published US patent applications (pre-grant) via the USPTO PPUBS service. Accepts a USPTO search syntax query and returns matching patent application records.

components.name: Search granted US patents
components.description: Search granted US patents via USPTO Patent Public Search using a USPTO BRS query string, returning patent records matching the query.

components.name: Fetch PatSnap patent or literature records
components.description: Fetch PatSnap patent or scientific-literature records using result URLs, or fetch patents by publication number. Patent output may include bibliographic data, claims, descriptions, legal data, families, citations, and drawings.

components.name: Patent and literature search
components.description: Search PatSnap's global patent and scientific-literature database using semantic concepts, BM25 keywords, and multidimensional filters. Returns matching records with URLs for fetching detailed information via patsnap_fetch.

components.name: Google Search
components.description: Performs web searches through the Serper API using a required query and optional region, language, location, time, pagination, result-count, and autocorrection controls. Returns search results and metadata, including organic results, related searches, people-also-ask results, and knowledge-graph information.

components.name: Search
components.description: Executes a Google web search for a supplied query and returns matching organic results with titles, snippets, links, and positions.

components.name: Get Recovery Collection
components.description: Retrieve WHOOP recovery scores for a specified date range using ISO 8601 or relative dates such as today, last 7 days, or this week. Results include daily HRV, resting heart rate, SpO2, and skin temperature data.

components.name: Get sleep debt
components.description: Report observed nightly sleep deficits, standing debt, and local clock consistency from WHOOP data using an optional 3–90 day window (default 14) and start-date expression. At least three scored main sleeps are needed for aggregate metrics; deficit sums are not outstanding debt or recovery predictions.

components.name: Query abnormal heart beat
components.description: Reads device-reported abnormal-heartbeat events within an inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date range from locally cached health data. Returns event records and a count as JSON text, with earliest events first.

components.name: Query heart rate
components.description: Read timestamped heart-rate samples in beats per minute over an inclusive calendar-date range, optionally filtered by stored sample type. The read-only tool queries a local SQLite cache and returns JSON containing the samples, count, source, and generation timestamp.

components.name: Query SpO2
components.description: Query stored blood oxygen saturation measurements over an inclusive calendar date range. The read-only local SQLite cache returns timestamped SpO2 percentages and a count as JSON text.

components.name: Workout heart-rate series
components.description: Read an auto-downsampled heart-rate time series for a specified workout from a local cached account, returning time offsets, beats-per-minute values, downsampling metadata, and full-resolution summary statistics.

components.name: ATC Classification for a Drug
components.description: Look up WHO ATC (Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical) classification(s) for a drug by name via NLM RxClass. Returns one entry per ATC code with therapeutic and pharmacological class hierarchy.

components.name: ATC Code Details
components.description: Look up an ATC code at levels 1-4 to retrieve its class name and hierarchy level using NLM RxClass. Accepts codes 1-5 characters long; substance-level codes are not exposed.

components.name: ATC Class Members
components.description: Lists the drugs (substances) that belong to a given ATC class, returning each member with its substance-level ATC code. Supports exploring ATC subtrees at any level.

components.name: CID-10 Chapter Lookup
components.description: Retrieves one CID-10 chapter (1-22) and its constituent groups with code ranges and titles. The tool takes a chapter number as input and returns the chapter detail including group codes and descriptions.

components.name: CID-10 Chapters
components.description: Lists the 22 chapters of the CID-10 classification with code ranges and Portuguese titles, providing a navigable table of contents for downstream tooling.

components.name: CID-10 code lookup
components.description: Look up a specific CID-10 code and return its Portuguese name, including canonical display and gender or cause-of-death restriction flags where applicable. Accepts both dotted and undotted code forms.

components.name: CID-10 search
components.description: Searches the Brazilian CID-10 (International Classification of Diseases, 10th revision) by Portuguese clinical terms or text. Returns matching 3-character categories and 4-character subcategories from the bundled DataSUS V2008 dataset with diacritic-insensitive matching.

components.name: Find Equivalents Across Terminologies
components.description: Ranked unified search for equivalent terms across multiple medical terminologies including ICD-11, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, and MeSH. Accepts a query term or code and returns matching concept records from the selected terminologies for mapping and data integration.

components.name: List ICD-11 Chapters
components.description: Lists all ICD-11 chapters (top-level categories), returning an overview of the ICD-11 classification structure for navigation and identification of chapters by body system or condition type.

components.name: Browse ICD-11 Hierarchy
components.description: Navigates the ICD-11 hierarchy to find parent or child entities for an ICD-11 code or foundation URI, returning ancestor or subcategory records.

components.name: ICD-11 Entity Details
components.description: Get detailed information about a specific ICD-11 entity by code or foundation URI, including definition, coding notes, exclusions, official title, and synonyms, with optional WHO official translations.

components.name: ICD-11 Postcoordination Options
components.description: Get postcoordination information for an ICD-11 code, including available axes for building composite codes and required versus optional extensions such as severity, laterality, and anatomy.

components.name: Search ICD-11
components.description: Search ICD-11 for medical conditions, diseases, and health problems by name or keyword, with optional language selection; returns matching entities with codes, titles, and relevance scores from the WHO ICD-API.

components.name: LOINC Answer Lists
components.description: Get the list of valid answers for a LOINC questionnaire item identified by its LOINC code, returning standardized answer options for data entry validation.

components.name: LOINC Code Details
components.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific LOINC code, including its full name, component, property, timing, system, scale type, and method, given a LOINC number in format XXXXX-X.

components.name: LOINC Panel Structure
components.description: Get the structure of a LOINC panel or form and return the list of LOINC codes that make up the panel, such as tests in a CBC or metabolic panel.

components.name: Search LOINC
components.description: Search LOINC for laboratory tests, clinical observations, and measurements by query, returning matching LOINC codes with names, components, and properties.

components.name: Map ICD-10 to ICD-11
components.description: Maps ICD-10 codes to ICD-11 categories using WHO transition tables, returning primary and alternative ICD-11 codes with titles, chapters, and URIs for clinical coding and retrospective analysis.

components.name: Map LOINC to SNOMED CT (Guidance)
components.description: Looks up a LOINC code in NLM Clinical Tables and returns guidance on where to obtain a LOINC to SNOMED CT mapping; it does not perform the mapping.

components.name: Map SNOMED CT to ICD-10
components.description: Maps a SNOMED CT concept identifier to its corresponding ICD-10 code for cross-referencing clinical terminology with classification and billing systems. Accepts a SNOMED CT ID such as 73211009 and returns the mapped ICD-10 code or indicates no mapping.

components.name: MeSH Descriptor Details
components.description: Get detailed information about a MeSH descriptor by its MeSH ID, including the full definition (scope note), tree numbers, related concepts, and synonyms. Optionally specify a language code to request NLM official translations.

components.name: MeSH Allowable Qualifiers
components.description: Get allowed qualifiers (subheadings) for a MeSH descriptor, returning which qualifiers can be combined with that descriptor and helping build precise MeSH search queries.

components.name: Search MeSH
components.description: Search for MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) descriptors from the NLM MeSH Linked Data API, taking a search term and returning matching descriptors with MeSH IDs and labels.

components.name: MeSH Tree Locations
components.description: Get the tree hierarchy location(s) for a MeSH descriptor, showing where a term fits in the MeSH hierarchy and its broader/narrower relationships. Accepts a MeSH descriptor ID and returns hierarchical MeSH tree numbers.

components.name: RxNorm Drug Classes
components.description: Get therapeutic and pharmacologic classes for a drug using its RxNorm identifier (RxCUI), including class IDs, names, and classification sources such as mechanism of action and therapeutic categories.

components.name: RxNorm Concept Details
components.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific RxNorm concept by RxCUI, including full name, synonyms, concept status, and related concepts such as ingredients, brands, and forms.

components.name: RxNorm Drug Ingredients
components.description: Get active ingredients for a drug by RxCUI from RxNorm, returning ingredient RxCUIs and names.

components.name: RxNorm / NDC Mapping
components.description: Maps between RxNorm concepts (RxCUI) and National Drug Codes (NDC) using RxNorm and NDC coding systems, enabling retrieval of NDC codes for a drug or the RxCUI for an NDC code.

components.name: Search RxNorm Drugs
components.description: Search RxNorm for drug concepts by brand or generic name, returning matching drugs with RxCUI identifiers, names, and term types from NLM RxNav.

components.name: SNOMED CT Concept Details
components.description: Retrieve detailed information for a SNOMED CT concept by SCTID, including Fully Specified Name, Preferred Term, active status, and definition status from the configured Snowstorm edition.

components.name: SNOMED CT Concept Descriptions
components.description: Get all active descriptions (names) for a SNOMED CT concept, including the Fully Specified Name, Preferred Term, and synonyms, with type and acceptability. The tool accepts a SNOMED CT concept identifier and returns description records from SNOMED CT; production use requires an IHTSDO license.

components.name: SNOMED CT ECL Query
components.description: Executes Expression Constraint Language (ECL) queries against SNOMED CT to retrieve matching clinical concepts for terminology navigation and reference.

components.name: Browse SNOMED CT Hierarchy
components.description: Retrieve hierarchical parent and child concepts for a given SNOMED CT concept based on IS-A relationships, using the configured Snowstorm edition.

components.name: Search SNOMED CT
components.description: Search SNOMED CT concepts by term and return matching concepts with SCTID, Fully Specified Name (FSN), and Preferred Term (PT).

components.name: Terminology Version Diff
components.description: Reports what diff data is available between two versions of a medical terminology. For most terminologies it returns guidance and publisher changelog references, while for ICD-10 vs ICD-11 it surfaces a bundled WHO transition-table summary.

components.name: Terminology Versions
components.description: List current version, release date, publisher, source URL, and update cadence for the medical terminologies supported by the server, optionally filtering by terminology name.

components.name: Validate Medical Codes
components.description: Validates a mixed batch of medical codes against source terminologies, returning whether each code exists, is active, and any ICD-10 to ICD-11 replacement information.

components.name: Analyze sponsor network
components.description: Analyzes a clinical trial sponsor's portfolio and network using the organization name and optional analysis scope, including therapeutic areas, stage distribution, collaboration patterns, and optional trial portfolio.

components.name: Analyze trial details
components.description: Analyzes clinical trial details by NCT identifier, providing eligibility parsing, arm/intervention mapping, outcome measures, and computed assessments.

components.name: Analyze trial outcomes
components.description: Extracts and analyzes outcome measures from clinical trials by NCT identifier, with optional filtering by outcome category and comparison modes.

components.name: Export and format trials
components.description: Exports clinical trial records by NCT ID to JSON, CSV, or Markdown, with options for field selection, summary statistics, grouping, and sorting.

components.name: Find similar trials
components.description: Finds clinical trials similar to a reference trial identified by NCT ID from ClinicalTrials.gov, returning matching trial records for competitive analysis. Supports optional filtering by similarity dimensions, threshold, sponsor, and completion status.

components.name: Get Enrollment Intelligence
components.description: Analyzes clinical trial enrollment patterns and market capacity, optionally filtered by condition, intervention type, geographic location, and enrollment status; can include capacity, velocity, and competitor summaries.

components.name: Get trial metadata schema
components.description: Retrieves the metadata schema and available search fields for clinical trial records, returning field definitions, search areas, enumerations, or statistics based on the selected scope.

components.name: Match patient to trials
components.description: Match a patient profile containing age, gender, primary condition, and optional secondary conditions, location, and treatment preferences to eligible clinical trials.

components.name: Query trial statistics
components.description: Queries aggregate statistics and trends from ClinicalTrials.gov clinical trial data using configurable filters such as statistic type, condition, phase, enrollment status, and countries.

components.name: Search clinical trials
components.description: Search clinical trials by query, disease/condition, intervention, phase, enrollment status, location, age, sex, and other filters. Returns structured clinical trial records from ClinicalTrials.gov.

components.name: Research cancel
components.description: Cancel an in-flight research run in a notebook using its poll task identifier, returning whether cancellation was requested and the observed run status.

components.name: Research source import
components.description: Imports the sources from a completed research task into a specified Google NotebookLM notebook. The import can be limited to cited sources or a maximum number of sources, and repeated imports skip sources already present unless duplicates are allowed.

components.name: Research session start
components.description: Starts a non-blocking research session in a Google NotebookLM notebook using a notebook name or ID and a query. Supports web or Drive sources and fast or deep modes, and returns a poll task identifier for tracking the session.

components.name: Research status
