components.description: Checks the status of research for a specified NotebookLM notebook, optionally pinned to a task. Returns the research status, task identifier, sources, and report metadata, with optional report content and source pagination.

components.name: Cancel batch analysis
components.description: Cancels a running batch analysis job in a Smartsheet sheet identified by a sheet ID and job ID.

components.name: Get health summary CH
components.description: Get a summary of Apple Health data from ClickHouse, including total record count, record type breakdown, and optionally a date range aggregation.

components.name: Get health summary duckdb
components.description: Retrieves a summary of Apple Health data from a DuckDB database, including total record count, record type breakdown, and optionally a date range aggregation.

components.name: Get health summary ES
components.description: Get a summary of Apple Health data from Elasticsearch, including total record count, record type breakdown, and optionally a date range aggregation.

components.name: Health record statistics by type
components.description: Get comprehensive statistics for a specific health record type from ClickHouse. It returns the record type, total count, and statistical summary of the value field including count, minimum, maximum, and average.

components.name: Get Statistics by Type DuckDB
components.description: Get comprehensive statistics for a specific health record type from DuckDB, returning total count and value statistics including count, min, and max.

components.name: Get health record statistics by type
components.description: Retrieves comprehensive statistics for a specified health record type from Elasticsearch, including total record count and summary statistics for the value field.

components.name: Get Trend Data (ClickHouse)
components.description: Get trend data for a specific health record type over time using ClickHouse date histogram aggregation, with optional interval and date range filters.

components.name: Get trend data DuckDB
components.description: Retrieves trend data for a specified Apple Health record type over time using DuckDB date histogram aggregation. Supports aggregation interval and optional ISO8601 date range filters.

components.name: Health trend data retrieval
components.description: Retrieves time-series trend data for a specified Apple Health record type from Elasticsearch using date histogram aggregation, with optional date range and interval controls.

components.name: Get XML by type
components.description: Retrieves all records of a specific Apple Health record type from an exported Apple Health XML file and returns them as XML elements, optionally limiting the number returned.

components.name: Get XML structure
components.description: Analyzes the structure and metadata of an Apple Health XML export file without loading the entire content, returning file size, root elements, record types, workout types, and data sources.

components.name: Search Health Records CH
components.description: Search health records stored in ClickHouse using flexible query parameters and return matching health record documents.

components.name: Search health records DuckDB
components.description: Search health records in DuckDB with flexible query building. Accepts a required record type and search/filter parameters and returns matching health record documents ordered by date from most to least recent.

components.name: Search health records Elasticsearch
components.description: Searches health records stored in Elasticsearch using flexible query and filter parameters and returns matching health record documents.

components.name: Search health record values
components.description: Search for Apple Health records with exactly matching values using ClickHouse. Accepts a health record type, search value, and optional date range, and returns matching health records.

components.name: Search values in DuckDB
components.description: Searches Apple Health records stored in DuckDB for exact value matches, filtered by record type and optional date range, returning matching health records.

components.name: Search values ES
components.description: Searches health records using Elasticsearch for records with exactly matching values, including text values, optionally filtered by date range.

components.name: Search XML Content
components.description: Search Apple Health XML records and workouts for a query string and return up to max_results matching XML elements.

components.name: Add document to Pinecone
components.description: Adds a document to the Pinecone vector index for a specified FHIR DocumentReference ID, ingesting new documents into the index for subsequent search operations.

components.name: Get LOINC codes
components.description: Get the most relevant LOINC codes for a given observation name by filtering for active codes and sorting by common test rank.

components.name: Request allergy intolerance resource
components.description: Performs FHIR CRUD operations on AllergyIntolerance resources by sending an HTTP request to a FHIR server and returning the FHIR resource or error.

components.name: Request Condition Resource
components.description: Makes HTTP requests to a FHIR server to perform CRUD operations on FHIR Condition resources, accepting an HTTP method and resource path and returning the resulting condition resource or FHIR response.

components.name: Request Document Reference Resource
components.description: Makes HTTP requests to a FHIR server to perform CRUD operations on the FHIR DocumentReference resource, accepting a structured FHIR query request and returning a FHIR query response or error.

components.name: Request Encounter Resource
components.description: Makes HTTP requests to a FHIR server to perform CRUD operations on the Encounter resource, accepting an HTTP method and resource path and returning the FHIR server response.

components.name: Request Family Member History resource
components.description: Performs CRUD operations on FHIR FamilyMemberHistory resources via an HTTP request to a FHIR server, taking a FHIR query request and returning the resulting family member history records or a FHIR error.

components.name: Request generic resource
components.description: Makes generic HTTP requests to a FHIR server to perform CRUD operations on any FHIR resource when specialized tools are not applicable. Accepts an FhirQueryRequest and returns an FhirQueryResponse or FhirError.

components.name: Request immunization resource
components.description: Performs CRUD operations (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) on the FHIR Immunization resource by making HTTP requests to a FHIR server using a specified HTTP method and resource path.

components.name: Request medication resource
components.description: Makes HTTP requests to a FHIR server to perform CRUD operations on the FHIR Medication resource using methods such as GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE. Returns FHIR query responses or errors and is intended for managing medication records with user-provided data only.

components.name: Request Observation Resource
components.description: Makes HTTP requests to a FHIR server to perform CRUD operations on the Observation resource. Before fetching observations that require LOINC codes, use the get_loinc_code tool to resolve appropriate codes.

components.name: Request patient resource
components.description: Makes an HTTP request to the FHIR server to perform CRUD operations on the FHIR Patient resource. It takes an HTTP method and resource path and returns a FHIR Patient response or error.

components.name: Search Pinecone
components.description: Searches a Pinecone vector index for information related to a given FHIR DocumentReference ID, using a user query and returning matching search results.

components.name: Deep Research
components.description: Use any LLMs for deep research; supports SSE API and MCP server.

components.name: Generate SERP Query
components.description: Generates a search engine results page (SERP) query from a provided research plan, with an optional response language. Uses an external AI API to produce the query.

components.name: Search task
components.description: Executes a list of research query tasks, each with a query and research goal, and returns search results with optional controls for language, maximum result count, and reference inclusion.

components.name: Write final report
components.description: Writes a final report from a research plan and a set of research tasks, each containing a query, research goal, learned knowledge, and sources.

components.name: Write Research Plan
components.description: Generates a research plan for a given topic using external LLM-based deep research. Accepts a required query string and an optional language, and returns a research plan.

components.name: Analyze search query
components.description: Analyzes a literature search query, returning structured query analysis including MeSH expansion and PICO handoff for the PubMed Search MCP.

components.name: Build citation tree
components.description: Builds a citation tree from a seed article identifier for literature references and supports exploration of the resulting citation network.

components.name: Build research chronicle
components.description: Builds a persistent, versionable research chronicle that maps the evolution of a research topic as an evidence-supported timeline with branch projections.

components.name: Configure institutional access
components.description: Configures institutional access for PubMed literature retrieval using an OpenURL link resolver.

components.name: ICD-10 to MeSH conversion
components.description: Converts ICD-10 codes to MeSH terms for biomedical terminology mapping.

components.name: Delete pipeline
components.description: Deletes a specified saved literature search pipeline.

components.name: Diagnose institutional access
components.description: Diagnoses institutional access configuration for the OpenURL link resolver used by PubMed search and returns a diagnostic report.

components.name: Fetch article details
components.description: Fetch detailed bibliographic metadata for a PubMed article using an article identifier.

components.name: Find citing articles
components.description: Find articles that cite a given PubMed article by article identifier and return the citing article records from PubMed.

components.name: Find related articles
components.description: Find articles related to a given article identifier in PubMed and return matching article records.

components.name: Generate search queries
components.description: Generates PubMed search queries from an agent-provided PICO handoff as part of the query intelligence category.

components.name: Get article figures
components.description: Retrieves figures and visual data associated with a scientific article using an article identifier, supporting extraction of graphical content from publications.

components.name: Get Article References
components.description: Retrieves the reference list for a specified article, taking an article identifier as input and returning the cited references.

components.name: Get citation metrics
components.description: Retrieve citation metrics for a PubMed article by its PMID.

components.name: Get compound details
components.description: Retrieve detailed information for a chemical compound from PubChem using a compound identifier.

components.name: Get compound literature
components.description: Retrieve literature records associated with a chemical compound using a compound identifier or name.

components.name: Get Full Text
components.description: Retrieves the full text of a biomedical article by article identifier for full-text access and downstream text mining.

components.name: Get Gene Details
components.description: Retrieves detailed gene information for a supplied gene identifier from NCBI Gene.

components.name: Get gene literature
components.description: Retrieve PubMed literature records associated with a gene identifier from the PubMed database.

components.name: Get institutional link
components.description: Generates an OpenURL institutional access link for a publication, taking a publication identifier and returning a resolver URL.

components.name: Get Pipeline History
components.description: Retrieves execution history records for stored PubMed literature-search pipelines.

components.name: Get text mined terms
components.description: Retrieve text-mined terms from a full-text article using its article identifier in the PubMed Search MCP. The tool belongs to the fulltext and text mining category.

components.name: List pipelines
components.description: List saved search pipelines managed by the PubMed search MCP server, returning pipeline records.

components.name: List resolver presets
components.description: Lists the available OpenURL link resolver presets for institutional full-text access configuration; it returns the preset options without requiring input.

components.name: Load pipeline
components.description: Loads a saved search pipeline definition and returns its configuration for reuse in literature search workflows.

components.name: Prepare export
components.description: Prepares citation exports for literature references, supporting citation format export as part of the export tool group.

components.name: Prepare figure search
components.description: Prepares an experimental visual search request for biomedical figures, accepting a figure query and returning a prepared figure search.

components.name: Read research chronicle
components.description: Reads a stored research chronicle, returning its persistable, version-comparable, evidence-supported chronological axes and branch projections.

components.name: Save literature notes
components.description: Saves literature notes to local storage, supporting note-taking for literature references as part of an export workflow.

components.name: Search biomedical images
components.description: Searches for biomedical images based on a search query and returns matching image records.

components.name: Search ClinVar
components.description: Search NCBI ClinVar for genetic variant records and associated clinical significance information using a query.

components.name: Search Compound
components.description: Search PubChem for chemical compound records using a compound query, returning matching compound records.

components.name: Search gene
components.description: Search for gene records by gene query terms and return matching gene records.

components.name: Test institutional access
components.description: Tests institutional access for PubMed full-text retrieval by verifying the configured OpenURL link resolver.

components.name: Unified search
components.description: Unified multi-source literature search gateway for searching biomedical literature across multiple sources using a query.

components.name: Validate PICO plan
components.description: Validates an agent-provided PICO plan for literature search, checking the population, intervention, comparison, and outcome components before query generation.

components.name: Verify Reference List
components.description: Verifies a supplied list of references against PubMed and returns PubMed evidence for each reference.

components.name: Advanced search
components.description: Perform advanced PubMed searches using multiple criteria such as terms, authors, journals, publication types, and date ranges, returning matching article records.

components.name: Batch get article details
components.description: Fetch article details for many PMIDs efficiently in batches, returning article records along with success and failure counts.

components.name: Batch search multiple queries
components.description: Performs multiple PubMed searches in parallel for efficiency, accepting a list of queries and returning result counts, timings, and any errors.

components.name: Cache statistics
components.description: Get cache performance statistics for the NCBI MCP server, including metrics on cache hits, misses, and other performance indicators.

components.name: Clear cache
components.description: Clears expired cache entries in the NCBI MCP server's cache manager, returning the number of cleared entries and a success message.

components.name: Get analytics summary
components.description: Get comprehensive analytics summary including usage stats, performance metrics, and system health.

components.name: Get article details
components.description: Fetch detailed information for specific PubMed articles using a list of PubMed IDs (PMIDs).

components.name: Get detailed metrics
components.description: Retrieves detailed performance metrics for the MCP server over a specified time period (hours), defaulting to the last 24 hours.

components.name: Get related articles
components.description: Given a PubMed article identifier (PMID), returns related PubMed article records from PubMed.

components.name: Reset analytics
components.description: Resets all collected analytics data by stopping the current analytics manager and creating a new one, clearing all accumulated metrics.

components.name: Search MeSH terms
components.description: Search Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) terms by a text query and return matching MeSH term records from the MeSH database.

components.name: Search PubMed
components.description: Search PubMed database for scientific literature using a text query and return matching bibliographic records.

components.name: Detect contrast phase
components.description: Estimate the contrast phase of a CT image provided as a NIfTI file or DICOM ZIP. The tool returns a model-derived contrast-phase result and internally runs anatomical segmentation, with support for GPU, CPU, or MPS execution.

components.name: Estimate body statistics
components.description: Estimate body weight, height, age, sex, BMI, and body surface area from CT or MR images supplied as NIfTI files or DICOM ZIP archives. Returns model-derived body statistics.

components.name: Get Class Options
components.description: Returns every TotalSegmentator task that outputs each requested anatomical class name. The input is a list of exact class names, and the output maps each class to matching segmentation task names.

components.name: Get modality
components.description: Predicts whether a supplied NIfTI image is CT or MR and returns the predicted imaging modality.

components.name: Get task details
components.description: Returns full registry metadata for selected TotalSegmentator tasks identified by exact task names, including imaging modality, output classes, licensing requirements, and other available metadata.

components.name: List all classes
components.description: Returns every unique TotalSegmentator output class, grouped by imaging modality, along with the total class count.

components.name: List all tasks
components.description: Returns a catalogue of all available TotalSegmentator tasks, grouped by imaging modality, with exact task names for use in subsequent operations.

components.name: Run segmentation
components.description: Runs TotalSegmentator anatomical segmentation on a medical image using a selected task and optional focused ROI subset. The tool writes segmentation outputs and can calculate structure volumes and mean image intensities as statistics.

components.name: PubMed search
components.description: Searches the PubMed medical literature database using a search query and returns matching article records, with optional max_results between 1 and 15.

components.name: Get citation
components.description: Retrieve and format a paper citation from a DOI, PMID, PMCID, or arXiv identifier. DOI citations use Crossref content negotiation, while other supported identifiers are resolved through metadata sources before generating a citation in a selected style.

components.name: Get paper by ID
components.description: Retrieves publication or trial details from a supported identifier, including DOI, PMID, arXiv, PMC, and other supported source identifiers. It can optionally compare expected metadata and attach a bounded citation graph from publication sources.

components.name: Lookup MeSH
components.description: Looks up Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) terms using the NCBI MeSH database via NCBI E-utilities. Accepts a search term and returns matching MeSH descriptor names and unique IDs.

components.name: Search papers
components.description: Searches publications or trial registrations across supported academic and research sources using a query and entity type. Returns merged matching records with counts and per-source errors, with optional filtering, ranking, and publication enrichment.

components.name: Create FHIR resource
components.description: Creates a new FHIR resource on a FHIR server using a supplied resource type and full JSON payload, and returns the created resource.

components.name: Delete FHIR resource
components.description: Deletes a FHIR resource by resource type and logical ID, optionally conditionally using FHIR search parameters, or executes a named FHIR operation such as $expunge on the resource. Returns a FHIR OperationOutcome describing success or failure.

components.name: Get capabilities
components.description: Discover FHIR capability metadata for a requested FHIR resource type, including valid search parameters and operations permitted by the configured FHIR server. The tool must be invoked before any FHIR resource operation and does not fetch actual resources.

components.name: Get user
components.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's FHIR profile containing demographic and contact details such as id, name, and birthDate. It requires an authenticated user context and returns a dictionary with the profile data.

components.name: Read FHIR resource
components.description: Reads a specific FHIR resource instance by its resource type and logical identifier, optionally applying search parameters, and returns the matching FHIR resource.

components.name: Search
components.description: Searches a FHIR server for resources of a specified type using FHIR search parameters and returns matching resource records, with optional response field filtering and paginated results for large data sets.

components.name: Update FHIR resource
components.description: Updates a FHIR resource by type and logical ID using a provided JSON payload. Supports conditional updates via search parameters and custom operations such as $validate, returning the updated resource or an OperationOutcome.

components.name: Analysis BAM summary
components.description: Inspect SAM, BAM, or CRAM alignment data from inline content, a prior artifact, or an allowed host path. Returns alignment headers, contigs and lengths, sample and read-group information, flagstat mapping metrics, and per-contig mapped and unmapped counts when an index is available.

components.name: BAM view region
components.description: Queries a genomic region in a SAM, BAM, or CRAM alignment using samtools-style count, depth, pileup, or reads modes. Returns read counts, per-base or binned coverage, pileup rows, SAM rows, or a BAM artifact for downstream analysis.

components.name: Analysis BCF Summary
components.description: Inspect a VCF/BCF variant file to summarize its total variant record count, contigs, sample count and names, and the INFO/FORMAT fields declared in the header. Indexed files can include per-contig record counts, while large inputs may return guidance before streaming.

components.name: Analysis BCF view region
components.description: Query variants in a genomic region from a VCF or BCF source using selected fields, samples, filters, and variant types. The tool returns a bounded variant table or, with artifact format, a sliced VCF.gz for downstream analysis.

components.name: Analysis BED operation
components.description: Performs genomic interval algebra on BED tracks using intersect, merge, subtract, coverage, jaccard, or sort operations. It accepts source and optional B-side interval tracks with overlap and sorting controls, and produces bounded table or JSON results.

components.name: Biowasm CLI
components.description: Runs an allowlisted samtools, bedtools, or bcftools subcommand with an argument array for advanced bioinformatics file analysis. The tool returns captured command output with an I/O statistics summary and enforces bounded arguments and /shared path constraints.

components.name: Biowasm format conversion
components.description: Converts SAM, BAM, CRAM, VCF, and BCF sources using samtools or bcftools, including VCF/BCF to TSV conversion with field projection and optional filtering. The tool accepts a source and target format and returns a reusable artifact handle, with optional inline content for small artifacts.

components.name: Biowasm Session Info
components.description: Reports the Biowasm runtime state, including pinned samtools, bedtools, and bcftools versions, asset cache location and verification time, engine status, retained artifact count, and process memory. The read-only diagnostic tool does not download assets or start the worker.

components.name: Analysis R DESeq2
components.description: Performs differential expression analysis of RNA-seq count data using Bioconductor DESeq2 in a sandboxed WebAssembly R runtime. It accepts a gene-by-sample integer count matrix, sample metadata, and a design with an optional contrast or coefficient, and returns ranked differential-expression results with summary stati…

components.name: Analysis R edgeR
components.description: Performs differential expression analysis of RNA-seq count data with Bioconductor edgeR, using TMM normalization, empirical Bayes dispersion estimation, and either a quasi-likelihood F-test or a two-group exact test. The analysis runs in a sandboxed WebAssembly R runtime.

components.name: RNA-seq differential expression analysis with limma-voom
components.description: Analyzes RNA-seq count data for differential expression using limma-voom, with TMM normalization via edgeR, precision-weighted linear models, and empirical Bayes moderation in a sandboxed WebAssembly R runtime.

components.name: Analysis R session info
components.description: Reports the R analysis runtime status, including the R/WebAssembly version, installed Bioconductor package versions, library paths, memory usage, and package mirror endpoint. The tool is intended to diagnose issues with the R analysis tools.

components.name: Article retrieval
components.description: Retrieve an article by PMID, PMCID, DOI, or preprint DOI, including article metadata and optionally selected sections. Citation data can include forward and backward citations from Europe PMC, Semantic Scholar, OpenCitations, Crossref, and PubMed.

components.name: Article search
components.description: Searches biomedical literature across PubMed, Europe PMC, Semantic Scholar, PubTator, LitSense, arXiv, and bioRxiv or medRxiv preprint indexing using a text query, returning deduplicated matching article records.

components.name: Database query
components.description: Execute a read-only SQL query against configured database backends, with optional named parameters. The tool returns the query result as JSON-formatted text and supports configured SQLite or MySQL databases.

components.name: Disease drugs
components.description: Retrieve drugs associated with a disease from OpenTargets using a disease ID. The tool returns matching drug records as JSON.

components.name: Disease information retrieval
components.description: Retrieves detailed disease information using a disease identifier, with optional selection of response sections.

components.name: Disease search
components.description: Searches for disease records using a disease name, phenotype, or keyword and returns matching disease information.

components.name: Disease trials
components.description: Retrieves clinical trial records matching a disease identifier through the clinicaltrials data connection, returning trial identifiers, titles, and overall statuses.

components.name: Drug get
components.description: Get detailed information about a drug by name, with selectable core, regulatory, safety, target, indication, and adverse-event sections. Adverse-event data includes FDA FAERS adverse reactions ranked by report count.

components.name: Drug search
components.description: Search for drugs using a name, mechanism, or keyword query and return matching drug records.

components.name: Drug trials
components.description: Find clinical trial records for a specified drug name.

components.name: Ensembl consequence prediction
components.description: Predicts the functional consequence of a variant using Ensembl VEP for HGVS notation or dbSNP rsIDs, including the most severe consequence and per-transcript effects. Results may include codon or amino-acid changes, SIFT and PolyPhen values, and co-located known variants with ClinVar, COSMIC, gnomAD, or 1000 Genomes a…

components.name: Ensembl homology
components.description: Find orthologues or paralogues for a gene across species using Ensembl Compara. Accepts a gene symbol or Ensembl gene ID and can restrict results by source species, target species, or taxon; returns target stable IDs, species, taxonomy level, and percent identity.

components.name: Ensembl Lookup
components.description: Resolve an HGNC gene symbol or Ensembl gene identifier against Ensembl for any supported species. Returns stable identifier mappings, canonical transcript and genomic coordinates, with optional transcript and translation/protein details.

components.name: Ensembl region
components.description: Query a genomic interval, such as a 1-based GRCh38 human region, for genes, transcripts, and known variants. Results include feature identifiers and annotations such as symbols, biotypes, alleles, consequence terms, and clinical significance, subject to a maximum result limit.

components.name: GenBank genes
components.description: Maps a GenBank or RefSeq nucleotide accession to its corresponding NCBI Gene IDs using the NCBI nuccore-to-gene link.

components.name: GenBank get
components.description: Fetches a GenBank or RefSeq nucleotide record from NCBI as a text GenBank flat file or FASTA record. Supports accession-based retrieval, optional sequence regions, strand selection, and response-size limits.

components.name: GenBank search
components.description: Search NCBI nucleotide records from GenBank, RefSeq, and INSDC using plain terms, accessions, or NCBI field syntax, with optional organism filtering. Results include accession versions, definitions, sequence lengths, organisms, and topology.

components.name: Gene articles
components.description: Find articles about a gene using an HGNC gene symbol as input and return matching article records.

components.name: Gene diseases
components.description: Find diseases associated with an HGNC gene symbol. The Tool retrieves disease associations from DisGeNET and falls back to OpenTargets gene-disease data when DisGeNET is unavailable.

components.name: Gene drugs
components.description: Find drugs targeting a gene using an HGNC gene symbol and return matching drug results.

components.name: Gene enrichment
components.description: Performs pathway enrichment analysis for a list of HGNC gene symbols and returns pathway enrichment results.

components.name: Gene Get
components.description: Retrieve detailed gene information by official HGNC gene symbol, with optional section selection and alias resolution for common gene names.

components.name: Gene search
components.description: Search for genes by symbol, name, or keyword, with an optional chromosome filter, and return matching gene records.

components.name: Gene trials
components.description: Find clinical trials associated with a gene using its HGNC gene symbol as input. Returns matching clinical trial records.

components.name: GEO Get
components.description: Retrieve full GEO record details for series, sample, platform, or curated dataset accessions. The tool returns record metadata and can optionally download the first supplementary file to a local temporary path.

components.name: GEO Search
components.description: Search NCBI GEO for functional genomics records, including expression microarray, RNA-seq, and other high-throughput sequencing studies. Accepts free-text or NCBI field-syntax queries with optional entry-type and organism filters and returns matching GEO records.

components.name: GTEx eQTL
components.description: Retrieves significant cis-eQTL associations for an HGNC gene symbol or Ensembl gene identifier in a required GTEx tissue. Results from GTEx Analysis v10 include variant identifiers, p-values, and normalized effect sizes, sorted by ascending p-value.

components.name: GTEx expression
components.description: Retrieves median gene expression across 54 GTEx tissue sites using an HGNC symbol or Ensembl gene ID, with an optional tissue filter. Results are reported as TPM values and sorted by highest expression first.

components.name: Patent details lookup
components.description: Get patent details by publication number, including the abstract, claims, citations, family, and classifications when requested. US full text is retrieved through USPTO Public Search, while EP and WO content uses EPO OPS.

components.name: Patent Search
components.description: Search worldwide patent records using free-text queries and optional assignee, inventor, CPC classification, status, and date-range filters. Results can use USPTO, EPO OPS, USPTO ODP, or Google Patents backends and may include foundational prior art discovered through citation mining.

components.name: PDB
components.description: Accesses the RCSB Protein Data Bank to search macromolecular structures, retrieve PDB entry metadata by identifier, and download structure files in CIF or PDB format.

components.name: SRA record retrieval
components.description: Retrieve full details for an NCBI Sequence Read Archive accession, including SRP studies, SRX experiments, SRR runs, and SRS samples. The accession is normalized and validated before the corresponding SRA record is returned.

components.name: SRA search
components.description: Search NCBI's Sequence Read Archive for sequencing experiments and runs using free-text queries, SRA accessions, or NCBI field syntax. Results include experiment, study, and sample accessions with organism, library strategy, run count, and chaining accessions.

components.name: Trial get
components.description: Get detailed clinical trial information by NCT ID, with optional selection of sections to include.

components.name: Trial search
components.description: Search clinical trials using a condition, intervention, or keyword query, with optional filters for study status, phase, and intervention type. Returns matching clinical trial records.

components.name: Variant get
components.description: Retrieves detailed information for a genomic variant identified by an rsID, HGVS expression, or ClinVar ID. Core variant data including identifier, gene, rsID, and significance is returned, with optional frequency, prediction, and clinical sections.

components.name: Variant OncoKB
components.description: Annotates a variant in a cancer gene using its gene symbol and protein change, returning OncoKB variant annotations.

components.name: Variant search
components.description: Search for genetic variant records using free-text, rsID, HGVS, gene, protein or cDNA changes, significance, consequence, frequency, and CADD score filters. The tool returns matching variant records.

components.name: Variant trials
components.description: Find clinical trials associated with a supplied genetic variant identified by an rsID, HGVS notation, or other variant ID.

components.name: arXiv
components.description: Describes a planned arXiv search workflow for English or mixed-language academic queries in computer science, machine learning, mathematics, and physics. The documented design uses keyword and category filters and Atom results to assemble normalized paper evidence.

components.name: Crossref
components.description: Search the Crossref DOI registry for English scholarly works using academic, DOI-oriented, citation, or journal-article queries. The Crossref works API returns normalized publication metadata including title, authors, venue, year, abstract or synthesized snippet, and DOI URL.

components.name: DBLP bibliography search
components.description: Search the DBLP computer science bibliography for technical papers, conference proceedings, and journal articles using author, venue, year, or general research queries. The DBLP publication API returns normalized bibliographic evidence with titles, authors, venue, year, record type, and available external links; abstr…

components.name: DDGS
components.description: Describes a planned general web-search workflow for English or mixed-language queries using the ddgs package without an API key. The documented design maps DuckDuckGo hits into evidence items with titles, URLs, and truncated snippets.

components.name: Google News
components.description: Search Google News for current events, recent developments, and announcements using an English US RSS feed, producing evidence items with headlines, short summaries, and Google News redirect URLs.

components.name: OpenAlex
components.description: Search OpenAlex's public works API for papers, preprints, chapters, and other scholarly outputs using academic or mixed-language queries. The skill returns normalized evidence with titles, URLs, authors, abstracts, citation counts, and open-access landing pages when available, reconstructing abstracts from OpenAlex's…

components.name: Papers
components.description: Search for academic papers across arXiv, PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv, and Google Scholar using an English or mixed-language research query. The skill produces paper evidence items with non-empty titles and URLs, with results aggregated across sources.

components.name: PubMed
components.description: Search PubMed for biomedical, clinical, pharmaceutical, and life-science literature using a text query, returning article metadata and identifiers such as titles, URLs, DOI, or PubMed ID. Searches use the NCBI E-utilities API.

components.name: SearXNG web search
components.description: Search the broad web, including news and general research queries, through a local SearXNG meta-search instance. The search accepts a text query and returns JSON evidence items containing titles and URLs; it requires the SEARXNG_URL environment setting.

components.name: Sogou Weixin
components.description: Discover Chinese-language WeChat Official Account articles through the public Sogou WeChat search results page. The skill accepts Chinese or mixed-language queries and returns evidence items with non-empty article titles, URLs, and a matching source channel field, using the documented API search method.

components.name: Citation index
components.description: Deduplicate and canonicalize evidence URLs across report sections or subagent outputs, assign stable citation numbers, and merge inline citations into a consistent citation index and numbered reference list.

components.name: Reflective search loop
components.description: Manage an explicit multi-round research loop using visible state for the query, rubrics, outstanding gaps, visited and failed URLs, accumulated evidence, evaluator feedback, and budget. Each round reflects, performs a search or fetch action, integrates results, evaluates failures when enabled, and produces an updated…

components.name: Autosearch router
components.description: Route an autosearch research task to 1–3 relevant skill groups and select 3–8 matching leaf skills for loading. The router uses query intent, keyword hints, domain and scenario tags, and progressive disclosure to avoid loading unrelated skill descriptions.

components.name: Deep research
components.description: Perform multi-source research with citation tracking, evidence persistence, and claim-level verification to produce structured research reports from user research queries.

components.name: Autoresearch
components.description: Improve an existing skill by researching alternative approaches, generating four distinct SKILL.md variations, evaluating them against a weighted rubric, and applying the highest-scoring version. The workflow requires a target skill name and its existing SKILL.md, then produces an updated skill document and a pull req…

components.name: Glim MCP
components.description: Answer a research question using live web and platform data from glim.sh MCP, including web search, page extraction, and sources such as X/Twitter, Reddit, GitHub, Amazon, and YouTube transcripts. Produce a Markdown digest with a concise answer, grouped supporting evidence, source URLs, and a call-count record.

components.name: You.com Web Search
components.description: Search the web for a query or topic using You.com's Search API, with optional real-time web crawling. Produce formatted web and news results containing titles, URLs, snippets, and publication dates.

components.name: AlphaFold Database
components.description: Retrieve AlphaFold DB predicted protein structures and metadata by UniProt ID, saving coordinates as PDB or mmCIF and metadata as JSON. Analyze local metadata or PAE files to produce pLDDT confidence fractions, verdicts, domains, and PAE statistics using VenusFactory tools.

components.name: arXiv
components.description: Search the official arXiv API for preprints using keywords and return JSON paper records including metadata such as titles, abstracts, identifiers, and authors. Given an arXiv identifier, download the paper as a PDF, HTML document, or LaTeX source tarball.

components.name: Biopython
components.description: Use Biopython guidance to parse and analyze biological sequence files, sequence alignments, protein structures, and NCBI Entrez records. The skill covers SeqIO, alignment tools, Bio.PDB, and Entrez parsing, while recommending VenusFactory download tools for fetching large remote datasets before parsing saved files.

components.name: bioRxiv and medRxiv preprints
components.description: Search bioRxiv and medRxiv biology or medicine preprints by keyword or category within a date window, or retrieve a specific preprint by DOI. DOI retrieval returns JSON metadata including version history and optionally an abstract, along with a JATS XML link.

components.name: BRENDA database
components.description: Download BRENDA enzyme data using an EC number, substrate, organism comparison, or pathway specification, including Km and kcat values, reactions, environmental parameters, and enzyme associations. The download-only SOAP tools save JSON or CSV files to disk and require BRENDA credentials.

components.name: ChEMBL database
components.description: Retrieve ChEMBL molecule or drug records by identifier, or search for similarity neighbors and substructure hits from a SMILES string using VenusFactory download tools. Results are saved on disk as JSON or TSV data and may be parsed or further filtered with RDKit.

components.name: Clustal Omega protein multiple sequence alignment
components.description: Align two or more protein sequences from a FASTA file using the EBI Clustal Omega REST service, then save the resulting multiple sequence alignment as a FASTA file.

components.name: FDA / openFDA
components.description: Query openFDA through VenusFactory for drug labels and adverse events, and for broader regulatory records involving devices, foods, recalls, and 510(k) or PMA submissions. Drug lookups use the query_fda tool, while broader categories use FDAQuery through agent_generated_code.

components.name: FoldSeek structural similarity
components.description: Search the PDB for fold-level structural homologs and neighbors from a local PDB structure, optionally masking a specified 1-based inclusive residue region such as a catalytic site or epitope. The FoldSeek submit-poll-download pipeline produces rich JSON results with m8 and FASTA files, with optional retrieval of sele…

components.name: HPA Expression Context
components.description: Retrieve Human Protein Atlas protein summaries, subcellular localization, tissue expression ranks, and optional single-cell or blood expression context for a human gene symbol. VenusFactory download tools produce JSON/TSV-style payloads and can generate a bar chart of top tissue expression.

components.name: InterPro domain annotation
components.description: Retrieve InterPro domain and family metadata, UniProt-linked annotations, and protein or accession lists from a UniProt accession or InterPro entry identifier using VenusFactory download tools. UniProt metadata can also be retrieved to cross-check protein function and GO annotations.

components.name: KEGG Database
components.description: Access KEGG REST data through VenusFactory download tools for database information, gene, pathway, and compound lookups, entry details, cross-links, identifier conversion, and drug–drug interaction queries. components.name: Nature-style scientific writing
components.description: Draft, restructure, or plan Nature-style scientific manuscript sections and full manuscript arguments from author-provided claims, results, figures, notes, or Chinese drafts. components.name: NCBI ClinVar variant query
components.description: Query the NCBI ClinVar archive for human genetic variants using gene, condition, clinical-significance, or other search criteria, and retrieve variant records with clinical significance and review-status information. components.name: NCBI Gene
components.description: Query NCBI Gene using the Datasets API or E-utilities by gene symbol, Gene ID, organism, or batches of symbols, and retrieve gene annotations such as RefSeqs, locations, functions, pathways, phenotypes, and cross-references as JSON. components.name: NCBI Sequence Tools
components.description: Use NCBI E-utilities to retrieve protein or nucleotide FASTA sequences and accession metadata, search NCBI Protein by gene and organism, translate CDS records to protein, and run NCBI-hosted BLAST. components.name: OpenAlex
components.description: Search the OpenAlex scholarly graph by keyword, filters, and sorting, or retrieve a single work, author, source, institution, topic, concept, publisher, or funder by OpenAlex ID. The skill produces JSON records and search result pages containing scholarly metadata such as names, citation counts, publication years, and…

components.name: Protein engineering hypothesis
components.description: Structure a protein-engineering question into an evidence-bounded observation, falsifiable hypothesis, ordered computational tests, predicted outcome, suggested wet-lab falsifier, and risks or confounders. components.name: Protein Property Prediction

components.name: Protein sequence similarity search
components.description: Search for homologous proteins from a raw protein sequence or FASTA file and return a full JSON hit list with alignment statistics and metadata, plus a top-10 Markdown preview. components.name: Protein structure pipeline
components.description: Retrieve AlphaFold or experimental RCSB protein structures from UniProt or PDB identifiers, or predict a structure from an amino-acid sequence with ESMFold. components.name: ProteinMPNN design workflow
components.description: Design or score protein sequences conditioned on a fixed PDB backbone, with optional designed-chain, fixed-chain, fixed-residue, and homomer constraints. components.name: PubMed
components.description: Search PubMed by keyword to return paper records inline, or batch-fetch full abstracts and metadata for a known list of PMIDs as normalized JSON. Batch retrieval uses a single NCBI E-utilities efetch request and includes titles, authors, journals, years, DOIs, and abstracts when available.

components.name: PyMOL structural rendering and superposition
components.description: Use headless PyMOL to render protein structures from PDB files as static PNG images with corresponding PSE session files, using coloring by pLDDT, B-factor, chain, or secondary structure. It can also superpose two PDB structures with cealign, produce a rendered comparison, and report RMSD and aligned-residue metadata.

components.name: RCSB Protein Data Bank
components.description: Search the RCSB Protein Data Bank by text, sequence, structure, or attributes, retrieve metadata for a specified PDB entry, and download experimentally determined biomolecular structure coordinates as PDB, mmCIF, or XML files.

components.name: RDKit cheminformatics
components.description: Use RDKit through VenusFactory bioinformatics scripts or importable Python modules to calculate molecular properties, apply SMARTS or SMILES substructure filters, and search molecular records by fingerprint similarity. components.name: UniProt database
components.description: Search UniProtKB, retrieve protein sequences and metadata, map identifiers across databases, and run SPARQL queries against the UniProt endpoint. components.description: Fine-tune custom protein models in VenusFactory from labeled amino-acid sequence data supplied as CSV or Hugging Face datasets, then run predictions on hold-out or new sequences. components.name: Zero-shot mutation workflow
components.description: Rank candidate protein mutations from a FASTA sequence or PDB structure using VenusFactory sequence or structure-aware protein language models. components.name: Biology Biopython
components.description: Use Biopython to manipulate DNA, RNA, and protein sequences; parse and convert FASTA or GenBank files; query NCBI databases and BLAST; analyze phylogenetic trees; and inspect PDB or mmCIF structures. components.name: Chemistry RDKit

components.name: Literature search
components.description: Design and document systematic literature reviews from a research question using PICO concepts, Boolean search strategies, database selection, predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria, two-pass screening, quality assessment, and data extraction. components.name: Scientific writing
